context.en-US: Soluplus is an amphiphilic graft copolymer used to formulate polymeric micelles that encapsulate poorly soluble drugs. Fenbendazole-loaded Soluplus micelles showed lower total clearance and volume of distribution, supporting improved delivery.
context.zh-TW: Soluplus 是兩親性接枝共聚物，用於配製包封難溶性藥物的聚合物微胞。裝載 fenbendazole 的 Soluplus 微胞表現較低的總清除率與分布體積，支持改善的遞送。

context.en-US: Sphingomyelin is a phosphosphingolipid composed of ceramide linked to phosphocholine and serves as a reservoir for ceramide generation. It is a major structural lipid of the plasma membrane and myelin, and sphingomyelinases convert it back to ceramide.
context.zh-TW: 神經鞘磷脂是由 ceramide 連接磷酸膽鹼組成的磷酸鞘脂，並作為 ceramide 生成的儲庫。它是質膜與髓鞘的主要結構脂質，神經鞘磷脂酶將其轉化回 ceramide。

context.en-US: STAT3 is a transcription factor involved in inflammation and oncogenic signaling, with the JAK/STAT3 pathway targeted in certain cancers. Metformin modulates STAT3 signaling in some contexts, linking this metabolic drug to the inflammatory/STAT3 axis.
context.zh-TW: STAT3 是參與發炎與致癌訊號的轉錄因子，JAK/STAT3 途徑在某些癌症中被靶向。Metformin 在某些情境下調控 STAT3 訊號，將此代謝藥物與發炎/STAT3 軸相連結。

context.en-US: Statins inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, lowering flux through the mevalonate pathway and thereby depleting ubiquinone/CoQ10 — the substrate FSP1 requires to regenerate the membrane radical trap. By starving the FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis, statins can sensitize cells to ferroptosis, an effect that converges with their GPX4-related effects via selenocysteine-tRNA maturation.
context.zh-TW: Statins 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，降低甲羥戊酸路徑的通量，從而耗竭泛醌/CoQ10——這正是 FSP1 重新生成膜自由基陷阱所需的受質。透過饑餓化 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸，statins 可使細胞對鐵死亡增敏，此效應與它們經由硒半胱氨酸-tRNA 成熟對 GPX4 的相關效應交會。

context.en-US: By sustaining peroxiredoxin 3 function, sulfiredoxin preserves mitochondrial ROS buffering and protects against cumulative oxidative stress and apoptosis-inducing damage. It represents a key node linking reversible cysteine oxidation to mitochondrial resilience and longevity.
context.zh-TW: 藉由維持過氧化還原酶 3 的功能，Sulfiredoxin 保留粒線體 ROS 緩衝能力，並保護其免受累積性氧化壓力與誘發凋亡的損傷。它代表連結可逆半胱氨酸氧化與粒線體韌性及長壽的關鍵節點。

context.en-US: Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) is a repair enzyme that reverses the over-oxidation of typical 2-Cys peroxiredoxins such as Peroxiredoxin 3. Its expression is induced by oxidative stress through Nrf2, forming a feed-forward repair loop that reinforces antioxidant defense.
context.zh-TW: 硫氧還蛋白（Sulfiredoxin/SRXN1）是逆轉典型 2-Cys 過氧化還原酶（如 Peroxiredoxin 3）過度氧化的修復酶。其表現由氧化壓力經由 Nrf2 誘導，形成強化抗氧化防禦的前饋修復迴路。

context.en-US: Sulfiredoxin expression is induced by oxidative stress through the transcription factor Nrf2, forming a feed-forward repair loop that reinforces antioxidant defense. This allows the peroxiredoxin system to recover after oxidative bursts rather than being permanently disabled.
context.zh-TW: Sulfiredoxin 的表現由氧化壓力經轉錄因子 Nrf2 誘導，形成強化抗氧化防禦的正回饋修復循環。這使過氧化還原酶系統能在氧化爆發後恢復，而非永久失能。

context.en-US: Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) is an ATP-dependent repair enzyme that reverses the over-oxidation of typical 2-Cys peroxiredoxins, most notably peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) in mitochondria. It reduces the sulfinic acid (Cys-SO2H) state back to the sulfenic/sulfhydryl state, recycling the peroxiredoxin and restoring peroxide-detoxifying capacity. Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) is reversibly inactivated when its peroxidatic cysteine is hyperoxidized to sulfinic acid during oxidative bursts. Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) repairs this hyperoxidation in an ATP-dependent reaction, restoring PRDX3's peroxide-scavenging activity.
context.zh-TW: Sulfiredoxin（SRXN1）是 ATP 依賴的修復酵素，可逆轉典型 2-Cys 過氧化還原酶（尤其是粒線體中的過氧化還原酶 3，PRDX3）的過度氧化。它將亞磺酸（Cys-SO2H）狀態還原回亞磺烯基/硫氫基狀態，回收過氧化還原酶並恢復過氧化物解毒能力。 在氧化爆發期間，過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）的過氧化半胱氨酸被過度氧化為亞磺酸時會可逆地失活。Sulfiredoxin（SRXN1）以 ATP 依賴的反應修復此過度氧化，恢復 PRDX3 的過氧化氫清除活性。

context.en-US: Sulforaphane, found abundantly in broccoli sprouts, is highlighted as a potent activator of NRF2 and an upregulator of Phase II detoxification enzymes. NRF2 is one of the key stress-response pathways activated by the acute ROS pulse that defines mitohormesis, alongside AMPK, PGC-1alpha, and SIRT1. Cruciferous vegetables are therefore recommended in the dietary protocol as polyphenol-rich xenohormetins and NRF2 activators that support the hormetic response.
context.zh-TW: 蘿蔔硫素，在西蘭花芽中大量發現，被強調為NRF2的強效激活劑和II期解毒酶的上調劑。NRF2是定義mitohormesis的急性ROS脈衝激活的關鍵應激反應通路之一，與AMPK、PGC-1α和SIRT1並列。因此，十字花科蔬菜在飲食方案中被推薦為富含多酚的xenohormetins和NRF2激活劑，支持hormetic反應。

context.en-US: A super-enhancer is a large cluster of enhancers with high density of transcription-factor binding and histone-acetyl marks that drives high cell-type-specific transcription. Senescence-activated super-enhancers are enriched in H3K27ac and drive SASP gene expression.
context.zh-TW: 超級增強子是帶有高密度轉錄因子結合與組蛋白乙醯標記的增強子大簇，驅動高度細胞型特異轉錄。衰老活化的超級增強子富集 H3K27ac 並驅動 SASP 基因表現。

context.en-US: The sympathetic nervous system is the fight, flight, or freeze branch of the autonomic nervous system. It releases adrenaline and cortisol to prepare the body for action during events such as a HIIT workout, cold plunge, or fasting. When the SNS is active, it forces the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, thereby lowering HRV. Chronic sympathetic dominance keeps the system stuck in the on position, producing a chronically depressed HRV that signals under-recovery and overtraining rather than adaptation.
context.zh-TW: 交感神經系統是自主神經系統的戰鬥、逃跑或凍結分支。它釋放腎上腺素和皮質醇，使身體在HIIT鍛煉、冷水浸泡或禁食等事件期間準備行動。當SNS活躍時，它迫使心臟跳動更快、更規律，從而降低HRV。慢性交感神經主導地位使系統卡在開啟位置，產生慢性抑鬱的HRV，表示恢復不足和過度訓練而非適應。

context.en-US: System Xc- (SLC7A11/SLC3A2 cystine/glutamate antiporter) imports cystine in exchange for glutamate; intracellular cystine is reduced to cysteine, the rate-limiting precursor for Glutathione synthesis. Its inhibition (e.g., by erastin) depletes GSH and is the classic trigger of GPX4-dependent ferroptosis, defining the upstream node of the parallel GPX4 axis.
context.zh-TW: System Xc-（SLC7A11/SLC3A2 胱氨酸/麩氨酸逆向轉運體）以麩氨酸交換導入胱氨酸；細胞內胱氨酸被還原為半胱氨酸，即 Glutathione 合成的速率限制前驅物。其抑制（例如被 erastin）會耗竭 GSH，是 GPX4 依賴性鐵死亡的典型觸發因子，界定了平行 GPX4 軸的上游節點。

context.en-US: TAK1, a key cytoplasmic kinase in modulation of the SASP, is rapidly phosphorylated upon genotoxic stress and functionally participates in the transition of the acute stress-associated phenotype (ASAP) towards the SASP through dual feedforward mechanisms. Phosphorylation and activation of p38 MAPK occurs downstream of TAK1, followed by engagement of the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway that supports the chronic secretory phenotype. Apigenin does not block ATM or TAK1 phosphorylation but abrogates the sequential molecular events downstream, acting through the HSPA8 hub to dampen p38 MAPK and downstream PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement.
context.zh-TW: TAK1，調節SASP的關鍵細胞質激酶，在基因毒性應激後快速磷酸化，並通過雙重前饋機制功能性參與急性應激相關表型（ASAP）向SASP的轉變。p38 MAPK的磷酸化和激活發生在TAK1下游，隨後是PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路的參與，該通路支持慢性分泌表型。芹菜素不阻斷ATM或TAK1磷酸化，但廢除了下游的順序分子事件，通過HSPA8樞紐作用來抑制p38 MAPK和下游PI3K/Akt/mTOR的參與。

context.en-US: Telomeres protect chromosome ends from being recognized as double-strand breaks, and telomere dysfunction deprotects chromosome ends contributing to genomic instability. Shortened or dysfunctional telomeres drive DNA-damage signaling and instability.
context.zh-TW: 端粒保護染色體末端不被辨識為雙股斷裂，而端粒功能障礙會去保護染色體末端，促成基因體不穩定。縮短或功能障礙的端粒驅動 DNA 損傷訊號與不穩定。

context.en-US: Telomeres cap chromosome ends and shorten with each cell division until they reach a critical length that triggers replicative senescence or apoptosis. Telomere attrition is thus a direct trigger of cellular senescence.
context.zh-TW: 端粒封蓋染色體末端，並隨每次細胞分裂縮短，直到達到觸發複製性衰老或細胞凋亡的關鍵長度。因此端粒磨損是細胞衰老的直接觸發因素。

context.en-US: The acetyltransferase ACAT1 acetylates TFEB at multiple lysine residues with opposing functional outcomes: acetylation at K116 hinders TFEB binding to DNA (PMID 30059277), while acetylation at K91, K103, and K430 promotes nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These site-specific acetylation events modulate TFEB's ability to interact with chromatin and activate transcription of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The K116 acetylation that inhibits DNA binding is reversed by SIRT1 deacetylation, which enhances TFEB transcriptional activity. Together these marks show that acetylation acts as a dynamic post-translational switch controlling TFEB's DNA-binding capacity and thus its gene-regulatory output.
context.zh-TW: 乙醯基轉移酶 ACAT1 在多個賴氨酸殘基上乙醯化 TFEB，產生相反的功能結果：K116 的乙醯化阻礙 TFEB 與 DNA 的結合（PMID 30059277），而 K91、K103 和 K430 的乙醯化則促進核轉位與 DNA 結合。這些位點特異性的乙醯化事件調節 TFEB 與染色質相互作用並啟動溶酶體和自噬基因轉錄的能力。K116 的乙醯化抑制 DNA 結合，此作用可被 SIRT1 去乙醯化逆轉，進而增強 TFEB 的轉錄活性。這些修飾標記表明，乙醯化作為一個動態的翻譯後開關，控制 TFEB 的 DNA 結合能力及其基因調節輸出。

context.en-US: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, resulting in cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor (PMID 28165011). This places TFEB downstream of PI3K/Akt signaling, so growth factor and insulin signals can restrain TFEB's nuclear translocation and thus suppress the lysosomal/autophagic transcriptional program. The S467 site is shared with AMPK, which phosphorylates the same residue to produce the opposite outcome - enhanced transcriptional activity - illustrating how different kinases can converge on a single phosphorylation site to generate context-dependent regulation of TFEB. Akt-mediated cytoplasmic retention keeps TFEB inactive in the cytosol until activating signals relieve the phosphorylation.
context.zh-TW: Akt 在絲氨酸 467 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留（PMID 28165011）。這使 TFEB 位於 PI3K/Akt 信號通路的下游，因此生長因子和胰島素信號可以抑制 TFEB 的核轉位，從而抑制溶酶體/自噬轉錄程序。S467 位點與 AMPK 共享，AMPK 磷酸化同一殘基產生相反結果——增強轉錄活性——說明不同的激酶如何匯聚在同一磷酸化位點上，根據語境產生 TFEB 的差異調節。Akt 介導的胞質保留使 TFEB 在細胞質中保持非活性狀態，直到啟動信號解除其磷酸化。

context.en-US: AMPK phosphorylates TFEB at serines 467, 466, and 469, and these phosphorylation events enhance TFEB's transcriptional activity (PMID 33734022). This is consistent with AMPK's role as an energy-stress sensor that promotes catabolic programs: when cellular energy is low, AMPK activates TFEB to drive lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. The S467 site is notable because Akt phosphorylates the same residue with the opposite effect (cytoplasmic retention), demonstrating that distinct upstream signals can use a single phosphorylation site to either activate or repress TFEB depending on context. AMPK phosphorylation thus couples cellular energy status to the autophagy-lysosome gene expression program.
context.zh-TW: AMPK 在絲氨酸 467、466 和 469 上磷酸化 TFEB，這些磷酸化事件增強 TFEB 的轉錄活性（PMID 33734022）。這與 AMPK 作為能量壓力感知器促進分解代謝程序的角色一致：當細胞能量不足時，AMPK 活化 TFEB 以驅動溶酶體生物發生和自噬。S467 位點值得注意，因為 Akt 磷酸化同一殘基產生相反效應（胞質保留），表明不同的上游信號可以利用單一磷酸化位點根據語境啟動或抑制 TFEB。因此，AMPK 磷酸化將細胞能量狀態與自噬-溶酶體基因表達程序耦合。

context.en-US: Calcineurin dephosphorylates TFEB at S211 and S142, promoting nuclear translocation of the transcription factor (PMID 26043755). This dephosphorylation reverses the cytoplasmic-retention effect imposed by mTORC1 (S211) and ERK2/mTORC1 (S142) phosphorylation, allowing TFEB to enter the nucleus and activate lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes. Calcineurin is a calcium/calmodulin-dependent phosphatase, so this pathway couples calcium signaling to the TFEB-mediated cellular clearance program. It forms the dephosphorylation arm of TFEB regulation alongside PP2A, providing a calcium-sensitive route to activate the autophagy-lysosome pathway under stress conditions.
context.zh-TW: 鈣調磷酸酶在 S211 和 S142 上去磷酸化 TFEB，促進該轉錄因子的核轉位（PMID 26043755）。此去磷酸化逆轉 mTORC1（S211）和 ERK2/mTORC1（S142）磷酸化所施加的胞質保留效應，使 TFEB 能進入細胞核並啟動溶酶體生物發生和自噬基因。鈣調磷酸酶是一種鈣/鈣調蛋白依賴性磷酸酶，因此此通路將鈣信號與 TFEB 介導的細胞清除程序耦合。它與 PP2A 共同構成 TFEB 調節的去磷酸化臂，在壓力條件下提供一條鈣敏感的通路來啟動自噬-溶酶體通路。

context.en-US: TFEB is retained in the cytosol when it is phosphorylated at cytoplasmic-retention sites. Phosphorylation of S211 by mTORC1 or p38 MAPK, of S142 by mTORC1 or ERK2, of S122 by mTORC1, of S467 by Akt, and of S3 by MAP4K3 all promote cytoplasmic retention of TFEB, keeping the transcription factor away from its nuclear target genes. This phosphorylation-dependent cytosolic sequestration is the primary mechanism by which nutrient-rich and growth-factor-rich conditions suppress the lysosomal and autophagic transcriptional program. Dephosphorylation of these sites by calcineurin or PP2A relieves the retention and permits TFEB to translocate to the nucleus.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 在胞質保留位點被磷酸化時被保留在細胞質中。mTORC1 或 p38 MAPK 對 S211 的磷酸化、mTORC1 或 ERK2 對 S142 的磷酸化、mTORC1 對 S122 的磷酸化、Akt 對 S467 的磷酸化，以及 MAP4K3 對 S3 的磷酸化，均促進 TFEB 的胞質保留，使轉錄因子遠離其核靶基因。這種依賴磷酸化的胞質隔離是營養豐富和生長因子豐富條件抑制溶酶體和自噬轉錄程序的主要機制。鈣調磷酸酶或 PP2A 對這些位點的去磷酸化解除保留，允許 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

context.en-US: ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 142, producing cytoplasmic retention and nuclear export of the transcription factor (PMID 21617040, 29992949). Phosphorylation at this site, shared with mTORC1 and CDK4/CDK6, keeps TFEB out of the nucleus and thereby represses its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes. This places TFEB under the control of mitogen/extracellular-signal-regulated kinase (ERK) signaling in addition to nutrient sensing, integrating growth factor cues into the control of lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. Dephosphorylation of S142 by calcineurin reverses this effect and promotes TFEB translocation to the nucleus.
context.zh-TW: ERK2 在絲氨酸 142 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留和核輸出（PMID 21617040、29992949）。此位點的磷酸化與 mTORC1 和 CDK4/CDK6 共享，使 TFEB 保持在細胞核外，從而抑制其溶酶體和自噬基因的轉錄程序。這使 TFEB 除了營養感知外，還受到絲裂原/細胞外信號調節激酶（ERK）信號通路的控制，將生長因子線索整合到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的調節中。鈣調磷酸酶對 S142 的去磷酸化逆轉此效應，促進 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

context.en-US: The acetyltransferase GCN5 acetylates TFEB at lysines K274 and K279, hindering TFEB binding to DNA and thus dampening its transcriptional output (PMID 31750630). Acetylation of these residues reduces TFEB's affinity for its target gene promoters, suppressing the expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. This represents a second acetylation-based regulatory mechanism, complementary to ACAT1-mediated acetylation, by which TFEB's DNA-binding capacity is negatively controlled. Such marks illustrate the breadth of post-translational control over TFEB, where phosphorylation, acetylation, ubiquitination, SUMOylation, and other modifications converge to regulate the master regulator of cellular clearance.
context.zh-TW: 乙醯基轉移酶 GCN5 在賴氨酸 K274 和 K279 上乙醯化 TFEB，阻礙 TFEB 與 DNA 的結合，從而降低其轉錄輸出（PMID 31750630）。這些殘基的乙醯化降低 TFEB 對其靶基因啟動子的親和力，抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表達。這代表第二種基於乙醯化的調節機制，與 ACAT1 介導的乙醯化互補，共同對 TFEB 的 DNA 結合能力進行負向控制。這些修飾標記展示了 TFEB 翻譯後控制的廣度，其中磷酸化、乙醯化、泛素化、SUMO 化及其他修飾共同調節這一細胞清除的主調控因子。

context.en-US: GSK3beta phosphorylates TFEB at serine 138, promoting lysosomal localization and nuclear export (PMID 27617930, 29992949), and at S134 promoting lysosomal localization. Phosphorylation of TFEB by GSK3beta modulates its subcellular distribution, controlling access of the transcription factor to its nuclear targets. The S138 site is particularly notable because it is also subject to O-GlcNAc glucosylation that blocks TFEB nuclear export, illustrating cross-talk between phosphorylation and glycosylation at the same residue. GSK3beta regulation of TFEB links glycogen synthase kinase signaling to the control of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy.
context.zh-TW: GSK3beta 在絲氨酸 138 上磷酸化 TFEB，促進溶酶體定位和核輸出（PMID 27617930、29992949），並在 S134 上磷酸化 TFEB 促進溶酶體定位。GSK3beta 對 TFEB 的磷酸化調節其亞細胞分布，控制轉錄因子對其核靶標的可及性。S138 位點特別值得注意，因為它也受到 O-GlcNAc 糖基化的調節，該糖基化阻斷 TFEB 的核輸出，說明同一殘基上磷酸化和糖基化之間的交談。GSK3beta 對 TFEB 的調節將糖原合酶激酶信號與溶酶體生物發生和自噬的控制聯繫起來。

context.en-US: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at multiple sites with distinct functional consequences: phosphorylation at S211 and S122 causes cytoplasmic retention, at S142 it drives cytoplasmic retention and nuclear export, and at S138 it promotes nuclear export. Phosphorylation of these sites prevents TFEB from translocating to the nucleus, thereby limiting its transcriptional program. This is the canonical nutrient-sensing mechanism by which mTORC1 couples lysosomal and autophagic gene expression to amino acid availability. Dephosphorylation of S211 (by calcineurin) and S122 (by PP2A) releases this brake and allows TFEB nuclear translocation. Cited references include PMID 28055300 and 30120233.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 在多個位點磷酸化 TFEB，產生不同的功能後果：S211 和 S122 的磷酸化導致胞質保留，S142 的磷酸化驅動胞質保留和核輸出，S138 的磷酸化促進核輸出。這些位點的磷酸化阻止 TFEB 轉位至細胞核，從而限制其轉錄程序。這是 mTORC1 將溶酶體和自噬基因表達與胺基酸可用性耦合的典型營養感知機制。S211 的去磷酸化（由鈣調磷酸酶）和 S122 的去磷酸化（由 PP2A）釋放此制動，允許 TFEB 核轉位。引用的參考文獻包括 PMID 28055300 和 30120233。

context.en-US: TFEB translocates to the nucleus in response to dephosphorylation of its cytoplasmic-retention sites. Dephosphorylation of S211 and S142 by calcineurin, and of S122 and S109/S114 by PP2A, promotes nuclear translocation, while phosphorylation of S401 by p38 MAPK also drives the transcription factor into the nucleus. Acetylation at K91/K103/K430 and PARsylation by TNKS1 likewise promote nuclear translocation, and O-GlcNAc glucosylation of S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 promotes nuclear entry while S138 glucosylation blocks nuclear export. Once in the nucleus, TFEB activates transcription of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes, making nuclear localization the key regulatory decision point.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 通過其胞質保留位點的去磷酸化響應而轉位至細胞核。鈣調磷酸酶對 S211 和 S142 的去磷酸化，以及 PP2A 對 S122 和 S109/S114 的去磷酸化，促進核轉位；p38 MAPK 對 S401 的磷酸化也驅動轉錄因子進入細胞核。K91/K103/K430 的乙醯化以及 TNKS1 的 PARylation 同樣促進核轉位，S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 的 O-GlcNAc 糖基化促進核輸入，而 S138 的糖基化則阻斷核輸出。一旦進入細胞核，TFEB 啟動溶酶體生物發生和自噬基因的轉錄，使核定位成為關鍵的調節決定點。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial dysfunction is the failure of mitochondria to maintain homeostasis and produce energy, often driving oxidative stress. It can be mitigated by TFEB-mediated induction of mitophagy and mitochondrial biogenesis.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體功能障礙是粒線體無法維持恆定與產生能量，常驅動氧化壓力。它可由 TFEB 介導的 mitophagy 與粒線體生合成誘導來減輕。

context.en-US: The stress kinase p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB with context-dependent outcomes: phosphorylation at S211 causes cytoplasmic retention (PMID 34930303), while phosphorylation at S401 promotes nuclear translocation (PMID 36507874). The S211 site is the same residue phosphorylated by mTORC1, so p38 MAPK participates in the nutrient-independent control of TFEB localization, and phosphorylation at S401 conversely drives the transcription factor into the nucleus. This places TFEB downstream of cellular stress signaling via p38 MAPK, allowing stressors to modulate the lysosomal/autophagic transcriptional program. The opposing effects at different sites illustrate how site-specific phosphorylation integrates multiple signals into a final TFEB localization decision.
context.zh-TW: 應激激酶 p38 MAPK 磷酸化 TFEB，產生依賴語境的結果：S211 的磷酸化導致胞質保留（PMID 34930303），而 S401 的磷酸化促進核轉位（PMID 36507874）。S211 位點與 mTORC1 磷酸化的殘基相同，因此 p38 MAPK 參與 TFEB 定位的非營養依賴性控制，而 S401 的磷酸化則相反地驅動轉錄因子進入細胞核。這使 TFEB 位於 p38 MAPK 細胞應激信號的下游，允許應激因子調節溶酶體/自噬轉錄程序。不同位點的相反效應說明位點特異性磷酸化如何將多重信號整合為最終的 TFEB 定位決定。

context.en-US: Protein kinase C beta (PKCbeta) phosphorylates TFEB at S466 and the cluster S461/S462 and S468, promoting its stability (PMID 23599343). Phosphorylation at S466 is shared with AMPK, which phosphorylates the same site to enhance transcriptional activity, while PKCbeta-mediated phosphorylation stabilizes the TFEB protein. By stabilizing TFEB, PKCbeta signaling can raise the cellular pool of the transcription factor available for nuclear translocation when other activating signals arrive. This illustrates how post-translational phosphorylation by multiple kinases converges on TFEB to control its abundance, localization, and activity, integrating diverse cellular signaling inputs into the regulation of lysosomal and autophagic gene expression.
context.zh-TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCbeta）在 S466 以及 S461/S462 和 S468 群簇上磷酸化 TFEB，促進其穩定性（PMID 23599343）。S466 的磷酸化與 AMPK 共享，AMPK 磷酸化同一部位以增強轉錄活性，而 PKCbeta 介導的磷酸化穩定 TFEB 蛋白。通過穩定 TFEB，PKCbeta 信號可以增加細胞中可用於核轉位的轉錄因子池，當其他啟動信號到達時。這說明多重激酶的翻譯後磷酸化如何匯聚在 TFEB 上，控制其豐度、定位和活性，將多樣的細胞信號輸入整合到溶酶體和自噬基因表達的調節中。

context.en-US: The protein phosphatase PP2A dephosphorylates TFEB at S122 and at the cluster S109 and S114, promoting translocation of the transcription factor to the nucleus (PMID 29945972). Dephosphorylation of these sites reverses the cytoplasmic-retention effect of mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at S122, releasing TFEB to enter the nucleus and activate lysosomal and autophagic gene transcription. This places protein phosphatase 2A as a counteracting force to nutrient-sensing kinase pathways, helping determine the net phosphorylation state of TFEB and thus its subcellular localization. Together with calcineurin, PP2A provides the dephosphorylation arm of TFEB's regulatory cycle.
context.zh-TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 PP2A 在 S122 以及 S109 和 S114 群簇上去磷酸化 TFEB，促進該轉錄因子轉位至細胞核（PMID 29945972）。這些位點的去磷酸化逆轉 mTORC1 介導的 S122 磷酸化所產生的胞質保留效應，釋放 TFEB 進入細胞核並啟動溶酶體和自噬基因轉錄。這使蛋白磷酸酶 2A 成為營養感知激酶通路的拮抗力量，有助於決定 TFEB 的淨磷酸化狀態及其亞細胞定位。與鈣調磷酸酶一起，PP2A 提供了 TFEB 調節週期的去磷酸化臂。

context.en-US: TFEB binds Rag GTPases as part of the amino acid-sensing machinery at the lysosomal surface, and this interaction is modulated by post-translational modification: oxidation of cysteine 212 inhibits TFEB's binding to Rag GTPases (PMID 31826695). The Rag GTPase complex is central to nutrient sensing, recruiting mTORC1 and its substrate machinery to the lysosome when amino acids are abundant, and TFEB's association with this complex links TFEB localization to nutrient availability. Oxidation at C212, by disrupting this binding, represents a redox-responsive mechanism that influences TFEB's cellular localization and activity, coupling oxidative stress to the regulation of the autophagy-lysosome pathway.
context.zh-TW: TFEB作為溶酶體表面氨基酸感應機制的一部分與Rag GTPases結合，並且這種相互作用受翻譯後修飾調節：半胱氨酸212的氧化抑製TFEB與Rag GTPases的結合（PMID 31826695）。Rag GTPase复合物是營養感應的核心，當氨基酸充足時將mTORC1及其底物機制招募到溶酶體，TFEB與該复合物的關聯將TFEB定位與營養可用性聯繫起來。C212處的氧化通過破壞這種結合，代表了一種氧化還原響應機制，影響TFEB的細胞定位和活性，將氧化應激與自噬-溶酶體途徑的調節聯繫起來。

context.en-US: The deacetylase SIRT1 deacetylates TFEB at lysine 116, and this deacetylation enhances TFEB transcriptional activity (PMID 27209302). SIRT1 reverses the inhibitory acetylation of K116 deposited by ACAT1, which hinders TFEB binding to DNA, thereby restoring TFEB's capacity to activate its target genes for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. This places TFEB under the control of the NAD+-dependent sirtuin SIRT1, linking cellular energy and redox status to the activity of the master transcriptional regulator of cellular clearance. The SIRT1/ACAT1 balance at K116 is a prototypical example of how a single residue integrates opposing enzymatic activities.
context.zh-TW: 去乙醯酶 SIRT1 在賴氨酸 116 上去乙醯化 TFEB，此去乙醯化增強 TFEB 的轉錄活性（PMID 27209302）。SIRT1 逆轉 ACAT1 沉積的 K116 抑制性乙醯化，該乙醯化阻礙 TFEB 與 DNA 的結合，從而恢復 TFEB 啟動其溶酶體生物發生和自噬靶基因的能力。這使 TFEB 受到 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的調節，將細胞能量和氧化還原狀態與這一細胞清除的主轉錄調控因子的活性聯繫起來。K116 處的 SIRT1/ACAT1 平衡是單一殘基整合相反酶活性的典型範例。

context.en-US: The E3 ubiquitin ligase STUB1 ubiquitinates TFEB, and this ubiquitination enhances TFEB activity (PMID 28754656). Rather than simply marking TFEB for degradation, ubiquitination by STUB1 in this case increases the transcription factor's functional output, consistent with the growing appreciation that ubiquitination can serve non-proteolytic regulatory functions. This adds TFEB to the set of proteins whose activity is tuned by ubiquitin conjugation. The finding illustrates the diversity of post-translational modifications - including ubiquitination, PARsylation, and SUMOylation in addition to phosphorylation and acetylation - that regulate TFEB's localization, stability, and transcriptional activity in the control of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy.
context.zh-TW: E3 泛素連接酶 STUB1 泛素化 TFEB，此泛素化增強 TFEB 活性（PMID 28754656）。在此情況下，STUB1 的泛素化並非簡單地將 TFEB 標記為降解，而是增加該轉錄因子的功能輸出，這與日益增強的認識一致——泛素化可以發揮非蛋白水解的調節功能。這將 TFEB 加入活性通過泛素偶聯調節的蛋白質集合。此發現說明了翻譯後修飾的多樣性——包括泛素化、PARylation 和 SUMO 化，以及磷酸化和乙醯化——共同調節 TFEB 的定位、穩定性和轉錄活性，以控制溶酶體生物發生和自噬。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin donates electrons to regenerate oxidized peroxiredoxins, enabling hydrogen peroxide clearance in the cytosol. The thioredoxin-peroxiredoxin cycle is a central route by which the cell disposes of peroxide while coupling to redox signaling.
context.zh-TW: 硫氧還蛋白提供電子以再生成被氧化的過氧化還原酶，從而在細胞質中清除過氧化氫。硫氧還蛋白-過氧化還原酶循環是細胞處置過氧化物並與氧化還原訊息傳遞耦合的中心途徑。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin supplies reducing equivalents to ribonucleotide reductase, providing the electrons needed to regenerate the enzyme between catalytic cycles for de novo dNTP synthesis. This links the thioredoxin redox system directly to DNA replication and repair.
context.zh-TW: 硫氧還蛋白供應還原當量給核醣核苷酸還原酶，提供在催化循環之間再生成酵素以進行 de novo dNTP 合成所需的電子。這將硫氧還蛋白氧化還原系統直接與 DNA 複製及修復連結起來。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin proteins are recycled to their active reduced state by thioredoxin reductase in an NADPH-consuming cycle. Together with the glutathione system, thioredoxin and thioredoxin reductase constitute the bulk of cellular antioxidant capacity.
context.zh-TW: 硫氧還蛋白透過硫氧還蛋白還原酶在耗用 NADPH 的循環中被回收至活化的還原態。與麩胱甘肽系統一起，硫氧還蛋白與硫氧還蛋白還原酶構成了細胞抗氧化能力的主要部分。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD) is frequently up-regulated in tumors, where the thioredoxin system supports redox fitness and resistance to apoptosis and therapy. TXNRD inhibitors such as auranofin, PX-12, and ebselen are under investigation as anticancer agents.
context.zh-TW: 硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD）在腫瘤中常被上調，硫氧還蛋白系統在此支持氧化還原適應力以及對凋亡與治療的抵抗。Auranofin、PX-12 與 ebselen 等 TXNRD 抑制劑正作為抗癌劑進行研究。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD) is a selenoprotein whose catalytic activity depends on a C-terminal selenocysteine (Sec) residue encoded by a recoded UGA codon. This selenium dependence makes TXNRD exquisitely sensitive to electrophilic inhibitors that react with selenols, including auranofin.
context.zh-TW: 硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD）是一種硒蛋白，其催化活性依賴由重編碼 UGA 密碼子編碼的 C 端硒半胱氨酸（Sec）殘基。此硒依賴性使 TXNRD 對能與硒醇反應的親電子抑制劑（包括 auranofin）極為敏感。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD1) is the NADPH-dependent enzyme that recycles oxidized thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) back to its active reduced form in the cytosol. The two form the functional thioredoxin system, sustaining peroxiredoxin regeneration, ribonucleotide reductase, and redox-sensitive signaling.
context.zh-TW: 硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD1）是 NADPH 依賴的酵素，在細胞質中將被氧化的硫氧還蛋白-1 (Trx1) 回收回其活化的還原態。兩者構成功能性硫氧還蛋白系統，維持過氧化還原酶的再生成、核醣核苷酸還原酶以及氧化還原敏感的訊息傳遞。

context.en-US: The mitochondrial isoform of thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD2) recycles oxidized thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) to its active reduced form using NADPH, supporting mitochondrial redox balance and peroxiredoxin 3 regeneration.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體型的硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD2）利用 NADPH 將被氧化的硫氧還蛋白-2 (Trx2) 回收回其活化的還原態，支持粒線體氧化還原平衡與過氧化還原酶 3 的再生成。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) reduces the redox-sensitive protein APE1/Ref-1, maintaining its critical cysteine residues in the reduced state. Reduced Ref-1 in turn activates redox-sensitive transcription factors such as AP-1 and NF-kappaB, coupling the thioredoxin system to transcriptional decisions.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 會還原氧化還原敏感的蛋白質 APE1/Ref-1，使其關鍵的半胱氨酸殘基維持在還原態。被還原的 Ref-1 進而活化 AP-1 和 NF-kappaB 等氧化還原敏感的轉錄因子，將硫氧還蛋白系統與轉錄決策連結起來。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the canonical high-affinity redox-dependent inhibitor of the stress kinase ASK1. In its reduced state Trx1 binds ASK1's N-terminal thioredoxin-binding domain and keeps the kinase inactive, targeting it for degradation; on oxidative stress Trx1 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK/p38 MAPK apoptosis and senescence signaling.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是壓力激酶 ASK1 的典型高親和力、依賴氧化還原狀態的抑制劑。在還原態下，Trx1 結合 ASK1 的 N 端硫氧還蛋白結合域並使激酶保持不活化，並使其被降解；在氧化壓力下，Trx1 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動 JNK/p38 MAPK 的細胞凋亡與衰老訊息傳遞。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) contains the CxxC active-site motif (Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys, residues Cys32-Cys35), which forms the catalytic core of its oxidoreductase activity. The N-terminal Cys32 attacks substrate disulfides while Cys35 resolves the mixed disulfide.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 含有 CxxC 活性位點基序（Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys，殘基 Cys32-Cys35），構成其氧化還原酶活性的催化核心。N 端的 Cys32 攻擊受質雙硫鍵，而 Cys35 則解析混合雙硫鍵。

context.en-US: Systemic overexpression of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is among the few antioxidant interventions that prolong the lifespan of mice, chiefly by improving oxidative-stress resistance and reducing oxidative damage during the earlier portion of life. The benefit is best characterized as a healthspan gain rather than an extension of maximum lifespan, and chronic sustained overexpression can increase tumor burden in old age.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 的全身性過度表現是少數能延長小鼠壽命的抗氧化介入之一，主要透過改善氧化壓力抵抗並降低生命早期階段的氧化損傷。此效益最好被描述為健康壽命（healthspan）的提升，而非最大壽命的延長，且長期持續的過度表現可能在老年時增加腫瘤負擔。

context.en-US: Levels of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) are significantly decreased in cardiomyocytes from individuals with advanced heart failure, along with MnSOD and Bcl-xL. This loss of the protective thioredoxin system is thought to reduce cardiac resistance to pathologic insults in end-stage disease.
context.zh-TW: 在晚期心臟衰竭患者的心肌細胞中，Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 的濃度會顯著下降，MnSOD 與 Bcl-xL 亦然。此保護性硫氧還蛋白系統的喪失被認為會降低末期疾病中心臟對病理傷害的抵抗能力。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) enhances the stability and activity of the transcription factor HIF-1alpha, supporting the cellular hypoxic response. By maintaining HIF-1alpha in its reduced, active state, Trx1 contributes to redox-dependent gene regulation under low-oxygen conditions.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 會增強轉錄因子 HIF-1alpha 的穩定性與活性，支持細胞的低氧反應。藉由維持 HIF-1alpha 的還原且活化狀態，Trx1 有助於低氧條件下的氧化還原依賴性基因調控。

context.en-US: Cardiac-specific overexpression of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) reduces infarct size after ischemia-reperfusion injury and improves survival, preserving contractile reserve, mitochondrial complex activity, and membrane potential. This cardioprotection is lost in middle-aged mice due to nitrative inactivation of Trx1.
context.zh-TW: 心臟特異性的 Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 過度表現可減少缺血再灌流損傷後的心肌梗塞面積並改善存活，維持收縮儲備、粒線體複合物活性與膜電位。此心臟保護作用在中年小鼠中會因 Trx1 的硝化失活而喪失。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) donates reducing equivalents to regenerate methionine sulfoxide reductases, the enzymes that repair oxidized methionine residues in proteins. This makes Trx1 an essential partner in reversing oxidative protein damage.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 提供還原當量以再生成甲硫胺酸亞碸還原酶，這些酵素負責修復蛋白質中被氧化的甲硫胺酸殘基。這使 Trx1 成為逆轉氧化性蛋白質損傷的關鍵夥伴。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) maintains the kinase mTOR in its reduced, active state by protecting the oxidation-sensitive Cys1483 residue. Loss of Trx1 oxidizes mTOR, impairs substrate phosphorylation (S6K, 4EBP1), and suppresses nuclear-encoded mitochondrial gene expression and respiration, linking redox state to anabolic and mitochondrial signaling.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 透過保護對氧化敏感的 Cys1483 殘基，使激酶 mTOR 維持在還原且活化的狀態。失去 Trx1 會使 mTOR 氧化、損害受質磷酸化（S6K、4EBP1），並抑制核基因編碼的粒線體基因表現與呼吸作用，將氧化還原狀態與合成代謝及粒線體訊息傳遞連結起來。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) modulates the DNA-binding activity of the p50 subunit of the transcription factor NF-kappaB, influencing inflammatory gene expression in a context-dependent pro- or anti-inflammatory manner. This couples the cellular redox state to inflammatory and survival signaling.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 會調節轉錄因子 NF-kappaB 之 p50 次單元的 DNA 結合活性，以情境依賴的方式影響發炎基因表現，可為促發炎或抗發炎。這將細胞的氧化還原狀態與發炎及存活訊息傳遞連結起來。

context.en-US: Cytosolic thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) donates electrons to regenerate oxidized peroxiredoxins (Prx1/2 and the family generally) after they reduce hydrogen peroxide, sustaining cytosolic peroxide clearance. Trx1 is itself recycled by thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD1) using NADPH. This is the cytosolic mirror of the mitochondrial Trx2/Prx3 arm and involves the same peroxiredoxin family that consumes SOD-generated H2O2, tying Trx1 into the SOD-peroxide-thioredoxin relay in the cytoplasm.
context.zh-TW: 細胞質 thioredoxin-1（Trx1）捐贈電子以再生氧化態的 peroxiredoxins（一般指 Prx1/2 及該家族），使它們在還原過氧化氫後恢復活性，從而維持細胞質的過氧化物清除。Trx1 本身再由 thioredoxin reductase（TXNRD1）以 NADPH 回收。這是粒線體 Trx2/Prx3 分支的細胞質鏡像，涉及同一消耗 SOD 所產生 H2O2 的 peroxiredoxin 家族，因此將 Trx1 納入細胞質中的 SOD-過氧化物-thioredoxin 接力。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the dominant physiological electron donor that regenerates ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) between catalytic cycles, re-reducing the enzyme's active-site disulfide. Through this link the thioredoxin system directly fuels de novo dNTP synthesis for DNA replication and repair.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是再生成核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）的主要生理電子供體，在每個催化循環之間重新還原酵素的活性中心雙硫鍵。透過此連結，硫氧還蛋白系統直接供應 DNA 複製與修復所需的 de novo dNTP 合成。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the cytosolic isoform of the thioredoxin family, most often the entity meant when thioredoxin is discussed in aging and cardioprotection contexts. Together with the mitochondrial Thioredoxin-2 it comprises the two principal mammalian isoforms.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是硫氧還蛋白家族中位於細胞質的異構型，在老化與心臟保護的討論中最常被指涉。它與粒線體的 Thioredoxin-2 共同構成哺乳類的兩個主要異構型。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) specifically antagonizes the mitochondria-located pool of the stress kinase ASK1. In basal conditions Trx2 keeps mitochondrial ASK1 inactive; on oxidative or mitochondrial stress Trx2 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK-independent mitochondrial apoptotic signaling.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 專門拮抗壓力激酶 ASK1 位於粒線體的部分。在基礎條件下，Trx2 使粒線體 ASK1 保持不活化；在氧化或粒線體壓力下，Trx2 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動不依賴 JNK 的粒線體凋亡訊息傳遞。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) supports oxidative phosphorylation by maintaining the reduced, active state of respiratory chain components and matrix enzymes, supporting complex activity and membrane potential under stress. Its redox defects impair respiration and elevate mitochondrial ROS.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 透過維持呼吸鏈組成與基質酵素的還原且活化狀態來支持氧化磷酸化，在壓力下維持複合物活性與膜電位。其氧化還原缺陷會損害呼吸作用並提高粒線體 ROS。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) donates electrons to reduce the oxidized (disulfide) form of peroxiredoxin 3 (Prx3), restoring its peroxide-scavenging activity. Trx2 is itself recycled to the reduced form by mitochondrial thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD2) using NADPH. Because Prx3 consumes the H2O2 generated by MnSOD, the Trx2/Prx3 arm is the water-evolving half of the mitochondrial peroxide-relay and a direct functional partner of MnSOD in the matrix. Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) donates electrons to sustain the mitochondrial peroxide-removal cycle, and its H2O2 disposal partner peroxiredoxin 3 consumes the hydrogen peroxide produced by superoxide dismutase. Together they form the matrix peroxide-relay SOD2 to H2O to H2O.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體 thioredoxin-2（Trx2）捐贈電子以還原 peroxiredoxin 3（Prx3）的氧化態（雙硫）形式，恢復其過氧化物清除活性。Trx2 本身再由粒線體 thioredoxin reductase（TXNRD2）以 NADPH 回收為還原形式。由於 Prx3 消耗 MnSOD 所產生的 H2O2，Trx2/Prx3 分支是粒線體過氧化物接力中產生水的半段，也是 MnSOD 在基質中的直接功能夥伴。 Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 提供電子以維持粒線體過氧化氫清除循環，其 H2O2 清除夥伴過氧化還原酶 3 消耗超氧化物歧化酶所產生的過氧化氫。兩者共同構成基質過氧化物接力 SOD2 → H2O2 → H2O。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite oxidizes and inactivates Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) along with mitochondrial permeability transition pore components. This oxidation contributes to mitochondrial swelling and apoptosis, linking nitrative stress to mitochondrial dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: 過氧亞硝酸鹽會與粒線體通透性轉換孔組成一起氧化並使 Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 失活。此氧化作用會促成粒線體腫脹與細胞凋亡，將硝化壓力與粒線體功能障礙連結起來。

context.en-US: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) is the mitochondrial isoform of the thioredoxin family, maintaining mitochondrial thiol-redox balance and regenerating peroxiredoxin 3. It is the organellar counterpart to the cytosolic Thioredoxin-1.
context.zh-TW: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 是硫氧還蛋白家族中位於粒線體的異構型，維持粒線體硫醇氧化還原平衡並再生成過氧化還原酶 3。它是細胞質 Thioredoxin-1 的胞器對應物。

context.en-US: The mitochondrial isoform of thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD2) recycles oxidized Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) back to its active reduced form using NADPH, in a membrane-associated system that also regenerates peroxiredoxin 3. TXNRD2 is thus essential for sustaining the mitochondrial thioredoxin redox cycle.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體型的硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD2）利用 NADPH 將被氧化的 Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 回收回其活化的還原態，此膜相關系統同時也會再生成過氧化還原酶 3。因此 TXNRD2 對維持粒線體硫氧還蛋白氧化還原循環至關重要。

context.en-US: Thrombocytopenia is a reduction in circulating platelets and one of the hematological cytopenias linked to chronic mTOR inhibitor use. Mild, reversible thrombocytopenia is among the most common hematological side effects of chronic high-dose rapamycin.
context.zh-TW: 血小板減少症是循環血小板減少，是與慢性 mTOR 抑制劑使用相關的血液細胞減少症之一。輕度可逆的血小板減少是慢性高劑量 rapamycin 最常見的血液學副作用之一。

context.en-US: Thymic epithelial cells produce a number of colony stimulating factors and hematopoietic cytokines, including IL-1, IL-3, IL-6, IL-7, TGF-β, oncostatin M, and leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF). Intrathymic and systemic production of these cytokines and growth factors regulates the complex process of thymopoiesis and is responsible for stromal cross-talk within the thymic microenvironment. IL-7 in particular is a crucial cytokine for thymocyte survival and T cell development, making the thymic cytokine milieu a candidate target for therapies aimed at reversing age-induced thymic involution. Loss of TEC-derived IL-7 production with age contributes to declining thymic output.
context.zh-TW: 胸腺上皮細胞產生多種集落刺激因子和造血細胞因子，包括 IL-1、IL-3、IL-6、IL-7、TGF-β、oncostatin M 和白血病抑制因子（LIF）。胸腺內和全身性的這些細胞因子和生長因子的產生調節胸腺生成的複雜過程，並負責胸腺微環境內的基質交談。IL-7 尤其是胸腺細胞存活和 T 細胞發育的關鍵細胞因子，使胸腺細胞因子環境成為旨在逆轉年齡相關胸腺退化的治療候選靶點。隨著年齡增長，TEC 來源的 IL-7 產生減少導致胸腺輸出下降。

context.en-US: Thymic epithelial cells (TECs) in the cortex and medulla form a complex network that supports T cell differentiation, providing the essential microenvironment for productive thymopoiesis. The thymus consists of cells of stromal and hematopoietic origin, including TECs, mesenchymal cells (fibroblasts), endothelial cells and dendritic cells. Differentiating thymocytes migrate from the cortico-medullary junction through the cortex and back to the medulla, encountering functionally distinct microenvironments that regulate positive and negative selection.
context.zh-TW: 皮質和髓質中的胸腺上皮細胞（TECs）形成一個複雜的網絡，支持 T 細胞分化，為 productive thymopoiesis 提供必要的微環境。胸腺由基質和造血來源的細胞組成，包括 TECs、間充質細胞（成纖維細胞）、內皮細胞和樹突狀細胞。分化中的胸腺細胞從皮髓交界處遷移穿過皮質再回到髓質，遇到功能不同的微環境，調節陽性和陰性選擇。

context.en-US: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
context.zh-TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

context.en-US: Thymopoiesis is the process by which T cell development, maturation and induction of self-tolerance occur in the thymic epithelial space. Lymphoid progenitors enter the thymus at the cortico-medullary junction, migrate to the outer cortex for early development and TCR gene rearrangement and positive selection, then return to the medulla for negative selection before export to the periphery. Reduction of functional thymopoiesis with aging results in loss of TCR gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery.
context.zh-TW: 胸腺生成是 T 細胞發育、成熟和自身耐受誘導在胸腺上皮空間中發生的過程。淋巴祖細胞在皮髓交界處進入胸腺，遷移至外皮質進行早期發育和 TCR 基因重排及陽性選擇，然後返回髓質進行陰性選擇，最後輸出至外周。隨著年齡增長，功能性胸腺生成的減弱導致 TCR 基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。

context.en-US: The thymus exhibits profound age-associated involution, a striking paradoxical feature of this critical lymphoid tissue. Thymic function begins to decrease from the first year of life; the lymphoid component of the thymic epithelial space involutes roughly 3% per year through middle age (35-45 years) and about 1% per year thereafter, while the perivascular space expands with adipocytes and peripheral lymphocytes. By age 70, the TES falls below 10% of total thymus tissue. Although thymic decline is of minimal consequence to healthy individuals, the reduced efficacy of the aging immune system has direct etiological links with opportunistic infections, autoimmunity, and cancer burden.
context.zh-TW: 胸腺表現出顯著的年齡相關退化，這是這一關鍵淋巴組織的一個突出矛盾特徵。胸腺功能從生命第一年開始下降；胸腺上皮空間的淋巴成分以每年約 3% 的速度退化至中年（35-45 歲），此後每年約 1%，而血管周圍空間隨脂肪細胞和外周淋巴細胞擴增。到 70 歲時，TES 降至總胸腺組織的 10% 以下。儘管胸腺衰退對健康個體影響極小，但老化免疫系統效力降低與機會性感染、自身免疫和癌症負擔有直接的病因學聯繫。

context.en-US: The thymus is a vital organ for homeostatic maintenance of the peripheral immune system. Within its two compartments, the true thymic epithelial space (TES, comprising cortex and medulla) and the perivascular space (PVS), T cells develop, mature, and undergo induction of self-tolerance in a process called thymopoiesis. The cortex hosts early thymocyte development including T cell receptor gene rearrangement and positive selection, while the medulla carries out negative selection to remove autoreactive T cells. The perivascular space, composed of adipocytes, peripheral lymphocytes and stroma, is a non-thymopoietic component.
context.zh-TW: 胸腺是外周免疫系統穩態維持的重要器官。在其兩個隔室——真正的胸腺上皮空間（TES，包含皮質和髓質）和血管周圍空間（PVS）——中，T 細胞發育、成熟並經歷稱為胸腺生成的自身耐受誘導過程。皮質主持早期胸腺細胞發育，包括 T 細胞受體基因重排和陽性選擇，而髓質執行陰性選擇以清除自身反應性 T 細胞。血管周圍空間由脂肪細胞、外周淋巴細胞和基質組成，是非胸腺生成的成分。

context.en-US: TMG (trimethylglycine/betaine) is a methyl donor that, via betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase, converts homocysteine to methionine. By supporting remethylation it helps maintain a high SAM:SAH ratio, reducing SAH accumulation and preserving methylation capacity.
context.zh-TW: TMG（三甲基甘氨酸/betaine）是甲基供體，經由甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶將同型半胱氨酸轉化為甲硫氨酸。透過支持再甲基化，它有助於維持高 SAM:SAH 比例，減少 SAH 累積並保存甲基化能力。

context.en-US: TNF signaling is the pathway activated by TNF family cytokines through TNFR1/2, converging on NF-kB, MAPK, and apoptosis pathways. Apigenin downregulates TNF signaling and NF-kB signaling to suppress the SASP in senescent cells.
context.zh-TW: TNF 訊號是 TNF 家族細胞激素經由 TNFR1/2 活化的途徑，匯聚於 NF-κB、MAPK 與細胞凋亡途徑。Apigenin 下調 TNF 訊號與 NF-κB 訊號以壓制衰老細胞中的 SASP。

subject: Toluidine Blue O

context.en-US: Toluidine blue O (TB), the 3,7-dimethyl analog of methylene blue, is the most potent of the tested phenothiazine derivatives, with EC50s of 1.75 nM for viability, 0.11 nM for ROS reduction, and 1.54 nM for preserving mitochondrial membrane potential in the HT-22 glutamate assay. Like MB, TB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction in the complex I-III assay with NADH as electron donor, enhanced cellular oxygen consumption, and decreased lactate production, sharing MB's alternative electron-transfer-carrier function but with greater potency.
context.zh-TW: 甲苯胺藍 O（TB）是甲烯藍的 3,7-二甲基類似物，是已測試的吩噻嗪衍生物中最有效的，在 HT-22 谷氨酸測定中，其 EC50 分別為 viability 1.75 nM、ROS 減少 0.11 nM、保護線粒體膜電位 1.54 nM。與 MB 一樣，TB 在以 NADH 為電子供體的 complex I-III 測定中顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，增強了細胞氧消耗，降低了乳酸產生，共享 MB 的替代電子轉載體功能但效力更強。

source_document: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md

context.en-US: A topologically associating domain (TAD) is a contiguous genomic region within which DNA sequences contact one another more frequently than with outside sequences. TADs are fundamental units of chromosome folding that constrain enhancer-promoter communication and looping.
context.zh-TW: 拓撲關聯結構域（TAD）是其中 DNA 序列彼此接觸頻率高於與外部序列的連續基因體區域。TAD 是約束增強子-啟動子溝通與環化的染色體摺疊基本單位。

context.en-US: TADs constrain enhancer-promoter communication, and super-enhancers reside within TADs where they loop to target promoters. In senescence, TAD-scale rewiring reshapes enhancer-promoter looping to drive SASP expression.
context.zh-TW: TAD 約束增強子-啟動子溝通，超級增強子位於 TAD 內並環化至目標啟動子。在衰老中，TAD 尺度重組重塑增強子-啟動子環化以驅動 SASP 表現。

context.en-US: Transcriptomic aging describes the progressive remodeling of the transcriptome with age, reflecting dysregulated inflammatory and stress-response pathways. Slower transcriptomic aging implies dampened expression of inflammaging-associated gene programs.
context.zh-TW: 轉錄組老化描述轉錄組隨年齡的進行性重塑，反映失調的發炎與壓力反應途徑。較慢的轉錄組老化意味著發炎老化相關基因程式的表現被削弱。

context.en-US: Triapine has been evaluated in 35+ clinical trials across solid tumors and leukemias, most frequently as a chemosensitizer or radiosensitizer. It remains an investigational drug never FDA-approved, with dose-limiting myelosuppression and methemoglobinemia.
context.zh-TW: Triapine 已在 35 個以上的臨床試驗中於實體腫瘤與白血病中進行評估，最常作為化療或放療增敏劑。它仍是從未獲 FDA 核准的研究性藥物，具有劑量限制性的骨髓抑制與變性血紅素血症。

context.en-US: By inactivating ribonucleotide reductase, Triapine collapses cellular dNTP pools, causing replicative DNA replication stress and death of proliferating cells. It also synergizes with ionizing radiation and genotoxic agents by impairing DNA-repair capacity.
context.zh-TW: 藉由使核醣核苷酸還原酶失活，Triapine 使細胞 dNTP 池崩潰，造成複製性 DNA 複製壓力與增殖細胞死亡。它也透過損害 DNA 修復能力與游離輻射及基因毒性藥物產生協同作用。

context.en-US: Triapine (3-AP) is a potent tridentate iron (Fe2+/Fe3+) and copper chelator. It chelates the iron atoms of the binuclear center in the RRM2/RRM2B small subunit of ribonucleotide reductase, destabilizing and quenching the tyrosyl-radical cofactor.
context.zh-TW: Triapine（3-AP）是強效的三齒鐵（Fe2+/Fe3+）與銅螯合劑。它螯合核醣核苷酸還原酶 RRM2/RRM2B 小次單元雙核中心的鐵原子，使酪胺醯自由基輔因子不穩定並淬滅之。

context.en-US: Triapine (3-AP) is an investigational alpha-N-heterocyclic thiosemicarbazone iron chelator that inhibits ribonucleotide reductase by chelating the iron of the RRM2/RRM2B small subunits. This strips the tyrosyl-radical cofactor, inactivating RNR and collapsing de novo dNTP synthesis.
context.zh-TW: Triapine（3-AP）是研究性的 alpha-N-雜環硫代半卡巴腙鐵螯合劑，透過螯合 RRM2/RRM2B 小次單元的鐵來抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶。這剝離酪胺醯自由基輔因子，使 RNR 失活並使 de novo dNTP 合成崩潰。

context.en-US: Troponin is a heterotrimeric complex regulating striated muscle contraction, and cardiac troponin I and T are highly cardiac-specific gold-standard biomarkers of myocardial injury. Troponin release from the heart signals myocardial damage.
context.zh-TW: 肌鈣蛋白（troponin）是調控橫紋肌收縮的異三聚體複合體，而心肌肌鈣蛋白 I 與 T 是高度心臟特異的心肌損傷金標準生物標記。心臟釋放的肌鈣蛋白指示心肌損傷。

context.en-US: alpha/beta-tubulin heterodimers polymerize into microtubules, the dynamic polymers of the mitotic spindle and cytoskeleton.
context.zh-TW: α/β-微管蛋白異二聚體聚合成微管，即有絲分裂紡錘體和細胞骨架的動態聚合物。

context.en-US: Tubulin is the target of microtubule-interfering agents including benzimidazoles, taxanes and vinca alkaloids.
context.zh-TW: 微管蛋白是微管干擾藥物的靶標，包括苯並咪唑、紫杉烷和長春花生物鹼。

context.en-US: Tubulin polymerization into the mitotic spindle is essential for chromosome segregation; its disruption triggers G2/M arrest.
context.zh-TW: 微管蛋白聚合成有絲分裂紡錘體對染色體分離至關重要；其破壞觸發 G2/M 阻滯。

context.en-US: Tumor antigens are the molecular signatures by which the immune system distinguishes malignant cells, presented on MHC to cytotoxic T cells. Loss or down-regulation of antigen/MHC is a key route to immune evasion.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤抗原是免疫系統用以區分惡性細胞的分子特徵，在 MHC 上呈遞給細胞毒性 T 細胞。抗原/MHC 的喪失或下調是免疫逃逸的關鍵途徑。

context.en-US: TXNDC5 is an ER-localized thioredoxin-family chaperone that synergizes with HSPA8 (HSC70) to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts via NF-kB signaling. Because HSPA8 is the bridge node apigenin disrupts, TXNDC5-HSPA8 cooperativity is relevant to SASP suppression.
context.zh-TW: TXNDC5 是 ER 定位的硫氧還蛋白家族伴護蛋白，與 HSPA8（HSC70）協同，經由 NF-κB 訊號加劇滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。由於 HSPA8 是 apigenin 破壞的橋接節點，TXNDC5-HSPA8 協同與 SASP 壓制相關。

context.en-US: Ubiquinone/CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Because FSP1 depends on this ubiquinone supply, interventions that suppress mevalonate flux toward cholesterol (statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) deplete the CoQ10 pool and converge on FSP1, predicting ferroptosis sensitivity.
context.zh-TW: 泛醌/CoQ10 是甲羥戊酸路徑的非固醇產物。由於 FSP1 依賴此泛醌供應，抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的介入（statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會耗竭 CoQ10 池並在 FSP1 處交會，預示鐵死亡敏感性。

context.en-US: UBN1 is an essential, dedicated subunit of the HIRA histone chaperone complex, with an N-terminal domain that binds HIRA. Together with HIRA and ASF1a, it mediates replication-independent deposition of H3.3.
context.zh-TW: UBN1 是 HIRA 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體的必需專屬亞基，其 N 端結構域結合 HIRA。它與 HIRA 及 ASF1a 一起介導 H3.3 的非複製依賴沉積。

context.en-US: UBN1 is a dedicated subunit of the HIRA complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). It confers specificity to the HIRA complex for H3.3 deposition during senescence.
context.zh-TW: UBN1 是 HIRA 複合體的專屬亞基，為形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需。它賦予 HIRA 複合體在衰老期間沉積 H3.3 的特異性。

context.en-US: Uncoupling protein 3 (UCP3) is expressed primarily in skeletal muscle and is a candidate mediator of the proton leak that contributes to resting metabolic rate and exercise-related energy expenditure. Speakman cites evidence that UCP3 mRNA is elevated after exercise and that its expression, together with UCP2, may account for a fraction of the exercise-induced rise in metabolic rate. The functional importance of UCP3 in mediating proton leak remains debated, because knockout studies in mice do not show gross changes in resting metabolic rate, but its induction by training and by lipids keeps it a focus for understanding inter-individual differences in energy expenditure.
context.zh-TW: 解偶聯蛋白 3（UCP3）主要在骨骼肌中表達，是貢獻於靜息代謝率和運動相關能量消耗的質子洩漏的候選介導因子。Speakman 引用了 UCP3 mRNA 在運動後升高的證據，以及其表達與 UCP2 一起可能解釋運動誘導代謝率上升的一部分。UCP3 在介導質子洩漏中的功能重要性仍有爭議，因為小鼠基因敲除研究未顯示靜息代謝率的顯著變化，但其被訓練和脂質誘導的特性使其成為理解個體間能量消耗差異的焦點。

context.en-US: The mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) is a form of retrograde signaling that communicates mitochondrial proteotoxic stress to the nucleus. Activation of the UPRmt has been linked to lifespan extension, making it a central mitohormetic stress-response pathway.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）是將粒線體蛋白毒性壓力傳達至細胞核的逆行訊號形式。UPRmt 的活化與壽命延長相關，使其成為核心的毒物興奮（mitohormetic）壓力反應途徑。

context.en-US: Urolithin A, a gut-microbiome metabolite of ellagitannins, is associated with antioxidant responses that involve phase II enzymes including glutathione S-transferases. GST activity contributes to the detoxification and redox-buffering program engaged by such polyphenol metabolites.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 是鞣花單寧的腸道微生物代謝物，與涉及包括穀胱甘肽 S-轉移酶在內之第二相酶的抗氧化反應相關。GST 活性有助於此類多酚代謝物啟動的解毒與氧化還原緩衝程式。

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A is a mitophagy-enhancing intervention that selectively removes damaged mitochondria, improving muscle health in aged models. It represents one of the leading mitochondria-targeted anti-aging strategies, alongside NAD+ repletion (nicotinamide riboside, NMN), mitochondrial biogenesis activation (AMPK activators, PGC-1α pathway), mitochondrial transplantation (nMITO bioengineered mitochondria), mtDNA editing (mitoTALENs, mitoZFNs), and scalable mitochondrial transfer platforms. Urolithin A is a potent inducer of mitophagy, the clean-up process that recycles old, damaged mitochondria so new ones can take their place, and is described as a core mitohormetic mechanism. It is recommended to be taken with the first fat-containing meal of the day, as co-ingesting with healthy fats such as eggs, avocado, or yogurt can enhance its absorption. By supporting mitochondrial recycling, Urolithin A complements the energy production and renewal pathways targeted by the overall mitohormesis protocol. Rzeski 2026 adds the molecular anchor: PINK1 stabilization on depolarized mitochondria with Parkin-mediated ubiquitination, extending C. elegans median lifespan 45.4% via dct-1/bec-1-dependent mitophagy (Ryu 2016).
context.zh-TW: 尿石素 A 是一種增強線粒體自噬的干預措施，選擇性地清除受損線粒體，改善老化模型中的肌肉健康。它代表了領先的線粒體靶向抗衰老策略之一，與 NAD+ 補充（菸鹼胺核苷、NMN）、線粒體生物發生啟動（AMPK 啟動劑、PGC-1α 通路）、線粒體移植（nMITO 生物工程線粒體）、mtDNA 編輯（mitoTALENs、mitoZFNs）和可擴展的線粒體轉移平台並列。 尿石素 A 是一種有效的線粒體自噬誘導劑，該清理過程回收老舊受損的線粒體以便新線粒體取而代之，被描述為核心的 mitohormetic 機制。建議在一天中第一頓含脂肪的餐食中服用，因為與健康脂肪（如雞蛋、酪梨或優格）一起攝入可以增強其吸收。通過支持線粒體回收，尿石素 A 補充了整體 mitohormesis 方案所靶向的能量產生和更新通路。Rzeski 2026 補充分子機制：PINK1 穩定化與 Parkin 泛素化，線蟲中位壽命延長 45.4%（Ryu 2016）。
