The infective embryonated eggs are ingested, larvae hatch in the small intestine and migrate through the portal circulation, liver, heart and lungs before being swallowed back into the intestine, where they mature into 15-30 cm adults; the prepatent period is roughly 60-75 days.
context.zh-TW: Ascaris 是大型寄生圓蟲的一屬，其主要人體寄生物種 Ascaris lumbricoides 會引起 Ascariasis（蛔蟲病）。感染途徑為攝入帶胚胎的蟲卵，幼蟲在小腸孵化後穿過腸壁，經門脈循環、肝臟、心臟與肺臟移行，再被咳吞回小腸成熟為 15–30 公分的成蟲；潛伏期（感染至產卵）約為 60–75 天。

context.en-US: Albendazole is the WHO-recommended first-line therapy for Ascariasis, given as a single 400 mg dose with cure rates above 90%. As a benzimidazole it binds nematode beta-tubulin, inhibiting microtubule polymerization and glucose uptake, which immobilizes and kills the parasite; annual or biannual mass administration of Albendazole or Mebendazole is the backbone of control in endemic regions.
context.zh-TW: Albendazole 是 World Health Organization 建議的 Ascariasis（蛔蟲病）第一線治療，單次劑量 400 mg，治癒率超過 90%。作為 benzimidazole（苯並咪唑）類藥物，它結合線蟲的 β-tubulin，抑制微管聚合與葡萄糖攝取，使寄生蟲癱瘓並死亡；在流行區，Albendazole 或 Mebendazole 每年或每半年一次的大規模投藥是防治的骨幹。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is an effective alternative anthelmintic against Ascaris infection at 150-200 micrograms/kg, though it is less active against immature stages. Albendazole 400 mg single dose remains first-line, with Mebendazole and pyrantel pamoate as further alternatives, while mass drug administration programmes integrated with soil-transmitted helminth control remain the cornerstone of public health control.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 以 150–200 微克／公斤的劑量對 Ascaris（蛔蟲）感染有效，但對未成熟期蟲體活性較低。Albendazole 400 mg 單次劑量仍為第一線，Mebendazole 與 pyrantel pamoate 為其他替代選項；與土壤傳播蠕蟲防治整合的大規模投藥計畫則是公共衛生防治的骨幹。

context.en-US: BAY 87-2243 is a ubiquinone-binding site (Q-site) dependent inhibitor of mitochondrial Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase), originally developed as a HIF-1 pathway inhibitor. It blocks electron transfer from NADH to ubiquinone, producing an increased NADH:NAD+ ratio, NAD+ and ATP depletion, AMPK activation and collapse of the TCA cycle in glutamine-dependent cells.
context.zh-TW: BAY 87-2243 是粒線體 Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone 氧化還原酶）的泛醌結合位點（Q-site）依賴型抑制劑，最初作為 HIF-1 途徑抑制劑開發。它阻斷 NADH 將電子傳遞給泛醌，造成 NADH:NAD+ 比值上升、NAD+ 與 ATP 耗竭、AMPK 活化，並使依賴麩醯胺酸的細胞 TCA cycle 崩潰。

context.en-US: Downstream of its Complex I inhibition, BAY 87-2243 induces prominent AMPK activation, which serves as the readout of energetic stress. In MYC-high triple-negative breast cancer cells this prominent AMPK activation is consistent with Complex I inhibition as the compound's primary mechanism, and the resulting NAD+ depletion generates reductive stress.
context.zh-TW: BAY 87-2243 在抑制 Complex I 之後會誘導明顯的 AMPK 活化，此可視為能量壓力的讀值。在 MYC 高表現的三陰性乳癌細胞中，這種明顯的 AMPK 活化與 Complex I 抑制作為其主要機轉一致，而由此造成的 NAD+ 耗竭則產生還原性壓力。

context.en-US: BAY 87-2243 and Mubritinib share an aromatic ring chain topology with the clinically tested IACS-10759, a molecular scaffold critical for Q-site Complex I inhibition. In a screen of 526 oncology compounds, both compounds showed the highest MYC selectivity across triple-negative breast cancer cell lines, and molecular docking confirmed high Q-site binding affinity.
context.zh-TW: BAY 87-2243 與 Mubritinib 與臨床測試中的 IACS-10759 共享芳香環鏈拓撲，此分子骨架對 Q-site 的 Complex I 抑制至關重要。在 526 種腫瘤藥物的篩選中，兩者對三陰性乳癌細胞株展現最高的 MYC 選擇性，分子對接亦確認其對 Q-site 有高度親和力。

context.en-US: BH3 profiling reports dependence on specific anti-apoptotic proteins, with the Noxa BH3 peptide selectively binding Mcl-1 so that a strong Noxa response identifies Mcl-1 dependence. That dependency readout is used to select candidates for Mcl-1 inhibitors such as AMG 176 and S63845, and high Mcl-1 expression is a major mechanism of venetoclax resistance that this assay can detect.
context.zh-TW: BH3 profiling 會讀出細胞對特定抗凋亡蛋白的依賴性，其中 Noxa BH3 胜肽選擇性結合 Mcl-1，因此 Noxa 訊號強烈反應即判定為 Mcl-1 依賴。此依賴性讀值用於篩選 AMG 176、S63845 等 Mcl-1 抑制劑的候選腫瘤，而 Mcl-1 高表現也是 venetoclax 抗藥性的主要機轉，可由此檢測偵測。

context.en-US: BH3 profiling predicts responsiveness to BH3-mimetic drugs: for Navitoclax (ABT-263), a Bcl-xL/Bcl-2 inhibitor, the assay identifies tumors with Bcl-xL or Bcl-2 dependence that are likely to respond, while its clinical use is limited by on-target thrombocytopenia caused by platelet dependence on Bcl-xL. Dynamic profiling extends this by measuring priming changes after treatment.
context.zh-TW: BH3 profiling 可預測對 BH3 類似物的反應：對 Navitoclax（ABT-263）這個 Bcl-xL／Bcl-2 抑制劑，該檢測可辨識具 Bcl-xL 或 Bcl-2 依賴性、可能產生反應的腫瘤，但其臨床使用受血小板對 Bcl-xL 依賴所造成的標的性血小板減少限制。動態型 profiling 則進一步量測治療後 priming 的變化。

context.en-US: BH3 profiling measures how close a cancer cell is to the threshold of committing to Apoptosis via MOMP by gently permeabilizing cells and exposing them to BH3 peptides that selectively displace pro-apoptotic effectors from anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members. The resulting Bax/Bak oligomerization, MOMP and cytochrome c release are read out as loss of mitochondrial membrane potential (Delta psi m) with dyes such as JC-1 or TMRE.
context.zh-TW: BH3 profiling 藉由輕柔通透化細胞並施加 BH3 胜肽（選擇性地將促凋亡效應分子自抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族蛋白上置換下來），量測癌細胞距離經由 MOMP 進入 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）門檻有多近。所造成的 Bax／Bak 寡聚化、MOMP 與 cytochrome c（細胞色素 c）釋放，則以 JC-1 或 TMRE 等電位敏感情料偵測的粒線體膜電位（ΔΨm）喪失作為讀值。

context.en-US: Bmi-1 is essential for the self-renewal and maintenance of Cancer Stem Cells, a stemness function that helps explain its oncogenic role: as a core Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 component it silences genes, and its overexpression in breast cancer, lung cancer and leukemia is well documented. Targeting Bmi-1 is therefore a route to deplete the stem-cell compartment.
context.zh-TW: Bmi-1 對 Cancer Stem Cells（癌幹細胞）的自我更新與維持至關重要，此幹性功能有助解釋其致癌角色：作為 Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 的核心成分，它負責沉默基因，而它在乳癌、肺癌與白血病中的過度表現已有充分記錄。因此標定 Bmi-1 是清除幹細胞群的一条途徑。

context.en-US: Bmi-1 expression confers resistance to Doxorubicin: silencing Bmi-1 in breast cancer cells downregulates pAkt and the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-2, rendering the cells more sensitive to Doxorubicin with an increase in apoptotic cells in vitro. Bmi-1 therefore promotes survival by downregulating pro-apoptotic genes and maintaining Akt signalling.
context.zh-TW: Bmi-1 的表現賦予對 Doxorubicin 的抗藥性：在乳癌細胞中沉默 Bmi-1 會下调 pAkt 與抗凋亡蛋白 Bcl-2，使細胞對 Doxorubicin 更加敏感，體外實驗可見凋亡細胞增加。因此 Bmi-1 藉由下调促凋亡基因並維持 Akt 訊號來促進細胞存活。

context.en-US: Bmi-1 upregulates the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-2 (along with phosphorylated Akt): silencing Bmi-1 in breast cancer cells reduces both pAkt and Bcl-2 expression, while Bmi-1 overexpression in breast cancer, lung cancer and leukemia promotes survival by downregulating pro-apoptotic genes. This couples Bmi-1 to evasion of Apoptosis in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Bmi-1 會上调抗凋亡蛋白 Bcl-2（以及磷酸化 Akt）：在乳癌細胞中沉默 Bmi-1 會同時降低 pAkt 與 Bcl-2 的表現；而 Bmi-1 在乳癌、肺癌與白血病中的過度表現，則藉由下调促凋亡基因促進存活。這使 Bmi-1 與腫瘤的 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）逃脫相連結。

context.en-US: Brugia malayi is a filarial nematode and one of the three causative agents of Lymphatic Filariasis, alongside Wuchereria bancrofti and Brugia timori. Adult worms reside in lymphatic vessels and lymph nodes, viviparous females release sheathed microfilariae with nocturnal periodicity into the bloodstream, and chronic infection produces lymphangitis, lymphedema, elephantiasis and tropical pulmonary eosinophilia.
context.zh-TW: Brugia malayi 是絲蟲類線蟲，與 Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia timori 並列為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病）三大致病原之一。成蟲寄生於淋巴管與淋巴結，胎生的雌蟲釋出具鞘微絲蟲並呈夜間週期性出現在血流中；慢性感染會造成淋巴管炎、淋巴水腫、象皮病與熱帶肺嗜酸性粒細胞症。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is a macrocyclic lactone used in mass drug administration against Brugia malayi, where annual single-dose combinations with Albendazole (in onchocerciasis co-endemic areas) or Diethylcarbamazine interrupt transmission by killing microfilariae. Diethylcarbamazine remains the cornerstone drug because it kills both microfilariae and adult worms.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是巨環內酯類藥物，用於對 Brugia malayi 的大規模投藥：在與蟲尾絲蟲病共同流行區與 Albendazole 合併、或與 Diethylcarbamazine 合併的每年單次劑量可藉殺滅微絲蟲阻斷傳播。Diethylcarbamazine 仍是核心藥物，因為它能同時殺死微絲蟲與成蟲。

context.en-US: Brugia timori is a filarial nematode, one of the three principal causative agents of Lymphatic Filariasis, geographically restricted to the Lesser Sunda Islands of eastern Indonesia. Adult worms reside in lymphatic vessels releasing microfilariae into the blood, and chronic infection causes lymphangiitis, hydrocele and elephantiasis; like other filariae it depends on Wolbachia endosymbionts for development.
context.zh-TW: Brugia timori 是絲蟲類線蟲，與 Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia malayi 並列為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病）三大主要致病原之一，地理分布侷限於印尼東部的小巽他群島。成蟲寄生於淋巴管並將微絲蟲釋放至血液，慢性感染造成淋巴管炎、陰囊積液與象皮病；與其他絲蟲一樣，其發育仰賴 Wolbachia 內共生菌。

context.en-US: Albendazole, a Benzimidazole anthelmintic, disrupts Tubulin and microtubule assembly and also perturbs the Warburg Effect, with documented antitumor activity. This microtubule disruption is the basis of its antiparasitic action and the reason it is being pursued for anticancer repurposing alongside compounds such as Ivermectin.
context.zh-TW: Albendazole 是 Benzimidazole（苯並咪唑）類驅蟲藥，會破壞 Tubulin（微管蛋白）與微管組裝，並擾亂 Warburg Effect（瓦氏效應），具有文獻記載的抗腫瘤活性。此微管破壞作用既是其抗寄生蟲機轉的基礎，也是它與 Ivermectin 等藥物同被推動進行抗癌重新定位的原因。

context.en-US: CKII phosphorylates and thereby stabilizes the anti-apoptotic protein Mcl-1, one of more than 300 CKII substrates spanning transcription factors, tumour suppressors such as p53 and PTEN, cell-cycle regulators and apoptotic proteins. Stabilized Mcl-1 buffers the apoptotic threshold, letting CKII drive proliferation while disabling cell-death checkpoints.
context.zh-TW: CKII 磷酸化並因此穩定抗凋亡蛋白 Mcl-1；Mcl-1 只是 CKII 三百多個受質之一，另有轉錄因子、p53 與 PTEN 等腫瘤抑制基因、細胞週期調節因子及凋亡相關蛋白。穩定化的 Mcl-1 緩衝了凋亡門檻，使 CKII 得以一方面驅動增殖、另一方面關閉細胞死亡檢查點。

context.en-US: CKII inhibits the pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein Bid, and also restrains the initiator Caspase-2. Because CKII is tonically active, constitutively overexpressed in human cancer and supports PI3K-AKT and WNT signalling, its phosphorylation of apoptotic regulators contributes directly to Hallmarks of Cancer such as sustained proliferative signalling and resistance to therapy-induced death.
context.zh-TW: CKII 抑制促凋亡的 BH3-only 蛋白 Bid，並也抑制起始型 Caspase-2。由於 CKII 持續活化、在人類癌症中組成性過度表現且支援 PI3K–AKT 與 WNT 訊號，它對凋亡調節分子的磷酸化直接貢獻於 Hallmarks of Cancer（癌症特徵），如持續的增殖訊號與對治療誘發死亡的抗性。

context.en-US: CKII inhibits the initiator Caspase-2, lowering the threshold for both intrinsic and extrinsic Apoptosis; accordingly ATP-competitive CKII inhibitors such as silmitasertib (CX-4945) are being evaluated with Chemotherapy or BH3 mimetics to reawaken apoptotic pathways and as sensitizers for TRAIL receptor agonists and DNA-damaging agents.
context.zh-TW: CKII 抑制起始型 Caspase-2，因而降低內在與外在 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）的門檻；相應地，silmitasertib（CX-4945）等 ATP 競爭性 CKII 抑制劑正與 Chemotherapy（化學治療）或 BH3 類似物合併評估，以重新啟動凋亡途徑，並作為 TRAIL 受體促效劑與 DNA 損傷藥物的增敏劑。

context.en-US: The CDK1-CYCLIN B1 complex phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308, a site that blocks caspase-2 maturation and thereby couples mitotic entry to apoptotic restraint: actively dividing cells keep Caspase-2 off, while loss of CYCLIN B1 at mitotic exit or under genotoxic arrest relieves the inhibition and permits Caspase-2-driven death.
context.zh-TW: CDK1–CYCLIN B1 複合體在 Ser308 位點磷酸化 Caspase-2，該位點可阻斷 caspase-2 的成熟，因而把進入有絲分裂與凋亡抑制相偶聯：正在分裂的細胞使 Caspase-2 保持關閉，而在有絲分裂退出或基因毒性停滯時 CYCLIN B1 流失會解除此抑制，允許 Caspase-2 驅動的死亡發生。

context.en-US: CYCLIN B1 is the activating regulatory partner of CDK1, forming the maturation-promoting factor (MPF) that governs the G2/M transition. As the activating partner it enables CDK1 to phosphorylate the substrates that execute mitosis, while CYCLIN B1 abundance peaks at mitosis and is degraded by APC/C after metaphase to allow mitotic exit; its level serves as a proliferation and prognostic biomarker in cancer.
context.zh-TW: CYCLIN B1 是 CDK1 的活化型調節夥伴，兩者形成成熟促進因子（MPF）以掌控 G2/M 轉換。作為活化夥伴，它使 CDK1 能磷酸化執行有絲分裂的受質；而 CYCLIN B1 的含量在有絲分裂時達峰，於中期後由 APC/C 降解以允許退出有絲分裂，其濃度在癌症中可作為增殖與預後的生物標記。

context.en-US: CYCLIN B1 inhibits Apoptosis during mitosis through its kinase activity on Caspase-2, and in Cancer it is frequently overexpressed or dysregulated, sustaining CDK1 activity, chromosomal instability and resistance to death. High CYCLIN B1 correlates with advanced stage, high grade and poor prognosis in breast, lung and cervical carcinomas, and tumors can co-opt this anti-apoptotic phosphorylation to survive therapeutic stress.
context.zh-TW: CYCLIN B1 透過對 Caspase-2 的激酶活性在有絲分裂期間抑制 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）；在 Cancer（癌症）中它常被過度表現或失調，維持 CDK1 活性、染色體不穩定性與死亡抗性。CYCLIN B1 高表現與乳癌、肺癌與子宮頸癌的晚期、高分級及不良預後相關，腫瘤可藉此抗凋亡磷酸化存活於治療壓力之下。

context.en-US: CYP2C19 is a hepatic monooxygenase of the Cytochrome P450 superfamily that metabolizes at least 10% of clinical medicines, including the benzimidazole anthelmintics Albendazole and Fenbendazole. Because these benzimidazoles are of interest for repurposed anticancer activity, CYP2C19 metabolizer status -- extensive, poor (*2, *3) or ultrarapid (*17) -- affects their intratumoral exposure and toxicity.
context.zh-TW: CYP2C19 是 Cytochrome P450（細胞色素 P450）超家族的肝臟單加氧酶，代謝至少 10% 的臨床用藥，包括苯並咪唑類驅蟲藥 Albendazole 與 Fenbendazole。由於這些苯並咪唑類藥物具有抗癌重新定位的興趣，CYP2C19 的代謝者型態（廣泛型、代謝不良型 *2／*3、超快速型 *17）會影響其腫瘤內暴露量與毒性。

context.en-US: CYP2C19 metabolizes the benzimidazole anthelmintic Fenbendazole, in addition to proton-pump inhibitors, anti-epileptics and the antiplatelet prodrug clopidogrel. The prominent polymorphism of CYP2C19 makes it a flagship pharmacogenomic enzyme: poor metabolizers show elevated substrate levels and toxicity, ultrarapid metabolizers are under-treated, and CPIC recommends genotyping to guide dosing.
context.zh-TW: 除了質子幫浦抑制劑、抗癲癇藥與抗血小板前驅藥 clopidogrel 之外，CYP2C19 也代謝苯並咪唑類驅蟲藥 Fenbendazole。CYP2C19 顯著的基因多型性使它成為藥物基因組學的代表性酵素：代謝不良者對受質的暴露與毒性升高，超快速代謝者則劑量不足，CPIC 建議以基因分型來指導給藥。

context.en-US: CYP2C19 is a member of the Cytochrome P450 superfamily: a membrane-bound hemoprotein in the endoplasmic reticulum that uses NADPH and molecular oxygen to insert an oxygen atom into substrates via a high-valent iron-oxo species, favouring lipophilic, weakly basic drugs. It contributes both to detoxification and to the activation of prodrugs.
context.zh-TW: CYP2C19 是 Cytochrome P450（細胞色素 P450）超家族的成員：為位於內質網的膜結合血基質蛋白，利用 NADPH 與分子氧經由高價鐵—氧中間物將氧原子插入受質，偏好親脂性、弱鹼性藥物。它同時參與解毒與前驅藥的活化。

context.en-US: CYP2J2 epoxidizes Arachidonic acid at carbons 8, 9, 11 and 14 to form the corresponding epoxyeicosatrienoic acids (8,9-, 11,12-, 14,15-EET). These EETs activate soluble epoxide hydrolase-regulated signalling that promotes vasodilation, inhibits Inflammation, modulates ion channels and endothelial function, and in cancer models has been reported to suppress proliferation and limit Oxidative Stress.
context.zh-TW: CYP2J2 將 Arachidonic acid（花生四烯酸）在第 8、9、11、14 號碳位環氧化，形成相應的 epoxyeicosatrienoic acids（EET，環氧二十碳三烯酸）。這些 EET 活化可溶性環氧乙烷水解酶調節的訊號，促進血管擴張、抑制 Inflammation（發炎）、調節離子通道與內皮功能；在癌症模型中據報可抑制增殖並限制 Oxidative Stress（氧化壓力）。

context.en-US: CYP2J2 metabolizes the benzimidazole anthelmintics Albendazole and Fenbendazole, sharing these substrates with CYP2C19, and additionally hydroxylates endogenous eicosanoids and xenobiotics. Because CYP2J2 is ectopically expressed in many malignancies, its activity is a metabolic route affecting intratumoral drug exposure and interactions with Chemotherapy.
context.zh-TW: CYP2J2 代謝苯並咪唑類驅蟲藥 Albendazole 與 Fenbendazole，與 CYP2C19 共用這些受質，並額外羥化內源性類二十碳四烯酸與外來化合物。由於 CYP2J2 在多種惡性腫瘤中異位表現，其活性是影響腫瘤內藥物暴露與 Chemotherapy（化學治療）交互作用的代謝途徑。

context.en-US: CYP2J2-derived epoxyeicosatrienoic acids inhibit Inflammation: CYP2J2/EET signalling protects the cardiovascular system and dampens inflammatory injury, and soluble epoxide hydrolase inhibitors that stabilize EETs are explored for cardioprotection and potentially anticancer adjuvant effects. Its tumor-selective expression makes CYP2J2 both a putative suppressor axis and a handle for tumor-targeted approaches.
context.zh-TW: CYP2J2 產生的 epoxyeicosatrienoic acids（EET）會抑制 Inflammation（發炎）：CYP2J2／EET 訊號保護心血管系統並緩解發炎傷害，而可穩定 EET 的可溶性環氧乙烷水解酶抑制劑正被探索用於心臟保護與可能的抗癌輔助效果。CYP2J2 在腫瘤中的選擇性表現，使它既是潛在的抑制腫瘤軸，也是腫瘤標靶介入的著力點。

context.en-US: Following mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP), often mediated by Bax and Bak, Cytochrome c is released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytoplasm, where it binds Apaf-1 and pro-Caspase-9 in the presence of dATP/ATP. This nucleates Apoptosome assembly, which activates the initiator Caspase-9 in the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 在粒線體外膜通透化（MOMP）之後（常由 Bax 與 Bak 介導），Cytochrome c（細胞色素 c）由粒線體膜間腔釋放至細胞質，並在 dATP／ATP 存在下結合 Apaf-1 與 pro-Caspase-9，啟動 Apoptosome（凋亡小體）的組裝，進而活化起始型 Caspase-9，完成 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）內在途徑的啟動。

context.en-US: Cytochrome c activates the initiator Caspase-9 indirectly: it is a crucial component of the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis, and once released into the cytoplasm it joins Apaf-1 and pro-Caspase-9 in the Apoptosome to trigger Caspase-9 activation and the downstream caspase cascade. While its primary physiological role is in the mitochondrial electron transport chain, this apoptotic role makes it a key readout of MOMP.
context.zh-TW: Cytochrome c 間接活化起始型 Caspase-9：它是 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）內在途徑的關鍵成分，一旦釋放至細胞質，即與 Apaf-1 及 pro-Caspase-9 在 Apoptosome（凋亡小體）中結合，觸發 Caspase-9 活化與下游 caspase 级聯。雖然其主要生理角色在於粒線體電子傳遞鏈，此凋亡角色使它成為 MOMP 的關鍵讀值。

context.en-US: Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns include cytosolic chromatin fragments and mitochondrial DNA, which act as DAMPs that activate cGAS-STING signalling. In senescent cells this cGAS activation drives STING-dependent expression of the SASP, and HMGB1 release from senescent cells further amplifies the inflammatory signalling, linking senescence to Inflammation.
context.zh-TW: DAMP（損傷相關分子模式）包含細胞質中的染色質碎片與粒線體 DNA，它們作為 DAMPs 活化 cGAS-STING 訊號。在衰老細胞中，此 cGAS 活化驅動 SASP（衰老相關分泌表型）的 STING 依賴性表現，而衰老細胞釋放 HMGB1 進一步放大發炎訊號，將衰老與 Inflammation（發炎）相連結。

context.en-US: HMGB1 is a key Damage-Associated Molecular Pattern: a nuclear protein released during necrosis and by senescent cells that binds TLR4 and RAGE. Its release is amplified in the SASP programme of senescent cells, where HMGB1 release further amplifies inflammatory signalling alongside cytosolic DNA-driven cGAS-STING activation.
context.zh-TW: HMGB1 是關鍵的 DAMP（損傷相關分子模式）：它是壞死時與衰老細胞釋出的核蛋白，可結合 TLR4 與 RAGE。其釋放在衰老細胞的 SASP（衰老相關分泌表型）程式中被放大，與細胞質 DNA 驅動的 cGAS-STING 活化一同進一步放大發炎訊號。

context.en-US: DAMPs such as uric acid and extracellular ATP activate the Inflammasome: uric acid released from damaged cells activates the NLRP3 inflammasome, while ATP activates P2X7 purinergic receptors. This is the microbial-independent counterpart to PAMP signalling, and its chronic versus acute release determines whether the outcome in Cancer is pro-tumorigenic Inflammation or immunogenic cell death and antitumor immunity.
context.zh-TW: DAMP 如尿酸與細胞外 ATP 可活化 Inflammasome（發炎小體）：受損細胞釋放的尿酸活化 NLRP3 發炎小體，ATP 則活化 P2X7 嘌呤能受體。這是與 PAMP 訊號相對應、不依賴微生物的途徑；在 Cancer（癌症）中，其慢性或急性釋放決定結果是促腫瘤的 Inflammation（發炎）還是免疫原性細胞死亡與抗腫瘤免疫。

context.en-US: Diethylcarbamazine (DEC) is a piperazine-derived synthetic antifilarial whose primary approved indication is Lymphatic Filariasis, where it is typically given as annual single-dose mass treatment with Ivermectin or Albendazole. DEC rapidly kills both microfilariae and adult worms, potentiating eosinophil- and macrophage-mediated killing while altering parasite membrane permeability and motility.
context.zh-TW: Diethylcarbamazine（DEC）是哌嗪衍生的合成抗絲蟲藥，主要核准適應症為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病），通常與 Ivermectin 或 Albendazole 一起以每年單次劑量進行大規模投藥。DEC 能迅速殺死微絲蟲與成蟲，並藉增強嗜酸性球與巨噬細胞介導的殺傷、改变寄生蟲膜通透性與運動性而作用。

context.en-US: Diethylcarbamazine reduces Inflammation by inhibiting cyclooxygenase and lipoxygenase pathways, lowering pro-inflammatory eicosanoids, and by modulating innate immunity to dampen eosinophil-driven inflammation. This is mechanistically relevant to oncology because chronic Inflammation and Arachidonic acid metabolite signalling foster tumour initiation, angiogenesis and Metastasis.
context.zh-TW: Diethylcarbamazine 藉由抑制環氧化酶與脂氧化酶途徑、降低促發炎類二十碳四烯酸，並透過調節先天免疫以抑制嗜酸性球驅動的發炎反應，來降低 Inflammation（發炎）。這在腫瘤學上具機轉相關性，因為慢性發炎與 Arachidonic acid（花生四烯酸）代謝物訊號會促進腫瘤起始、血管新生與 Metastasis（轉移）。

context.en-US: Preclinical studies indicate Diethylcarbamazine inhibits Metastasis by suppressing tumour-associated lymphangiogenesis and lymphatic spread, interfering with VEGF-C/VEGF signalling and macrophage recruitment and thereby limiting spread to lymph nodes. Its immunomodulatory effects may additionally enhance antitumor immunity, though the clinical anticancer evidence remains early and hypothesis-generating.
context.zh-TW: 臨床前研究顯示，Diethylcarbamazine 藉由抑制腫瘤相關淋巴管新生與淋巴播散、干涉 VEGF-C／VEGF 訊號與巨噬細胞募集，因而抑制向淋巴結的 Metastasis（轉移）。其免疫調節作用亦可能增強抗腫瘤免疫，但抗癌的臨床證據仍屬早期階段、多屬假說-generating。

context.en-US: Doramectin is a semi-synthetic Avermectin, the 25-cyclohexyl derivative of avermectin B1, retaining the 16-membered macrocyclic lactone with an oleandrose disaccharide. The cyclohexyl substituent increases lipophilicity relative to Ivermectin, slowing clearance and prolonging tissue persistence, which is exploited for single-injection parasite control in cattle and swine.
context.zh-TW: Doramectin 是半合成 Avermectin（阿維菌素），為 avermectin B1 的 25-環己基衍生物，保留含油葡萄糖雙糖的 16 員巨環內酯骨架。相較 Ivermectin，環己基取代基提高脂溶性、減慢清除並延長組織滯留，此特性被用於牛與豬的單次注射寄生蟲防治。

context.en-US: Doramectin is a P-glycoprotein (P-gp/ABCB1) substrate, and mammalian CNS selectivity of avermectins depends on P-gp efflux at the intact blood-brain barrier. Dogs carrying the ABCB1-1delta (MDR1) deletion, such as collies, Australian shepherds and Shelties, are therefore at risk of neurotoxicity (mydriasis, ataxia, tremors, coma) even at modest doses, and its long persistence makes this especially hazardous.
context.zh-TW: Doramectin 是 P 醣蛋白（P-gp／ABCB1）的受質，而 avermectin 類對哺乳類中樞神經的選擇性仰賴 P-gp 在完整血腦障壁的排出。因此帶有 ABCB1-1Δ（MDR1）缺失的犬隻（如牧羊犬、澳洲牧羊犬與雪特犬）即使在中等劑量下也有神經毒性風險（瞳孔放大、共濟失調、顫抖、昏迷），而其長效滯留使此風險格外危險。

context.en-US: Doramectin shares its mechanism and endectocide spectrum with Ivermectin: like ivermectin it agonizes invertebrate glutamate- and GABA-gated chloride channels to produce sustained Cl- influx and parasite paralysis, but its cyclohexyl group extends the elimination half-life to days in cattle, enabling long-acting single-dose control. Unlike Ivermectin it is a livestock-only label, making Milbemycin Oxime or Selamectin preferable in MDR1-affected dogs.
context.zh-TW: Doramectin 與 Ivermectin 共享其機轉與內外寄生蟲兼殺範圍：與 ivermectin 相同，它激动無脊椎動物的麩胺酸與 GABA 門控氯離子通道以產生持續 Cl⁻ 內流並使寄生蟲麻痺，但其環己基使牛體內排除半衰期延長至數日，可實現長效單次劑量控制。與 Ivermectin 不同的是它僅標示為家畜用藥，因此在 MDR1 異常犬隻中應優先選用 Milbemycin Oxime 或 Selamectin。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole was cytotoxic to EMT6 mammary tumor cells in vitro at high concentrations (1-3 micromolar with 24-h incubations), with modest preferential toxicity under severe hypoxia, and additive toxicity with Docetaxel. Crucially, in vivo fenbendazole (50 mg/kg/day intraperitoneal or 150 ppm diet) did not alter EMT6 tumor growth, radiation response or metastatic pattern in BALB/cRw mice, making EMT6 a documented negative in vivo model.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 在體外以高濃度（1–3 μM、孵育 24 小時）對 EMT6 乳房腫瘤細胞具細胞毒性，在嚴重缺氧下有輕微的選擇性毒性，並與 Docetaxel 產生加成毒性。關鍵的是，體內給予 fenbendazole（50 mg/kg/日腹腔注射或 150 ppm 飲食）並未改變 BALB/cRw 小鼠的 EMT6 腫瘤生長、放射反應或轉移模式，使 EMT6 成為有文獻記載的體內陰性模型。

context.en-US: EMT6 serves as a model for Radiation Therapy research: it is a cloned BALB/c-derived mouse mammary tumor cell line used as monolayer cultures in vitro and as intradermal solid tumors in BALB/cRw mice in vivo, and it has been extensively characterized for radiation responses. In that model fenbendazole failed to sensitize tumors to radiation, altering neither tumor growth, radiation response nor metastatic pattern, which is why EMT6 is cited as a negative-result model in fenbendazole reviews.
context.zh-TW: EMT6 是 Radiation Therapy（放射治療）研究的模型：它是源自 BALB/c 小鼠的乳癌細胞株，體外以單層培養、體內以 BALB/cRw 小鼠皮內實體腫瘤兩種形式使用，並已被廣泛用於放射反應的表徵。在該模型中 fenbendazole 未能使腫瘤對輻射增敏，既未改變腫瘤生長、放射反應，也未改變轉移模式，因此 EMT6 在 fenbendazole 的文獻回顧中被引用為陰性結果模型。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole sulfone is a downstream oxidized metabolite of Fenbendazole, formed by presystemic and systemic metabolism; it predominates in plasma after administration. It is essentially the inactive end product of the pathway, since the sulfoxide Oxfendazole, not the sulfone, is the primary metabolite responsible for Fenbendazole's anthelmintic and putative anticancer activity.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole sulfone 是 Fenbendazole 的下游氧化代謝物，由預系統性與系統性代謝產生，並在給藥後於血漿中占優勢。它基本上是該代謝途徑的惰性終產物，因為負責 Fenbendazole 驅蟲與潛在抗癌活性的主要代謝物是硫氧化物 Oxfendazole，而非硫酮。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole is converted mainly by Flavin-containing Monooxygenase and CYP3A4 to the sulfoxide Oxfendazole, and to hydroxyfenbendazole by CYP2J2/CYP2C19; further oxidation yields fenbendazole sulfone. Oxfendazole is the primary metabolite responsible for Fenbendazole's biological activity, distinguishing the active species from the sulfone that predominates in plasma.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 主要經 Flavin-containing Monooxygenase（FMO）與 CYP3A4 轉換為硫氧化物 Oxfendazole，並經 CYP2J2／CYP2C19 轉為 hydroxyfenbendazole；再進一步氧化則生成 fenbendazole sulfone。Oxfendazole 才是負責 Fenbendazole 生物活性的主要代謝物，此點可區分活性物種與在血漿中占優勢的硫酮。

context.en-US: Fibrinogen binds Integrins: its Aalpha chain carries an RGD peptide motif and its gamma chain a C-terminal KQAGDV sequence, both integrin-binding sites. The exposed RGD motif engages alphaIIb beta3 on platelets as well as alpha v beta3 and alpha5 beta1, transducing outside-in signals that promote platelet aggregation, cell adhesion and migration, and it also binds Fibronectin, vitronectin and growth factors to organize the provisional ECM.
context.zh-TW: Fibrinogen（纖維蛋白原）可結合 Integrins（整合素）：其 Aα 鏈帶有 RGD peptide（胜肽）基序，γ 鏈則露出 C 端 KQAGDV 序列，兩者皆為整合素結合位點。暴露的 RGD 基序會結合血小板的 αIIbβ3 以及 αvβ3、α5β1，傳遞由外向內的訊號以促進血小板聚集、細胞黏附與遷移；它亦結合 Fibronectin（纖維連結蛋白）、vitronectin 與生長因子以組織暫時性細胞外基質。

context.en-US: Fibrinogen contains an RGD peptide motif on its Aalpha chain (with a C-terminal KQAGDV sequence on gamma) that serves as the integrin-binding site; upon vascular injury thrombin cleaves fibrinopeptides A and B, exposing these polymerization and adhesion sites so that fibrin monomers assemble into a branching clot network and engage alphaIIb beta3, alpha v beta3 and alpha5 beta1.
context.zh-TW: Fibrinogen 的 Aα 鏈上含有 RGD peptide（胜肽）基序（γ 鏈另有 C 端 KQAGDV 序列）作為整合素結合位點；血管受損時凝血酶切除纖維蛋白肽 A 與 B，使這些聚合與黏附位點暴露，讓纖維蛋白單體組裝成分支狀血塊網絡，並與 αIIbβ3、αvβ3 及 α5β1 結合。

context.en-US: Fibrinogen supports Metastasis by bridging coagulation and malignancy: tumors exploit the fibrin-rich ECM so that circulating tumour cells hitchhike on platelet-fibrin clots to evade immunity and colonize distant sites. Elevated plasma fibrinogen is a negative prognostic marker in Breast Cancer, Colorectal Cancer and Lung Cancer, and anticoagulants plus alphaIIb beta3 integrin antagonists are being investigated to curb tumour dissemination.
context.zh-TW: Fibrinogen（纖維蛋白原）藉由連結凝血與惡性腫瘤來支持 Metastasis（轉移）：腫瘤利用富含纖維素的細胞外基質，使循環腫瘤細胞搭乘血小板—纖維血塊以逃避免疫並在遠端定殖。血漿纖維蛋白原升高在 Breast Cancer（乳癌）、大腸癌與肺癌中是負面預後標記，而抗凝血劑與 αIIbβ3 整合素拮抗劑正被研究以遏制腫瘤播散。

context.en-US: Fibrinogen binds Fibronectin, vitronectin and growth factors, co-assembling with them to organize the provisional extracellular matrix at sites of vascular injury. Together with fibronectin, fibrin(ogen) therefore scaffolds the pro-metastatic Tumor Microenvironment in which disseminated tumour cells can shelter, while also amplifying Inflammation via macrophage integrin signalling.
context.zh-TW: Fibrinogen 會結合 Fibronectin（纖維連結蛋白）、vitronectin 與生長因子，與其共同組裝以在血管受損處組織暫時性細胞外基質。因此 fibrin(ogen) 與 fibronectin 一同支架出促轉移的 Tumor Microenvironment（腫瘤微環境），供播散的腫瘤細胞棲身，並透過巨噬細胞整合素訊號放大 Inflammation（發炎）。

context.en-US: Fibronectin binds Integrins through the RGD peptide motif in its Type III connecting segment (IIICS), engaging alpha5 beta1, alpha v beta3 and alpha v beta5 to mediate cell-matrix adhesion and migration. This outside-in signalling activates FAK, Src, PI3K/Akt and MAPK/ERK, regulating cytoskeleton remodeling, survival and proliferation.
context.zh-TW: Fibronectin（纖維連結蛋白）透過其 Type III 連接段（IIICS）中的 RGD peptide（胜肽）基序結合 Integrins（整合素），與 α5β1、αvβ3 及 αvβ5 結合以介導細胞—基質黏附與遷移。此由外向內的訊號活化 FAK、Src、PI3K／Akt 與 MAPK／ERK，調節細胞骨架重塑、存活與增殖。

context.en-US: Fibronectin engages integrins to trigger outside-in signalling that activates FAK, Src, PI3K/Akt and the MAPK/ERK pathways. Force-dependent fibronectin fibrillogenesis exposes cryptic binding sites and stiffens the matrix in a positive feedback loop, and this mechanical signalling is a key driver of EMT and invasion in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Fibronectin 與整合素結合後觸發由外向內的訊號，活化 FAK、Src、PI3K／Akt 與 MAPK／ERK 途徑。Fibronectin 的纖維化本身依賴機械力：細胞收縮力暴露隱藏的結合位點並使基質硬化，形成正回饋迴路，而這種機械訊號是癌症中 EMT 與侵襲的關鍵驅動因素。

context.en-US: Fibronectin supports Angiogenesis and Metastasis by being overexposed and remodeled at tumour borders and in the stroma, where it is a foundational scaffold of the Tumor Microenvironment and promotes cancer-associated fibroblast activation. It also supports Angiogenesis and Chemotherapy resistance, and its extra domain A splice isoform acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern activating toll-like receptors to fuel Inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Fibronectin 因在腫瘤邊界與間質中被過度表現並重塑，而支持 Angiogenesis（血管新生）與 Metastasis（轉移）；它是 Tumor Microenvironment（腫瘤微環境）的基礎支架，並促進癌症相關纖維母細胞活化。它也支援 Angiogenesis 與 Chemotherapy（化學治療）抗性，而其 extra domain A 剪接異構體可作為損傷相關分子模式活化類鐸受體以助長 Inflammation（發炎）。

context.en-US: Fibronectin promotes EMT: fibronectin mechanical signalling is a key driver of the epithelial-mesenchymal transition and invasion, and fibronectin is overexpressed at tumour borders where it scaffolds pro-tumor stroma. Alternative splicing of its IIICS region generates extra domain A/B isoforms that are upregulated during development, wound healing and cancer.
context.zh-TW: Fibronectin 促進 EMT：纖維連結蛋白的機械訊號是上皮—間質轉換與侵襲的關鍵驅動因素，且它在腫瘤邊界過度表現並支架出促腫瘤間質。其 IIICS 區域的選擇性剪接會產生 extra domain A／B 異構體，在發育、傷口癒合與癌症中皆表現上升。

context.en-US: Cell fate after DNA damage is set by p53 dynamics rather than by damage load alone. Pulsed p53 signalling selectively activates arrest and repair genes such as CDKN1A and permits recovery, whereas sustained p53 drives terminal programs including apoptosis; CDKN1A induction occurs at lower p53 thresholds than BAX. This temporal refinement explains why the same insult can yield arrest, senescence, or death.
context.zh-TW: DNA 損傷後細胞的命運由 p53 的動態而非損傷負載本身決定。脈衝式 p53 訊號選擇性活化 CDKN1A 等阻滯與修復基因並允許細胞恢復，而持續性 p53 則啟動包括凋亡在內的終末程序；CDKN1A 的誘導閾值低於 BAX。這項時間動態上的修正，說明為何同一種傷害可以分別導致細胞停滯、衰老或死亡。

context.en-US: BAX is activated in senescent fibroblasts under both irradiation-induced and oncogene-induced senescence, where BAX/BAK macropores release mitochondrial DNA into the cytosol without committing the cell to death. Sublethal engagement of the death machinery by low-dose BH3 mimetics is itself sufficient to induce senescence, showing that minority MOMP is an active state rather than a failed apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 在輻射誘導與致癌基因誘導的衰老纖維母細胞中，BAX 被活化，BAX/BAK 大孔洞會將粒線體 DNA 釋放至細胞質，卻未將細胞推向死亡。以低劑量 BH3 擬似物亞致死性地動用此死亡機制，本身即足以誘發衰老，顯示 minority MOMP 是一種主動狀態，而非凋亡的失敗。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization at a sublethal level releases mitochondrial DNA into the cytosol, which activates the cGAS-STING pathway and produces the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. Inhibiting BAX with BAI1 blocks both mitochondrial DNA release and SASP output, and MOMP inhibition reduced inflammation and improved healthspan in aged mice, confirming the axis in vivo.
context.zh-TW: 亞致死程度的外膜通透化會將粒線體 DNA 釋放至細胞質，啟動 cGAS-STING 訊息路徑並產生細胞衰老相關分泌表型。以 BAI1 抑制 BAX 可同時阻斷粒線體 DNA 釋放與 SASP 輸出；而抑制 MOMP 能在老年小鼠中降低發炎並改善健康壽命，於體內證實此軸線。

context.en-US: During apoptosis the same BAX/BAK macropores that release mitochondrial DNA in senescent cells are accompanied by active caspases that silence the inflammatory response. Senescent cells lack that caspase suppression, so an identical pore event becomes a chronic inflammatory engine driving the SASP rather than remaining immunologically quiet.
context.zh-TW: 在凋亡過程中，與衰老細胞釋放粒線體 DNA 相同的 BAX/BAK 大孔洞事件，伴隨活性 caspase 抑制發炎反應。衰老細胞缺乏這種 caspase 抑制，因此相同的孔洞事件反而成為驅動 SASP 的慢性發炎引擎，而不會保持免疫學上的沉默。

context.en-US: Senescent cells actively maintain an anti-apoptotic state rather than merely carrying intact but unused death machinery. They up-regulate Bcl-2, Bcl-w and Bcl-xL, add HSP90, ephrins, PI3Kδ and PAI-2 to the survival network, and throttle p53 through Mdm2 and FOXO4 sequestration. Senescence is therefore the deferred death of cells that survived the executioner.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞是主動維持抗凋亡狀態，而非僅僅保有完整卻未啟用的死亡機制。它們上調 Bcl-2、Bcl-w 與 Bcl-xL，並將 HSP90、ephrin、PI3Kδ 與 PAI-2 納入存活網絡，同時透過 Mdm2 與 FOXO4 的隔離來抑制 p53。因此，衰老可被視為度過執行者之後的延遲性死亡。

context.en-US: Senescent and drug-tolerant persister cells are intrinsically ferroptosis-sensitive, making ferroptosis the paradoxical lethal vulnerability of an otherwise apoptosis-resistant state. Senescence-linked PUFA remodeling through Acid ceramidase and ACSL4 creates this vulnerability along an axis that is independent of GPX4, GSH and iron, and SASP-driven IL-6 and IL-8 transmit it as a paracrine phenotype to bystander cells.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞與藥物耐受持續細胞（persister）天生對鐵死亡敏感，使鐵死亡成為這個原本具凋亡抗性的狀態之 paradoxical 致命弱點。衰老相關的 PUFA 重塑（經由 Acid ceramidase 與 ACSL4）在獨立於 GPX4、GSH 與鐵的軸線上造就此弱點，而由 SASP 驅動的 IL-6 與 IL-8 則以旁分泌方式將此表型傳遞給旁觀細胞。

context.en-US: Only a small fraction of doxorubicin-treated breast cancer cells escape apoptosis, and those survivors are senescent, which makes therapy-induced senescence by construction a cell-death evasion state. Senescent tumor cells can re-enter the cell cycle through p16/p21 loss, Cdk1 upregulation, autophagy and polyploidy, and they are cross-resistant to many drugs while in that state.
context.zh-TW: 接受 doxorubicin 處理的乳癌細胞中，只有極少部分逃過凋亡，而倖存者皆為衰老細胞，因此治療誘導的衰老在建構上就是一種細胞死亡逃避狀態。衰老腫瘤細胞可藉由 p16/p21 喪失、Cdk1 上調、自噬與多倍體化而重新進入細胞週期，並在該狀態下對多種藥物產生交叉抗藥性。

context.en-US: Autophagy is a functional effector of the drug-tolerant senescent state rather than a bystander: senescent tumor cells re-enter the cell cycle partly through autophagy and are cross-resistant to the majority of screened agents. Interfering with autophagy diverts these persister cells into ferroptosis and delays relapse, which is why senolytics are used as a second punch after therapy-induced senescence.
context.zh-TW: 自噬是藥物耐受性衰老狀態的實際效應者，而非旁觀者：衰老腫瘤細胞部分透過自噬重新進入細胞週期，並對多數受篩藥物產生交叉抗藥性。干擾自噬會把這些持續存活細胞轉向鐵死亡並延緩復發，因此治療誘導衰老之後常以 senolytics 作為第二擊。

context.en-US: The COMT rs4680 Val158Met genotype acts as a pharmacogenetic gate on α-tocopherol supplementation. In two re-analysed randomized trials, Met/Met slow COMT carriers showed about a 12% reduction in invasive cancer (HR 0.88) while Val/Val fast COMT carriers showed an 18% increase (HR 1.18), with heterozygotes null; the harm arm covers roughly one in four people.
context.zh-TW: COMT rs4680 的 Val158Met 基因型如同 α-tocopherol 補充的藥遺傳學閘門。在兩項重新分析的隨機試驗中，Met/Met 慢型 COMT 帶因者的侵襲性癌症風險約降低 12%（HR 0.88），而 Val/Val 快型 COMT 帶因者則增加 18%（HR 1.18），異型合子則無效應；有害族群約占人口的四分之一。

context.en-US: COMT activity determines whether α-tocopherol is inert or pro-apoptotic. Vitamin E alone is inert at 3–10 µg/mL in HCT116 colorectal cells, whereas COMT knockdown combined with vitamin E enhances apoptosis dose-dependently through p53 activation, BCL-2 family dysregulation and IAP downregulation, recapitulating the direction of benefit seen in Met/Met slow COMT carriers.
context.zh-TW: COMT 活性決定 α-tocopherol 是惰性還是促凋亡。在 HCT116 結腸癌細胞中，3–10 µg/mL 的 vitamin E 單獨作用為惰性；而 COMT 敲低合併 vitamin E 則以劑量依賴方式經由 p53 活化、BCL-2 家族失衡與 IAP 下調增強凋亡，重現 Met/Met 慢型 COMT 帶因者所見的效益方向。

context.en-US: Val158Met is a supplement-response modifier rather than a baseline cancer risk gene. A meta-analysis of 99 case-control studies found no association between Val158Met alone and overall cancer, even though the same genotype strongly modifies the effect of α-tocopherol supplementation. This dissociation means carrier status carries no prognostic information outside a supplement context.
context.zh-TW: Val158Met 是補充劑反應的修飾因子，而非基礎癌症風險基因。整合 99 項病例對照研究的中位分析顯示，Val158Met 本身與整體癌症並無關聯，儘管同一基因型能強烈修飾 α-tocopherol 補充的效果。這種分離意味著在非補充劑情境下，帶因狀態不提供任何預後資訊。

context.en-US: The COMT genotype signal is not vitamin-E-specific. In the companion Women's Health Study analysis, COMT also modified the cardiovascular effect of low-dose aspirin, and a COMT by β-carotene interaction was noted in ATBC. COMT therefore emerges as a general gate on supplement and drug response rather than a vitamin E peculiarity.
context.zh-TW: COMT 基因型的訊號並非 vitamin E 專屬。在配套的 Women's Health Study 分析中，COMT 同樣修飾了低劑量 aspirin 的心血管效果，ATBC 中也觀察到 COMT 與 β-carotene 的交互作用。因此 COMT 浮現為補充劑與藥物反應的普遍閘門，而非 vitamin E 特有的現象。

context.en-US: COMT detoxifies catechol substrates, including reactive catechol estrogen quinones and catechol carcinogens, which is one mechanistic candidate for its role as a response gate. COMT haploinsufficiency at 22q11.2 carries a cancer predisposition, and competition from catechol-bearing dietary polyphenols such as Quercetin and Fisetin means fast COMT clears these faster, potentially reshaping the whole catechol/antioxidant milieu.
context.zh-TW: COMT 負責解毒兒茶酚類基質，包括反應性的兒茶酚雌激素醌與兒茶酚致癌物，這是它作為反應閘門的機制候選之一。22q11.2 區段的 COMT 單倍體不足帶有癌症易感傾向；而來自 Quercetin、Fisetin 等含兒茶酚膳食多酚的競爭意味著快型 COMT 清除它們得更快，可能重塑整體的兒茶酚／抗氧化 milieu。

context.en-US: Hormesis is the named form of a biphasic dose-response in which low doses stimulate and high doses inhibit, tracing to the Arndt-Schulz law of 1887 and the coined Greek term for excitation in 1943. Because the same curve shape is described in a dozen other fields under different names, restricting a search to the word hormesis misses most of the relevant literature.
context.zh-TW: Hormesis 是一種具名的雙相劑量反應形式：低劑量刺激、高劑量抑制，其源流可回溯至 1887 年的 Arndt-Schulz 法則，以及 1943 年創造的希臘文「興奮」一詞。由於同一條曲線形狀在十多個其他領域以不同名稱描述，僅以 hormesis 一詞檢索會遺漏大部分相關文獻。

context.en-US: Low-dose ionizing radiation is the radiation-biology instance of hormesis, where sub-threshold exposure upregulates DNA repair enzymes and produces resistance to higher doses, the adaptive response first described in 1988. The interpretation is politically contested because it conflicts with the linear no-threshold model, so the field deliberately avoids the word hormesis.
context.zh-TW: 低劑量游離輻射是輻射生物學中的 hormesis 實例：次閾值暴露會上調 DNA 修復酵素並產生對更高劑量的抗性，即 1988 年首次描述的適應反應。此一詮釋具政治爭議性，因為它與線性無閾值模型衝突，所以該領域刻意避開 hormesis 一詞。

context.en-US: Caloric restriction and its relatives, dietary restriction and intermittent fasting, are the endocrinology field's entry point to the same hormetic dose-response, with the glucose-to-ketone switch acting as the signal. Shared quantitative features across domains, such as a 30–60% maximum stimulatory response over a 5–100-fold dose range, would be invisible without a vocabulary that unifies the field-specific names.
context.zh-TW: Caloric restriction 及其相關的 dietary restriction 與 intermittent fasting，是內分泌學領域通往同一 hormetic 劑量反應的入口，其中葡萄糖到酮體的轉換即為訊號。在缺乏統一各領域專屬名稱的詞彙橋之前，跨領域共有的量化特徵（如 5–100 倍劑量範圍內 30–60% 的最大刺激反應）依然是不可見的。

context.en-US: The upper bound of the hormetic window, defined as the no-observed-adverse-effect level, is not merely the onset of toxicity but the execution boundary at which regulated cell death is triggered. Above this dose the same adaptive machinery that produced resistance at low dose tips into programmed execution, which is why the two literatures keep colliding.
context.zh-TW: Hormetic window 的上界（定義為無可觀察不良效應濃度）不只是毒性的起點，更是啟動 regulated cell death 的執行邊界。超過此劑量時，低劑量下產生抗性的同一套適應機制會翻轉為程式性執行，這也是 hormesis 與細胞死亡文獻一再交會的原因。

context.en-US: Preconditioning is the experimental proof that the regulated cell death threshold is itself hormetically tunable. Brief sublethal ischemia raises the threshold for later lethal ischemic insult, prior low-dose HOCl or tert-butylhydroquinone shifts the viability curve to the right while preserving its biphasic shape, and caloric restriction and exercise do the same through AMPK, SIRT1, PGC-1α and NRF2.
context.zh-TW: Preconditioning 是 regulated cell death 閾值本身可被 hormetic 調節的實驗證明。短暫的亞致死性缺血會提高之後致命性缺血傷害的閾值；先前的低劑量 HOCl 或 tert-butylhydroquinone 會在保留雙相曲線形狀的同時把存活曲線右移；caloric restriction 與運動則透過 AMPK、SIRT1、PGC-1α 與 NRF2 達成同樣效果。

context.en-US: Accidental cell death lies outside the hormetic frame because it is instantaneous, passive and biophysical, with no sensor, no signal and no checkpoint to adapt. Its dose-response is monotonic, so no preconditioning can make a cell physically resistant to catastrophic trauma. Only the stressors that cause it are hormetic at sublethal doses.
context.zh-TW: Accidental cell death 位於 hormesis 框架之外，因為它是瞬時、被動且生物物理性的，沒有感測器、沒有訊號、也沒有可供適應的檢查點。它的劑量反應是單調的，因此沒有任何 preconditioning 能讓細胞在物理上抵抗災難性創傷。只有造成它的 stressor 在亞致死劑量下才是 hormetic 的。

context.en-US: NRF2 with ARE is the Tier I program of the hierarchical oxidative-stress model formalised for hormesis, occupying the low-dose adaptive zone with antioxidant and phase II enzyme induction and glutathione restoration. Tier II adds NF-κB-driven inflammation and cell-cycle arrest, and Tier III executes apoptosis and necrosis, so the tiers are the same control network at increasing saturation.
context.zh-TW: NRF2 搭配 ARE 是分層氧化壓力模型中的第一層程式，並在為 hormesis 形式化後佔據低劑量適應區，伴隨抗氧化與第二相酵素誘導以及 glutathione 的恢復。第二層加入 NF-κB 驅動的發炎與細胞週期阻滯，第三層則執行凋亡與壞死，因此各層其實是同一控制網絡在飽和度遞增下的表現。

context.en-US: In the tiered stress-response model, NF-κB occupies the intermediate stressed tier whose program feeds directly into the caspase, RIPK and GPX4 checkpoints that execute death once the NOAEL is exceeded. This is the molecular bridge between hormesis and cell-death biology: the same transcription factor that primes survival at moderate dose participates in execution context at high dose.
context.zh-TW: 在分層壓力反應模型中，NF-κB 位於中間的受壓層，其程式在超過 NOAEL 後直接餵入執行死亡的 caspase、RIPK 與 GPX4 檢查點。這是 hormesis 與細胞死亡生物學之間的分子橋樑：同一個轉錄因子在中等劑量下為存活預備，在高劑量下卻參與執行情境。

context.en-US: Autophagy is the cleanest example of a pathway that is protective at the adaptive dose and lethal if overdriven. Mild autophagy clears damaged mitochondria and lowers the ROS that would otherwise commit the cell to regulated cell death, and part of preconditioning's benefit is autophagy-dependent; excessive autophagy instead becomes autophagic cell death.
context.zh-TW: 自噬是「在適應劑量下具保護性、過度驅動時則致命」最清楚的例子。溫和的自噬清除受損粒線體並降低原本會把細胞推向 regulated cell death 的 ROS，而 preconditioning 的部分效益依賴自噬；過度的自噬則反過來成為自噬性細胞死亡。

context.en-US: Once the hormetic window is exceeded, regulated cell death executes apoptosis first, and regulated necrotic modalities such as necroptosis, pyroptosis and ferroptosis follow when apoptosis is blocked. The sequence is why caspase inhibition can convert a controlled response into a lytic, more inflammatory one, and it is where the RCD tier ends and the unregulated ACD tier begins.
context.zh-TW: 一旦超出 hormetic window，regulated cell death 先執行凋亡；當凋亡被阻斷時，necroptosis、pyroptosis 與 ferroptosis 等受調控的壞死型態才隨之而來。這個順序解釋了為何 caspase 抑制會把受控反應轉為溶解性、發炎性更強的反應，也正是 RCD 層結束、失控的 ACD 層開始之處。

context.en-US: Heat-shock preconditioning acts through the HSF1-driven HSP70 response, where a sublethal thermal pulse raises proteostasis capacity and resistance to a later lethal stress. The same mild pulse can drive HSP70 to a striking share of total protein, which is the energetic-cost and overcompensation basis proposed for hormesis generally.
context.zh-TW: 熱休克 preconditioning 透過 HSF1 驅動的 HSP70 反應作用，一次亞致死的熱脈衝提升蛋白穩定性能力並增強對之後致命壓力的抗性。相同的溫和脈衝甚至可讓 HSP70 佔總蛋白相當高的比例，這正是文獻為 hormesis 提出的能量成本與過度補償基礎。

context.en-US: Exercise-generated ROS act as the signalling trigger for mitochondrial biogenesis through the AMPK-PGC-1α axis, with SOD, catalase and GPx induction as effectors. This is the domain's strongest hormetic case, which is why co-supplementing antioxidants around workouts blunts the mROS to AMPK to PGC-1α cascade that the adaptation depends on.
context.zh-TW: 運動產生的 ROS 會透過 AMPK-PGC-1α 軸作為粒線體生物發生的訊號觸發，並以 SOD、catalase 與 GPx 的誘導作為效應者。這是該領域最強的 hormetic 案例，也因此在運動前後補充抗氧化劑會削弱適應所依賴的 mROS → AMPK → PGC-1α 級聯。

context.en-US: The energy deficit of fasting is the caloric-stress hormetic signal, and the glucose-to-BHB switch is the readout that marks it. AMPK with mTORC1 inhibition, SIRT1 and TFEB then drive autophagy and mitophagy as the effectors, with BDNF-linked neurogenesis and lysosomal biogenesis downstream.
context.zh-TW: 禁食造成的能量赤字是熱量壓力上的 hormetic 訊號，而葡萄糖到 BHB 的轉換則是標記它的讀值。接著 AMPK 搭配 mTORC1 抑制、SIRT1 與 TFEB 驅動自噬與粒線體自噬作為效應者，下游則連結 BDNF 相關的神經新生與溶小體生物發生。

context.en-US: Brief low-oxygen pulses are the sensor-driven core of intermittent hypoxia hormesis, with HIF-1α acting alongside AMPK and SIRT1 to raise EPO, VEGF and BDNF. Five-minute hypoxia and normoxia cycles over 60–120 minutes, repeated three to five times weekly for two to four weeks, is the operational dose; chronic severe hypoxia is the maladaptive extreme.
context.zh-TW: 短暫的低氧脈衝是間歇性低氧 hormesis 的感測核心，HIF-1α 與 AMPK、SIRT1 共同作用以提升 EPO、VEGF 與 BDNF。每週三至五次、每次 60–120 分鐘的 5 分鐘低氧／常氧循環、持續二至四週，是操作劑量；而慢性嚴重低氧則是不適應的極端。

context.en-US: Xenohormesis describes how mild plant toxins act as hormetins: they switch on the cell's own antioxidant defences through NRF2, with HSF1, AMPK and SIRT1 as co-sensors and SOD, catalase, GPx, HO-1 and phase II detox as effectors. The framing is the opposite of the antioxidant one, since the goal is induction rather than scavenging.
context.zh-TW: Xenohormesis 描述的是溫和植物毒素如何作為 hormetin：它們透過 NRF2 啟動細胞自身的抗氧化防禦，並以 HSF1、AMPK 與 SIRT1 為共同感測器，以 SOD、catalase、GPx、HO-1 與第二相解毒作為效應者。此一框架與抗氧化劑框架正好相反，因為目標是誘導而非清除。

context.en-US: Low-dose ionizing radiation hormesis runs through ATM and p53 as sensors, with BRCA1 and GADD45 as effectors of DNA repair and NRF2/ARE enzymes alongside CD69-positive T cells. The same sensor module that mediates adaptive protection at low dose mediates damage accumulation at high dose, which is the whole point of a biphasic curve.
context.zh-TW: 低劑量游離輻射的 hormesis 透過 ATM 與 p53 作為感測器運作，並以 BRCA1 與 GADD45 作為 DNA 修復的效應者，NRF2/ARE 酵素與 CD69 陽性 T 細胞並列其中。同一組感測模組在低劑量下媒介適應性保護，在高劑量下卻媒介損傷累積，這正是雙相曲線的核心意涵。

context.en-US: Fermentable fibre and live fermented foods are the gut-colonisation hormetic input, with the microbiome generating short-chain fatty acids such as butyrate that drive autophagy and barrier integrity. Toll-like receptor signalling and the vagal gut-brain axis are the sensors, and Tregs, barrier integrity and BDNF are the effectors; broad-spectrum antibiotics and chronic proton pump inhibitors are the anti-hormetic extremes.
context.zh-TW: 可發酵纖維與活發酵食品是腸道定殖的 hormetic 輸入，腸道菌群產生 butyrate 等短鏈脂肪酸，進而驅動自噬與屏障完整性。Toll-like receptor 訊號與迷走神經腸腦軸是感測器，Tregs、屏障完整性與 BDNF 則是效應者；而廣效抗生素與長期質子幫浦抑制劑則是反 hormetic 的極端。

context.en-US: Ascorbate is the water-phase reductant that regenerates the α-tocopheroxyl radical at the membrane-water interface, which is why one tocopherol molecule can trap many peroxyl radicals before it is lost. Vitamin E is therefore catalytic rather than stoichiometric, and its functional reserve is set by the ascorbate, glutathione and NADPH pool rather than by tocopherol concentration.
context.zh-TW: Ascorbate 是水相還原劑，在膜－水介面上將 α-tocopheroxyl 自由基再生，因此單一 tocopherol 分子在被消耗前可捕捉許多過氧自由基。Vitamin E 因此是催化性而非化學計量性的，其功能儲備由 ascorbate、glutathione 與 NADPH 的儲備決定，而非由 tocopherol 濃度決定。

context.en-US: Tocopherol chain-breaks lipid peroxidation by donating its chromanol phenolic hydrogen to the lipid peroxyl radical, stopping propagation before a hydroperoxide forms. The resulting tocopheroxyl radical is too unreactive to abstract hydrogen from a neighbouring polyunsaturated fatty acid, which is what makes a recyclable trap possible. Vitamin E cannot be replaced by vitamin C, which never enters the hydrocarbon interior.
context.zh-TW: Tocopherol 藉由將其 chromanol 環上的酚氫轉移給脂質過氧自由基來截斷脂質過氧化鏈，在過氧化物形成之前就阻止傳播。所生成的 tocopheroxyl 自由基反應性過低，無法再從鄰近的 polyunsaturated fatty acid 奪取氫，這正是可回收型捕獲劑得以成立的原因。Vitamin E 無法由 vitamin C 取代，因為後者從不進入碳氫核心區。

context.en-US: GPX4 is the only enzyme that reduces phospholipid hydroperoxides inside the membrane, using its catalytic selenocysteine and two glutathione to convert LOOH to the inert lipid alcohol before the chain branches. Substituting cysteine for selenocysteine costs about 100-fold activity, and dietary Selenium loss removes the catalytic residue entirely, which is why selenium deficiency sensitizes tissue to ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: GPX4 是唯一能在膜內還原磷脂質過氧化物的酵素，利用其催化的 selenocysteine 與兩個 glutathione 將 LOOH 轉為惰性的脂質醇，在鏈式反應分支之前完成。將 selenocysteine 換成 cysteine 會使活性下降約 100 倍，而飲食中 Selenium 流失則完全移除催化殘基，這也是 selenium 缺乏會讓組織易感鐵死亡的原因。

context.en-US: The GPX4 repair tier stalls whenever glutathione supply fails, because two glutathione equivalents are consumed per hydroperoxide reduced. Erastin blocks system xc⁻ and collapses cystine uptake so that glutathione synthesis halts and GPX4's substrate vanishes, while RSL3 bypasses glutathione entirely by covalently modifying the selenocysteine. Glutathione depletion converts an aldehyde clearance pathway into a liability.
context.zh-TW: 只要 glutathione 供應中斷，GPX4 修復層就會停滯，因為每還原一個過氧化物就消耗兩個 glutathione 當量。Erastin 阻斷 system xc⁻ 讓胱胺酸攝入崩潰，glutathione 合成因而停止、GPX4 的基質消失；而 RSL3 則繞過 glutathione，直接共價修飾 selenocysteine。Glutathione 耗竭會把原本的醛清除路徑轉為危害來源。

context.en-US: FSP1 is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein that uses NADPH to reduce coenzyme Q10 to ubiquinol, supplying a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that operates entirely outside the glutathione system. Loss of either the FSP1-CoQ10 axis or the GPX4-glutathione axis is survivable, but combined loss is synergistic, which is why coenzyme Q10 status and vitamin E status both matter for membrane integrity.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 是利用 NADPH 將 coenzyme Q10 還原為 ubiquinol 的細胞膜黃素蛋白，提供一個完全在 glutathione 系統之外運作的親脂性自由基捕獲抗氧化劑。FSP1-CoQ10 軸或 GPX4-glutathione 軸任一失去皆可存活，但兩者同時失去則產生協同效應，因此 coenzyme Q10 狀態與 vitamin E 狀態都對膜完整性重要。

context.en-US: Ferroptosis sensitivity is set less by antioxidant capacity than by how much polyunsaturated fatty acid is esterified into membrane phospholipids. ACSL4 charges arachidonate and adrenate to acyl-CoA and LPCAT3 inserts them at the sn-2 position of phosphatidylethanolamines, and those oxidized PE species are the lethal substrates. Neuronal membranes, enriched in DHA, are consequently the most oxidation-fragile tissue in the body.
context.zh-TW: 鐵死亡的易感性與其說取決於抗氧化能力，不如取決於有多少 polyunsaturated fatty acid 被酯化進膜磷脂中。ACSL4 將 arachidonate 與 adrenate 接到 acyl-CoA 上，LPCAT3 再將它們插入 phosphatidylethanolamine 的 sn-2 位，而這些被氧化的 PE 物種正是致命基質。因此富含 DHA 的神經膜是人體中最易受氧化破壞的組織。

context.en-US: Acid ceramidase raises ferroptosis sensitivity by increasing phospholipid PUFA content through ceramide-derived free fatty acids, a mechanism that operates independently of GPX4, glutathione and iron. Less PUFA substrate means less lipid peroxidation to begin with, so knockdown protects cells without touching the antioxidant tier at all, showing that substrate availability can dominate defensive capacity.
context.zh-TW: Acid ceramidase 透過 ceramide 衍生的游離脂肪酸提高膜磷脂 PUFA 含量，進而提升鐵死亡易感性；此機制獨立於 GPX4、glutathione 與鐵。基質上的 PUFA 較少意味著起始的脂質過氧化就較少，因此敲低可在完全不動抗氧化層的情況下保護細胞，顯示基質可得性可以凌駕防禦能力。

context.en-US: At low flux, 4-HNE is a signalling molecule rather than damage: it modifies KEAP1 and releases NRF2 to induce phase II detoxification enzymes, glutathione synthesis and the cystine antiporter, a hormetic adaptive response. At high flux the same bifunctional electrophile overwhelms clearance and adducts proteins irreversibly, so the concentration threshold separates adaptation from injury.
context.zh-TW: 在低通量下，4-HNE 是訊號分子而非損傷來源：它修飾 KEAP1，釋放 NRF2 以誘導第二相解毒酵素、glutathione 合成與胱胺酸反向運輸體，形成 hormetic 的適應反應。在高通量下，同一個雙功能親電體會壓過清除能力並不可逆地與蛋白質成加合物，因此濃度閾值正是區分適應與傷害的分界。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial ROS convert the fission GTPase from a housekeeping enzyme into a stress-driven cutter by oxidizing the redox-sensitive Cys644 of DRP1. Sulfenylated DRP1 has higher GTPase activity and fragments the network, and the resulting mitochondrial ROS feed forward to oxidize more DRP1, a self-reinforcing loop that MitoTEMPO and mito-catalase interrupt.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體 ROS 藉由氧化 DRP1 上對氧化還原敏感的 Cys644，把這個分裂 GTPase 由家務性酵素轉為壓力驅動的切割者。被 sulfenyl 化的 DRP1 GTPase 活性升高並使網絡碎裂，而產生的粒線體 ROS 又回饋氧化更多 DRP1，形成自我強化的迴路，可由 MitoTEMPO 與 mito-catalase 打断。

context.en-US: A conserved WRG motif in the DRP1 variable domain intercalates into the bilayer and binds cardiolipin specifically, driving a disorder-to-order transition that relieves autoinhibition and stabilizes assembled DRP1. Because cardiolipin is externalized to the outer membrane only under stress, the interaction gates stress-induced hyperfragmentation while leaving housekeeping fission largely intact.
context.zh-TW: DRP1 可變區中的保守 WRG 模序會插入雙層並專一結合 cardiolipin，促使無序到有序的轉換而解除自動抑制，並穩定已組裝的 DRP1。由於 cardiolipin 僅在壓力下才被外翻到外膜，此交互作用便把壓力誘發的過度碎裂設閘，而家務性分裂大致不受影響。

context.en-US: Cardiolipin normally resides in the inner mitochondrial membrane but is externalized to the outer membrane under apoptosis, mitophagy and other stress, where it licenses the punctiform hyperfragmentation needed for autophagosome engulfment. Unbound outer-membrane cardiolipin is converted to phosphatidic acid instead, which hyperactivates Mfn1/2 and can produce hyperfusion, so the same lipid cuts or fuses depending on where it sits.
context.zh-TW: Cardiolipin 正常位於粒線體內膜，但在凋亡、mitophagy 與其他壓力下會外翻至外膜，並在那裡許可自噬體吞噬所需的點狀過度碎裂。未結合的外膜 cardiolipin 則會被轉為 phosphatidic acid，後者過度活化 Mfn1/2 並可能造成過度融合，因此同一種脂質依其位置決定是切割還是融合。

context.en-US: About 90% of mitochondrial α-tocopherol resides in the outer membrane, the exact leaflet where DRP1 assembles and where cardiolipin externalization is read. By intercepting the lipid peroxidation chain before it reaches cardiolipin, tocopherol keeps local ROS below the Cys644 sulfenylation threshold, making it an anti-hyperfragmentation nutrient that removes the trigger of stress-driven fission without stopping housekeeping fission.
context.zh-TW: 約 90% 的粒線體 α-tocopherol 存在於外膜，正是 DRP1 組裝且 cardiolipin 外翻被讀取的那一層。Tocopherol 在脂質過氧化鏈到達 cardiolipin 之前攔截它，使局部 ROS 維持在 Cys644 sulfenylation 閾值以下，因此成為抗過度碎裂的營養因子：它移除壓力驅動分裂的觸發因素，卻不停止家務性分裂。

context.en-US: Inside the organelle, ubiquinol from the electron transport chain is the electron donor that recycles α-tocopherol in situ. Respiratory substrates such as succinate spare mitochondrial tocopherol from oxidative loss and that sparing is blocked by TTFA but not myxothiazol, establishing ubiquinol rather than ascorbate as the local reductant. The outer-membrane pool is maintained by quinone recycling rather than by megadosing.
context.zh-TW: 在粒線體內，電子傳遞鏈產生的 ubiquinol 是就地再生 α-tocopherol 的電子供應者。succinate 等呼吸受質可使粒線體 tocopherol 免於氧化損失，而此保護可被 TTFA 阻斷卻不被 myxothiazol 阻斷，確立 ubiquinol 而非 ascorbate 為當地的還原劑。外膜的 tocopherol 儲備靠醌循環維持，而非靠 mega 劑量補充。

context.en-US: All-trans retinoic acid at 0.1–10 µM over 24 hours raises DRP1 protein in HEK293 and HL-1 cardiomyocytes and in mouse heart, with DRP1 redistributing to mitochondria while OPA1, MFN1/2 and FIS1 are unchanged. The effect is therefore specific to the fission arm, producing higher tip-to-tip fission rates and a more fragmented network, which pairs with the separate biogenesis program.
context.zh-TW: 全反式 retinoic acid 以 0.1–10 µM 處理 24 小時，會在 HEK293 與 HL-1 心肌細胞以及小鼠心臟中提高 DRP1 蛋白量，且 DRP1 重新分布至粒線體，而 OPA1、MFN1/2 與 FIS1 不變。因此此效應專屬於分裂臂，產生更高的 tip-to-tip 分裂率與更碎裂的網絡，並與獨立的生物發生程式相配合。

context.en-US: Retinoic acid drives mitochondrial biogenesis through p38 MAPK to PGC-1α in muscle and primary myoblasts and through PPARδ in human hepatocytes, raising PGC-1α, NRF1, mtDNA and ATP. Because it raises biogenesis and the fission rate together, retinoic acid is best read as a differentiation signal that supplies new biomass for fission to partition.
context.zh-TW: Retinoic acid 在肌肉與原代肌母細胞中經 p38 MAPK 活化 PGC-1α，在人類肝細胞中則經 PPARδ 途徑驅動粒線體生物發生，提升 PGC-1α、NRF1、mtDNA 與 ATP。由於它同時提高生物發生與分裂率，retinoic acid 最好被理解為分化訊號，為分裂提供可供分配的全新生物量。

context.en-US: Fission functions as segregation rather than destruction: one asymmetric division yields a high-membrane-potential fusion-competent daughter and a low-potential mitophagy-competent daughter, so PINK1/Parkin mitophagy runs only on the condemned half. Because both excessive fission and fission blockade are pathological, the balance in Mitochondrial Dynamics, not the absolute rate, is the phenotype.
context.zh-TW: 分裂的功能是分隔而非破壞：一次不對稱分裂產生一個高膜電位、可融合的子代與一個低膜電位、可被 mitophagy 清除的子代，因此 PINK1/Parkin 介導的 mitophagy 只作用於被判定死亡的半邊。由於過度分裂與分裂阻斷皆屬病態，Mitochondrial Dynamics 中的平衡而非絕對速率才是表型。

context.en-US: Vitamin E blunts mitohormesis less than the antioxidant framing implies, because the two act in different compartments. The mitohormetic signal is largely aqueous-phase Hydrogen Peroxide at 10–100 nM acting reversibly on cysteine sensors, whereas tocopherol terminates LOO• chains inside the bilayer, so it removes the damage arm more readily than the signal arm.
context.zh-TW: Vitamin E 對 mitohormesis 的削弱程度低於抗氧化劑框架的暗示，因為兩者作用區隔不同。Mitohormetic 訊號主要是 10–100 nM 的水相 Hydrogen Peroxide，可逆地作用於半胱胺酸感測器；而 tocopherol 則在雙層內截斷 LOO• 鏈，因此它較容易移除損傷臂而非訊號臂。

context.en-US: Lipophilic tocopherols in the fruit act synergistically with polyphenols to downregulate pro-inflammatory cascades and keep LDL from undergoing oxidative modification. LDL oxidizability is inversely proportional to its α-tocopherol content, and once oxidized the particle is cleared by scavenger receptors on macrophages to form foam cells rather than by the LDL receptor.
context.zh-TW: 水果中的親脂性 tocopherol 與 polyphenol 協同作用，下調促發炎級聯並防止 LDL 遭受氧化修飾。LDL 的可氧化性與其 α-tocopherol 含量成反比；一旦被氧化，該顆粒會經巨噬細胞上的清除受體被清除而形成泡沫細胞，而非經由 LDL 受體途徑。

context.en-US: The carotenoid payload of the pulp, dominated by all-E-beta-carotene with alpha-carotene, lutein and beta-cryptoxanthin, acts as a provitamin A precursor and a singlet oxygen quencher that mitigates photo-oxidative stress. Delivered inside a lipid matrix alongside α-tocopherol, the carotenoids are solubilized into a vehicle that directly targets lipid-bilayer peroxidation, which is what gives the fruit a specialized lipophilic niche rather than a general antioxidant one.
context.zh-TW: 果肉富含以 all-E-β-carotene 為主、並含 α-carotene、lutein 與 β-cryptoxanthin 的類胡蘿蔔素，既是 provitamin A 前驅物，也是可淬滅 singlet oxygen、緩解光氧化壓力的物質。當它們與 α-tocopherol 一起被包在脂質基質中送入時，類胡蘿蔔素便被溶解進直接針對脂質雙層過氧化的載體中，這使該果實取得的是脂溶性專門利基而非一般性抗氧化利基。

context.en-US: Unrefined red palm oil is the practical delivery vehicle for the same lipophilic defence suite, supplying roughly 8 mg carotenoids plus 6–11 mg total tocols per tablespoon. This is the route that reaches a meaningful carotenoid and vitamin E intake at one to two tablespoons daily, whereas the Queen Palm whole fruit would require 120 to 300 fruits for the same carotenoid target.
context.zh-TW: 未精煉的紅棕櫚油是同一套脂溶性防禦物質的實用載體，每一大匙約提供 8 mg 類胡蘿蔔素與 6–11 mg 總 tocol。這是每日一到兩大匙即可達到有意義類胡蘿蔔素與 vitamin E 攝取量的途徑；相較之下，同樣的類胡蘿蔔素目標若靠 Queen Palm 整果則需 120 至 300 顆。

context.en-US: Low-dose Alpha-Lipoic Acid and Coenzyme Q10 regenerate oxidized tocopherol and are proposed to outperform large vitamin E boluses for membrane protection. Regenerating the tocopheroxyl radical rather than adding new tocopherol fits the relay architecture, where functional reserve is set by the reducing pool rather than by tocopherol concentration.
context.zh-TW: 低劑量的 Alpha-Lipoic Acid 與 Coenzyme Q10 可再生已氧化的 tocopherol，在膜保護上被認為優於大劑量 vitamin E 補充。再生 tocopheroxyl 自由基而非增加 tocopherol，符合中繼架構的原理：功能儲備由還原性物質池決定，而非由 tocopherol 濃度決定。

context.en-US: For the hormesis goal itself, xenohormetins such as Sulforaphane, Curcumin and Resveratrol are preferred over antioxidant dosing, because they are mild electrophilic stressors that induce NRF2 rather than scavenge reactive species. Vitamin E is framed as situational membrane insurance rather than a longevity signal under this strategy.
context.zh-TW: 就 hormesis 目標本身而言，Sulforaphane、Curcumin 與 Resveratrol 等 xenohormetin 優於抗氧化劑補充，因為它們是誘導 NRF2 的溫和親電壓力源，而非清除活性物質。在這個策略下，Vitamin E 被定位為情境性的膜保障，而非長壽訊號。

context.en-US: Chronic generation of Malondialdehyde and 4-Hydroxynonenal from ongoing lipid peroxidation degrades mitohormetic capacity, so preventing that generation is not the same as blunting the hormetic signal. The distinction resolves the apparent conflict between membrane protection and hormesis: lipid-peroxidation control preserves the adaptive response rather than suppressing it.
context.zh-TW: 持續脂質過氧化所產生的 Malondialdehyde 與 4-Hydroxynonenal 會侵蝕 mitohormetic 容量，因此阻止其生成與削弱 hormetic 訊號並不相同。這項區分化解了膜保護與 hormesis 之間的表面衝突：控制脂質過氧化是保存而非壓抑適應反應。

context.en-US: Notch-mediated secondary senescence produces a weaker, damped SASP by design, which limits the runaway paracrine spread of the primary program. This is the deliberate brake in the senescence cascade and the reason primary and secondary senescence can be separated as distinct states in single-cell and spatial classifiers rather than treated as one.
context.zh-TW: Notch 媒介的次級衰老依設計產生較弱、受抑制的 SASP，用以限制初級程式的失控旁分泌擴散。這是衰老級聯中的刻意煞車，也因此初級與次級衰老可在單細胞與空間分類器中被區分為不同狀態，而不被混為一談。

context.en-US: A mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA arm runs SLC25A1 to ACLY to supply the acetyl-CoA needed for H3K27ac at SASP loci, and inhibiting this arm suppresses the SASP while improving aged-mouse healthspan without reversing arrest. Suppressing the arm works independently of cGAS-STING, which is what makes it a separate gate from innate immune activation.
context.zh-TW: 一條粒線體 citrate–acetyl-CoA 臂經由 SLC25A1 通往 ACLY，提供 SASP 位點上 H3K27ac 所需的 acetyl-CoA；抑制此臂可在不逆轉細胞停滯的情況下抑制 SASP 並改善老年小鼠的健康壽命。抑制此臂的作用獨立於 cGAS-STING，正是它作為獨立於先天免疫活化之外的另一道閘門之處。

context.en-US: IL-6 and IL-8 drive paracrine senescence in neighbouring cells, but the outcome flips with context: in pre-malignant lesions this SASP arm suppresses clearance and is tumour-suppressive, whereas in normal aged tissue the same factors spread senescence and are detrimental. No single-timepoint abundance measurement can separate the beneficial from the detrimental population.
context.zh-TW: IL-6 與 IL-8 會在鄰近細胞中驅動旁分泌性衰老，但結果隨情境翻轉：在癌前病灶中此 SASP 臂抑制清除而具腫瘤抑制作用，在正常老化組織中同樣因子卻散播衰老而有害。任何單一時間點的豐度測量都無法區分有益與有害的細胞族群。

context.en-US: p53 acts as a restraint on the SASP alongside the p16 and p21 senescence programs. When p53 function is restored in tumors the resulting immunogenic SASP can recruit macrophages, NK and CD4/CD8 cells and drive regression, which is the molecular basis for the acute-versus-chronic duality of the secretome.
context.zh-TW: p53 與 p16、p21 衰老程式並列，作為 SASP 的抑制力量。當腫瘤中 p53 功能恢復時，所產生的免疫原性 SASP 可徵募巨噬細胞、NK 與 CD4/CD8 細胞並促成腫瘤退縮，這正是分泌表型急性與慢性雙面性的分子基礎。

context.en-US: LINE-1 retroelement activity drives the deepest stage of the SASP cascade, producing a type-I interferon signature late in the senescence trajectory. Because the secretome switches from an early TGFβ-rich immunosuppressive and profibrotic profile through a late IL-6/IL-8/MMP-rich inflammatory one to this interferon arm, temporal stage is one of the four axes that shape outcome.
context.zh-TW: LINE-1 反轉錄轉位子活性驅動衰老級聯最深的階段，在軌跡後期產生 type-I interferon 訊號特徵。由於分泌表型會從早期富含 TGFβ 的免疫抑制與促纖維輪廓，經過晚期富含 IL-6/IL-8/MMP 的發炎輪廓，再轉入這個 interferon 臂，時間階段正是塑造結果的四大軸之一。

context.en-US: 4E-BP1 is a major downstream effector of mTORC1. Hypophosphorylated 4E-BP1 suppresses cap-dependent translation of autophagy repressors, thereby promoting Autophagy, so 4E-BP1 acts as a key effector of mTORC1-dependent autophagy control.
context.zh-TW: 4E-BP1 是 mTORC1 的主要下游效應器。過磷酸化的 4E-BP1 抑制自噬抑制蛋白的帽依賴性轉譯，因而促進 Autophagy，因此 4E-BP1 是 mTORC1 依賴性自噬調控的關鍵效應器。

context.en-US: 4E-BP1 is a translational repressor that binds eIF4E and prevents eIF4F complex formation. It is phosphorylated and inactivated by mTORC1, and that phosphorylation prevents its binding to eIF4E, releasing eIF4E to promote cap-dependent translation.
context.zh-TW: 4E-BP1 是轉譯抑制蛋白，會結合 eIF4E 並阻止 eIF4F 複合體形成。它受 mTORC1 磷酸化而失活；該磷酸化阻止其結合 eIF4E，使 eIF4E 得以促進帽依賴性轉譯。

context.en-US: mTORC1 promotes protein synthesis by phosphorylating 4E-BP1 and S6K1. The phosphorylation of 4E-BP1 prevents its binding to eIF4E, enabling eIF4E to promote cap-dependent translation.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 藉由磷酸化 4E-BP1 與 S6K1 來促進蛋白質合成。4E-BP1 的磷酸化阻止其結合 eIF4E，使 eIF4E 能促進帽依賴性轉譯。

context.en-US: ALKBH5 is an m6A RNA demethylase that promotes TFEB expression by demethylating TFEB mRNA, thereby establishing a positive feedback axis with TFEB.
context.zh-TW: ALKBH5 是一種 m6A RNA 去甲基化酵素，藉由使 TFEB 的 mRNA 去甲基化來促進 TFEB 表現，因而與 TFEB 建立正回饋軸。

context.en-US: ALKBH5 is an m6A demethylase that removes m6A Modification from mRNA, acting in opposition to the m6A methyltransferase METTL3. It regulates RNA metabolism including splicing, export, and stability.
context.zh-TW: ALKBH5 是 m6A 去甲基化酵素，可移除 mRNA 上的 m6A Modification，作用方向與 m6A 甲基轉移酶 METTL3 相反。它調控 RNA 代謝，包括剪接、輸出與穩定性。

context.en-US: AP2 is recruited to autolysosomal microdomains enriched in PtdIns(4,5)P2 during Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, where it nucleates clathrin coats that drive the membrane tubulation producing proto-lysosomes. Depletion of AP2 subunits impairs tubule formation and lysosome reformation.
context.zh-TW: 在 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 過程中，AP2 會被招募到富含 PtdIns(4,5)P2 的自噬溶酶體微區，並在該處成核形成 clathrin 衣被以驅動產生 proto-lysosome 的膜管形成。AP2 次單元耗竭會損害膜管形成與溶酶體再形成。

context.en-US: AP2's engagement with membranes is lipid-dependent: it binds PtdIns(4,5)P2 microdomains at the autolysosomal surface, where phosphorylation of its mu2 subunit by AAK1/GAK cooperatively opens the complex into an active, cargo-engaging conformation that nucleates clathrin coats.
context.zh-TW: AP2 與膜的結合依賴脂質：它在自噬溶酶體表面結合 PtdIns(4,5)P2 微區，並由 AAK1/GAK 磷酸化其 mu2 次單元，協同將複合體開啟為可結合貨物的活化構形，藉此成核 clathrin 衣被。

context.en-US: AP2-mediated Autophagic Lysosome Reformation generates proto-lysosomes that replenish the lysosomal compartment and sustain Autophagic Flux. Defects in AP2 or its PtdIns(4,5)P2 cue perturb Autophagy resolution, producing swollen, digestion-incompetent vacuoles.
context.zh-TW: AP2 媒介的 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 會產生 proto-lysosome，補充溶酶體池並維持 Autophagic Flux。AP2 或其 PtdIns(4,5)P2 訊號缺陷會擾動 Autophagy 的分解，出現腫大且無法進行消化的液泡。

context.en-US: AP4 is required for Autophagic Lysosome Reformation: it delivers lysosomal membrane proteins such as LAMP1 and LAMP2 from the trans-Golgi network to the reforming autolysosomal tubules, maintaining membrane identity and hydrolase competence. Loss of AP4 produces ALR defects, enlarged vacuoles, and reduced Autophagic Flux.
context.zh-TW: AP4 對 Autophagic Lysosome Formation 而言是必要的：它將 LAMP1、LAMP2 等溶酶體膜蛋白從 trans-Golgi network 運送至再形成的自噬溶酶體膜管，維持膜身分與水解酵素能力。AP4 缺失會造成 ALR 缺陷、液泡腫大與 Autophagic Flux 下降。

context.en-US: AP4 enriches lysosomal membrane proteins such as LAMP1 and LAMP2 at sites of autolysosomal tubulation, ensuring that regenerated lysosomes are properly equipped for degradation. Patient fibroblasts with biallelic AP4 mutations show mistrafficked LAMP proteins.
context.zh-TW: AP4 在自噬溶酶體管化的位點富集 LAMP1 與 LAMP2 等溶酶體膜蛋白，確保再生的溶酶體具備正確的降解能力。帶有 AP4 雙等位突變的患者纖維母細胞可見 LAMP 蛋白運送錯誤。

context.en-US: AP4 lacks the clathrin-binding slots of AP1/AP2 and instead builds uncoated vesicles and tubules destined for late endosomes/lysosomes. During Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, AP4 complements AP2, which provides the clathrin coat, by supplying the correct lysosomal cargo.
context.zh-TW: AP4 不具 AP1/AP2 的 clathrin 結合槽，而是與 gadkin 等因子合作，形成運送至晚期內體/溶酶體的無衣被囊泡與膜管。在 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 中，AP4 提供正確的溶酶體貨載，作為提供 clathrin 衣被的 AP2 的補充。

context.en-US: Abemaciclib (LY2835219) is a selective CDK4/CDK6 inhibitor with pharmacology distinct from Palbociclib: higher potency, a continuous dosing schedule, and the ability to cross the blood-brain barrier.
context.zh-TW: Abemaciclib（LY2835219）是選擇性的 CDK4/CDK6 抑制劑，其藥理特性與 Palbociclib 不同：效力較高、採連續給藥，且能通過血腦障蔽。

context.en-US: Abemaciclib, like Palbociclib, specifically inhibits CDK4/CDK6 and induces TFEB-dependent lysosomal biogenesis by inhibiting the nuclear export of TFEB, so blocking CRM1-mediated export raises nuclear TFEB activity.
context.zh-TW: Abemaciclib 與 Palbociclib 類似，能專一性抑制 CDK4/CDK6，並藉由抑制 TFEB 的核輸出而誘導 TFEB 依賴性的溶酶體生成，因此阻斷 CRM1 媒介的輸出會提高核內 TFEB 活性。

context.en-US: Abemaciclib induces Autophagy in cancer cells, and combining it with autophagy inhibition enhances cytotoxicity. It also inhibits mTORC1 through CDK4/6-mediated regulation of TSC2.
context.zh-TW: Abemaciclib 在癌細胞中誘導 Autophagy，將其與自噬抑制劑併用可增強細胞毒性。它也透過 CDK4/6 媒介的 TSC2 調控而抑制 mTORC1。

context.en-US: Autophagy facilitates adaptive immune cell activation and differentiation, and regulates antigen presentation, lymphocyte survival, and immune memory. Autophagy inducers such as Spermidine can rejuvenate B cell responses and enhance production of virus-specific memory CD8+ T cells.
context.zh-TW: Autophagy 促進適應性免疫細胞的活化與分化，並調控抗原呈現、淋巴球存活與免疫記憶。Spermidine 等 Autophagy inducer 可活化 B 細胞反應，並增強病毒特異性記憶型 CD8+ T cell 的產生。

context.en-US: As an autophagy inducer, Spermidine rejuvenates B cell responses and enhances the production of virus-specific memory CD8+ T cells, countering the decline of adaptive immunity with age (immune aging).
context.zh-TW: 作為自噬誘導劑，Spermidine 可活化 B 細胞反應並增強病毒特異性記憶型 CD8+ T cell 的產生，抵銷適應性免疫隨年齡衰退的現象（immune aging）。

context.en-US: Adrenoleukodystrophy is caused by mutations in the ABCD1 gene, which encodes a transporter responsible for moving very long-chain fatty acids into the peroxisome for degradation. Loss of this transporter impairs peroxisomal lipid turnover and causes toxic VLCFA accumulation.
context.zh-TW: Adrenoleukodystrophy 由 ABCD1 基因突變造成；該基因編碼的運輸蛋白負責將 very long-chain fatty acids 運入 Peroxisome 進行降解。此運輸蛋白喪失會損害過氧化體脂質周轉，造成 VLCFA 的毒性累積。

context.en-US: In Adrenoleukodystrophy, defective VLCFA transport impairs peroxisomal lipid turnover and Beta-Oxidation, and impaired Autophagy contributes to neuroinflammation and demyelination.
context.zh-TW: 在 Adrenoleukodystrophy 中，VLCFA 運輸缺陷損害過氧化體脂質周轉與 Beta-Oxidation，而受損的 Autophagy 會促成神經發炎與脫髓鞘化。

context.en-US: Ambra-1 is a scaffold protein that bridges Beclin1 to the ULK1 complex, coordinating autophagosome nucleation as a positive regulator of the PI3K III complex.
context.zh-TW: Ambra-1 是支架蛋白，將 Beclin1 與 ULK1 複合體連結起來，作為 PI3K III 複合體的正向調節因子來協調自噬體成核。

context.en-US: Ambra-1 links autophagy to the Cytoskeleton via interactions with dynein and myosin, and it is phosphorylated by ULK1 during starvation, which releases it from the dynein complex to enable Beclin1 activation.
context.zh-TW: Ambra-1 透過與 dynein、myosin 的交互作用把自噬與 Cytoskeleton 連結起來；在飢餓時它受 ULK1 磷酸化，因而從 dynein 複合體釋放，使 Beclin1得以活化。

context.en-US: During starvation ULK1 phosphorylates Ambra-1, releasing it from the dynein complex so that Beclin1 can be activated and autophagosome nucleation can proceed.
context.zh-TW: 在飢餓期間，ULK1 磷酸化 Ambra-1，使其從 dynein 複合體釋放，讓 Beclin1 能被活化並進行自噬體成核。

context.en-US: Atg1 is a conserved serine/threonine kinase that plays a central role in the initiation of Autophagy in response to nutrient deprivation. It is ULK1 in mammals and nucleates the Autophagosome once mTORC1 dissociates during starvation.
context.zh-TW: Atg1 是保守的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，在營養缺乏時於 Autophagy 的起始扮演核心角色。它在哺乳類即為 ULK1，並在飢餓時 mTORC1 解離後成核形成 Autophagosome。

context.en-US: Atg1 is part of the Atg1-Atg13-Atg17-Atg101 complex that receives nutrient signals from mTORC1. Under nutrient-rich conditions mTORC1 phosphorylates Atg13, inhibiting Atg1 activity; during starvation mTORC1 dissociates and unleashes Atg1 kinase activity.
context.zh-TW: Atg1 是接收 mTORC1 營養訊號的 Atg1-Atg13-Atg17-Atg101 複合體的一部分。在營養充足時 mTORC1 磷酸化 Atg13 而抑制 Atg1 活性；飢餓時 mTORC1 解離，釋放 Atg1 的激酶活性。

context.en-US: Atg12 is a ubiquitin-like protein covalently conjugated to Atg5 through a process requiring the E1-like enzyme Atg7 and the E2-like enzyme Atg10. The resulting Atg12-Atg5 conjugate then interacts with Atg16 to form a large multimeric complex.
context.zh-TW: Atg12 是一種類泛素蛋白，透過需要 E1 類酵素 Atg7 與 E2 類酵素 Atg10 的反應，與 Atg5 形成共價結合。形成的 Atg12-Atg5 結合物再與 Atg16 交互作用，組成大型多聚複合體。

context.en-US: The Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 complex acts as an E3-like ligase for the lipidation of LC3 (Atg8), promoting its attachment to the Autophagosome membrane; the complex is required for phagophore elongation and dissociates once the autophagosome is completed.
context.zh-TW: Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 複合體作為 E3 類連接酶促進 LC3（Atg8）的脂化，使其附著到 Autophagosome 膜上；此複合體為吞噬泡延長所需，並在自噬體完成後自膜上解離。

context.en-US: Atg16 non-covalently binds the Atg12-Atg5 conjugate; this complex multimerizes and localizes to the expanding phagophore, functioning as an E3-like enzyme that specifies the site of LC3-II formation and facilitates conjugation of LC3 to phosphatidylethanolamine on the Autophagosome membrane.
context.zh-TW: Atg16 以非共價方式結合 Atg12-Atg5 結合物；此複合體多聚化並定位於擴張中的吞噬泡，作為 E3 類酵素指定 LC3-II 形成的位點，促進 LC3 與 phosphatidylethanolamine 在 Autophagosome 膜上的結合。

context.en-US: Atg16L1 is a critical component of the Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 complex, which acts as an E3-like enzyme to facilitate conjugation of Atg8 family proteins such as LC3 to the autophagosomal membrane during the elongation phase of Autophagy.
context.zh-TW: Atg16L1 是 Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 複合體的關鍵組成；該複合體作為 E3 類酵素，在 Autophagy 的延長階段促進 LC3 等 Atg8 家族蛋白與自噬體膜的結合。

context.en-US: The T300A variant of Atg16L1 is a risk factor for Crohn's Disease, linking impaired Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1-dependent LC3 lipidation to intestinal inflammatory disease.
context.zh-TW: Atg16L1 的 T300A 變異是 Crohn's Disease 的風險因子，將 Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 依賴的 LC3 脂化受損與腸道發炎性疾病連結起來。

context.en-US: Atg17 (FIP200 in mammals) is a scaffold protein that forms a complex with Atg13 and Atg101 to recruit Atg1/ULK1. It acts as a starvation sensor, is essential for autophagosome formation, and defines the phagophore assembly site.
context.zh-TW: Atg17（哺乳類為 FIP200）是支架蛋白，與 Atg13、Atg101 形成複合體以招募 Atg1/ULK1。它是 Starvation 感測器，對自噬體形成不可或缺，並界定吞噬泡組裝位點。

context.en-US: Atg5 is essential for T Cell survival and proliferation. Atg5-deficient T cells are incapable of autophagy initiation, which abrogates the differentiation towards a regulatory Foxp3+ phenotype induced by Spermidine.
context.zh-TW: Atg5 對 T Cell 的存活與增殖不可或缺。缺乏 Atg5 的 T cell 無法起始自噬，因而阻斷 Spermidine 誘導的調控型 Foxp3+ 表現型分化。

context.en-US: SIRT1 forms a molecular complex with Atg5, Atg7 and Atg8, and transiently increased expression of SIRT1 is sufficient to stimulate basal rates of autophagy; SIRT1 also interacts with the Cullin 4B-Ring E3 ligase complex, which promotes autophagy of cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 與 Atg5、Atg7、Atg8 形成分子複合體，而 SIRT1 的短暫表現增加即足以刺激基礎自噬速率；SIRT1 亦與 Cullin 4B-Ring E3 連接酶複合體交互作用，後者可促進癌細胞的自噬。

context.en-US: Atg9 is the only transmembrane ATG protein and a carrier for membrane delivery to the expanding Autophagosome during biogenesis. It cycles between the Golgi, endosomes, and the phagophore assembly site, and is essential for both Macroautophagy and selective autophagy pathways.
context.zh-TW: Atg9 是唯一的跨膜 ATG 蛋白，在自噬體生成過程中負責將膜運送至擴張中的 Autophagosome。它在 Golgi、內體與吞噬泡組裝位點之間循環，且對 Macroautophagy 與選擇性自噬途徑皆不可或缺。

context.en-US: Atg9 cycling between the Golgi, endosomes, and the phagophore assembly site is controlled by the Atg1/ULK1 and Atg2 complexes, which thereby determine membrane delivery to the forming autophagosome.
context.zh-TW: Atg9 在 Golgi、內體與吞噬泡組裝位點之間的循環受 Atg1/ULK1 與 Atg2 複合體調控，藉此決定膜如何運送至形成中的自噬體。

context.en-US: An Autolysosome is a hybrid organelle formed by fusion of an Autophagosome with a Lysosome, mediated by SNARE proteins (STX17, SNAP29, VAMP8). Acidic lysosomal hydrolases then degrade the inner membrane and the sequestered cytoplasmic cargo.
context.zh-TW: Autolysosome 是由 Autophagosome 與 Lysosome 融合形成的混合胞器，此過程由 SNARE proteins（STX17、SNAP29、VAMP8）媒介。隨後酸性的溶酶體水解酵素分解內膜與被隔離的細胞質貨載。

context.en-US: After degradation, autolysosomes undergo Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, a process that regenerates functional lysosomes from the hybrid organelle. ALR depends on AMPK, mTORC1 reactivation, and clathrin-mediated budding.
context.zh-TW: 降解完成後，autolysosome 會進行 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation，由該混合胞器再生出可運作的溶酶體。ALR 依賴 AMPK、mTORC1 再活化與 clathrin 媒介的出芽。

context.en-US: SNARE proteins (STX17, SNAP29, VAMP8) mediate fusion of the Autophagosome outer membrane with a Lysosome to produce an Autolysosome; modifications that reduce SNAP29 interaction with Stx17 and VAMP8 inhibit SNARE complex assembly and Autolysosome formation.
context.zh-TW: SNARE proteins（STX17、SNAP29、VAMP8）媒介 Autophagosome 外膜與 Lysosome 融合以形成 Autolysosome；降低 SNAP29 與 Stx17、VAMP8 交互作用的修飾會抑制 SNARE 複合體組裝與 Autolysosome 形成。

context.en-US: The Autophagosome is the double-membrane vesicle that forms the central structure of Macroautophagy. It sequesters cytoplasmic cargo such as damaged organelles or protein aggregates and delivers it to the Lysosome for degradation.
context.zh-TW: Autophagosome 是構成 Macroautophagy 核心結構的雙層膜囊泡。它隔離受損胞器或蛋白聚集體等細胞質貨載，並將其送至 Lysosome 降解。

context.en-US: Autophagosome formation is regulated by the Atg machinery, including the ULK1 complex and the PI3K/Vps34 complex, and nucleation requires both ULK1 and PI3K activity. Completed autophagosomes then translocate toward the cell center and fuse with lysosomes or endosomes.
context.zh-TW: Autophagosome 的形成受 Atg 機制調控，包含 ULK1 複合體與 PI3K/Vps34 複合體，且成核需要 ULK1 與 PI3K 活性。完成的自噬體隨後移向細胞中央，並與溶酶體或內體融合。

context.en-US: LC3 (Atg8) is lipidated to LC3-II and incorporated into the autophagosomal membrane, serving as the standard marker for autophagosomes; SIRT1 promotes autophagy of cancer cells by reducing acetylation of LC3.
context.zh-TW: LC3（Atg8）經脂化形成 LC3-II 並納入自噬體膜，是自噬體的標準標記；SIRT1 藉由降低 LC3 的乙醯化來促進癌細胞的自噬。

context.en-US: An autophagy inhibitor is a compound that blocks autophagic flux. Classes include lysosomotropic agents (Chloroquine, Hydroxychloroquine, Bafilomycin A1), PI3K inhibitors, ULK1 inhibitors (SBI-0206965, MRT68921), and ATG4 inhibitors.
context.zh-TW: 自噬抑制劑是阻斷自噬流的化合物。其類別包括溶酶體親和性藥物（Chloroquine、Hydroxychloroquine、Bafilomycin A1）、PI3K 抑制劑、ULK1 抑制劑（SBI-0206965、MRT68921）以及 ATG4 抑制劑。

context.en-US: Eltrombopag is a direct inhibitor of TFEB: it disrupts TFEB's interaction with DNA, preventing induction of autophagy genes and thereby blocking autophagic flux.
context.zh-TW: Eltrombopag 是 TFEB 的直接抑制劑：它破壞 TFEB 與 DNA 的交互作用，阻斷自噬基因的誘導，因而阻斷自噬流。

context.en-US: BEC-1 is the C. elegans orthologue of the mammalian Beclin1 (and the yeast Atg6). It is a key regulator of Autophagy, part of the Class III Vps34 complex, and is required for autophagosome nucleation and for longevity extension by dietary restriction.
context.zh-TW: BEC-1 是 C. elegans 中哺乳類 Beclin1（以及酵母 Atg6）的同源基因。它是 Autophagy 的關鍵調節因子，屬於 Class III Vps34 複合體，並為自噬體成核與飲食限制延長壽命所必需。

context.en-US: BEC-1 is part of the Class III PI3K complex containing Vps34, through which it acts as a key regulator of Autophagy and is essential for nucleation of the Autophagosome in C. elegans.
context.zh-TW: BEC-1 是含有 Vps34 的 Class III PI3K 複合體的組成，藉此作為 Autophagy 的關鍵調節因子，並對 C. elegans 中 Autophagosome 的成核不可或缺。

context.en-US: While mitochondria handle the bulk of beta-oxidation for short and medium-chain fatty acids, the Peroxisome is the primary site for the preliminary beta-oxidation of very long-chain fatty acids, shortening these large lipids before they can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation.
context.zh-TW: 雖然短鏈與中鏈脂肪酸的 beta-oxidation 主要由粒線體處理，但 Peroxisome 是 very long-chain fatty acids 初步 beta-oxidation 的主要場所，先將這些大型脂質縮短，之後才能進入粒線體進行完全氧化。

context.en-US: Genetic defects in the transporter ABCD1 impair peroxisomal beta-oxidation, leading to toxic accumulation of very long-chain fatty acids and severe metabolic diseases such as Zellweger syndrome and Adrenoleukodystrophy.
context.zh-TW: 運輸蛋白 ABCD1 的基因缺陷會損害過氧化體的 beta-oxidation，導致 very long-chain fatty acids 毒性累積，並造成 Zellweger syndrome 與 Adrenoleukodystrophy 等嚴重代謝疾病。

context.en-US: C. elegans is a transparent nematode used as a premier model organism in genetics and ageing research, with autophagy, insulin signaling (DAF-2) and nutrient sensing (mTOR) highly conserved with humans. It has provided critical insight into nutrient regulation of autophagy via HLH-30 and MXL-3.
context.zh-TW: C. elegans 是透明的線蟲，為遺傳學與老化研究的首要模式生物，其 Autophagy、胰島素訊號（DAF-2）與營養感測（mTOR）與人類高度保守。它透過 HLH-30 與 MXL-3 提供了營養調控自噬的重要洞見。

context.en-US: HLH-30, the C. elegans ortholog of TFEB and TFE3, translocates to the nucleus following starvation to up-regulate expression of the lysosomal lipases LIPL-1 and LIPL-3, which are key enzymes in Lipophagy.
