context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是 22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a／B1b 大環內酯，為 Avermectin 的衍生物；Avermectin 由大村智 Sato 團隊在北里研究所從一份日本土壤樣本中分離，並與 Merck 共同開發。它活化寄生蟲的麩胺酸門控氯離子通道，造成氯離子內流與神經元超極化、GABA 釋放與體肌麻痺。

source_document: _document_ - Ivermectin, ‘Wonder drug’ from Japan the human use perspective.md

subject: Ivermectin

context.en-US: Ivermectin became the drug of choice for onchocerciasis because of its potent microfilaricidal effect, absence of severe side effects and excellent safety; a single annual oral dose of 150 μg/kg reduces skin microfilariae to zero and, by interfering with worm embryogenesis, delays the build-up of new microfilariae for up to two years. It is the sole tool in onchocerciasis elimination campaigns.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 因具強效的殺微絲蟲作用、缺乏嚴重副作用且安全性優異，而成為 Onchocerciasis 的首選藥物；每年單次口服 150 μg/kg 即可將皮膚微絲蟲降至零，並藉干擾蟲體胚胎發生延緩新微絲蟲累積長達兩年。它是河盲症根除計畫中唯一的防治工具。

source_document: _document_ - Ivermectin, ‘Wonder drug’ from Japan the human use perspective.md

subject: Ivermectin

context.en-US: Avermectin originated solely from a single microorganism isolated from Japanese soil by researchers at the Kitasato Institute and sent to Merck's laboratories in 1974; despite decades of worldwide searching, that Japanese microorganism remains the only known source of avermectin ever found. TDR later funded the cattle screening networks in which ivermectin was shown to be effective against Onchocerca.
context.zh-TW: Avermectin 唯一源自北里研究所（Kitasato Institute）研究者自一份日本土壤中分離的單一微生物，並於 1974 年送至 Merck 實驗室；數十年來全球搜尋後，該日本微生物仍是阿維菌素唯一已知來源。TDR 之後資助了牛隻篩檢網絡，Ivermectin 在其中被證實對 Onchocerca 有效。

source_document: _document_ - Ivermectin, ‘Wonder drug’ from Japan the human use perspective.md

subject: melittin

context.en-US: Honeybee venom and its major component melittin suppress activation of EGFR and HER2 by interfering with receptor phosphorylation in the plasma membrane of breast carcinoma cells. Immunoblotting showed downregulation of p-EGFR (Tyr1068), p-HER2 (Tyr1248), p-p44/42 MAPK, p-Akt, p-JNK and p-p38 MAPK within 5-20 minutes, and BRET data indicate melittin sits within 10 nm of the receptor without occupying the EGF-binding site.
context.zh-TW: 蜂蜜蜂毒及其主要成分 melittin 藉干擾乳癌細胞細胞膜上的受體磷酸化，抑制 EGFR 與 HER2 的活化。免疫 blot 顯示在 5 至 20 分鐘內 p-EGFR（Tyr1068）、p-HER2（Tyr1248）、p-p44/42 MAPK、p-Akt、p-JNK 與 p-p38 MAPK 均被下調；BRET 數據則顯示 melittin 位於受體 10 nm 範圍內，但未占據 EGF 結合位。

source_document: _document_ - Honeybee venom and melittin suppress growth factor receptor activation in HER2-enriched and triple-negative breast cancer - npj Precision Oncology.md

subject: melittin

context.en-US: Melittin and docetaxel showed strong synergistic interaction (combination indices below 1) in the murine p53-negative TNBC line T11, and combination treatment in a BALB/c allograft model gave superior tumor control than either agent alone, reducing proliferation (Ki-67) and raising TUNEL positivity. Melittin also reduced the immune-checkpoint protein PD-L1 in tumors, attenuating immune evasion.
context.zh-TW: Melittin 與 docetaxel 在小鼠 p53 陰性的三陰性乳癌 T11 細胞中呈現強烈協同作用（組合指數低於 1），且在 BALB/c 同種移植模型中，併用比任一單獨用藥的腫瘤控制更佳，同時降低增殖（Ki-67）並提高 TUNEL 陽性率。Melittin 亦降低腫瘤中的免疫檢查點蛋白 PD-L1，減弱免疫逃脫。

source_document: _document_ - Honeybee venom and melittin suppress growth factor receptor activation in HER2-enriched and triple-negative breast cancer - npj Precision Oncology.md

subject: melittin

context.en-US: RGD1-melittin is a bifunctional peptide created by engineering an N-terminal alpha-helical RGD motif derived from TGF-β3 (HGRGDLGRLKK) onto melittin. The RGD motif engages αvβ6 and αvβ3 integrins overexpressed on breast cancer membranes and tumor vasculature, widening the therapeutic window between normal and TNBC cells (IC50 ratio 2.73 versus 1.76) without loss of potency, and confining melittin localization to the plasma membrane.
context.zh-TW: RGD1-melittin 是將源自 TGF-β3（HGRGDLGRLKK）的 N 端 α 螺旋 RGD 模體接在 melittin 上所設計的雙功能胜肽。該 RGD 模體與乳癌細胞膜及腫瘤血管上過度表現的 αvβ6 與 αvβ3 integrins 結合，在不降低效力的前提下擴大正常細胞與三陰性乳癌之間的治療窗（IC50 比值 2.73 對 1.76），並使 melittin 的分布侷限於細胞膜。

source_document: _document_ - Honeybee venom and melittin suppress growth factor receptor activation in HER2-enriched and triple-negative breast cancer - npj Precision Oncology.md

context.en-US: siRNA are 20-25 base-pair double-stranded RNA molecules that operate within the RNA interference pathway, where they guide degradation of complementary mRNA and thereby silence gene expression. Delivering siRNA is also a standard way to test gene function in cancer models before committing to a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: siRNA 是約 20-25 鹼基對的雙股 RNA 分子，在 RNA Interference 路徑中作用，引導互補 mRNA 的降解，進而靜默基因表現。在癌症模型中遞送 siRNA，也是在投入治療標的前檢測基因功能的標準做法。

context.en-US: Oxfendazole (fenbendazole sulfoxide) is the primary active sulfoxide metabolite of Fenbendazole, oxidized from the parent drug in the liver and reducible back to it, so the two form a reversible hepatic redox pair that is further metabolized to fenbendazole sulfone.
context.zh-TW: Oxfendazole（fenbendazole sulfoxide）是 Fenbendazole 的主要活性硫氧化物代謝物，在肝臟中由母藥氧化而得，並可被還原回去，因此兩者形成可逆的肝臟氧化還原配對，之後進一步被代謝為 fenbendazole sulfone。

context.en-US: Oxfendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic, sitting alongside the sister benzimidazoles Albendazole and Mebendazole, and is handled by the same class of hepatic metabolizing enzymes, which is why it shares their drug-interaction and toxicology profile.
context.zh-TW: Oxfendazole 是 benzimidazole 類的驅蟲藥，與姊妹藥 Albendazole 及 Mebendazole 同屬此類，並由同一類肝臟代謝酵素處理，因此共享其藥物交互作用與毒理學特性。

context.en-US: Tubulin is the direct molecular target of Oxfendazole: the drug binds beta-tubulin and prevents it from assembling into microtubules, which in helminths paralyzes glucose uptake and in rapidly dividing tumor cells disrupts the mitotic spindle, arresting cells in metaphase and triggering mitotic catastrophe and Apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: Tubulin 是 Oxfendazole 的直接分子標的：該藥與 beta-tubulin 結合並阻止其組裝成 microtubule，在蠕蟲中使葡萄糖攝取麻痺，在快速分裂的腫瘤細胞中則破壞紡錘體，使細胞停滯於中期，誘發有絲分裂災難與 Apoptosis。

context.en-US: By inhibiting Microtubule polymerization, Oxfendazole reproduces the mechanism of clinically used tubulin-binding chemotherapy such as taxanes and vinca alkaloids, which is what makes it a low-cost candidate for repurposing as an anticancer agent in tumors with high proliferative index.
context.zh-TW: 藉由抑制 Microtubule 聚合，Oxfendazole 重現了 taxanes 與 vinca alkaloids 等臨床抗微管化療藥的機制，這正是它作為抗癌藥再定位候選、成本低廉的原因，尤其適用於增殖指數高的腫瘤。

context.en-US: Like other benzimidazoles, Oxfendazole is metabolized by Cytochrome P450 enzymes including CYP2C19 and the cardiac isoform CYP2J2, which shapes drug exposure and the potential for drug-drug interactions during repurposing trials.
context.zh-TW: 與其他 benzimidazole 類藥物相同，Oxfendazole 由包括 CYP2C19 與心臟型 CYP2J2 在內的 Cytochrome P450 酵素代謝，這會影響藥物暴露量以及再定位試驗中的潛在藥物交互作用。

context.en-US: TLR4 is a pattern recognition receptor of the Innate Immune System that specifically recognizes the PAMP LPS from Gram-negative bacteria; the same receptor also senses host-derived DAMPs such as ATP, HMGB1 and uric acid, blurring the PAMP-versus-DAMP boundary.
context.zh-TW: TLR4 是 Innate Immune System 的模式辨識受體，專一性辨識來自革蘭氏陰性菌的 PAMP——LPS；同一受體也能感知宿主來源的 DAMP，例如 ATP、HMGB1 與尿酸，模糊了 PAMP 與 DAMP 的界線。

context.en-US: RIG-I, together with MDA5, is a cytosolic pattern recognition receptor that detects PAMP in the form of viral RNA, contributing to type I interferon induction; by contrast, cGAS senses cytosolic DNA of microbial origin.
context.zh-TW: RIG-I 與 MDA5 一起作為胞質內的模式辨識受體，偵測以病毒 RNA 形式存在的 PAMP，參與第一型干擾素的誘導；相對地，cGAS 則偵測微生物來源的胞質 DNA。

context.en-US: PAMP are conserved microbial motifs absent from host cells; their engagement of pattern recognition receptors such as TLRs, NOD-like receptors and RLRs is what activates the Innate Immune System and triggers an inflammatory response.
context.zh-TW: PAMP 是微生物特有、宿主細胞不具的保守分子基序；它們與 TLR、NOD-like receptors、RLR 等模式辨識受體結合，正是啟動 Innate Immune System 並引發發炎反應的原因。

context.en-US: Inflammation is the direct downstream consequence of PAMP recognition: PRR signalling sets in motion NF-κB-driven cytokine release, and chronic infection-driven inflammation sustained by PAMP signalling is a documented contributor to Tumorigenesis in H. pylori-associated gastric cancer, HPV-associated cervical cancer and HBV/HCV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
context.zh-TW: Inflammation 是 PAMP 辨識後的直接下游結果：PRR 訊號啟動 NF-κB 驅動的細胞激素釋放，而由 PAMP 訊號維持的慢性感染發炎，則是 H. pylori 相關胃癌、HPV 相關子宮頸癌與 HBV/HCV 相關肝細胞癌中已被記錄的 Tumorigenesis 促成因素。

context.en-US: cGAS senses cytosolic DNA and does not distinguish its origin: microbial DNA functions as a PAMP while host-derived cytosolic DNA functions as a DAMP, so cGAS is a shared node for both branches of the cGAS-STING pathway.
context.zh-TW: cGAS 偵測胞質 DNA 且不區分其來源：微生物 DNA 扮演 PAMP，宿主來源的胞質 DNA 則扮演 DAMP，因此 cGAS 是 cGAS-STING 訊號路徑兩條分支的共同節點。

context.en-US: PKA phosphorylates the initiator Caspase-9 at Ser99, Ser183 and Ser195, modulating its stability and activity so as to dampen the intrinsic apoptotic program. This survival-toned phosphorylation can protect normal cells under stress but also supports Cancer cell survival and resistance to cell death.
context.zh-TW: PKA 會在 Ser99、Ser183 與 Ser195 磷酸化起始型 Caspase-9，調節其穩定性與活性，從而抑制內在性凋亡程式。這種偏向存活的磷酸化可保護受壓的正常細胞，但也能支持 Cancer 細胞存活與對細胞死亡的抵抗。

context.en-US: Bim is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member whose stability and activity are modulated by PKA phosphorylation. By phosphorylating Bim and other pro-apoptotic effectors, PKA reduces the apoptotic set-point of the cell, which is a mechanism tumors exploit to survive.
context.zh-TW: Bim 是促凋亡的 Bcl-2 家族成員，其穩定性與活性受 PKA 磷酸化調節。PKA 藉由磷酸化 Bim 及其他促凋亡效應蛋白，降低細胞的凋亡設定點，而腫瘤正是利用此機制得以存活。

context.en-US: PKA inhibits Apoptosis by phosphorylating pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members such as Bad and Bim and the apoptotic executioner Caspase-9. Dysregulation of this cAMP/PKA axis is implicated in endocrine tumors, leukemias and other malignancies, and blocking it is explored to sensitize tumors to Chemotherapy.
context.zh-TW: PKA 藉由磷酸化促凋亡的 Bcl-2 家族成員（如 Bad 與 Bim）以及凋亡執行者 Caspase-9 而抑制 Apoptosis。此 cAMP/PKA 軸的失調與內分泌腫瘤、白血病及其他惡性腫瘤有關，抑制此軸正被探索以提高腫瘤對 Chemotherapy 的敏感性。

context.en-US: PP1 counteracts CaMKII in death signaling: by dephosphorylating serines and threonines on Caspase-2 that CaMKII had activated, PP1 sets the threshold for PIDDosome-dependent Apoptosis downstream of DNA damage. CaMKII places the mark, PP1 removes it, and the balance between the two sets the apoptotic set-point.
context.zh-TW: 在死亡訊號中 PP1 與 CaMKII 相互對抗：PP1 將 CaMKII 活化的 Caspase-2 上的絲胺酸與蘇胺酸去磷酸化，因而設定 DNA 損傷下游 PIDDosome 依賴性 Apoptosis 的閾值。由 CaMKIA 加上標記、PP1 移除標記，兩者的平衡決定凋亡設定點。

context.en-US: PP1 regulates Caspase-2 by reversing phosphorylation, so in Cancer, where PP1 activity is frequently altered, both loss of tumor-suppressive dephosphorylation and ectopic activity that dampens apoptotic priming have been described. Substrate specificity is conferred by regulatory subunits such as spinophilin and inhibitor-1 rather than by the promiscuous catalytic core.
context.zh-TW: PP1 藉由逆轉磷酸化來調節 Caspase-2；在 Cancer 中 PP1 活性經常改變，無論是腫瘤抑制型去磷酸化的喪失，還是抑制凋亡預備狀態的異位活性，都已被描述。PP1 的受質專一性由 spinophilin 與 inhibitor-1 等調節次單元賦予，而非由本身具多效性的催化核心賦予。

context.en-US: Because PP1 integrates cAMP, calcium and stress signalling to maintain homeostasis, its activity levels directly shift the balance between survival and Apoptosis, a node that maps onto evasion of cell death among the Hallmarks of Cancer. Calyculin A and okadaic acid are research inhibitors; targeting specific PP1 holoenzymes would offer selectivity that catalytic inhibition cannot.
context.zh-TW: 由於 PP1 整合 cAMP、鈣離子與壓力訊號以維持恆定，其活性 level 直接左右存活與 Apoptosis 的平衡，此節點對應 Hallmarks of Cancer 中的細胞死亡逃逸。Calyculin A 與 okadaic acid 是研究用抑制劑；若能針對特定 PP1 全酵素，將可獲得催化抑制所沒有的選擇性。

context.en-US: PP1α is the alpha catalytic isoform of PP1, encoded by PPP1CA. Like all PP1 isoforms it carries the conserved PP1 catalytic fold with a beta12-alphaC loop binding two Mn2+/Fe2+ ions, but its substrate specificity comes from associated regulatory proteins recognizing RVxF motifs rather than from the catalytic core itself.
context.zh-TW: PP1α 是 PP1 的 alpha 催化異型，由 PPP1CA 編碼。與所有 PP1 異型相同，它帶有保守的 PP1 催化摺疊，其 beta12-alphaC 迴圈結合兩個 Mn2+/Fe2+ 離子；但其受質專一性來自辨識 RVxF 基序的結合調節蛋白，而非催化核心本身。

context.en-US: PP1α activates Caspase-9 by removing the inhibitory phosphate from Thr125 in the caspase-9 prodomain, a mark placed by survival kinases such as Akt and Rsk. Relieving that inhibition permits apoptosome-driven activation, making PP1α a pro-death phosphatase in the intrinsic apoptosis pathway.
context.zh-TW: PP1α 藉由移除 caspase-9 前結構域上 Thr125 的抑制性磷酸基（由 Akt 與 Rsk 等存活激酶加上）而活化 Caspase-9。解除該抑制後即可進行 apoptosome 驅動的活化，使 PP1α 在內在性凋亡路徑中成為促死亡的磷酸酶。

context.en-US: Through Caspase-9 activation, PP1α promotes Apoptosis. In Cancer, reduced PP1α access to Caspase-9, whether through scaffold competition or inhibitory phosphorylation of PP1α itself, blocks apoptosis and thereby supports evasion of cell death; enhancing PP1α activity is therefore proposed as a way to overcome Chemotherapy resistance.
context.zh-TW: PP1α 透過活化 Caspase-9 促進 Apoptosis。在 Cancer 中，PP1α 對 Caspase-9 的可及性下降——無論是支架競爭還是 PP1α 本身被抑制性磷酸化——都會阻斷凋亡並助長細胞死亡逃逸；因此提升 PP1α 活性被提出作為克服 Chemotherapy 抗藥性的方法。

context.en-US: Akt and PP1α act on the same Caspase-9 residue from opposite directions: Akt phosphorylates Thr125 and suppresses initiator caspase activity, whereas PP1α dephosphorylates that same site and releases the inhibition. The resulting balance determines apoptotic priming in tumor cells.
context.zh-TW: Akt 與 PP1α 從相反方向作用於 Caspase-9 的同一殘基：Akt 磷酸化 Thr125 並抑制起始型 caspase 活性，而 PP1α 則將同一位置去磷酸化並解除抑制。兩者的平衡決定腫瘤細胞的凋亡預備狀態。

context.en-US: PTPN2 (TC-PTP) is a ubiquitously expressed non-receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase belonging to the PTPN family, distinguished by an N-terminal catalytic domain with the conserved HCxxR motif and a C-terminal tail that directs nuclear/cytoplasmic localization and substrate engagement.
context.zh-TW: PTPN2（TC-PTP）是廣泛表現的非受體型蛋白酪胺酸磷酸酶，屬於 PTPN family，其特徵為帶有保守 HCxxR 基序的 N 端催化區，以及負責核質定位與受質招募的 C 端尾部。

context.en-US: Members of the PTPN family, including PTPN2, PTPN5 and PTPN23, are required for the dephosphorylation and inactivation of BAK at Tyr108 during anoikis in fibrosarcoma and Colon Cancer cells. BAK dephosphorylation is therefore a checkpoint that keeps unattached, damaged cells from committing to mitochondrial death.
context.zh-TW: PTPN family 的成員（包括 PTPN2、PTPN5 與 PTPN23）在纖維肉瘤與 Colon Cancer 細胞的失巢凋亡過程中，是 BAK 於 Tyr108 被去磷酸化並失活所必需。BAK 的去磷酸化因此成為一道檢查點，防止脫落且受損的細胞提交線粒體死亡。

context.en-US: PTPN23 (HD-PTP) is a PTPN family member distinguished from other members by an N-terminal Bro1 domain that links it to CHMP proteins of the ESCRT-III complex and to ubiquitinated cargo, allowing the phosphatase domain to couple death signalling to endosomal sorting.
context.zh-TW: PTPN23（HD-PTP）是 PTPN family 的成員，與其他成員不同的是它帶有 N 端 Bro1 結構域，可連結 ESCRT-III 複合體的 CHMP 蛋白與泛素化貨載，使磷酸酶區域能把死亡訊號與內體分選串接起來。

context.en-US: The Colon Cancer context is where PTPN family phosphatase activity was characterized mechanistically: PTPN2, PTPN5 and PTPN23 were identified as the phosphatases required for BAK inactivation in fibrosarcoma and Colon Cancer cells, tying this family to evasion of apoptosis as a cancer hallmark.
context.zh-TW: PTPN family 磷酸酶活性在機轉上被確認的背景正是 Colon Cancer：PTPN2、PTPN5 與 PTPN23 被確認為纖維肉瘤與 Colon Cancer 細胞中 BAK 失活所必需的磷酸酶，將此家族與作為癌症特徵的凋亡逃逸連結起來。

context.en-US: PTPN2 dephosphorylates JAK2 and STAT3, removing activating phosphotyrosines and thereby terminating cytokine and growth-factor signalling. Loss of PTPN2, frequent in colorectal, breast and leukemia contexts, permits sustained JAK/STAT and MAPK signalling that supports the Hallmarks of Cancer.
context.zh-TW: PTPN2 會將 JAK2 與 STAT3 去磷酸化，移除其活化性磷酸酪胺酸，藉此終止細胞激素與生長因子訊號。PTPN2 的喪失在結直腸癌、乳癌與白血病情境中相當常見，使 JAK/STAT 與 MAPK 訊號持續活化，支撐 Hallmarks of Cancer。

context.en-US: STAT3 is a principal substrate of PTPN2, whose dephosphorylation restrains cytokine-driven transcription. Because PTPN2 also acts on the pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein BAK, it links growth signalling to Apoptosis, and its deletion both sustains signalling and impairs cytotoxic T-cell priming in the tumor microenvironment, enabling Immune Evasion.
context.zh-TW: STAT3 是 PTPN2 的主要受質，被其去磷酸化後可抑制細胞激素驅動的轉錄。由於 PTPN2 也作用於促凋亡的 Bcl-2 家族蛋白 BAK，它把生長訊號與 Apoptosis 連結起來；其缺失不僅維持訊號活化，也損害腫瘤微環境中細胞毒性 T 細胞的起始，促成 Immune Evasion。

context.en-US: Intact PTPN2 suppresses Immune Evasion by permitting cytotoxic T-cell priming within the tumor; conversely, PTPN2 deletion or downregulation lets tumor cells escape immune killing. Pharmacologic inhibition (e.g. lictrestivint) is being explored to reverse this, enhancing checkpoint-blockade efficacy.
context.zh-TW: 完整的 PTPN2 藉由容許腫瘤內細胞毒性 T 細胞的起始而抑制 Immune Evasion；反之，PTPN2 的缺失或下調則讓腫瘤細胞逃過免疫殺傷。藥理抑制（如 lictrestivint）正被探索用來逆轉此現象以提升檢查點阻斷療法的效力。

context.en-US: PTPN2 dephosphorylates the pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein BAK, modulating its activation and thereby influencing Apoptosis. Because it is required for BAK inactivation at Tyr108, PTPN2 is positioned to dampen mitochondrial death commitment, which is why BAK-targeted death sensitization is often limited when PTPN2 is intact.
context.zh-TW: PTPN2 會將促凋亡的 Bcl-2 家族蛋白 BAK 去磷酸化，調節其活化程度，進而影響 Apoptosis。由於它是 BAK 於 Tyr108 失活所必需的酵素，PTPN2 得以抑制線粒體死亡承諾；這也是為何當 PTPN2 完整存在時，以 BAK 為標的的死亡致敏策略常受侷限。

context.en-US: Alongside JAK2 and STAT3, ERK is one of the signalling nodes whose activating phosphotyrosines PTPN2 removes, terminating proliferative and survival output. This makes PTPN2 a broad brake on oncogenic cascades rather than a pathway-specific inhibitor.
context.zh-TW: 與 JAK2、STAT3 並列，ERK 也是 PTPN2 移除其活化性磷酸酪胺酸以終止增殖與存活輸出的訊號節點。這使 PTPN2 成為癌化訊號級聯的廣泛煞車，而非路徑專一性抑制劑。

context.en-US: PTPN23 dephosphorylates and regulates the pro-apoptotic protein BAK, connecting trafficking control to mitochondrial death commitment. This Bak-regulating activity is required during anoikis in fibrosarcoma and Colon Cancer cells, where loss of PTPN23 permits survival of detached cells and evasion of Apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: PTPN23 會將促凋亡蛋白 BAK 去磷酸化並加以調節，把運輸調控與線粒體死亡承諾連結起來。這項 Bak 調節活性在纖維肉瘤與 Colon Cancer 細胞的失巢凋亡期間是必需的；PTPN23 喪失時，脫落的細胞得以存活並逃過 Apoptosis。

context.en-US: PTPN23 acts as a Tumor Suppressor Gene: by promoting lysosomal degradation of oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinases such as EGFR and restraining survival signalling, it suppresses proliferation and supports the death of damaged cells. Reduced PTPN23 expression is associated with aggressive disease and loss of apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: PTPN23 扮演 Tumor Suppressor Gene 的角色：藉由促進 EGFR 等致癌受體酪胺酸激酶的溶酶體降解並抑制存活訊號，它抑制增殖並支持受損細胞死亡。PTPN23 表現降低與侵襲性疾病及凋亡喪失相關。

context.en-US: Through its Bro1 domain, PTPN23 participates in multivesicular body biogenesis and lysosomal degradation of EGFR, downregulating the receptor and blunting the survival signalling it emits. Loss of this function lets EGFR signalling persist and contributes to the Hallmarks of Cancer.
context.zh-TW: PTPN23 透過其 Bro1 結構域參與多囊泡體生成與 EGFR 的溶酶體降解，使該受體下調並削弱其發出的存活訊號。此功能喪失時 EGFR 訊號得以持續，助長 Hallmarks of Cancer。

context.en-US: Pancreatic Beta Cells are the endocrine cells of the islets of Langerhans that synthesize and secrete Insulin in response to glucose. Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion couples glycolytic flux to granule exocytosis and requires intact mitochondrial function plus coordinated ERK and STAT3 signalling.
context.zh-TW: Pancreatic Beta Cells 是 Langerhans 島中負責合成並分泌 Insulin 的內分泌細胞。葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌將糖解通量與顆粒胞吐耦合，並需要完整的粒線體功能以及協調的 ERK 與 STAT3 訊號。

context.en-US: Humanin inhibits Apoptosis in beta cells, and the protective effect is transduced in an ERK- and STAT3-dependent manner. This links mitochondrial-derived peptide signalling to cytokine resistance, opposing the IL-1beta, TNFalpha and Interferon-gamma driven cell death triggered by infiltrating Lymphocytes and activated Macrophages in type 1 diabetes.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 在 beta 細胞中抑制 Apoptosis，且其保護作用經由 ERK 與 STAT3 依賴的方式傳遞。這把粒線體衍生胜肽訊號與細胞激素抗性連結起來，對抗第一型糖尿病中浸潤的 Lymphocytes 與活化的 Macrophages 所釋放 IL-1β、TNFα 與 Interferon-gamma 引發的細胞死亡。

context.en-US: In the islet, IL-1β released by infiltrating Lymphocytes and activated Macrophages induces Apoptosis in Pancreatic Beta Cells, alongside TNFalpha and Interferon-gamma. Progressive lymphocyte accumulation and beta-cell destruction are the central lesions of type 1 diabetes, and Humanin counteracts this cytokine-driven death.
context.zh-TW: 在胰島中，浸潤的 Lymphocytes 與活化的 Macrophages 釋放的 IL-1β 與 TNFα、Interferon-gamma 一同誘發 Pancreatic Beta Cells 的 Apoptosis。淋巴球逐漸累積與 beta 細胞破壞是第一型糖尿病的核心病灶，而 Humanin 可對抗這種細胞激素驅動的死亡。

context.en-US: The beta-cell survival signal delivered by Humanin requires both ERK and STAT3. Downstream of these kinases the mitochondrial-derived peptide connects peptide signalling to islet preservation, which is why MEK/ERK or STAT3 inhibition would be expected to blunt the protective effect.
context.zh-TW: Humanin 傳遞的 beta 細胞存活訊號同時需要 ERK 與 STAT3。在這兩個激酶下游，這個粒線體衍生胜肽把胜肽訊號與胰島保存連結起來，因此抑制 MEK/ERK 或 STAT3 預期會削弱其保護作用。

context.en-US: Ivermectin treats Pediculosis: topical 0.5% lotion or oral ivermectin at 200 micrograms/kg repeated in 7-10 days are used for pubic lice, and the drug is an alternative when permethrin resistance or poor compliance complicates head-lice treatment.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 可治療 Pediculosis：0.5% 外用洗劑或每公斤 200 微克、7 至 10 天後重複的口服 ivermectin 可用於陰蝨，而當 permethrin 抗藥性或依從性不佳使頭蝨治療複雜化時，此藥為替代選擇。

context.en-US: Pediculosis is driven by a hypersensitivity reaction to louse saliva, and the intense pruritus that follows causes persistent scratching, excoriations and secondary bacterial impetiginization with cervical or occipital lymphadenopathy. These lesions reflect local Inflammation around the feeding sites.
context.zh-TW: Pediculosis 由對蝨唾液的過敏反應驅動，隨後的劇烈搔癢造成持續抓破、擦傷與繼發性細菌膿皰病，並可伴隨頸部或枕部淋巴結腫大。這些病灶反映了叮咬處的局部 Inflammation。

context.en-US: Pediculosis carries a substantial infectious-disease burden because body lice transmit Rickettsia prowazekii (epidemic typhus), Bartonella quintana (trench fever) and Borrelia recurrentis (relapsing fever). These louse-borne diseases flourish under war, disaster, displacement and homelessness, making epidemic typhus a re-emerging threat.
context.zh-TW: Pediculosis 帶有相當的傳染病負擔，因為體蝨會傳播 Rickettsia prowazekii（流行性斑疹傷寒）、Bartonella quintana（戰壕熱）與 Borrelia recurrentis（回歸熱）。這些蝨媒疾病在戰爭、災害、流離失所與無家可歸情境下盛行，使流行性斑疹傷寒成為重新興起的威脅。

context.en-US: Polo kinase 3 phosphorylates the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-xL at Ser49 during cell cycle progression and at checkpoint states, altering Bcl-xL's capacity to restrain Apoptosis and tipping damaged cells toward mitochondrial death. The site is distinct from the Ser62 targeted by PLK1, marking Plk3 as a stress-coupled rather than mitotic-execution kinase.
context.zh-TW: Polo kinase 3 在細胞週期推進與檢查點狀態下於 Ser49 磷酸化抗凋亡蛋白 Bcl-xL，改變 Bcl-xL 抑制 Apoptosis 的能力，使受損細胞倒向線粒體死亡。此位點與 PLK1 所標的的 Ser62 不同，標示出 Plk3 是與壓力偶聯的激酶，而非執行有絲分裂者。

context.en-US: Polo kinase 3 promotes Apoptosis indirectly: Plk3 is induced by genotoxic and oxidative stress, activated through stress-kinase cascades, and its phosphorylation of Bcl-xL enforces the checkpoint by eliminating cells with unresolved damage. Loss or silencing of Plk3 in Cancer lets stressed cells survive, contributing to evasion of apoptosis and genomic instability.
context.zh-TW: Polo kinase 3 間接促進 Apoptosis：Plk3 由基因毒與氧化壓力誘導，經壓力激酶級聯活化，並藉由磷酸化 Bcl-xL 強制執行檢查點，淘汰損傷未解決的細胞。Plk3 在 Cancer 中喪失或被靜默時，受壓細胞得以存活，促成凋亡逃逸與基因體不穩定。

context.en-US: Polo kinase 3 is distinct from PLK1 despite family membership: PLK1 is the oncogenic mitotic execution kinase that phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62, whereas Plk3 is a tumor-suppressive stress sensor acting at Ser49. Care is needed not to conflate the two when interpreting polo-kinase biology.
context.zh-TW: Polo kinase 3 雖同屬家族，卻與 PLK1 明顯不同：PLK1 是致癌的有絲分裂執行激酶，作用於 Bcl-xL 的 Ser62；而 Plk3 則是作用於 Ser49 的腫瘤抑制性壓力感測器。解讀 polo 激酶生物學時須注意不可將兩者混為一談。

context.en-US: Propolis is produced by the Honeybee (Apis mellifera) by mixing plant exudates with beeswax and salivary enzymes, and is used inside the hive as a sealant and antimicrobial barrier. Its composition varies with geographic and plant source, yielding distinct types such as Brazilian green and European poplar propolis.
context.zh-TW: Propolis 由 Honeybee（Apis mellifera）將植物分泌物與蜂蠟、唾液酵素混合製成，在蜂巢內作為封閉劑與抗菌屏障使用。其成分隨地理與植物來源而異，形成巴西綠蜂膠與歐洲楊樹蜂膠等不同類型。

context.en-US: Propolis inhibits NF-κB, with its caffeic acid phenethyl ester (CAPE) acting as a potent inhibitor of NF-κB and of COX-2. This transcription-factor suppression is the shared mechanistic basis for both the anti-inflammatory and the anti-cancer activity attributed to propolis extracts.
context.zh-TW: Propolis 抑制 NF-κB，其中咖啡酸苯乙酯（CAPE）是 NF-κB 與 COX-2 的強效抑制劑。這種轉錄因子抑制，是 propolis 萃取物同時具有抗發炎與抗癌活性的共同機轉基礎。

context.en-US: Propolis induces Apoptosis in tumor models, with its phenolic component CAPE directly inducing apoptosis and inhibiting NF-κB. Combined with cell cycle arrest and modulation of PI3K/Akt and Wnt/beta-catenin signalling, this underlies the observed antiproliferative activity in Breast Cancer, Prostate Cancer, Colorectal Cancer, Melanoma and Glioblastoma cell lines.
context.zh-TW: Propolis 在腫瘤模型中誘發 Apoptosis，其酚類成分 CAPE 可直接誘發凋亡並抑制 NF-κB。搭配細胞週期停滯以及 PI3K/Akt 與 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號的調節，這構成了其在 Breast Cancer、Prostate Cancer、Colorectal Cancer、Melanoma 與 Glioblastoma 細胞株中所觀察到的抗增殖活性基礎。

context.en-US: Quercetin is a member of the flavonoid fraction of Propolis alongside Chrysin, Galangin, Pinocembrin and Apigenin. Flavonoids are the major bioactive class in propolis, and quercetin in particular is independently studied as a Senolytic.
context.zh-TW: Quercetin 與 Chrysin、Galangin、Pinocembrin 及 Apigenin 同屬 Propolis 的黃酮類成分。Flavonoids 是蜂膠中主要的活性化合物類別，而 quercetin 本身也被獨立研究為 Senolytic。

context.en-US: Propolis reduces Inflammation by lowering IL-6, TNF-alpha and IL-1beta production in activated macrophages and through its antioxidant activity. This anti-inflammatory arm runs parallel to the antiproliferative arm in the traditional-medicine use of bee glue.
context.zh-TW: Propolis 藉由降低活化巨噬細胞中 IL-6、TNF-α 與 IL-1β 的產生，並透過其抗氧化活性來減少 Inflammation。這條抗發炎路徑與傳統醫學使用蜂膠時的抗增殖路徑並行。

context.en-US: R-CHOP is the standard first-line regimen for Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, combining the anti-CD20 antibody rituximab with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, Vincristine and prednisone. It serves as the conventional comparator against which alternative or repurposed approaches are framed.
context.zh-TW: R-CHOP 是 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 的標準一線治療方案，將抗 CD20 抗體 rituximab 與 cyclophosphamide、doxorubicin、Vincristine 及 prednisone 合併。它也是評估替代或再定位療法時的常規對照基準。

context.en-US: Vincristine is the microtubule-targeting constituent of R-CHOP, a vinca alkaloid that disrupts the mitotic spindle in dividing cells. Its inclusion links the regimen to the same microtubule-disrupting logic exploited by microtubule-targeted repurposing candidates such as Fenbendazole.
context.zh-TW: Vincristine 是 R-CHOP 中作用於微管的成分，屬於 vinca alkaloid 類，能破壞分裂細胞的有絲分裂紡錘體。其納入使該方案與 Fenbendazole 等作用於微管再定位候選藥所利用的同一套微管破壞邏輯相連結。

context.en-US: RGD peptide is the minimal, most widespread cell-adhesion motif recognized by a subset of Integrins (alpha-v-beta-3, alpha-v-beta-5, alpha-5-beta-1). It adopts a loop conformation that fits the integrin ligand-binding pocket, mediating cell-ECM adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, survival and migration.
context.zh-TW: RGD peptide 是被部分 Integrins（αvβ3、αvβ5、α5β1）辨識的最小且最普遍的細胞黏附基序。它採取能嵌入 integrin 配體結合口袋的環狀構形，介導細胞－細胞外基質黏附、細胞骨架組織、存活與移行。

context.en-US: RGD peptide inhibits Angiogenesis when mimetics competitively block integrin engagement: alpha-v-beta-3 and alpha-v-beta-5 are markedly upregulated on tumor vasculature, and blocking their adhesion disrupts focal adhesions, reduces neovascularization and reduces Metastasis in preclinical models. Cilengitide carried this concept into glioblastoma trials.
context.zh-TW: 當模擬物以競爭性方式阻斷 integrin 結合時，RGD peptide 會抑制 Angiogenesis：αvβ3 與 αvβ5 在腫瘤血管上顯著上調，封鎖其黏附可破壞焦點黏著、減少新生血管形成並在臨床前模型中降低 Metastasis。Cilengitide 已將此概念帶入 glioblastoma 臨床試驗。

context.en-US: RGD-containing peptides are pro-apoptotic: competitive blockade of integrin-mediated adhesion by RGD mimetics induces anoikis, the detachment-induced Apoptosis of endothelial and tumor cells. Some of these peptides are additionally able to induce auto-activation of proCaspase-3 directly.
context.zh-TW: 含 RGD 的胜肽具有促凋亡作用：RGD 模擬物競爭性阻斷 integrin 介導的黏附，會誘發失巢凋亡，即內皮與腫瘤細胞脫落誘發的 Apoptosis。部分此類胜肽更能直接誘導 proCaspase-3 的自我活化。

context.en-US: RGD peptide contributes to Metastasis in reverse: integrin signalling through RGD sites on extracellular matrix proteins such as Fibronectin, Vitronectin and Fibrinogen enables sustained survival, Angiogenesis and invasion, supporting the Hallmarks of Cancer. Blocking the motif therefore reduces dissemination.
context.zh-TW: RGD peptide 在反方向上促成 Metastasis：透過 Fibronectin、Vitronectin 與 Fibrinogen 等細胞外基質蛋白上的 RGD 位點所進行的 integrin 訊號，能提供持續存活、Angiogenesis 與侵襲，支撐 Hallmarks of Cancer。因此封鎖此基序可減少散布。

context.en-US: SLC19A1 (Reduced Folate Carrier 1) transports the cyclic dinucleotide cGAMP into the cell. When one cell's cGAS produces cGAMP and it is exported, neighbouring cells import it through SLC19A1, propagating the paracrine type I interferon response and amplifying the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype in the Tumor Microenvironment.
context.zh-TW: SLC19A1（Reduced Folate Carrier 1）將環狀二核苷酸 cGAMP 運入細胞。當某細胞的 cGAS 產生 cGAMP 並被輸出後，鄰近細胞可經 SLC19A1 攝入它，傳播旁分泌性的第一型干擾素反應，並放大 Tumor Microenvironment 中的 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype。

context.en-US: SLC19A1 amplifies the cGAS-STING Pathway in a paracrine manner by importing extracellular cGAMP, allowing STING activation signals to be transferred between cells. Expression of SLC19A1 may therefore predict response to STING agonists, since import is the rate-limiting step in signal spread.
context.zh-TW: SLC19A1 藉由攝入細胞外 cGAMP，以旁分泌方式放大 cGAS-STING Pathway，使 STING 活化訊號能在細胞之間傳遞。因此 SLC19A1 的表現可能預測對 STING 致效劑的反應，因為攝入是訊號擴散的限速步驟。

context.en-US: Folate and its reduced forms are the endogenous substrates of SLC19A1, the primary importer of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, the major circulating folate form. The same transporter moves antifolate drugs into cells, which is why reduced SLC19A1 expression is a well-recognized mechanism of methotrexate resistance in leukemia and other cancers.
context.zh-TW: Folate 及其還原態是 SLC19A1 的內源性受質，該運輸蛋白是主要循環形態 5-甲基四氫葉酸的主要輸入者。同一運輸蛋白也將抗葉酸藥物運入細胞，因此 SLC19A1 表現降低是白血病及其他癌症中公認的 methotrexate 抗藥性機制。

context.en-US: The SV40 Large T antigen inactivates p53, a Tumor Suppressor Gene product, thereby blocking p53-dependent Apoptosis and cell-cycle arrest. In permissive models, expression of the T antigens is sufficient to immortalize cultured cells and drive tumor formation, making SV40 a classic tool for studying viral oncogenesis.
context.zh-TW: SV40 的 Large T antigen 使 p53 失活；p53 是 Tumor Suppressor Gene 產物，此舉阻斷 p53 依賴性的 Apoptosis 與細胞週期停滯。在許可性模型中，T antigen 的表現即足以使培養細胞永生化並誘發腫瘤形成，因此 SV40 是研究病毒致癌作用的經典工具。

context.en-US: SV40 Large T antigen binds and inactivates Rb, the retinoblastoma protein, releasing E2F to force S-phase entry. The virus acts on both arms of the p53 and Rb tumor-suppressor axis simultaneously, which is why the association of SV40 with human mesothelioma, Brain Cancer and osteosarcoma remains vigorously contested.
context.zh-TW: SV40 的 Large T antigen 與 Rb（視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白）結合並使其失活，釋放 E2F 強迫細胞進入 S 期。該病毒同時作用於 p53 與 Rb 兩條腫瘤抑制軸，這也是 SV40 與人類間皮瘤、Brain Cancer 及骨肉瘤之間的關聯仍受激烈爭議的原因。

context.en-US: SV40 Small t antigen perturbs PP2A, deregulating proliferative signalling alongside the Large T antigen's action on p53 and Rb. PP2A is one of the major cellular serine/threonine phosphatases, so its subversion is a classic route by which viral oncoproteins sustain proliferation.
context.zh-TW: SV40 的 Small t antigen 擾動 PP2A，與 Large T antigen 對 p53 與 Rb 的作用一起使增殖訊號失調。PP2A 是主要的細胞內絲胺酸/蘇胺酸磷酸酶之一，因此其被顛覆是病毒致癌蛋白維持增殖的典型途徑。

context.en-US: SV40 is a classic Oncogene model: its alternatively spliced early region encodes Large T and Small t antigens, whose experimental transformation activity is robust even though natural human infection appears to play at most a minor or unproven role in malignancy.
context.zh-TW: SV40 是典型的 Oncogene 模型：其選擇性剪接的早期區編碼 Large T 與 Small t antigen，這些蛋白在實驗中的轉化活性十分強健，儘管自然感染在人類中至多只扮演次要或未證實的角色。

context.en-US: Ivermectin treats Scabies orally at 200 micrograms/kg repeated after 7-14 days, and is the cornerstone of crusted (Norwegian) scabies, where combination therapy uses ivermectin on days 1, 2, 8, 9 and 15 together with topical permethrin and keratolytics to strip hyperkeratotic crusts and reduce mite burden.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 以每公斤 200 微克口服、7 至 14 天後重複的方式治療 Scabies，並是結痂型（Norwegian）scabies 的核心用藥；此型以聯合療法處理，在第 1、2、8、9、15 天給予 ivermectin，並搭配外用 permethrin 與角質溶解劑以去除角化過度結痂、降低蟎數。

context.en-US: Scabies produces a delayed type IV hypersensitivity reaction to mite feces, eggs and saliva, manifesting as nocturnal pruritus, inflammatory papules, nodules and excoriations. Transmission requires prolonged skin-to-skin contact, and mites surviving 24-36 hours off the host permit fomite spread via bedding and clothing.
context.zh-TW: Scabies 會對蟎的糞便、卵與唾液產生第四型遲發性過敏反應，表現為夜間劇癢、發炎性丘疹、結節與抓痕。傳播需要長時間的皮膚直接接觸，而蟎在離開宿主後可存活 24 至 36 小時，故可經寢具與衣物造成媒介散布。

context.en-US: HIV and other immunocompromising states predispose to crusted (Norwegian) Scabies, in which patients harbour thousands to millions of mites under thick hyperkeratotic crusts. The resulting high mite load makes the form extremely contagious and a source of institutional outbreaks.
context.zh-TW: HIV 與其他免疫功能受損狀態會使人易患結痂型（Norwegian）Scabies，此時患者在厚厚的角化過度結痂下寄居數千至數百萬隻蟎。極高的蟎數使此型傳染性極強，並成為機構內群聚爆發的來源。

context.en-US: Selamectin is a semi-synthetic Avermectin (25-cyclohexyl-5-deoxy-22,23-dihydro-5-hydroxyiminoavermectin B1) whose mono-saccharide 5-oxime structure, formed by removing one oleandrose sugar, reduces oral absorption and makes it a topical spot-on endectocide absorbed transdermally.
context.zh-TW: Selamectin 是半合成的 Avermectin（25-cyclohexyl-5-deoxy-22,23-dihydro-5-hydroxyiminoavermectin B1）；其單醣 5-oxime 結構由去除一個 oleandrose 糖而得，降低了口服吸收，因此被做成經皮吸收的外用 spot-on 內外寄生蟲防治劑。

context.en-US: Selamectin is the closest veterinary structural analog of Ivermectin, sharing the macrocyclic lactone core, the same opening of invertebrate glutamate- and GABA-gated chloride channels, and overlapping spectrum. It is formulated for young puppies and kittens and adds flea, ear-mite and sarcoptic mange coverage that ivermectin does not provide topically.
context.zh-TW: Selamectin 是 Ivermectin 最接近的獸用結構類似物，共用巨環內酯核心、同樣藉由開啟無脊椎動物的麩胺酸與 GABA 門控氯離子通道發揮作用，且光譜重疊。它被配製給幼犬幼貓使用，並額外提供 ivermectin 外用時所沒有的跳蚤、耳螨與疥癬 coverage。

context.en-US: Selamectin is a P-gp (MDR1/ABCB1) substrate, and the transporter-mediated restriction is what keeps its brain concentrations low. Substantially lower CNS penetration than Ivermectin, demonstrated even in P-glycoprotein-deficient Mdr1a/b and Bcrp knockout mice, gives Selamectin a wider safety margin in collie-type dogs homozygous for the ABCB1-1delta deletion.
context.zh-TW: Selamectin 是 P-gp（MDR1/ABCB1）的受質，正是這種運輸蛋白介導的限制使其腦中濃度維持低檔。與 Ivermectin 相比更低的腦部穿透，即使在缺乏 P 醣蛋白的 Mdr1a/b 與 Bcrp 剔除小鼠中也已證實，使 Selamectin 對帶有 ABCB1-1Δ 缺失同型合子的柯利牧羊犬有更寬的安全餘裕。

context.en-US: Selamectin competes with Ivermectin for the same veterinary indication, monthly heartworm prevention, but with a longer duration of action than Moxidectin and Doramectin in some labels. Unlike Fenbendazole, selamectin is the lactone option that also covers heartworm, while remaining inactive against ticks and tapeworms.
context.zh-TW: Selamectin 在獸用適應症上與 Ivermectin 競爭同一每月心絲蟲預防用途，但在部分標籤中其作用時間比 Moxidectin 與 Doramectin 更長。與 Fenbendazole 不同，selamectin 是兼具心絲蟲覆蓋的內酯類選擇，但對蜱與絛蟲無效。

context.en-US: Simulium (blackflies) are the exclusive biological vectors of Onchocerca volvulus. Infective L3 larvae develop in the fly midgut and thoracic muscles over 6-12 days, migrate to the proboscis, and are injected into a new human host at the next blood meal; without the blackfly vector the parasite cannot complete its life cycle.
context.zh-TW: Simulium（黑蠅）是 Onchocerca volvulus 唯一的生物性媒介。具感染力的 L3 幼蟲在 6 至 12 天內於蠅的中腸與胸部肌肉發育，遷移至口喙，並在下次吸血時注入新宿主人體；若無黑蠅媒介，該寄生蟲便無法完成生活史。

context.en-US: Community-directed distribution of Ivermectin suppresses skin Microfilariae and thereby interrupts transmission of Onchocerca volvulus, complementing larviciding of Simulium breeding rivers. Because Microfilariae are the stage picked up by the fly, lowering their skin density removes the vector's infectious source.
context.zh-TW: 以社區為導向的 Ivermectin 發放可抑制皮膚中的 Microfilariae，藉此阻斷 Onchocerca volvulus 的傳播，與對 Simulium 孳生河流的殺幼蟲措施互補。由於 Microfilariae 正是被黑蠅吸入的階段，降低其皮膚密度等於移除病媒的感染來源。

context.en-US: Simulium ecology and vector distribution are research priorities for TDR, the WHO-coordinated Special Programme for Research and Training in Tropical Diseases that supported vector-ecology work under the Onchocerciasis Control Programme in West Africa.
context.zh-TW: Simulium 的生態與病媒分布是 TDR 的研究重點；TDR 是由 WHO 協調的「熱帶疾病研究與培訓特別方案」，曾支持西非 Onchocerciasis Control Programme 下的病媒生態研究。

context.en-US: Strongyloides, principally S. stercoralis, causes Strongyloidiasis. It is exceptional among parasitic nematodes in completing both a host-dependent and a free-living cycle and in producing autoinfective filariform larvae within the host, allowing chronic infection to persist for decades without exogenous re-exposure.
context.zh-TW: Strongyloides（以 S. stercoralis 為主）造成 Strongyloidiasis。它在寄生線蟲中相當特殊，既能完成宿主依賴型與自由生活型兩種生活史，又能在宿主體內產生自傳染性的絲狀幼蟲，使慢性感染在無外源性再暴露的情況下仍可持續數十年。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is the preferred therapy for Strongyloidiasis, superior to Albendazole for both acute and prophylactic use, and is also given prophylactically to immunocompromised patients at risk. Repeated courses may be needed, and eradication must be confirmed because autoinfection precludes natural clearance.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是 Strongyloidiasis 的首選療法，在急性治療與預防性使用上均優於 Albendazole，也用於給予有風險的免疫功能低下患者作為預防。可能需要重複療程，且必須確認根除，因為自傳染使自然清除不可能發生。

context.en-US: Albendazole is the secondary anthelmintic option for Strongyloidiasis when Ivermectin is unavailable or contraindicated. It is a benzimidazole that, like oxfendazole, acts on parasite tubulin, and its lower cure rates mean eradication should be documented serologically and parasitologically.
context.zh-TW: 當 Ivermectin 無法取得或禁忌時，Albendazole 是 Strongyloidiasis 的次選驅蟲藥。它屬於 benzimidazole 類，與 oxfendazole 相同作用於寄生蟲 tubulin；由於根除率較低，應以血清學與寄生蟲學方法確認根除。

context.en-US: In immunocompetent hosts, a Th2 milieu with Eosinophils, IgE and IL-5 normally restrains Strongyloides larval burden and keeps chronic Strongyloidiasis asymptomatic. Glucocorticoids and other cancer therapies suppress this control, permitting uncontrolled larval proliferation, hyperinfection and disseminated disease.
context.zh-TW: 在免疫健全宿主中，含有 Eosinophils、IgE 與 IL-5 的 Th2 環境通常會抑制 Strongyloides 的幼蟲負荷，使慢性 Strongyloidiasis 保持無症狀。糖皮質激素與其他癌症療法會抑制此控制作用，讓幼蟲不受限制地增殖，導致過度感染與播散性疾病。

context.en-US: Chemotherapy, long-term steroids, hematopoietic stem-cell transplant and checkpoint inhibitors such as anti-CTLA-4 or anti-PD-1 therapy for Cancer all increase susceptibility to Strongyloidiasis hyperinfection syndrome, which presents with enterocolitis, paralytic ileus, pulmonary infiltrates and gram-negative sepsis at high mortality. Screening endemic patients before immunosuppression is standard of care.
context.zh-TW: Chemotherapy、長期糖皮質激素、骨髓造血幹細胞移植，以及用於 Cancer 的 anti-CTLA-4 或 anti-PD-1 等檢查點抑制劑，都會提高 Strongyloidiasis 過度感染症候群的易感性；該症候群表現為腸結腸炎、麻痺性腸阻塞、肺部浸潤與高死亡率的革蘭氏陰性菌敗血症。在免疫抑制前篩檢流行地區患者屬標準照護。

context.en-US: CTLA-4 checkpoint blockade, including anti-PD-1 combinations, is a recognized trigger of disseminated Strongyloidiasis in carriers of latent infection. The mechanism is the same as for steroids: relief of the Th2/eosinophil brake allows autoinfective larvae to amplify, so steroid-refractory or atypical presentations should raise suspicion.
context.zh-TW: CTLA-4 檢查點阻斷（含與 anti-PD-1 的聯合）是潛伏感染者發生播散性 Strongyloidiasis 的公認誘發因素。其機轉與糖皮質激素相同：解除 Th2／嗜酸性球煞車後，自傳染性幼蟲得以大量增殖，因此對類固醇無反應或表現不典型時應提高懷疑。

context.en-US: TAT (Transactivator of transcription) is encoded by the tat gene of HIV-1. In virology it is essential for replication, binding the TAR RNA element in nascent transcripts and recruiting host P-TEFb to boost transcription elongation; the 11-residue basic domain YGRKKRRQRRR is what makes it useful as a cell-penetrating peptide.
context.zh-TW: TAT（transactivator of transcription）由 HIV-1 的 tat 基因編碼。在病毒學上它對複製不可或缺，會結合新生轉錄本中的 TAR RNA 元素並招募宿主 P-TEFb 以促進轉錄延長；正是這 11 殘基的鹼性區 YGRKKRRQRRR 使它可作為穿透細胞的胜肽使用。

context.en-US: Grafting a positively charged TAT sequence to the C-terminus of the negatively charged DEDE-melittin mutant restored membrane association and rescued its tumor-lytic anticancer activity. The example shows rational design in which a viral cell-penetrating peptide compensates for charge-driven loss of lytic function.
context.zh-TW: 將帶正電的 TAT 序列接植到帶負電的 DEDE-melittin 突變株 C 端，恢復了膜結合能力並救回其腫瘤溶解性抗癌活性。這個例子顯示了理性設計：病毒來源的穿膜胜肽補償了因電荷改變而喪失的溶解功能。

context.en-US: TAT is exploited to improve intracellular uptake of otherwise impermeant agents, including cytotoxic peptides, contrast agents and siRNA, and is used experimentally to enhance Chemotherapy delivery. Its limitations are endosomal trapping, low tumor specificity and rapid clearance, which motivate tumor-selective ligands such as trastuzumab.
context.zh-TW: TAT 被用來改善原本無法穿透細胞的藥物之胞內攝入，包括細胞毒性胜肽、顯影劑與 siRNA，並在實驗上用於強化 Chemotherapy 的遞送。其限制為內體滯留、腫瘤專一性低與快速清除，因此促使人們尋找如 trastuzumab 等腫瘤選擇性配體。

context.en-US: TDR is a component_of the World Health Organization system: it was established in 1975 and is co-sponsored by WHO together with UNICEF, UNDP, the World Bank and formerly the Rockefeller Foundation, with the mandate of building an evidence base for control, elimination and eradication of neglected tropical diseases.
context.zh-TW: TDR 是 World Health Organization 體系的一環：它成立於 1975 年，由 WHO 與 UNICEF、UNDP、世界銀行及（前）洛克菲勒基金會共同資助，使命是為熱帶疾病的控制、消除與根除建立證據基礎。

context.en-US: Onchocerciasis is a core disease in the TDR portfolio, addressed through operational research on how to deliver Ivermectin mass drug administration effectively, monitor drug resistance and measure progress toward elimination targets, together with mapping of Simulium vector distributions.
context.zh-TW: Onchocerciasis 是 TDR 疾病組合中的核心項目，其工作包含研究如何有效執行 Ivermectin 大規模藥物投予、監測抗藥性與衡量朝向根除目標的進度，以及 Simulium 病媒分布的製圖。

context.en-US: Lymphatic Filariasis is a TDR elimination target supported through mapping of mosquito vector distributions, pharmacovigilance for antiparasitic drugs and co-morbidity management strategies, in collaboration with the WHO NTD Roadmap and the Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis.
context.zh-TW: Lymphatic Filariasis 是 TDR 的根除目標，工作包含蚊媒分布製圖、抗寄生蟲藥物的藥物流行病學監測與共病管理策略，並與 WHO NTD Roadmap 及全球消除 Lymphatic Filariasis 計畫合作。

context.en-US: TDR supports the deployment research of Ivermectin, emphasizing implementation science and pharmacovigilance, and TDR's training component strengthens the careers of researchers from disease-endemic nations. The drug itself originated from Streptomyces in work recognized by the Nobel Prize to William C. Campbell.
context.zh-TW: TDR 支持 Ivermectin 的投放研究，強調實施科學與藥物警戒，其培訓部分則培植來自疾病流行國家的研究人員。該藥本身源自 Streptomyces，其相關研究由 William C. Campbell 獲得諾貝爾獎肯定。

context.en-US: William C. Campbell is the discoverer of the antiparasitic avermectin class to which Ivermectin belongs, work recognized by the Nobel Prize. TDR notes this as the clearest translational bridge between tropical-disease biology and cancer pharmacology, since avermectins later entered drug-repurposing oncology research.
context.zh-TW: William C. Campbell 是 Ivermectin 所屬抗寄生蟲 avermectin 類的發現者，其研究獲諾貝爾獎肯定。TDR 指出這是熱帶疾病生物學與癌症藥理學之間最清楚的轉譯橋樑，因為 avermectins 之後進入了藥物再定位的腫瘤學研究。

context.en-US: TRIM2 ubiquitinates the pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein Bim: its RING domain recruits an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme while coiled-coil and NHL repeat domains confer substrate specificity, attaching ubiquitin chains to Bim lysines that mark it for 26S proteasome destruction. This degradative route is a post-translational safeguard against Apoptosis, distinct from ERK/RSK-mediated transcriptional suppression of Bim.
context.zh-TW: TRIM2 會對促凋亡的 BH3-only 蛋白 Bim 進行泛素化：其 RING 結構域招募 E2 泛素連接酵素，coiled-coil 與 NHL repeat 結構域賦予受質專一性，把泛素鏈接到 Bim 的離胺酸上，使其被標記並由 26S 蛋白酶體分解。這條降解途徑是對抗 Apoptosis 的轉譯後防線，與 ERK/RSK 對 Bim 的轉錄抑制不同。

context.en-US: ERK licenses TRIM2-mediated ubiquitylation of Bim: growth-factor signalling through the ERK/MAPK cascade activates kinases such as RSK that prime Bim, enhancing its recognition by TRIM2. Loss of TRIM2 therefore sensitizes cells to apoptosis, whereas TRIM2 activity promotes survival, especially in neurons.
context.zh-TW: ERK 為 TRIM2 介導的 Bim 泛素化提供許可：透過 ERK/MAPK 級聯的生長因子訊號活化 RSK 等激酶以預備 Bim，提高其被 TRIM2 辨識的效率。因此 TRIM2 喪失會使細胞對凋亡敏感，而 TRIM2 活性則促進存活，在神經元中尤其明顯。

context.en-US: TRIM2 inhibits Apoptosis by eliminating Bim, a potent initiator of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization. Because the removal of Bim blunts chemotherapy-induced death, aberrant TRIM2 expression can confer resistance to apoptosis-inducing Chemotherapy and to targeted agents that rely on Bim upregulation.
context.zh-TW: TRIM2 藉由清除 Bim 這個線粒體外膜通透化作用的強效啟動者而抑制 Apoptosis。由於 Bim 被清除會削弱化療引發的死亡，TRIM2 的異常表現可使細胞對誘發凋亡的 Chemotherapy 以及依賴 Bim 上調的標靶藥物產生抗藥性。

context.en-US: TRIM2 is opposed by the related TRIM E3 ligase Trim17, which has the opposite substrate preference: instead of degrading pro-apoptotic Bim, Trim17 degrades the anti-apoptotic Mcl-1 to promote death. The TRIM2-Bim and Trim17-Mcl-1 axes therefore push the apoptotic threshold in opposite directions.
context.zh-TW: TRIM2 受到相關 TRIM E3 泛素連接酵素 Trim17 的對抗；Trim17 的受質偏好正好相反：它不是降解促凋亡的 Bim，而是降解抗凋亡的 Mcl-1 以促進死亡。因此 TRIM2–Bim 與 Trim17–Mcl-1 兩條軸把凋亡閾值推向相反方向。

context.en-US: Trim17 degrades the anti-apoptotic protein Mcl-1, removing a brake on mitochondrial apoptosis and thereby promoting cell death. As a pro-death E3 ligase it stands in contrast to TRIM2, and the pair illustrates how TRIM-family ubiquitin ligases set apoptotic thresholds through substrate choice.
context.zh-TW: Trim17 會降解抗凋亡蛋白 Mcl-1，移除線粒體凋亡上的一個煞車，藉此促進細胞死亡。作為促死亡的 E3 泛素連接酵素，它與 TRIM2 形成對比；這對酵素說明 TRIM 家族泛素連接酵素如何藉由受質選擇設定凋亡閾值。

context.en-US: Thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1, THBS1) is a large matricellular glycoprotein secreted by platelets, endothelial cells and Macrophages that binds CD36. Binding of this ligand to the receptor is what initiates TSP-1 signalling, expanding CD36's role beyond lipid uptake to adhesion, survival and inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Thrombospondin-1（TSP-1、THBS1）是由血小板、內皮細胞與 Macrophages 分泌的大型基質細胞糖蛋白，可與 CD36 結合。正是這種配體與受體的結合啟動了 TSP-1 訊號，將 CD36 的角色從脂質攝取擴展到黏附、存活與發炎。

context.en-US: CD36 activates FYN kinase downstream of Thrombospondin-1 binding; the Src-family kinase is the first intracellular signalling step of the TSP-1-CD36 axis, which then engages p38 MAPK to influence Macrophages adhesion, survival, phagocytosis and inflammatory behaviour.
context.zh-TW: 在 Thrombospondin-1 結合之後，CD36 會活化 FYN 激酶；這Src 家族激酶是 TSP-1–CD36 軸的第一個胞內訊號步驟，接著啟動 p38 MAPK，影響 Macrophages 的黏附、存活、吞噬與發炎行為。

context.en-US: CD36 activates p38 MAPK as part of TSP-1-CD36 signalling, shaping Macrophages behaviour and linking the CD36 receptor to Inflammation. Because Thrombospondin-1 has many other receptors such as Integrins, CD36 is one node in a broader network rather than the sole mediator of TSP-1 function.
context.zh-TW: CD36 在 TSP-1–CD36 訊號中活化 p38 MAPK，藉此塑造 Macrophages 行為並把 CD36 受體與 Inflammation 連結起來。由於 Thrombospondin-1 還有 Integrins 等其他受體，CD36 只是更廣泛網絡中的一個節點，而非 TSP-1 功能的唯一介導者。

context.en-US: Thrombospondin-1 inhibits Angiogenesis and is a major anti-angiogenic factor in the tumor microenvironment. The same glycoprotein also influences platelet function, wound healing, thrombosis and age-related Inflammation, so its net effect on new vessel growth is suppressive rather than permissive.
context.zh-TW: Thrombospondin-1 抑制 Angiogenesis，是腫瘤微環境中主要的抗血管新生因子。同一糖蛋白也影響血小板功能、傷口癒合、血栓形成與年齡相關的 Inflammation，因此其對新生血管生長的淨效應是抑制而非促進。

context.en-US: Integrins are alternative receptors for Thrombospondin-1 alongside CD36, contacted through the glycoprotein procollagen-like and EGF-like repeats. The receptor promiscuity of TSP-1 means that blocking CD36 alone leaves parallel integrin-mediated signalling intact.
context.zh-TW: Integrins 是 Thrombospondin-1 除 CD36 外的替代受體，透過該糖蛋白的類膠原與 EGF 樣重複區與其接觸。TSP-1 的受體多樣性意味著單獨封鎖 CD36 時， integrin 介導的平行訊號仍然存在。

context.en-US: LIPL-4 is a C. elegans lysosomal triglyceride lipase required for the longevity benefits of Dietary Restriction; it is expressed in the pharynx and intestine, and unlike other LIPL family members it is not predicted to be lysosomal and its expression is not repressed by MXL-3 under well-fed conditions. LIPL-4 signals to the nuclear hormone receptor NHR-49, which is required for Dietary Restriction-dependent lifespan extension in the worm.
context.zh-TW: LIPL-4 是 C. elegans 的溶酶體三酸甘油酯脂肪酶，為 Dietary Restriction 長壽效應所必需；它表現在咽與腸道中，且與 LIPL 家族其他成員不同，它不被預測為溶酶體定位，其表達在營養充足時也不受 MXL-3 抑制。LIPL-4 會活化核受體 NHR-49，而後者在線蟲中是 Dietary Restriction 依賴性壽命延展所必需的。

context.en-US: LIPL-4 is a C. elegans lysosomal lipase that activates the nuclear hormone receptor NHR-49. NHR-49 in turn drives expression of genes for fatty acid beta-oxidation, transport and desaturation, and is required for lifespan extension downstream of LIPL-4 under dietary restriction; LIPL-4 is also upregulated about 7-fold after 6 hours of fasting.
context.zh-TW: LIPL-4 是 C. elegans 的溶酶體脂肪酶，可活化核受體 NHR-49。NHR-49 進而驅動脂肪酸 β-氧化、運輸與去飽和相關基因的表達，且在飲食限制下 LIPL-4 下游的壽命延展需要它；LIPL-4 在禁食 6 小時後會上調約 7 倍。

context.en-US: Unlike other members of the LIPL family, LIPL-4 is not repressed by the MXL-3/BHLH-40 transcriptional complex under well-fed conditions, although it is up-regulated in the intestine of starvation-induced dauer larvae.
context.zh-TW: 與 LIPL 家族其他成員不同，LIPL-4 在營養充足條件下不受 MXL-3/BHLH-40 轉錄複合體抑制，儘管它在禁食誘導的 dauer 幼蟲腸道中會被上調。

context.en-US: LIPL-5 is a C. elegans triglyceride lipase that is modestly (about 2-fold) upregulated after 6 hours of fasting in adult worms. Its transcription is repressed by MXL-3 in well-fed animals and induced by HLH-30 during fasting.
context.zh-TW: LIPL-5 是 C. elegans 的三酸甘油酯脂肪酶，在成蟲禁食 6 小時後會中度（約 2 倍）上調。其轉錄在營養充足時受 MXL-3 抑制，並在禁食期間由 HLH-30 誘導。

context.en-US: HLH-30, the C. elegans MiT/TFE-family transcription factor, induces the fasting-responsive lysosomal lipase LIPL-5, which is conversely repressed by MXL-3 in well-fed animals. HLH-30 thus couples nutrient status to lysosomal lipase expression that fuels Lipophagy during starvation.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30（C. elegans 的 MiT/TFE 家族轉錄因子）會誘導禁食反應性的溶酶體脂肪酶 LIPL-5；相反地，LIPL-5 在營養充足時受 MXL-3 抑制。因此 HLH-30 將營養狀態與驅動 Lipophagy 的溶酶體脂肪酶表達連結起來。

context.en-US: LIPL-5 is a C. elegans lysosomal triglyceride lipase that contributes to Lipophagy and to fat mobilization during starvation. It is predicted to localize to the lysosome and is expressed in the intestine.
context.zh-TW: LIPL-5 是 C. elegans 的溶酶體三酸甘油酯脂肪酶，參與 Lipophagy 與禁食期間的脂肪動員。它被預測定位於溶酶體，並在腸道中表達。

context.en-US: Leptomycin B causes nuclear accumulation of the transcription factors TFEB, TFE3 and FOXO, which in turn enhances Autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis. Because CRM1 export is a key control layer over the autophagic transcriptional program, its blockade is a mechanistic probe of TFEB activation.
context.zh-TW: Leptomycin B 造成轉錄因子 TFEB、TFE3 與 FOXO 在細胞核內累積，進而增強 Autophagy 與溶酶體生成。由於 CRM1 依賴的核輸出是自噬轉錄程序的關鍵調控層，阻斷 CRM1 是探討 TFEB 活化機制的工具。

context.en-US: LipA is the mouse lysosomal acid lipase, the functional orthologue of human LAL and of C. elegans LIPL-1 and LIPL-3. It hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides inside the lysosome, and its fasting-induced transcription in liver is linked to TFEB activity.
context.zh-TW: LipA 是小鼠的溶酶體酸性脂肪酶，為人體 LAL 與 C. elegans LIPL-1、LIPL-3 的功能同源物。它在溶酶體內水解膽固醇酯與三酸甘油酯，且其在小鼠肝臟中禁食誘發的轉錄與 TFEB 活性相關。

context.en-US: LipA, the mouse lysosomal acid lipase, is the functional orthologue of human lysosomal acid lipase (LAL) and of the C. elegans lysosomal lipases LIPL-1 and LIPL-3, which are its nematode counterparts for cholesteryl ester and triglyceride hydrolysis.
context.zh-TW: LipA（小鼠溶酶體酸性脂肪酶）是人體溶酶體酸性脂肪酶（LAL）以及 C. elegans 溶酶體脂肪酶 LIPL-1 與 LIPL-3 的功能同源物，後兩者是其在線蟲中對應的膽固醇酯與三酸甘油酯水解酶。

context.en-US: Lysosomal localization — the recruitment or positioning of a protein on the lysosome membrane — is required for TFEB to be phosphorylated by mTORC1, and is itself regulated by GSK3beta. Positioning of lysosomes is controlled by Rab7 effectors, and perinuclear clustering of lysosomes facilitates Autophagy.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體定位（蛋白質在溶酶體膜上的招募或定位）是 TFEB 被 mTORC1 磷酸化所必需的，本身又受 GSK3beta 調控。溶酶體的定位由 Rab7 效應蛋白控制，而溶酶體的核周聚集有助於 Autophagy。

context.en-US: Lysosomal positioning and perinuclear clustering are regulated by Rab7 effectors, with FYCO1-type machinery driving plus-end transport and the RILP-ORP1L dynein adaptor driving minus-end movement. Perinuclear lysosomal clustering in turn facilitates Autophagy.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體的定位與核周聚集由 Rab7 效應蛋白調控，其中 FYCO1 類機器驅動向正端運輸，RILP-ORP1L 動力蛋白銜接蛋白驅动向負端移動。而核周溶酶體聚集反過來有助於 Autophagy。

context.en-US: Lysosomal storage disorders are ~70 inherited metabolic diseases caused by defects in lysosomal enzymes, membrane proteins or transporters, which lead to intralysosomal accumulation of undegraded macromolecules. Because the lysosome is the terminal degradative compartment shared with Autophagy, LSDs secondarily block Autophagic Flux and cause Oxidative Stress.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體儲積症是約 70 種遺傳性代謝疾病，由溶酶體酵素、膜蛋白或轉運蛋白缺陷引起，造成未降解大分子在溶酶體內累積。由於溶酶體是與 Autophagy 共用的終末降解胞器，溶酶體儲積症會次級阻斷 Autophagic Flux 並引發 Oxidative Stress。

context.en-US: Pharmacologic activation of TFEB is the unifying disease-modifying strategy for lysosomal storage disorders: TFEB activation enhances lysosomal biogenesis, exocytosis and clearance of stored material, and boosting basal Autophagy relieves the secondary autophagic block. Preclinical TFEB activators, for example via mTORC1 inhibition or trehalose-mimetic small molecules, reduce storage in multiple LSD models.
context.zh-TW: 藥理學上活化 TFEB 是溶酶體儲積症统一的疾病改造策略：TFEB 活化可促進溶酶體生成、胞吐與儲存物質的清除，而提升基礎 Autophagy 則可解除次級的自噬阻斷。前臨床 TFEB 活化劑（例如經由 mTORC1 抑制或海藻糖模擬小分子）在多種溶酶體儲積症模型中可減少儲積。

context.en-US: MALAT1 (metastasis associated lung adenocarcinoma transcript 1) is a nuclear-retained long non-coding RNA and the best-known fusion partner of TFEB: the TFEB gene on chromosome 6 fuses with MALAT1 (originally called Alpha), producing t(6;11) translocation renal cell carcinoma with TFEB overexpression. MALAT1 also interacts with TFEB to influence lysosomal gene transcription.
context.zh-TW: MALAT1（metastasis associated lung adenocarcinoma transcript 1）是核內滯留的長非編碼 RNA，也是 TFEB 最知名的融合對手基因：位於 6 號染色體的 TFEB 基因與 MALAT1（最初稱為 Alpha）融合，形成 t(6;11) 轉位腎細胞癌並導致 TFEB 過度表現。MALAT1 也與 TFEB 互動以影響溶酶體基因的轉錄。

context.en-US: MALAT1 modulates Autophagy by sponging miR-101, which upregulates STUB1 expression, and by interacting with TFEB to influence lysosomal gene transcription and by regulating mTORC1 signaling under hypoxic stress. The same mechanism has been reported to upregulate SIRT1.
context.zh-TW: MALAT1 透過「海綿」miR-101 來調節 Autophagy，進而提升 STUB1 的表達；它也與 TFEB 互動以影響溶酶體基因轉錄，並在缺氧壓力下調節 mTORC1 訊號。同一機制亦被報導可上調 SIRT1。

context.en-US: Macroautophagy is the primary and best-studied type of Autophagy: cytoplasmic cargo is sequestered into double-membrane autophagosomes that then fuse with lysosomes, whose hydrolases digest the cargo for recycling. It is regulated by Atg proteins such as Atg1, Atg5 and Atg8/LC3 and induced by metabolic stress via the AMPK/mTORC1 axis.
context.zh-TW: Macroautophagy 是 Autophagy 主要且研究最深入的類型：細胞質貨物被隔離進雙層膜的 autophagosome，隨後與溶酶體融合，由溶酶體水解酶分解以回收。它受 Atg1、Atg5 與 Atg8/LC3 等 Atg 蛋白調控，並經由 AMPK/mTORC1 軸受代謝壓力誘導。

context.en-US: Macroautophagy is essential for maintaining Cellular Homeostasis by removing damaged organelles and misfolded proteins. Its dysregulation is linked to neurodegenerative disease, cancer and aging, in each of which autophagic flux is inadequate or aberrant.
context.zh-TW: Macroautophagy 藉由清除受損胞器與錯誤摺疊蛋白質，對維持 Cellular Homeostasis 至關重要。其失調與神經退化性疾病、癌症與老化相關，這些疾病中自噬通量皆不足或異常。

context.en-US: MiT family translocation renal cell carcinoma is a kidney cancer subtype defined by chromosomal translocations fusing TFE3 or TFEB to partner genes, causing constitutive nuclear localization of these MiTF/TFE factors. TFEB overexpression is the driver in t(6;11) disease, where MALAT1 is the fusion partner.
context.zh-TW: MiT 家族轉位腎細胞癌是一種腎癌亞型，由將 TFE3 或 TFEB 與夥伴基因融合的染色體轉位所定義，造成這些 MiTF/TFE 因子的組成性核內定位。在 t(6;11) 型中 TFEB 過度表現為驅動力，其融合夥伴為 MALAT1。

context.en-US: The microphthalmia (MiT/TFE) family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors comprises TFEB, TFE3, MITF and TFEC. These factors regulate autophagy and lysosomal genes by binding CLEAR elements, and their translocation or nuclear trapping activates the autophagic-lysosomal transcriptional program.
context.zh-TW: 微眼畸形（MiT/TFE）家族的基本螺旋環螺旋－白胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子包含 TFEB、TFE3、MITF 與 TFEC。這些因子藉由結合 CLEAR elements 來調控自噬與溶酶體基因，其轉位或核內滯留可活化自噬－溶酶體轉錄程序。

context.en-US: MiT/TFE family members (TFEB, TFE3, MITF, TFEC) regulate autophagy and lysosomal genes by binding CLEAR elements, the short DNA motifs in target promoters that recruit these bHLH-LZ transcription factors to drive lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy transcription.
context.zh-TW: MiT/TFE 家族成員（TFEB、TFE3、MITF、TFEC）藉由結合 CLEAR elements 來調控自噬與溶酶體基因；CLEAR elements 是目標啟動子中的短 DNA 序列，可招募這些 bHLH-LZ 轉錄因子以驅動溶酶體生成與自噬轉錄。

context.en-US: Microautophagy is a type of Autophagy in which cytoplasmic components are directly engulfed by the lysosomal or vacuolar membrane via membrane invagination, without autophagosome formation. Unlike Macroautophagy it is generally considered nonselective, though selective forms exist, and it maintains organelle size and membrane homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: Microautophagy 是 Autophagy 的一種類型，細胞質成分透過膜內陷直接被溶酶體或液泡膜吞入，不經由 autophagosome 形成。與 Macroautophagy 不同，它一般被視為非選擇性（但也有選擇性形式），並參與維持胞器大小與膜恆定。

context.en-US: Microautophagy differs from Macroautophagy in that cargo is engulfed directly by the lysosomal/vacuolar membrane and no autophagosome is formed, whereas Macroautophagy routes cargo through double-membrane autophagosomes before lysosomal fusion. Both are among the three canonical types of autophagy alongside Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy.
context.zh-TW: Microautophagy 與 Macroautophagy 的差別在於：前者由溶酶體／液泡膜直接吞入貨物而不形成 autophagosome，後者則先讓貨物經由雙層膜的 autophagosome 再與溶酶體融合。兩者皆與 Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy 並列為自噬的三種類型。

context.en-US: Mucopolysaccharidosis-IIIA (Sanfilippo syndrome type A) is caused by deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme sulfamidase (SGSH), required for heparan sulfate degradation. Heparan sulfate accumulation in lysosomes triggers secondary storage of GM2 gangliosides, cholesterol and autophagic substrates, and Autophagic Flux is impaired, contributing to severe neurodegeneration.
context.zh-TW: Mucopolysaccharidosis-IIIA（Sanfilippo 症候群 A 型）由溶酶體酵素硫酸化酶（SGSH）缺乏所致，該酵素為肝素硫酸分解所必需。肝素硫酸在溶酶體內累積會引發 GM2 神經節苷脂、膽固醇與自噬受質的次級儲積，並使 Autophagic Flux 受損，加劇嚴重的神經退化。

context.en-US: Mucopolysaccharidosis-IIIA (Sanfilippo syndrome A) is a lysosomal storage disease characterized by accumulation of heparan sulfate; onset is at 2-6 years with developmental delay, behavioral problems, coarse facies, hepatosplenomegaly and progressive dementia, and no approved CNS-penetrant therapy exists.
context.zh-TW: Mucopolysaccharidosis-IIIA（Sanfilippo 症候群 A 型）是以肝素硫酸累積為特徵的溶酶體儲積症；通常於 2–6 歲發病，表現為發育遲緩、行為問題、粗糙面容、肝脾腫大與進行性失智，目前尚無核准的中樞神經穿透性療法。

context.en-US: Multiple sulfatase deficiency (MSD) is a rare lysosomal storage disease caused by mutations in SUMF1, which encodes the formylglycine-generating enzyme that activates all sulfatases, producing a combined deficiency of all 17 known human sulfatases. Arylsulfatase deficiency gives features resembling metachromatic leukodystrophy, while sulfamidase deficiency gives MPS-like features.
context.zh-TW: Multiple sulfatase deficiency（MSD）是由 SUMF1 突變造成的罕見溶酶體儲積症，SUMF1 編碼啟動所有硫酸化酶的 formylglycine 生成酶（FGE），其突變導致全部 17 種已知人類硫酸化酶合併缺乏。芳香基硫酸化酶缺乏產生類似 metachromatic leukodystrophy 的特徵，硫酸化酶缺乏則產生 MPS 樣特徵。

context.en-US: TFEB activation has been proposed as a strategy for multiple sulfatase deficiency because it augments lysosomal exocytosis and clearance, reducing storage burden; TFEB overexpression stimulates lysosomal exocytosis and cellular clearance in MSD cell models, while enzyme replacement and gene therapy remain preclinical.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 活化被提出作為 multiple sulfatase deficiency 的治療策略，因其能增強溶酶體胞吐與清除、降低儲積負擔；在 MSD 細胞模型中，TFEB 過度表現可促進溶酶體胞吐與細胞清除，而酵素替代療法與基因治療仍處於前臨床階段。

context.en-US: NHR-49 (nuclear hormone receptor 49) is the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian PPARα and a key transcriptional regulator of fat metabolism. It regulates genes for fatty acid beta-oxidation, transport and desaturation, and is critical for metabolic adaptation to starvation and for lifespan extension downstream of LIPL-4.
context.zh-TW: NHR-49（核受體 49）是哺乳類 PPARα 在 C. elegans 中的同源物，也是脂肪代謝的關鍵轉錄調控因子。它調控脂肪酸 β-氧化、運輸與去飽和相關基因，且對禁食的代謝適應以及 LIPL-4 下游的壽命延展至關重要。

context.en-US: NHR-49 regulates Lipophagy, beta-oxidation and lifespan extension downstream of LIPL-4 in C. elegans. The transcriptional regulation of lysosomal lipolysis mediated by MXL-3 and HLH-30, by contrast, has been reported to function independently of NHR-49.
context.zh-TW: 在 C. elegans 中，NHR-49 調控 LIPL-4 下游的 Lipophagy、β-氧化與壽命延展。相對地，由 MXL-3 與 HLH-30 介導的溶酶體脂解轉錄調控則被報導可獨立於 NHR-49 運作。

context.en-US: NHR-49 is critical for the metabolic adaptation of C. elegans to starvation, driving the transcriptional program for fatty acid oxidation that supplies energy when nutrient intake ceases.
context.zh-TW: NHR-49 對 C. elegans 對 Starvation 的代謝適應至關重要，它驅動脂肪酸氧化的轉錄程序，在營養攝取停止時供應能量。

context.en-US: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (Batten disease) is a group of inherited neurodegenerative disorders caused by mutations in at least 13 genes, most encoding lysosomal enzymes or transmembrane proteins involved in lysosomal function. Defective lysosomal degradation leads to accumulation of autofluorescent ceroid and lipofuscin composed of subunit c of mitochondrial ATP synthase and saposins.
context.zh-TW: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis（Batten 病）是一群遺傳性神經退化疾病，由至少 13 個基因突變引起，多數編碼溶酶體酵素或參與溶酶體功能的跨膜蛋白。溶酶體降解缺陷導致由粒線體 ATP 合成酶 c 次單元與 saposin 構成的自發光 ceroid 與 lipofuscin 累積。

context.en-US: TFEB activation has emerged as a potential therapeutic strategy for neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, since TFEB overexpression enhances lysosomal exocytosis and reduces stored material in NCL models. No curative treatment exists; enzyme replacement therapy (Brineura for CLN2), gene therapy and small-molecule chaperones are under clinical investigation.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 活化已成為 neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 的潛在治療策略，因為 TFEB 過度表現可在 NCL 模型中增強溶酶體胞吐並減少儲存物質。目前仍無根治性療法；酵素替代療法（CLN2 使用 Brineura）、基因療法與小分子伴護分子仍在臨床研究中。

context.en-US: Nuclear export of TFEB suppresses Autophagy: nutrient-rich conditions activate mTORC1 at the lysosome and ERK2, which phosphorylate TFEB at S142 (priming S138), creating a nuclear export signal that recruits CRM1 and traps TFEB in 14-3-3-bound cytosolic complexes. Under starvation, mTORC1 inhibition dephosphorylates TFEB, allowing nuclear accumulation and activation of CLEAR-network genes.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 的核輸出會抑制 Autophagy：營養充足時，溶酶體上的 mTORC1 與 ERK2 被活化，磷酸化 TFEB 的 S142（並使 S138 先行磷酸化），產生可招募 CRM1 的核輸出訊號，將 TFEB 困在與 14-3-3 結合的細胞質複合體中。禁食時 mTORC1 抑制使 TFEB 去磷酸化，因而在核內累積並活化 CLEAR network 基因。

context.en-US: Nutrient abundance activates mTORC1 at the lysosome, and mTORC1 together with ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at S142 (and primes S138), which licenses CRM1-dependent export of TFEB. This phosphorylation-dependent nuclear export is a key control layer atop the mTORC1/TFEB axis gating autophagic transcription.
context.zh-TW: 營養充足會活化溶酶體上的 mTORC1，mTORC1 與 ERK2 共同磷酸化 TFEB 的 S142（並使 S138 先行磷酸化），使 TFEB 可被 CRM1 依賴性輸出。這種磷酸化依賴的核輸出是 mTORC1/TFEB 軸之上調控自噬轉錄的關鍵層。

context.en-US: PARsylation (poly-ADP-ribosylation) is a reversible post-translational modification in which poly(ADP-ribose) chains are added to target proteins by PARP family enzymes (TNKS1, PARP1, PARP2) using NAD+ as substrate. It regulates TFEB nuclear localization via Tankyrases and also acts on ULK1 and mTORC1 components to control Autophagy; PARP inhibitors such as Olaparib induce autophagy in cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: PARsylation（poly-ADP-ribosylation）是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，由 PARP 家族酵素（TNKS1、PARP1、PARP2）以 NAD+ 為受體將 poly(ADP-ribose) 鏈加到目標蛋白上。它透過 Tankyrases 調控 TFEB 的核內定位，也作用於 ULK1 與 mTORC1 組件以控制 Autophagy；PARP 抑制劑如 Olaparib 可在癌細胞中誘發自噬。

context.en-US: PEX3 is a peroxisomal membrane protein that recruits the chaperone PEX19 for peroxisome biogenesis and also functions in Pexophagy recognition. Mutations in PEX3 disrupt membrane integrity and severely impair peroxisome biogenesis, causing neurological problems and developmental delay as seen in Zellweger syndrome variants and Riordan syndrome.
context.zh-TW: PEX3 是過氧化體膜蛋白，會招募伴護蛋白 PEX19 以進行過氧化體生成，並參與 Pexophagy 的辨識。PEX3 突變會破壞膜完整性並嚴重損害過氧化體生成，造成神經問題與發育遲緩，如 Zellweger syndrome 變異與 Riordan 症候群。

context.en-US: PEX3 encodes a peroxisomal membrane protein required for correct folding and transport of many other peroxins into the peroxisome membrane, acting as an essential building block of the Peroxisome Biogenesis Network. Loss of function leaves misfolded proteins that accumulate and disrupt membrane integrity.
context.zh-TW: PEX3 編碼過氧化體膜蛋白，負責許多其他 peroxin 正確摺疊並運送至過氧化體膜，是 Peroxisome Biogenesis Network 的必要組成。功能喪失會留下累積的錯誤摺疊蛋白，破壞膜完整性。

context.en-US: Beyond peroxisome assembly, PEX3 functions in Pexophagy recognition, helping the autophagic machinery identify peroxisomal material for selective degradation. Its role thus links peroxisome quality control to the autophagic pathway.
context.zh-TW: 除了過氧化體的組裝之外，PEX3 還參與 Pexophagy 的辨識，協助自噬機器辨識過氧化體物質以進行選擇性降解。它的作用因此將過氧化體的品質管制與自噬路徑連結起來。

context.en-US: PGP-2 is a C. elegans ABC (ATP-binding cassette) transporter localized to lysosome-related organelle (LRO) membranes that is essential for their biogenesis; these LROs — the gut granules — serve as fat storage sites. Its absence results in loss of gut granules and altered lipid storage, and it co-localizes with the lysosomal lipases LIPL-1 and LIPL-3.
context.zh-TW: PGP-2 是 C. elegans 的 ABC（ATP 結合盒）轉運蛋白，定位於溶酶體相關胞器（LRO）膜上，對其生成不可或缺；這些 LRO（即腸顆粒）是脂肪儲存場所。PGP-2 缺失會造成腸顆粒消失與脂質儲存改變，且它與溶酶體脂肪酶 LIPL-1 與 LIPL-3 共定位。

context.en-US: PGP-2 is widely used in C. elegans as a lysosomal marker: its membrane localization to lysosome-related organelles lets researchers quantify lysosomal content and size. Its expression is regulated by the HLH-30/TFEB MiT/TFE axis.
context.zh-TW: PGP-2 在 C. elegans 中被廣泛用作溶酶體標記：其在溶酶體相關胞器膜上的定位讓研究者能定量溶酶體內容物與大小。其表達受 HLH-30/TFEB 的 MiT/TFE 軸調控。

context.en-US: Polyamines such as spermidine are autophagy inducers. Polyamine-rich foods boost longevity in various model organisms, polyamine levels fall in aged somatic and immune cells, and restoring polyamines protects against age-induced memory impairment and rejuvenates B cell responses in an Autophagy-dependent manner.
context.zh-TW: 像 spermidine 這樣的多胺是自噬誘導物。富含多胺的食物在多種模式生物中提升壽命，多胺濃度在老化的體細胞與免疫細胞中下降，而補充多胺可保護免受年齡相關的記憶損傷，並以 Autophagy 依賴的方式恢復 B 細胞反應。

context.en-US: Spermidine, the natural polyamine metabolic product of arginine metabolism, extends lifespan via Autophagy and via Hypusination of eIF5A. Polyamine levels decline in aged somatic and immune cells, and polyamine supplementation reverses arterial aging and age-related decline.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine 是精胺酸代謝產生的天然多胺，可經由 Autophagy 以及 eIF5A 的 Hypusination 延長壽命。多胺濃度在老化的體細胞與免疫細胞中下降，補充多胺可逆轉動脈老化與年齡相關的衰退。

context.en-US: Protor-1 (PRR5) is a component of mTORC2 that binds mSIN1 and stabilizes the complex, and it interacts with Rictor. Within mTORC2, Protor-1 regulates substrate specificity toward SGK1 and PKC, though its precise physiological function remains to be fully elucidated.
context.zh-TW: Protor-1（PRR5）是 mTORC2 的組成成分，會結合 mSIN1 並穩定該複合體，且與 Rictor 互作。在 mTORC2 中，Protor-1 調控其對 SGK1 與 PKC 的受質專一性，但其確切生理功能尚未完全釐清。

context.en-US: During Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, PtdIns(4,5)P2 is locally synthesized on the autolysosomal surface and recruits clathrin and AP2, which drive membrane invagination and scission of proto-lysosomal tubules that regenerate a functional lysosomal pool. Loss of PIP5KI activity or PtdIns(4,5)P2 depletion impairs ALR, causing lysosomal depletion and autophagic stress.
context.zh-TW: 在 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 過程中，PtdIns(4,5)P2 於自噬溶酶體表面局部合成，並招募 clathrin 與 AP2，藉由驅動原溶酶體小管的膜內陷與剪切來再生可運作的溶酶體池。PIP5KI 活性喪失或 PtdIns(4,5)P2 耗竭會損害 ALR，造成溶酶體耗竭與自噬壓力。

context.en-US: PtdIns(4,5)P2 is a plasma-membrane-enriched phosphoinositide that also acts as a direct regulator of Autophagy: at the initiation stage its enrichment at forming phagophores supports vesicle curvature and recruits actin regulators that facilitate autophagosome closure, in addition to its role in autophagic lysosome reformation.
context.zh-TW: PtdIns(4,5)P2 是富含於質膜的磷脂訊號分子，也直接調控 Autophagy：在起始階段，它在形成的 phagophore 上富集以支持囊泡曲率，並招募促進 autophagosome 閉合的肌動蛋白調控因子；此外它還參與 autophagic lysosome reformation。

context.en-US: PtdIns3P is generated by Vps34, the sole class III phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase, in two distinct complexes: complex I with Atg14L at the phagophore and complex II with UVRAG at endosomes. Its spatial confinement is enforced by myotubularin phosphatases and by PIKfyve, which converts it to PtdIns(3,5)P2 on endolysosomal membranes.
context.zh-TW: PtdIns3P 由 Vps34（唯一的第三類磷脂肌醇 3-激酶）合成，存在於兩種不同複合體中：含 Atg14L 的 complex I 位於 phagophore，含 UUVRAG 的 complex II 位於內體。其空間分布由 myotubularin 磷酸酶以及將其轉為內溶體膜上 PtdIns(3,5)P2 的 PIKfyve 加以限制。

context.en-US: PtdIns3P is the defining lipid landmark of the autophagy initiation machinery: on the phagophore it serves as a docking platform for PX/FYVE-domain effectors, most notably the WIPI family and Atg18, which recruit downstream ATG proteins required for phagophore expansion and autophagosome growth.
context.zh-TW: PtdIns3P 是自噬起始機器的定義性脂質標記：在 phagophore 上，它作為 PX/FYVE 結構域效應蛋白的停靠平台，尤其是 WIPI 家族與 Atg18，它們會招募 phagophore 擴張與 autophagosome 生長所需的下游 ATG 蛋白。

context.en-US: PIKfyve phosphorylates PtdIns3P at the 5-position to produce PtdIns(3,5)P2 on endolysosomal membranes. This conversion is essential for endosomal maturation and for resolving autophagic cargo into the lysosome, and the early-endosome switch from Rab5/PtdIns3P to Rab7/PtdIns(3,5)P2 defines the early-to-late endosome transition.
context.zh-TW: PIKfyve 將 PtdIns3P 在 5 位磷酸化，生成內溶體膜上的 PtdIns(3,5)P2。此轉換對內體成熟與將自噬貨物送往溶酶體至關重要，而早期內體由 Rab5/PtdIns3P 轉換為 Rab7/PtdIns(3,5)P2，正定義了早到晚期內體的轉變。

context.en-US: Rab5 promotes homotypic early endosome fusion and recruits the class III PI3K Vps34 to generate PtdIns3P on endosomal membranes, a lipid also essential for phagophore formation. In its GTP-bound state Rab5 engages EEA1, the HOPS tethering complex and motor adaptors; Rabex-5 activates it while RabGAPs such as TBC1D2 inactivate it.
context.zh-TW: Rab5 促進早期內體的同型融合，並招募第三類 PI3K Vps34 在內體膜上產生 PtdIns3P，而此脂質對 phagophore 形成同樣必需。在 GTP 結合狀態下，Rab5 與 EEA1、HOPS 拴繫複合體及馬達銜接蛋白作用；Rabex-5 活化它，而如 TBC1D2 的 RabGAP 使其失活。

context.en-US: During endosome maturation Rab5 is replaced by Rab7: Rab5 actively recruits Rab7 through the Mon1-Ccz1 Rab7 GEF and SAND1/MON1, driving the Rab5-to-Rab7 conversion that defines the early-to-late endosome transition. This handoff is critical for proper autophagosome-lysosome fusion and delivery of autophagic cargo to degradative compartments.
context.zh-TW: 在內體成熟過程中 Rab5 被 Rab7 取代：Rab5 透過 Rab7 GEF Mon1-Ccz1 與 SAND1/MON1 主動招募 Rab7，驅動定義早到晚期內體轉變的 Rab5-to-Rab7 轉換。此交接對正常的 autophagosome–溶酶體融合與將自噬貨物送至降解區室至關重要。

context.en-US: SetA, a Legionella effector, glucosylates and inactivates Rab5 (and Rab22), immobilizing endosomes and blocking autophagosome-lysosome fusion to create a replication-permissive vacuole. Similar strategies are used by other vacuolar pathogens to evade xenophagy, and overactive Rab5 signaling is implicated in oncogenic growth.
context.zh-TW: SetA 是 Legionella 的效應蛋白，會對 Rab5（及 Rab22）進行葡萄糖基化使其失活，固定內體並阻斷 autophagosome–溶酶體融合，以形成利於複製的液泡。其他液泡型病原體也採取類似策略以逃避 xenophagy，而 Rab5 訊號過度活化則與致癌生長有關。

context.en-US: RHEB-1 is the C. elegans orthologue of the small GTPase Rheb and a key activator of mTOR (CeTOR) in response to nutrient signals. RHEB-1 activates Autophagy under dietary restriction and regulates dauer formation, and is required for the lifespan extension seen in certain intermittent fasting models.
context.zh-TW: RHEB-1 是小 GTP 酶 Rheb 在 C. elegans 中的同源物，也是營養訊號下 mTOR（CeTOR）的關鍵活化因子。RHEB-1 在飲食限制下活化 Autophagy 並調控 dauer 形成，且為某些間歇性禁食模型中壽命延展所必需。

context.en-US: The longevity phenotype of MXL-3 mutants is not suppressed by inactivation of rheb-1, indicating that the MXL-3 and Rheb/mTOR routes to longevity in C. elegans act through different pathways rather than a single linear axis.
context.zh-TW: MXL-3 突變體的長壽表型不會因 rheb-1 失活而被抑制，表示 C. elegans 中 MXL-3 與 Rheb/mTOR 兩條長壽路徑是透過不同機制作用，而非同一條線性軸。

context.en-US: Rab7 is a small Ras-related GTPase that defines late endosomal and lysosomal identity and governs the terminal steps of degradative membrane traffic. In its GTP-bound state on late endosomal membranes Rab7 drives the maturation of endosomes into lysosomes and is indispensable for the fusion of mature autophagosomes with late endosomes and lysosomes to form autolysosomes, thereby enabling autophagic degradation within the lysosomal lumen.
context.zh-TW: Rab7 是一個小的 Ras 相關 GTP 酶，定義晚內體與溶酶體的身分，並調控降解性膜運輸的最後步驟。在晚內體膜上處於 GTP 結合狀態時，Rab7 驅動內體成熟為溶酶體，對成熟自噬體與晚內體／溶酶體融合形成自噬溶酶體是不可或缺的，藉此在溶酶體腔內進行自噬降解。

context.en-US: Active Rab7 recruits tethering and fusion machinery that bridges SNARE complexes such as syntaxin 17, promoting membrane merger of autophagosomes with lysosomes. Loss of Rab7 or dominant-negative Rab7 mutants arrest autophagosomes as undigested vesicles and elevate p62 and LC3-II, the classic markers of impaired autophagic flux despite normal autophagosome formation.
context.zh-TW: 活化的 Rab7 招募連接與融合機制，橋接如 syntaxin 17 等 SNARE 複合體，促進自噬體與溶酶體的膜融合。Rab7 缺失或表現顯性負效應突變會使自噬體停滯為未消化囊泡，並提高 p62 與 LC3-II（自噬流受阻的典型標記），儘管自噬體形成本身正常。

context.en-US: Rab7 activation occurs as endosomes mature: the early endosome-specific GTPase Rab5, together with PtdIns3P, is replaced by late endosome-specific Rab7 and PtdIns(3,5)P2, with the Mon1–Ccz1 complex acting as Rab7's major GEF. Rab7 dysfunction thus reflects failure of the Rab5-to-Rab7 handoff during endolysosomal maturation.
context.zh-TW: Rab7 的活化發生在內體成熟過程中：內體特異的 GTP 酶 Rab5 與 PtdIns3P 被晚內體特異的 Rab7 與 PtdIns(3,5)P2 取代，其中 Mon1–Ccz1 複合體是 Rab7 的主要 GEF。因此 Rab7 的功能失調反映了內體成熟過程中 Rab5 到 Rab7 交接的失敗。

context.en-US: Rab7 participates in endo-lysosomal positioning, clustering degradative organelles perinuclearly under nutrient stress to facilitate Autophagy. Conversely, defective Rab7-mediated fusion contributes to accumulation of protein aggregates in Neurodegeneration and impairs clearance in Aging, while pathogens and oncogenic signals modulate Rab7 to evade xenophagy or sustain proliferative metabolism in Cancer.
context.zh-TW: Rab7 參與內體－溶酶體的定位，在營養壓力下將降解性胞器聚集於核周以促進自噬。反之，Rab7 介導的融合缺陷會促成神經退化性疾病中蛋白聚集體的累積，並在老化中損害清除能力；病原體與致癌訊號則藉由調節 Rab7 以逃避異源自噬或維持腫瘤的增殖性代謝。

context.en-US: Rapalogs are derivatives of Rapamycin (also known as sirolimus) that act as allosteric inhibitors of mTOR. Members of the class include Everolimus (RAD001), Temsirolimus and Ridaforolimus. Because they are rapamycin analogues, rapalogs share the mTOR-binding mechanism of the parent compound while differing in pharmacokinetic properties.
context.zh-TW: Rapalog 是 Rapamycin（又称 sirolimus）的衍生物，作為 mTOR 的異構性抑制劑。該類成員包括 Everolimus（RAD001）、Temsirolimus 與 Ridaforolimus。由於屬於 rapamycin 的類似物，Rapalog 與母體化合物共享 mTOR 結合機制，但在藥代動力學特性上有所不同。

context.en-US: Rapalogs are allosteric inhibitors of mTOR that act preferentially on mTORC1 and thereby induce Autophagy. Highly mTORC1-selective rapalogs are desired in the clinic to avoid the adverse effects on glucose tolerance that arise from mTORC2 inhibition, which is why rapalogs are widely used in Cancer therapy and as immunosuppressive agents in organ transplantation.
context.zh-TW: Rapalog 是 mTOR 的異構性抑制劑，主要作用於 mTORC1，進而誘導自噬。臨床上希望有高度 mTORC1 選擇性的 Rapalog，以避免因抑制 mTORC2 而造成的葡萄糖耐受不良；因此 Rapalog 廣泛用於癌症治療與器官移植的免疫抑制。

context.en-US: By inhibiting mTORC1, rapalogs relieve the tonic brake on autophagy initiation and induce Autophagy. This property underlies their investigation as geroprotective treatments for age-associated diseases such as COVID-19 and Osteoarthritis, alongside their established immunosuppressive and anticancer roles.
context.zh-TW: 藉由抑制 mTORC1，Rapalog 解除對自噬起始的持續性抑制並誘導自噬。這項性質使它們除了既定的免疫抑制與抗癌用途外，也被研究作為 COVID-19 與骨關節炎等年齡相關疾病的延緩老化治療。

context.en-US: Regulatory-associated protein of mTOR (Raptor) is an essential scaffold component of mTORC1. As the structural backbone of the five-subunit complex, Raptor regulates mTORC1 assembly and activity and is the subunit through which nutrient-loaded Rag GTPases recruit the complex to the lysosomal surface in nutrient-rich conditions.
context.zh-TW: mTOR 的調節相關蛋白 Raptor 是 mTORC1 不可或缺的支架成分。作為這五次單元複合體的結構骨架，Raptor 調控 mTORC1 的組裝與活性，也是富含營養時攜帶營養的 Rag GTP 酶把複合體招募到溶酶體表面的次單元。

context.en-US: Raptor is the substrate-binding scaffold of mTORC1, docking canonical substrates such as S6K1 and 4E-BP1 through their TOS motifs. This short linear motif engagement is what allows mTORC1 to phosphorylate these effectors and thereby control translation initiation and growth.
context.zh-TW: Raptor 是 mTORC1 的受體結合支架，透過 TOS 序列停靠 S6K1 與 4E-BP1 等典型受體。正是這種短線性序列的結合，使 mTORC1 能磷酸化這些效應蛋白，進而控制轉譯起始與生長。

context.en-US: Raptor interacts with RagA/B GTP–RagC/D GDP heterodimers to tether mTORC1 to the lysosome in nutrient-abundant conditions, where the lysosomal surface functions as the platform for mTORC1 activation by Rheb. Without this Raptor-mediated recruitment the complex cannot be positioned where its kinase action is coupled to luminal nutrient levels.
context.zh-TW: Raptor 與 RagA/B GTP–RagC/D GDP 異二聚體結合，在營養充足時把 mTORC1 錨定到溶酶體表面；該處正是 Rheb 活化 mTORC1 的平台。若缺乏 Raptor 介導的招募，複合體便無法被定位到其激酶作用與腔內營養濃度相耦合的位置。

context.en-US: Rapamycin-insensitive companion of mTOR (Rictor) is a core component of mTORC2, essential for the structural integrity and kinase activity of the six-protein complex. Rictor scaffolds mTOR, mSIN1, Protor-1 and mLST8, and its rapamycin-insensitivity is what gives mTORC2 its name.
context.zh-TW: Rapamycin 不敏感的 mTOR 伴隨蛋白 Rictor 是 mTORC2 的核心成分，對這個六蛋白複合體的結構完整性與激酶活性不可或缺。Rictor 支架化 mTOR、mSIN1、Protor-1 與 mLST8，而其對 rapamycin 的不敏感性正是 mTORC2 命名之由來。

context.en-US: Within mTORC2, Rictor acts as the organizing scaffold holding together mTOR, mSIN1, Protor-1 and mLST8. Loss of Rictor destabilizes the assembled complex, and it is this scaffolding role that permits the complex to phosphorylate its downstream effectors such as Akt at S473 and SGK1.
context.zh-TW: 在 mTORC2 中，Rictor 作為組織性支架，將 mTOR、mSIN1、Protor-1 與 mLST8 維繫在一起。Rictor 缺失會使組裝好的複合體不穩定，而正是這種支架功能讓複合體得以磷酸化其下游效應蛋白，如 Akt 的 S473 與 SGK1。

context.en-US: S-sulfhydration (persulfidation) is the post-translational modification of cysteine thiols to persulfides (-SSH) by hydrogen sulfide. TFEB undergoes S-sulfhydration at C212, and the modification enhances TFEB activity by promoting its nuclear translocation, the switch that turns on lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes.
context.zh-TW: S-硫氫化（persulfidation）是硫化氫將半胱胺酸硫醇修飾為過硫化物（-SSH）的轉譯後修飾。TFEB 在 C212 發生 S-硫氫化，該修飾藉由促進其核轉位而增強 TFEB 活性，也就是打開溶酶體生成與自噬基因的開關。

context.en-US: Hydrogen sulfide donors such as NaHS and GYY4137 induce Autophagy via TFEB nuclear translocation and AMPK activation. Because S-sulfhydration enhances the activity of TFEB, Keap1 and GAPDH, this H2S-driven modification has therapeutic potential in Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury and Neurodegeneration.
