context.zh-TW: 硫化氫供體如 NaHS 與 GYY4137 會透過 TFEB 核轉位與 AMPK 活化誘導自噬。由於 S-硫氫化可增強 TFEB、Keap1 與 GAPDH 的活性，這條由 H2S 驅動的修飾在心肌缺血再灌注損傷與神經退化性疾病中具有治療潛力。

context.en-US: Serum- and glucocorticoid-induced protein kinase 1 (SGK1) is an AGC family kinase that is activated by mTORC2. mTORC2 phosphorylates SGK1 at S422 and PDK1 at T256, and unlike Akt — which retains basal activity when mTORC2 is inhibited — SGK1 activity is totally abrogated under those conditions, making SGK1 a faithful readout of mTORC2 signalling.
context.zh-TW: 血清與糖皮質激素誘導蛋白激酶 1（SGK1）是 AGC 激酶家族成員，由 mTORC2 活化。mTORC2 在 S422 磷酸化 SGK1，PDK1 在 T256 磷酸化；與在 mTORC2 受抑制時仍保有基礎活性的 Akt 不同，SGK1 的活性在此條件下會完全消失，因此 SGK1 是 mTORC2 訊號的忠实讀出。

context.en-US: SGK1 is a member of the AGC family of kinases that shares functional similarities with Akt in regulating cell survival and stress responses. Downstream of mTORC2 it regulates ion transport, cell survival and Autophagy, placing it at the intersection of growth signalling and the stress-response machinery that governs autophagic induction.
context.zh-TW: SGK1 是 AGC 激酶家族成員，在調節細胞存活與壓力反應上與 Akt 具有功能相似性。在 mTORC2 下游，SGK1 調節離子運輸、細胞存活與自噬，位於生長訊號與調控自噬誘發的壓力反應機制的交會處。

context.en-US: SLC36A1-4 (PAT1–PAT4) are proton-coupled amino acid transporters; the lysosomal isoforms PAT1/SLC36A1 and PAT4/SLC36A4 face the lumen and release neutral amino acids such as glycine, alanine and proline to the cytosol, using the inward proton gradient maintained by the V-ATPase. They are secondary-active symporters coupling amino acid efflux to proton influx.
context.zh-TW: SLC36A1-4（PAT1–PAT4）是質子偶聯胺基酸轉運蛋白；溶酶體型的 PAT1/SLC36A1 與 PAT4/SLC36A4 朝向腔內，利用由 V-ATPase 維持的向內質子梯度，將甘胺酸、丙胺酸、脯胺酸等中性胺基酸釋放至細胞質。它們是將胺基酸外流與質子內流偶聯的次級主動同向轉運蛋白。

context.en-US: Lysosomal PAT1 exports the products of autophagic proteolysis into the cytosol, raising cytosolic amino acid pools that — together with the Ragulator–Rag proteins arginine-sensing axis — support mTORC1 activation. Inhibition or depletion of PAT1 conversely reduces amino-acid-dependent mTORC1 signalling and promotes autophagy, closing the loop between lysosomal catabolism and anabolism.
context.zh-TW: 溶酶體的 PAT1 將自噬蛋白水解的產物輸出至細胞質，提高細胞質胺基酸儲量；這些胺基酸與 Ragulator–Rag proteins 的精胺酸感測軸共同支持 mTORC1 活化。反之，抑制或耗竭 PAT1 會降低胺基酸依賴性的 mTORC1 訊號並促進自噬，於是連結了溶酶體分解代謝與合成代謝。

context.en-US: By moving amino acids out of the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol, the SLC36 family connects lysosomal catabolism to cellular nutrient sensing and modulates mTORC1 activity, thereby influencing Autophagy and lysosomal homeostasis. Depleting a member such as PAT1 relieves mTORC1 inhibition and increases autophagic flux.
context.zh-TW: SLC36 家族將胺基酸由溶酶體腔移至細胞質，把溶酶體分解代謝連結到細胞的營養感測並調節 mTORC1 活性，進而影響自噬與溶酶體恆定。耗竭 PAT1 這類成員可解除對 mTORC1 的抑制並提高自噬流。

context.en-US: SLC38A9 is a lysosomal sodium-coupled amino acid transporter that also acts as a lysosomal arginine sensor. When luminal arginine is present SLC38A9 engages the Ragulator–Rag proteins complex to promote GTP-loading of RagA/B, recruiting mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface where it is activated by Rheb; autophagy is consequently suppressed.
context.zh-TW: SLC38A9 是溶酶體的鈉偶聯胺基酸轉運蛋白，同時也是溶酶體精胺酸感測器。當腔內存在精胺酸時，SLC38A9 與 Ragulator–Rag proteins 複合體結合以促進 RagA/B 的 GTP 載入，把 mTORC1 招募到溶酶體表面並由 Rheb 活化，結果是自噬受到抑制。

context.en-US: SLC38A9 binds and transports cationic amino acids — principally arginine and lysine — from the lysosomal lumen using the inward Na+ gradient, and in its sensor capacity allosterically communicates lysosomal arginine availability to Ragulator. Cryo-EM structures show a canonical LeuT-fold architecture with a lysosomal-facing binding site that distinguishes cationic residues.
context.zh-TW: SLC38A9 利用向內的 Na+ 梯度結合並轉運來自溶酶體腔的陽離子胺基酸（主要是精胺酸與離胺酸），並在感測功能上以異構方式將溶酶體內的精胺酸可用性傳遞給 Ragulator。冷凍電顯結構顯示其為典型 LeuT 摺疊架構，具有朝溶酶體側、能區辨陽離子殘基的結合位點。

context.en-US: Amino acid starvation or SLC38A9 loss reduces Rag activation, dissociates mTORC1 from the lysosome and de-represses TFEB/TFE3 to induce lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic flux. SLC38A9 thus sits at the apex of the amino acid–mTORC1–autophagy axis and is required for mTORC1 reactivation after starvation refeeding.
context.zh-TW: 胺基酸飢餓或 SLC38A9 缺失會降低 Rag 活化、使 mTORC1 與溶酶體解離，並解除對 TFEB/TFE3 的抑制以誘導溶酶體生成與自噬流。SLC38A9 因此位於胺基酸–mTORC1–自噬軸的頂端，且為飢餓後再餵食時 mTORC1 重新活化所必需。

context.en-US: SMAD3 is the receptor-regulated (R-SMAD) transcription factor that mediates signalling from the TGFβ superfamily. It is directly phosphorylated at C-terminal serines in the SSXS motif by the TGFBR1 (ALK5) receptor kinase upon TGF-β ligand binding, then heteromerises with SMAD4 and translocates to the nucleus to regulate target gene transcription with co-activators such as P300 and Ski.
context.zh-TW: SMAD3 是受體調控型（R-SMAD）轉錄因子，負責傳遞 TGFβ 超家族的訊號。在 TGF-β 配體結合時，SMAD3 由 TGFBR1（ALK5）受體激酶直接在其 SSXS 序列的 C 端絲胺酸磷酸化，隨後與 SMAD4 形成異源複合體並轉位入核，與 P300、Ski 等輔活化因子共同調控標的基因轉錄。

context.en-US: SMAD3 is a critical negative regulator of autophagy through its repression of TFEB. Hyperactivated SMAD3 — under diabetic conditions or chronic TGF-β stimulation — binds the 3'-UTR of the TFEB gene and inhibits its transcription; reduced TFEB expression leads to lysosomal depletion, impaired autophagic clearance, and accumulation of protein aggregates and damaged organelles.
context.zh-TW: SMAD3 透過抑制 TFEB 成為自噬的關鍵負向調節因子。在糖尿病狀態或長期 TGF-β 刺激下，過度活化的 SMAD3 會結合 TFEB 基因的 3'-UTR 並抑制其轉錄；TFEB 表現降低導致溶酶體耗竭、自噬清除受損，以及蛋白聚集體與受損胞器的累積。

context.en-US: SMAD3 is the primary TGF-β effector driving pathological fibrosis. It directly activates transcription of extracellular matrix genes such as COL1A1 in fibroblasts and myofibroblasts, and Smad3-knockout mice are protected from bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis and carbon tetrachloride-induced liver fibrosis. SMAD3 also promotes EMT, contributing to fibroblast expansion in fibrotic organs.
context.zh-TW: SMAD3 是驅動病理性纖維化的主要 TGF-β 效應因子。它在纖維母細胞與肌纖維母細胞中直接活化細胞外基質基因（如 COL1A1）的轉錄，而 Smad3 基因剔除小鼠可免於博來黴素誘發的肺纖維化與四氯化碳誘發的肝纖維化。SMAD3 也促進 EMT，使纖維化器官中的纖維母細胞擴增。

context.en-US: SIRT6 suppresses the SMAD3 transcriptional axis by deacetylating H3K9 at SMAD3 target gene promoters, which reduces pro-fibrotic gene expression. This sirtuin-mediated counterbalance also attenuates EMT by suppressing the TGF-beta1/SMAD3 pathway, providing a brake on the fibrotic output of TGF-β signalling.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 藉由在 SMAD3 標的基因的啟動子上去乙醯化 H3K9，抑制 SMAD3 的轉錄軸，進而降低促纖維化基因的表現。這條 sirtuin 介導的制衡也透過抑制 TGF-beta1/SMAD3 路徑而減輕 EMT，為 TGF-β 訊號的纖維化輸出提供煞車。

context.en-US: SIRT7 deacetylates SMAD3 directly, reducing its transcriptional activity and pro-fibrotic output. Whereas SIRT6 acts indirectly at chromatin by deacetylating H3K9, SIRT7 removes acetyl groups from the SMAD3 protein itself, providing a second, distinct point of control over the same transcriptional effector.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7 直接去乙醯化 SMAD3，降低其轉錄活性與促纖維化輸出。相較於 SIRT6 在染色質層級藉由去乙醯化 H3K9 而間接作用，SIRT7 是移除 SMAD3 蛋白本身上的乙醯基，為同一轉錄效應因子提供第二個不同的調控點。

context.en-US: SNARE proteins are a large family of proteins that mediate membrane fusion between organelles, including the fusion of autophagosomes with lysosomes. Autophagosome-specific SNARE components such as STX17, SNAP29 and VAMP8 drive the tethering-and-merge step, with STX17 recruited to the completed autophagosome for fusion.
context.zh-TW: SNARE proteins 是一大族介導胞器間膜融合的蛋白質，包括自噬體與溶酶體的融合。自噬體特異的 SNARE 成分如 STX17、SNAP29 與 VAMP8 驅動連接與融合步驟，其中 STX17 被招募至已完成的自噬體以進行融合。

context.en-US: SNARE proteins mediate membrane fusion between organelles such as the fusion of autophagosomes or phagosomes with lysosomes. The autophagosome–lysosome fusion that these SNAREs execute is itself regulated by nutrients, linking membrane-fusion control to the nutrient status of the cell.
context.zh-TW: SNARE proteins 介導胞器間的膜融合，例如自噬體或吞噬體與溶酶體的融合。這些 SNARE 所執行的自噬體－溶酶體融合本身受營養狀態調控，使膜融合的控制與細胞的營養狀況相連結。

context.en-US: SREBP1 is a transcription factor controlling lipid biosynthesis genes for fatty acids, triglycerides and phospholipids, and autophagy and lipogenesis are coordinately regulated by mTORC1 to balance lipid anabolism and catabolism. Because the same mTORC1 node drives both SREBP1-dependent lipogenesis and autophagic initiation, lipid synthesis and lipid turnover are reciprocally constrained.
context.zh-TW: SREBP1 是控制脂肪酸、三酸甘油酯與磷脂質等脂質生合成基因的轉錄因子，而自噬與脂質生合成受 mTORC1 協調調控，以平衡脂質合成代謝與分解代謝。由於同一個 mTORC1 節點同時驅動 SREBP1 依賴的脂質生成與自噬起始，脂質合成與脂質周轉因此互相制約。

context.en-US: SREBP1 is a master transcription factor for lipid and cholesterol homeostasis whose activity is positively regulated by mTORC1. mTORC1 activates SREBP1 via S6K1 and LIPIN1, so that when nutrients are abundant the lipogenic program is switched on together with growth signalling and autophagy is held in check.
context.zh-TW: SREBP1 是脂質與膽固醇恆定的主要轉錄因子，其活性受 mTORC1 正向調節。mTORC1 透過 S6K1 與 LIPIN1 活化 SREBP1，因此當營養充足時，脂質生成程序與生長訊號一同被開啟，而自噬受到抑制。

context.en-US: SUMOylation is a reversible post-translational modification in which Small Ubiquitin-like Modifier proteins are covalently attached to lysine residues of target proteins. SUMOylation of TFEB at K316 attenuates its transcriptional activity, dampening expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes; like ubiquitylation it proceeds through an E1 activating enzyme (SAE1/SAE2), the E2 UBC9 and E3 ligases, but it modulates protein interactions, localization and stability rather than directing degradation.
context.zh-TW: SUMOylation 是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，Sumo 類泛素修飾蛋白被共價連接到目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基上。TFEB 在 K316 的 SUMOylation 會削弱其轉錄活性，壓低溶酶體與自噬基因的表現；與泛素化相同，它經由 E1 活化酶（SAE1/SAE2）、E2 UBC9 與 E3 連接酶進行，但它調節的是蛋白質交互作用、定位與穩定性，而非導向降解。

context.en-US: In Autophagy, SUMOylation dynamically regulates key nodes including ULK1, TFEB and GABARAP, balancing autophagic induction against lysosomal biogenesis. ULK1 SUMOylation influences its kinase activity and interaction with downstream ATG factors, modulating initiation under stress, while GABARAP family members — key LC3 paralogs for autophagosome closure — are SUMO-regulated to control their membrane association and flux.
context.zh-TW: 在自噬中，SUMOylation 動態調節 ULK1、TFEB 與 GABARAP 等關鍵節點，在自噬誘發與溶酶體生成之間取得平衡。ULK1 的 SUMOylation 影響其激酶活性與下游 ATG 因子的交互作用，調節壓力下的起始步驟；而作為自噬體閉合關鍵 LC3 旁系同源的 GABARAP 家族成員，也受 SUMO 調節以控制其膜結合與通量。

context.en-US: The balance of SUMOylation versus de-SUMOylation by SENP proteases sets the threshold for autophagic induction and autophagic–lysosomal maturation. Altered SUMOylation is implicated in Neurodegeneration, where impaired clearance of SUMO-modified aggregates accumulates, and in Cancer, where SUMO pathway enzymes are dysregulated to support proliferation and stress survival.
context.zh-TW: SUMOylation 與由 SENP 蛋白酶執行的去 SUMOylation 之間的平衡，決定了自噬誘發與自噬－溶酶體成熟的閾值。SUMOylation 的異常與神經退化性疾病相關（SUMO 修飾聚集體的清除受損而累積），也與癌症相關（SUMO 途徑酵素被失調以支持增殖與壓力存活）。

context.en-US: Sestrin2 is a stress-inducible leucine sensor and oxidoreductase that inhibits mTORC1 by binding GATOR2 in the absence of leucine. Because GATOR2 is part of the GATOR1 complex that relays amino acid availability to Rag GTPases, Sestrin2 acts as the low-leucine signal that releases the brake on mTORC1.
context.zh-TW: Sestrin2 是可被壓力誘發的亮胺酸感測蛋白與氧化還原酶，在缺乏亮胺酸時藉由結合 GATOR2 抑制 mTORC1。由於 GATOR2 是將胺基酸可用性傳遞給 Rag GTP 酶之 GATOR1 複合體的一部分，Sestrin2 便扮演低亮胺酸訊號，解除對 mTORC1 的煞車。

context.en-US: Sestrin2 activates Autophagy under stress conditions such as hypoxia, genotoxic stress and metabolic stress. It does so by inhibiting mTORC1 through GATOR2 and by activating AMPK via LKB1, two parallel arms that both converge on autophagic induction; Sestrin2 additionally functions as an antioxidant by reducing Peroxiredoxin.
context.zh-TW: Sestrin2 在缺氧、基因毒性壓力與代謝壓力等條件下活化自噬。其方式是透過 GATOR2 抑制 mTORC1，以及透過 LKB1 活化 AMPK，這兩條平行途徑皆匯入自噬誘發；此外 Sestrin2 也藉由還原 Peroxiredoxin 而具有抗氧化功能。

context.en-US: Sestrin2 activates AMPK via LKB1. This arm complements its GATOR2-mediated inhibition of mTORC1: because AMPK and mTORC1 are the two principal switches of the autophagy initiation decision, Sestrin2 engages both to make autophagic induction robust rather than threshold-dependent.
context.zh-TW: Sestrin2 透過 LKB1 活化 AMPK。這條途徑與其經由 GATOR2 抑制 mTORC1 的作用互補：由於 AMPK 與 mTORC1 是自噬起始決定的兩個主要開關，Sestrin2 同時調動兩者，使自噬誘發更為穩健而非僅依賴閾值。

context.en-US: SetA is an effector protein from Legionella pneumophila that glucosylates TFEB at multiple sites, leading to its nuclear enrichment by interfering with 14-3-3 protein binding. Because 14-3-3 binding normally retains TFEB in the cytosol, the glucosylation event hijacks the host's own regulatory mechanism to drive TFEB into the nucleus.
context.zh-TW: SetA 是來自嗜肺性退伍軍人菌的效應蛋白，會在多個位點對 TFEB 進行葡萄糖基化，藉由干擾 14-3-3 protein 的結合而使 TFEB 在核內富集。由於與 14-3-3 的結合通常將 TFEB 侷限於細胞質，這個葡萄糖基化事件劫持了宿主自身的調控機制，把 TFEB 驅入細胞核。

context.en-US: SetA is a Legionella pneumophila effector with glucosyltransferase activity that modifies host Rab5 and Rab7 to subvert endosomal trafficking and block Autophagy during infection. Glucosylating the very GTPases that define endosomal identity hijacks the host degradative pathway so that the pathogen's replication niche is not destroyed.
context.zh-TW: SetA 是嗜肺性退伍軍人菌的效應蛋白，具有葡萄糖基轉移酶活性，會修飾宿主的 Rab5 與 Rab7 以劫持內體運輸並在感染期間阻斷自噬。對定義內體身分的那些 GTP 酶進行葡萄糖基化，等於劫持宿主的降解途徑，使病原體的複製利基不會被破壞。

context.en-US: Single-cell omics comprises technologies such as scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, single-cell proteomics and spatial transcriptomics that profile individual cells, circumventing the averaging inherent in bulk measurements. In Autophagy research these methods reveal pronounced cell-to-cell heterogeneity in autophagic flux, lysosomal capacity and nutrient sensing, showing how mTORC1 and TFEB programs differ between cells within the same tissue.
context.zh-TW: Single-cell omics 包含 scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq、單細胞蛋白組學與空間轉錄組等技術，可分析個別細胞，避開大量測量的平均化缺陷。在自噬研究中，這些方法揭示了自噬流、溶酶體容量與營養感測的顯著細胞間異質性，顯示同一組織內不同細胞的 mTORC1 與 TFEB 程序如何有所差異。

context.en-US: Single-cell omics has exposed that autophagic heterogeneity underlies resistant clones in Cancer and focal vulnerability in Neurodegeneration, identifying subpopulations of senescent or metabolically stressed cells with high basal autophagy and tumour cells that evade autophagic death. As cost falls these methods are becoming standard for stratifying patients by autophagic–lysosomal health.
context.zh-TW: Single-cell omics 已揭示自噬的異質性是癌症中耐藥克隆的基礎，也是神經退化性疾病中局部脆弱性的來源，並可辨識出具有高基礎自噬的衰老或代謝壓力細胞亞群，以及逃避自噬性死亡的腫瘤細胞。隨著成本下降，這些方法正成為依自噬－溶酶體健康度對患者分層的標準。

context.en-US: Single-cell omics maps which ATG Genes are required in specific contexts: perturbation atlases combining CRISPR screens with scRNA-seq identify the autophagy machinery genes needed in a given cell state, while lineage tracing coupled to scRNA-seq reveals how Mitophagy and Selective Autophagy programs shift during differentiation.
context.zh-TW: Single-cell omics 可繪出在特定情境下哪些 Atg 基因為必要：結合 CRISPR 篩選與 scRNA-seq 的擾動圖譜能鑑定特定細胞狀態所需的自噬機制基因，而與 scRNA-seq 結合的細胞譜系追蹤則揭示 Mitophagy 與 Selective Autophagy 程序在分化過程中如何變化。

context.en-US: Autophagy protects against steatohepatitis by clearing lipid droplets (Lipophagy), damaged mitochondria (Mitophagy) and protein aggregates. Steatohepatitis — nonalcoholic steatohepatitis characterized by hepatic steatosis, lobular inflammation and hepatocyte ballooning — progresses to fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma when this clearance fails.
context.zh-TW: 自噬藉由清除脂質滴（Lipophagy）、受損粒線體（Mitophagy）與蛋白聚集體來防止脂肪性肝炎。非酒精性脂肪性肝炎以肝脂肪變性、 小葉發炎與肝細胞氣球樣變為特徵，當這種清除失效時，疾病會進展為纖維化、肝硬化與肝細胞癌。

context.en-US: Targeting TFEB with drugs such as Ezetimibe can ameliorate Steatohepatitis by promoting autophagic clearance. Ezetimibe induces nuclear TFEB translocation by inhibiting a MAPK/ERK-related pathway, and TFEB activation reduces steatosis and inflammation in preclinical NASH models.
context.zh-TW: 以 Ezetimibe 等藥物針對 TFEB 可藉由促進自噬清除而改善脂肪性肝炎。Ezetimibe 藉由抑制 MAPK/ERK 相關路徑誘導 TFEB 核轉位，而 TFEB 的活化在臨床前 NASH 模型中可減少脂肪變性與發炎。

context.en-US: Autophagy is unexpectedly indispensable for T cell biology, supporting thymic development, naive-to-effector activation, clonal expansion, memory formation and the metabolic reprogramming that fuels proliferation. Loss of Atg proteins in T cells impairs survival, skews cytokine output and diminishes memory generation, because autophagy supplies amino acids and intermediates during the nutrient-limited phases of clonal expansion while preserving proteostasis.
context.zh-TW: 自噬對 T 細胞生物學出乎意料地不可或缺，支持胸腺發育、初始 T 細胞到效應 T 細胞的活化、克隆擴增、記憶形成，以及支撐增殖的代謝重編程。T 細胞中 Atg 蛋白的缺失會損害存活、扭曲細胞激素輸出並減少記憶生成，因為自噬在克隆擴增的營養受限階段供應胺基酸與中間產物，同時維持蛋白質恆定。

context.en-US: Upon antigen recognition T cells shift from oxidative phosphorylation to aerobic glycolysis while still requiring mitochondrial integrity. Mitophagy removes depolarised mitochondria, preventing excess Oxidative Stress and apoptotic priming and thereby supporting the metabolic switch; in chronic infection and Cancer exhausted T cells show defective autophagic flux that compromises antitumour immunity.
context.zh-TW: 抗原被辨識時，T 細胞由氧化磷酸化轉向有氧糖解，但同時仍需要粒線體的完整性。Mitophagy 移除去極化的粒線體，避免過度的氧化壓力與凋亡啟動化，因而支撐這個代謝轉換；在慢性感染與癌症中，耗竭的 T 細胞顯示自噬流缺陷，損害抗腫瘤免疫。

context.en-US: T cell autophagy restrains excessive Inflammation by limiting inflammasome activation and mitochondrial DNA release, and it influences regulatory T cell suppressive function and effector CD8+ cytotoxic activity. Selective autophagy of signalling molecules tunes TCR and cytokine receptor downstream pathways, integrating environmental cues with immune output.
context.zh-TW: T 細胞自噬藉由限制發炎小體活化與粒線體 DNA 釋放來抑制過度的發炎，並影響調節型 T 細胞的抑制功能與 CD8+ 效應細胞的細胞毒性活性。對訊號分子的選擇性自噬可微調 TCR 與細胞激素受體的下游路徑，將環境訊號與免疫輸出整合起來。

context.en-US: The TAME Trial (Targeting Aging with Metformin) is a FDA-approved clinical study testing whether Metformin delays aging-related multimorbidity. It enrolled 3000 participants aged 65 to 79 and examines whether metformin can attenuate the hallmarks of Aging and delay the onset of age-related diseases, using a framework of blood-based Biomarkers to monitor the intervention's effects.
context.zh-TW: TAME Trial（Targeting Aging with Metformin）是一項經 FDA 核准的臨床研究，測試 Metformin 能否延緩與老化相關的多病共存。它納入了 3000 名 65 至 79 歲的受試者，檢視 metformin 能否減弱老化的特徵並延後年齡相關疾病的發生，並以血液生物標記的框架監測介入的效應。

context.en-US: In the TFEB disease-model survey, TFEB activation — via mTORC1 inhibition, nuclear translocation, or gene therapy — rescues Lysosome and Autophagy function across lysosomal storage, neurodegenerative and metabolic disease models. In gene-therapy arms, AAV-TFEB or adenovirus-TFEB delivery increased glycogen clearance in GAA knockdown mice, reduced cystine within 24 hours in cystinotic cells, and decreased infarct volume after permanent middle cerebral artery occlusion.
context.zh-TW: 在 TFEB 疾病模型綜述中，TFEB 的活化——透過抑制 mTORC1、核轉位或基因治療——可在溶酶體儲積、神經退化與代謝疾病模型中挽救溶酶體與自噬功能。在基因治療組中，AAV-TFEB 或腺病毒 TFEB 的給藥在 GAA 敲低小鼠中增加了肝醣清除、在胱胺酸症細胞中於 24 小時內降低胱胺酸，並在永久性大腦中動脈阻塞後減少了腦梗塞體積。

context.en-US: Across the TFEB disease-model table, mTORC-mediated phosphorylation of TFEB is the dominant inhibitory axis. mTORC1 inhibition with Torin 1, the mTOR inhibitor CCI-779, or Celastrol all activate TFEB, inhibiting EtOH-induced liver injury and steatosis, attenuating spiral ganglion neuron degeneration, and reducing insoluble phosphorylated Tau aggregates while improving memory deficiency in P301S Tau transgenic mice.
context.zh-TW: 在 TFEB 疾病模型表中，mTOR 介導的 TFEB 磷酸化是主要的抑制軸。以 Torin 1、mTOR 抑制劑 CCI-779 或 Celastrol 抑制 mTORC1 皆能活化 TFEB，進而抑制乙醇誘發的肝損傷與脂肪變性、減輕耳螺旋神經節神經元退化，並在 P301S Tau 轉殖小鼠中減少不溶性磷酸化 Tau 聚集體同時改善記憶缺陷。

context.en-US: Two distinct TFEB-targeting mechanisms protect against Alzheimer's disease in the model survey. Interrupting the mTORC axis with Celastrol in P301S Tau transgenic mice reduced insoluble phosphorylated Tau aggregates and improved memory deficiency, while SIRT1-mediated deacetylation with resveratrol in fAβ-incubated primary microglia promoted degradation of fAβ.
context.zh-TW: 在模型綜述中，有兩種不同的 TFEB 靶向機制可對抗阿茲海默症。在 P301S Tau 轉殖小鼠中以 Celastrol 阻斷 mTOR 軸，可減少不溶性磷酸化 Tau 聚集體並改善記憶缺陷；而在 fAβ 孵育的原代小膠質細胞中，以 resveratrol 促進 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化，則促進 fAβ 的降解。

context.en-US: In the α-synuclein A53T-transgenic model of Parkinson's disease, targeting the p38 MAPK-mediated phosphorylation of TFEB with the inhibitor SB203580 reduced synapsin-1, a presynaptic protein. The finding links loss of TFEB-dependent lysosomal biogenesis to the synaptic degeneration seen in synucleinopathies.
context.zh-TW: 在帕金森氏症的 α-突觸核蛋白 A53T 轉殖模型中，以抑制劑 SB203580 針對 p38 MAPK 介導的 TFEB 磷酸化，可降低突觸素-1（一種突觸前蛋白）。此發現將 TFEB 依賴的溶酶體生成喪失與突觸核蛋白病中可見的突觸退化連結起來。

context.en-US: Transcription Factor EC (TFEC) is one of four members of the MiTF TFE family, alongside TFEB, TFE3 and MITF. TFEC contains the conserved basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper (bHLH-LZ) domain characteristic of the family, enabling DNA binding to E-box and CLEAR-box motifs.
context.zh-TW: 轉錄因子 EC（TFEC）是 MiTF TFE 家族四個成員之一，其他成員為 TFEB、TFE3 與 MITF。TFEC 含有該家族典型的保守性鹼性螺旋－環－螺旋－白胺酸拉鍊（bHLH-LZ）結構域，可與 E-box 及 CLEAR-box 序列結合。

context.en-US: Unlike other family members, TFEC lacks a transactivation domain in its N-terminal region, and it may function primarily as a transcriptional repressor or modulator of the lysosomal-autophagic program. It forms homo- and heterodimers with TFEB, TFE3 and MITF and may competitively inhibit their activity by occupying CLEAR-box binding sites or forming non-productive heterodimers; TFEC knockout studies suggest compensatory upregulation of TFEB and TFE3.
context.zh-TW: 與其他家族成員不同，TFEC 的 N 端區域缺乏轉錄活化結構域，因此它可能主要作為溶酶體－自噬轉錄程序的轉錄抑制子或調節因子。它與 TFEB、TFE3 及 MITF 形成同源與異源二聚體，並可能藉由占據 CLEAR-box 結合位點或形成無功能的異源二聚體來競爭性抑制它們的活性；TFEC 剔除研究顯示 TFEB 與 TFE3 會代償性上調。

context.en-US: Regulation of TFEC nuclear translocation parallels that of other MiTF/TFE family members, involving mTORC1-dependent phosphorylation and 14-3-3 protein-mediated cytosolic retention. As with TFEB and TFE3, phosphorylation by mTORC1 keeps TFEC sequestered in the cytosol and restrains the lysosomal-autophagic transcriptional program.
context.zh-TW: TFEC 核轉位的調控與其他 MiTF/TFE 家族成員平行，涉及 mTORC1 依賴的磷酸化與 14-3-3 protein 介導的細胞質滯留。與 TFEB 和 TFE3 相同，mTORC1 的磷酸化使 TFEC 被滯留於細胞質，抑制溶酶體－自噬轉錄程序。

context.en-US: TGF-β signaling proceeds through SMAD2/3 phosphorylation by the TβRI receptor kinase, complex formation with SMAD4, and nuclear translocation for target gene regulation. SMAD3 is therefore the transducer of the pathway, and its phosphorylation state sets the output of the entire cascade.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β 訊號經由 TβRI 受體激酶磷酸化 SMAD2/3、與 SMAD4 形成複合體，以及核轉位以調控標的基因。SMAD3 因而是此路徑的傳遞者，其磷酸化狀態決定了整個級聯的輸出。

context.en-US: TGF-β induces autophagy via SMAD3 and ATF4, but the relationship is bidirectional: autophagy also regulates TGF-β by degrading key pathway components. This bidirectional crosstalk matters in fibrosis and cancer, and hyperactivation of the transducer SMAD3 can instead inhibit TFEB expression and blunt autophagic flux.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β 透過 SMAD3 與 ATF4 誘導自噬，但兩者關係是雙向的：自噬也藉由降解關鍵路徑成分來調節 TGF-β。這種雙向交互作用在纖維化與癌症中十分重要；而傳遞者 SMAD3 的過度活化則可能抑制 TFEB 表現並削弱自噬流。

context.en-US: The TGF-β–autophagy crosstalk is bidirectional: TGF-β induces autophagy via SMAD3 and ATF4, while autophagy in turn degrades key components of the TGF-β pathway. This reciprocal degradation sets the threshold at which TGF-β activity, and therefore fibrotic output, is switched on or off.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β 與自噬之間的交互作用是雙向的：TGF-β 透過 SMAD3 與 ATF4 誘導自噬，而自噬反過來降解 TGF-β 路徑的關鍵成分。這種相互降解設定了 TGF-β 活性（因而也是纖維化輸出）被開啟或關閉的閾值。

context.en-US: TNKS2 (tankyrase 2, PARP5B) is one of two tankyrase isozymes that catalyze poly-ADP-ribosylation of substrate proteins. Its ankyrin repeat domain binds substrates such as axin, TRF1 and TFEB, and PARsylation of TFEB promotes its destabilisation and restricts its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes.
context.zh-TW: TNKS2（tankyrase 2，PARP5B）是兩種 tankyrase 異構酶之一，催化受體蛋白的 poly-ADP-核糖基化。其 ankyrin repeat 結構域結合 axin、TRF1 與 TFEB 等受體，而 TFEB 的 PARsylation 會促進其去穩定化並限制其溶酶體與自噬基因的轉錄程序。

context.en-US: Inhibition of tankyrases with small molecules such as XAV939 or JW74 stabilises TFEB, enhancing expression of autophagy–lysosome components and boosting clearance of aggregated proteins — relevant to Tau Pathology and Neurodegeneration. The tankyrase–TFEB link thus couples ADP-ribosylation signalling to catabolic flux.
context.zh-TW: 以 XAV939 或 JW74 等小分子抑制 tankyrase 可穩定 TFEB，提升自噬－溶酶體成分的表現並促進聚集蛋白的清除，這在 Tau 病理與神經退化性疾病中具有意義。因此 tankyrase–TFEB 的連結把 ADP-核糖基化訊號與分解代謝通量耦合起來。

context.en-US: Tankyrases (TNKS1 and TNKS2) are PARP5 poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases that interact with and parsylate TFEB, modulating its stability and nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. The PARP domain transfers ADP-ribose units from NAD+ onto glutamate, aspartate or lysine residues, building branched PAR chains that typically tag substrates for proteasomal degradation or altered localisation.
context.zh-TW: Tankyrases（TNKS1 與 TNKS2）是 PARP5 類的 poly(ADP-核糖)聚合酶，會與 TFEB 交互作用並對其進行 PARsylation，調節其穩定性與核－細胞質穿梭。其 PARP 結構域將 ADP-核糖單元從 NAD+ 轉移到麩胺酸、天門冬胺酸或離胺酸殘基上，形成分支的 PAR 鏈，通常將受體標記以供蛋白酶體降解或改變定位。

context.en-US: Tankyrases regulate telomere maintenance via TRF1, Wnt/β-catenin signaling via AXIN degradation, GLUT4 trafficking, and Autophagy via ULK1/TFEB stabilization. Tankyrase inhibitors are in development for cancer and fibrosis, and tankyrases are also implicated in mitotic spindle function and metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: Tankyrases 藉由 TRF1 調節端粒維持、藉由 AXIN 降解調節 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號、參與 GLUT4 運輸，並透過 ULK1/TFEB 穩定化調節自噬。Tankyrase 抑制劑正在為癌症與纖維化開發，而 tankyrases 也與有絲分裂紡錘體功能及代謝疾病有關。

context.en-US: Tuberous sclerosis complex 1 (TSC1), also known as hamartin, forms a heterodimer with TSC2 to function as a negative regulator of mTORC1 signaling. The TSC1–TSC2 complex acts as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP) for Rheb, driving Rheb into its GDP-bound inactive state and thereby shutting off the kinase that activates mTORC1.
context.zh-TW: 結節性硬化症複合體 1（TSC1，又稱 hamartin）與 TSC2 形成異二聚體，作為 mTORC1 訊號的負向調節因子。TSC1–TSC2 複合體作為 Rheb 的 GTP 酶活化蛋白（GAP），將 Rheb 驅入 GDP 結合的失活狀態，進而關閉活化 mTORC1 的激酶。

context.en-US: TSC1 (hamartin) forms a complex with TSC2 (tuberin) that acts as a GAP for Rheb, inhibiting mTORC1. One of the most important sensors involved in regulation of mTORC1 activity, the TSC heterodimer is also recruited to lysosomes by RagA/B GDP–RagC/D GTP heterodimers in starvation conditions, where it is an essential brake on nutrient-deprivation signalling.
context.zh-TW: TSC1（hamartin）與 TSC2（tuberin）形成複合體，該複合體作為 Rheb 的 GAP 而抑制 mTORC1。作為調控 mTORC1 活性最重要的感測器之一，TSC 異二聚體在飢餓條件下也會被 RagA/B GDP–RagC/D GTP 異二聚體招募至溶酶體，在那裡它是營養缺乏訊號不可或缺的煞車。

context.en-US: Tau pathology — abnormal post-translational modification, misfolding and progressive accumulation of the microtubule-associated protein tau within neurons — is a defining feature of Alzheimer's disease and related tauopathies such as progressive supranuclear palsy and frontotemporal dementia. Pathologic tau transitions from physiological microtubule binding into hyperphosphorylated fibrillar species that form Neurofibrillary tangles, impairing axonal transport and synaptic function.
context.zh-TW: Tau 病理——神經元內微管相關蛋白 tau 的異常轉譯後修飾、錯誤摺疊與逐步累積——是阿茲海默症與相關 tau 病（如進行性核上性麻痺與額顳葉失智症）的定義性特徵。病理性 tau 由生理性的微管結合轉為過度磷酸化的纖維狀物種，形成神經纖維糾結，損害軸突運輸與突觸功能。

context.en-US: Aggregated tau disrupts mitochondria, elevates Oxidative Stress and overwhelms proteostasis, while the autophagic–lysosomal system is the principal degradative route for tau — but in disease it is often impaired, with reduced TFEB-driven lysosomal biogenesis limiting clearance. This is why autophagic–lysosomal induction is a leading therapeutic strategy for tauopathies.
context.zh-TW: 聚集的 tau 破壞粒線體、升高氧化壓力並壓垮蛋白質恆定；自噬－溶酶體系統是 tau 的主要降解途徑，但在疾病中常受損，TFEB 驅動的溶酶體生成減少使清除受限。這也是為何自噬－溶酶體誘發被視為 tau 病的主要治療策略。

context.en-US: Enhancing TFEB activity transcriptionally upregulates lysosomal enzymes and autophagic receptors, accelerating tau degradation. Small molecules such as Celastrol and related TFEB activators, as well as mTORC1 inhibitors (rapalogues), stimulate autophagic flux and reduce tau burden in models, while Selective Autophagy receptors (p62, NBR1) recognise ubiquitinated tau for delivery to phagophores.
context.zh-TW: 提升 TFEB 活性會在轉錄層面上調溶酶體酵素與自噬受體，加速 tau 的降解。小分子如 Celastrol 及相關的 TFEB 活化劑，以及 mTORC1 抑制劑（rapalog 類），能刺激自噬流並在模型中降低 tau 負擔；而選擇性自噬受體（p62、NBR1）則辨識泛素化的 tau 並將其運送至吞噬膜。

context.en-US: Under pathological stress, kinases such as GSK3β and CDK5 outpace phosphatases, driving tau hyperphosphorylation that reduces microtubule affinity and promotes self-association into oligomers and filaments. These species spread trans-synaptically in a prion-like manner, seed monomers in recipient neurons, disrupt mitochondria, elevate Oxidative Stress, and overwhelm proteostasis.
context.zh-TW: 在病理性壓力下，GSK3β 與 CDK5 等激酶的速度超過磷酸酶，驅動 tau 過度磷酸化，降低其對微管的親和力並促進自我聚集形成寡聚體與纖維。這些物種以類普里昂方式在突觸間傳播，在受體神經元中播種單體，破壞粒線體、升高氧化壓力並壓垮蛋白質恆定。

context.en-US: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) is one of the three canonical types of Autophagy (alongside Macroautophagy and Microautophagy). Unlike the other routes it does not require vesicle formation: cytosolic proteins carrying a KFERQ-like motif are delivered directly into the lysosome for enzymatic degradation.
context.zh-TW: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) 是 Autophagy 的三種典型類型之一（與 Macroautophagy、Microautophagy 並列）。與其他途徑不同，它不需要囊泡形成：帶有 KFERQ 類基序的細胞質蛋白質直接被運送進 lysosome 進行酵素分解。

context.en-US: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy is the selective, lysosome-dependent route by which individual cytosolic proteins are degraded: the substrate-chaperone complex is delivered to the lysosomal membrane and translocated into the lysosome lumen, where lysosomal proteases destroy the cargo. Its decline during Aging correlates with toxic protein aggregate accumulation.
context.zh-TW: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy 是選擇性、依賴 lysosome 的途徑，藉由它分解個別細胞質蛋白質：受質—chaperone 複合體被運送至 lysosome 膜並轉位進入 lysosome 腔內，由 lysosome 蛋白酶分解負載物。其活性隨 Aging 下降，並與毒性蛋白聚集物的累積相關。

context.en-US: LAMP-2A (lysosome-associated membrane protein type 2A) is the lysosomal receptor that makes Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy possible: the Hsc70-bound substrate docks on LAMP-2A, which translocates the protein into the lysosome for degradation. Without LAMP-2A the substrate never crosses the membrane.
context.zh-TW: LAMP-2A（lysosome-associated membrane protein type 2A）是使 Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy 得以進行的 lysosome 受體：由 Hsc70 結合的受質停靠在 LAMP-2A 上，後者將蛋白質轉位進 lysosome 進行分解。缺乏 LAMP-2A 時受質無法跨越膜。

context.en-US: Cholesterol Metabolism comprises biosynthesis via the Mevalonate pathway, uptake via the LDL Receptor, esterification by ACAT1, and efflux through ABCA1 and ABCG1. ACAT1 also acts outside lipid handling, regulating TFEB activity through acetylation.
context.zh-TW: Cholesterol Metabolism 包含經由 Mevalonate pathway 的生合成、經 LDL Receptor 的攝取、由 ACAT1 催化的酯化，以及經 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 的外排。ACAT1 也參與脂質處理以外的調節，透過乙醯化調控 TFEB 活性。

context.en-US: Cholesterol Metabolism and Autophagy are linked in both directions: Autophagy delivers cholesterol from lipid droplets to lysosomes for hydrolysis by Lysosomal Acid Lipase, while accumulated cholesterol impairs autophagic flux. Conversely, adequate autophagic capacity supports cholesterol efflux and prevents lipotoxic accumulation.
context.zh-TW: Cholesterol Metabolism 與 Autophagy 呈雙向關聯：Autophagy 將胆固醇從脂滴運送至 lysosome，由 Lysosomal Acid Lipase 水解；反之，胆固醇堆積會損害自噬流。足夠的自噬能力則支持胆固醇外排，避免脂毒性累積。

context.en-US: DAF-7 is the C. elegans TGFβ ortholog, expressed mainly in sensory neurons. Unlike the insulin/insulin-receptor pathway, DAF-7 responds to environmental cues such as food availability and pheromones and acts on a different transcriptional output, notably not through the metabolic repressor MXL-3.
context.zh-TW: DAF-7 是 C. elegans 的 TGFβ 直系同源物，主要在感覺神經元表現。與 insulin/insulin receptor 路徑不同，DAF-7 會對食物可得性與費洛蒙等環境線索作出反應，且作用於不同的轉錄輸出，尤其並非透過代謝抑制因子 MXL-3。

context.en-US: DAF-7 links nutrient conditions to Autophagy in C. elegans: TGFβ signaling adjusts dauer entry, fat metabolism and autophagic activity under environmental stress. Loss of daf-7 (daf-7(e1372)) therefore perturbs stress-adaptive autophagy even though it leaves MXL-3 expression largely unchanged.
context.zh-TW: DAF-7 在 C. elegans 中把營養狀況與 Autophagy 連結起來：TGFβ 訊號在環境壓力下調整 dauer 進入、脂肪代謝與自噬活性。因此 daf-7（daf-7(e1372)）的缺失會擾亂壓力適應性自噬，即使 MXL-3 表現大致不受影響。

context.en-US: TFEB-mediated autophagy protects Dopamine Neuron from Alpha-synuclein toxicity. Dopamine neurons of the Substantia Nigra pars compacta are selectively vulnerable in Parkinson's Disease, and deleting TFEB (or Atg7) in mice triggers their degeneration together with protein aggregation.
context.zh-TW: 由 TFEB 介導的自噬可保護 Dopamine Neuron 免受 Alpha-synuclein 毒性傷害。Substantia Nigra pars compacta 的多巴胺神經元在 Parkinson's Disease 中具有選擇易感性，在小鼠中剔除 TFEB（或 Atg7）會誘發其退化與蛋白聚集。

context.en-US: Dopamine Neuron survival depends on basal Autophagy: impairment of autophagy machinery causes dopamine neuron degeneration and protein aggregation. The reverse framing is equally important — basal autophagy is a prerequisite for maintaining these neurons, whose loss is a hallmark of Parkinson's Disease.
context.zh-TW: Dopamine Neuron 的存活依賴基礎的 Autophagy：自噬機制受損會造成多巴胺神經元退化與蛋白聚集。反過來說同樣重要——基礎自噬是維持這些神經元的前提，而其流失正是 Parkinson's Disease 的標誌。

context.en-US: ESCRT machinery (complexes 0-III) performs the membrane scission that lets Selective Autophagy capture damaged organelles. After a defective peroxisome is tagged with ubiquitin and sensed by PERO1, ESCRT is recruited and engages LC3 to initiate engulfment into an autophagosome.
context.zh-TW: ESCRT 機制（0-III 複合體）執行膜切割，使 Selective Autophagy 能夠包圍受損胞器。當缺陷的 peroxisome 被泛素標記並由 PERO1 辨識後，ESCRT 被招募並與 LC3 互動，啟動包裹進 autophagosome 的過程。

context.en-US: LC3 on the autophagosome recruits ESCRT to drive the scission step that seals the autophagosome around cargo. ESCRT complexes 0-III also mediate membrane scission in multivesicular body formation, cytokinesis and autophagosome closure.
context.zh-TW: autophagosome 上的 LC3 招募 ESCRT，推動將囊泡封閉於負載物周圍的切割步驟。ESCRT 0-III 複合體也參與 multivesicular body 形成、細胞分裂以及 autophagosome 閉合的膜切割。

context.en-US: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) is an ATP-dependent pathway that rebuilds Lysosome from endolysosomes after endocytic cargo has been degraded. It is distinct from Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, which regenerates lysosomes from autolysosomes after autophagic turnover.
context.zh-TW: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) 是一條 ATP 依賴途徑，在內吞負載物被分解後由 endolysosome 重建 Lysosome。它與 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 不同，後者是在自噬周轉之後由 autolysosome 再生 lysosome。

context.en-US: PIKfyve generates the phosphoinositide PtdIns(3,5)P2 on endolysosomal membranes, and that lipid signal is required for Endocytic Lysosome Reformation together with calcium-channel activation. Without PIKfyve, endolysosomes cannot be converted back into mature lysosomes.
context.zh-TW: PIKfyve 在 endolysosome 膜上產生磷脂質 PtdIns(3,5)P2，該脂質訊號與鈣離子通道活化一同為 Endocytic Lysosome Reformation 所必需。缺乏 PIKfyve 時，endolysosome 無法轉回成熟 lysosome。

context.en-US: TRPML1 is the lysosomal calcium channel whose activation triggers calcium efflux and tubulation during Endocytic Lysosome Reformation. Activating TRPML1 alongside PIKfyve-dependent PtdIns(3,5)P2 production drives regeneration of tubular lysosomal structures.
context.zh-TW: TRPML1 是 lysosome 鈣離子通道，其活化引發鈣離子外流與管狀化，是 Endocytic Lysosome Reformation 的關鍵。TRPML1 活化搭配 PIKfyve 依賴的 PtdIns(3,5)P2 生成，可推動管狀 lysosome 結構的再生。

context.en-US: Ezetimibe, a cholesterol-lowering drug, activates TFEB indirectly through AMPK and thereby increases Autophagy; this pathway ameliorates steatohepatitis. As an autophagy inducer, Ezetimibe's effects may also underlie part of its anti-inflammatory and anti-atherogenic benefit.
context.zh-TW: Ezetimibe 是一種降膽固醇藥物，透過 AMPK 間接活化 TFEB，進而提升 Autophagy；此途徑可改善 steatohepatitis。作為自噬誘導劑，Ezetimibe 的效應可能也是其抗發炎與抗動脈粥樣硬化部分益處的來源。

context.en-US: Ezetimibe induces hepatic Autophagy and reduces steatosis in NAFLD models by modulating cholesterol flux. Its autophagy-inducing action also cooperates with Statins for LDL-C lowering, the two acting synergistically at the level of cholesterol absorption.
context.zh-TW: Ezetimibe 透過調節膽固醇流，在 NAFLD 模型中誘導肝臟 Autophagy 並減少脂肪變性。其誘導自噬的作用也可與 Statins 協同降低 LDL-C，兩者在膽固醇吸收層面上具加成效果。

context.en-US: Ezetimibe targets Cholesterol Metabolism at the intestine: it blocks the NPC1L1 cholesterol transporter at the brush border, cutting dietary and biliary cholesterol absorption by roughly half and lowering LDL-C, especially in combination with Statins.
context.zh-TW: Ezetimibe 在腸道層面針對 Cholesterol Metabolism：阻斷刷狀緣的 NPC1L1 膽固醇轉運蛋白，使飲食與膽汁中的膽固醇吸收減少約一半，並降低 LDL-C，與 Statins 併用時效果尤其明顯。

context.en-US: The FACT complex (SSRP1/SUPT16H) is a histone chaperone that binds TFEB and thereby facilitates expression of lysosomal and antioxidant genes. SUMOylation of TFEB at K316 attenuates its transcriptional activity by reducing its binding to FACT complex.
context.zh-TW: FACT complex（SSRP1/SUPT16H）是 histone chaperone，可與 TFEB 結合，藉此促進 lysosome 與抗氧化基因的表現。TFEB 在 K316 的 SUMO 化會減少其與 FACT complex 的結合，因而削弱其轉錄活性。

context.en-US: FACT complex sets chromatin accessibility at Autophagy gene promoters, and FACT inhibition increases Autophagy by altering that epigenetic landscape. FACT also promotes transcription elongation by displacing and replacing H2A-H2B dimers during RNA polymerase II passage.
context.zh-TW: FACT complex 決定 Autophagy 基因啟動子上的染色質可及性；抑制 FACT 會藉由改變表觀遺傳景觀而提升 Autophagy。FACT 也透過在 RNA polymerase II 行進時置換 H2A-H2B 二聚體來促進轉錄延伸。

context.en-US: TFE3 is one of the two MiT/TFEB-family transcription factors to which FACT complex binds; the chaperone interaction helps these factors drive lysosomal and antioxidant gene transcription, which in turn supports lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic flux.
context.zh-TW: TFE3 是與 FACT complex 結合的兩個 MiT/TFEB 家族轉錄因子之一；此 chaperone 互動協助這些因子啟動 lysosome 與抗氧化基因的轉錄，進而支持 lysosome 生成與自噬流。

context.en-US: FIP200 (RB1CC1) is a core component of the ULK1 complex and the mammalian ortholog of yeast Atg17; it is essential for Macroautophagy initiation. It scaffolds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex so that the autophagy-initiation signal is transmitted to nascent Autophagosome nucleation.
context.zh-TW: FIP200（RB1CC1）是 ULK1 複合體的核心成員，也是酵母 Atg17 的哺乳類直系同源物，對 Macroautophagy 的起始不可或缺。它作為支架連結 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體，使自噬起始訊號得以傳遞至新生 Autophagosome 的成核。

context.en-US: FIP200 scaffolds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex: without the FIP200 scaffold the Atg13 and Atg101 subunits cannot assemble productively with ULK1, and Autophagosome formation fails. mTORC1 controls Autophagy chiefly through this ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 complex.
context.zh-TW: FIP200 作為支架連結 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體：沒有 FIP200 支架，Atg13 與 Atg101 次單元便無法與 ULK1 有效組裝，Autophagosome 形成隨之失敗。mTORC1 主要透過此 ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 複合體調控 Autophagy。

context.en-US: FIP200 (RB1CC1) is the mammalian ortholog of yeast Atg17. As the Atg17 scaffold, FIP200 holds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex together and is required for Autophagosome formation during Macroautophagy initiation.
context.zh-TW: FIP200（RB1CC1）是酵母 Atg17 的哺乳類直系同源物。作為 Atg17 支架，FIP200 將 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體維持在一起，並為 Macroautophagy 起始時的 Autophagosome 形成所必需。

context.en-US: FNIP1 forms a ternary complex with Folliculin and FNIP2 that acts as a GTPase-activating protein for Rag GTPases, converting RagC/D from GTP- to GDP-bound state so that mTORC1 is recruited to the lysosome upon amino acid stimulation. FNIP1 deletion impairs mTORC1 activation and causes constitutive nuclear translocation of TFE3 and TFEB.
context.zh-TW: FNIP1 與 Folliculin 及 FNIP2 組成三元複合體，作為 Rag GTPases 的 GTPase-activating protein，將 RagC/D 由 GTP 結合態轉為 GDP 結合態，使 mTORC1 在胺基酸刺激下被招募至 lysosome。FNIP1 缺失會損害 mTORC1 活化並造成 TFE3 與 TFEB 的組成性核轉位。

context.en-US: FNIP1 cooperates with Folliculin and FNIP2 in the FLCN-FNIP1/2 complex, whose RagC/D GAP activity gates Amino Acid Sensing-driven mTORC1 recruitment. FNIP1 also carries a DENN domain and AMPK phosphorylation sites, coupling the complex to energy state.
context.zh-TW: FNIP1 與 Folliculin 及 FNIP2 在 FLCN-FNIP1/2 複合體中协同作用，該複合體的 RagC/D GAP 活性把關 Amino Acid Sensing 驅動的 mTORC1 招募。FNIP1 另含 DENN 結構域與 AMPK 磷酸化位點，將複合體與能量狀態耦合。

context.en-US: FNIP1 is required for Folliculin-dependent regulation of cell growth and for Autophagy suppression under nutrient-replete conditions. Removing FNIP1 lifts Folliculin's brake on mTORC1, releasing TFE3/TFEB into the nucleus and increasing autophagic transcription.
context.zh-TW: FNIP1 是 Folliculin 依賴的細胞生長調控以及營養充足條件下 Autophagy 抑制所必需。移除 FNIP1 會解除 Folliculin 對 mTORC1 的抑制，使 TFE3/TFEB 釋放至細胞核並提高自噬相關轉錄。

context.en-US: FNIP2 sits upstream of mTORC1 as a scaffold of the Folliculin-FNIP1/2 complex, whose Rag GTPase GAP activity regulates mTORC1 translocation to the lysosomal surface in response to Amino Acid Sensing. AMPK directly phosphorylates FNIP2, linking Energy Homeostasis to mTORC1 regulation.
context.zh-TW: FNIP2 作為 Folliculin-FNIP1/2 複合體的支架位於 mTORC1 上游，該複合體的 Rag GTPase GAP 活性依 Amino Acid Sensing 調控 mTORC1 轉位至 lysosome 表面。AMPK 直接磷酸化 FNIP2，將 Energy Homeostasis 與 mTORC1 調控連結起來。

context.en-US: AMPK directly phosphorylates FNIP2, which is how Energy Homeostasis is wired to mTORC1 control. FNIP2 deficiency or AMPK failure leaves Rag GTPases in their activating state, so amino-acid-dependent mTORC1 activation and Autophagy regulation both fail to respond.
context.zh-TW: AMPK 直接磷酸化 FNIP2，這是 Energy Homeostasis 與 mTORC1 控制相互連結的方式。FNIP2 缺失或 AMPK 失效會使 Rag GTPases 維持在活化狀態，導致胺基酸依賴的 mTORC1 活化與 Autophagy 調控皆無法正常反應。

context.en-US: Missense mutations in FNIP2 are associated with Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome-like phenotypes such as fibrofolliculomas and renal cell carcinoma, and FNIP2 has been identified as a susceptibility locus in genome-wide association studies for chronic kidney disease, linking it to Folliculin-pathway tumor suppressor biology.
context.zh-TW: FNIP2 的錯義突變與 Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome 類表型（例如纖毛濾泡瘤與腎細胞癌）相關，且 FNIP2 在慢性腎病的全基因體關聯研究中被鑑定為易感位點，將其與 Folliculin 路徑的腫瘤抑制功能連結。

context.en-US: FNIP2 is required for proper Autophagy regulation and metabolic adaptation: FNIP2 deficiency impairs amino acid-dependent mTORC1 activation and disrupts autophagic flux. FNIP2 also heterodimerizes with Folliculin and FNIP1, sharing a DENN domain and an AMPK phosphorylation motif with FNIP1.
context.zh-TW: FNIP2 對正常的 Autophagy 調控與代謝適應是必需的：FNIP2 缺失會損害胺基酸依賴的 mTORC1 活化並破壞自噬流。FNIP2 亦可與 Folliculin 及 FNIP1 形成異二聚體，並與 FNIP1 共享 DENN 結構域與 AMPK 磷酸化基序。

context.en-US: Folliculin (FLCN) is a tumor suppressor that regulates mTORC1 activity and Lysosome positioning as a guanine nucleotide exchange factor and RagC/D GAP for Rag proteins in complex with FNIP1/FNIP2. Loss of FLCN leaves TFEB permanently nuclear because mTORC1 can no longer phosphorylate it.
context.zh-TW: Folliculin（FLCN）是腫瘤抑制因子，與 FNIP1/FNIP2 組成複合體，作為 Rag proteins 的 guanine nucleotide exchange factor 與 RagC/D GAP，調控 mTORC1 活性與 Lysosome 定位。FLCN 流失會使 TFEB 永久停留於細胞核，因為 mTORC1 已無法磷酸化它。

context.en-US: Folliculin acts on Rag proteins as a guanine nucleotide exchange factor, and within the FLCN-FNIP1/2 complex as the RagC/D GAP, thereby controlling which Rag heterodimer state is presented at the lysosome — RagA/B GDP-RagC/D GTP under starvation versus RagA/B GTP-RagC/D GDP in nutrient-replete conditions.
context.zh-TW: Folliculin 作為 guanine nucleotide exchange factor 作用於 Rag proteins，並在 FLCN-FNIP1/2 複合體中作為 RagC/D GAP，控制 lysosome 上呈現的 Rag 異二聚體狀態——禁食時為 RagA/B GDP-RagC/D GTP，營養充足時則為 RagA/B GTP-RagC/D GDP。

context.en-US: Folliculin is a Tumor Suppressor whose loss drives disease: FLCN mutations cause Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome with fibrofolliculomas, lung cysts and renal cancer. Loss of Folliculin also triggers constitutive TFE3/TFEB nuclear translocation, derepressing lysosomal-autophagy transcription.
context.zh-TW: Folliculin 是一個 Tumor Suppressor，其功能喪失會導致疾病：FLCN 突變引起 Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome，表現為纖毛濾泡瘤、肺囊腫與腎癌。Folliculin 流失也會觸發 TFE3/TFEB 的組成性核轉位，解除對 lysosome-自噬轉錄的抑制。

context.en-US: Foxp3 (Forkhead Box P3) is the forkhead transcription factor that specifies the Regulatory T Cell (Treg) lineage, making it the master regulator of Treg identity. Spermidine can promote differentiation of CD4+ T cells toward this Foxp3+ phenotype with an anti-inflammatory profile.
context.zh-TW: Foxp3（Forkhead Box P3）是指定 Regulatory T Cell（Treg）譜系的 forkhead 轉錄因子，是 Treg 身分的總調控因子。Spermidine 可促進 CD4+ T cells 向此 Foxp3+、具抗發炎特徵的表型分化。

context.en-US: Spermidine induces the Foxp3+ regulatory phenotype in CD4+ T cells, but this induction is abrogated in Atg5-deficient T cells that cannot initiate Autophagy. Spermidine's pro-Treg effect is therefore autophagy-dependent rather than purely transcriptional.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine 在 CD4+ T cells 中誘導 Foxp3+ 調節表型，但此誘導在無法啟動 Autophagy 的 Atg5 缺失 T cells 中被廢除。因此 Spermidine 的促 Treg 作用是自噬依賴的，而非純粹轉錄層面的。

context.en-US: Autophagy maintains Regulatory T Cell metabolic fitness and suppressive function; loss of Atg5 in Treg-like cells abolishes the Foxp3+ phenotype induced by Spermidine. Autophagy is thus a metabolic fitness requirement for Treg suppressive activity.
context.zh-TW: Autophagy 維持 Regulatory T Cell 的代謝適應度與抑制功能；在 Treg 樣細胞中失去 Atg5 會廢除 Spermidine 誘導的 Foxp3+ 表型。因此自噬是 Treg 抑制活性所需的代謝適應條件。

context.en-US: GABARAP belongs to the Atg8 protein family together with LC3 and GATE-16. It is conjugated to phosphatidylethanolamine on the Autophagosome membrane through the ubiquitin-like conjugation system and supports later maturation steps.
context.zh-TW: GABARAP 與 LC3、GATE-16 同屬 Atg8 蛋白家族。它經由類泛素接合系統被接附到 Autophagosome 膜上的磷脂乙醇胺，並支援後續的成熟步驟。

context.en-US: GABARAP mediates Autophagosome-Lysosome fusion by interacting with LAMP1 and PLEKHM1 on the lysosomal side. As an Atg8 family member it also recruits GABARAP-interacting proteins for Selective Autophagy cargo recognition on the nascent autophagosome.
context.zh-TW: GABARAP 透過與 lysosome 側的 LAMP1 及 PLEKHM1 互動，介導 Autophagosome 與 Lysosome 的融合。作為 Atg8 家族成員，它也會招募 GABARAP 互動蛋白，參與新生 autophagosome 上 Selective Autophagy 負載物的辨識。

context.en-US: As an Atg8 family protein, GABARAP is required for the later stages of Autophagosome maturation and its fusion with the Lysosome. Mammalian LC3, its family sibling, can likewise promote Atg1 kinase activity together with GATE-16 and GABARAP.
context.zh-TW: 作為 Atg8 家族蛋白，GABARAP 為 Autophagosome 後期成熟步驟及其與 Lysosome 融合所必需。哺乳類 LC3 作為同家族成員，也可與 GATE-16 及 GABARAP 一同促進 Atg1 kinase 活性。

context.en-US: GATE-16 (GABARAPL2) is a Golgi-associated member of the Atg8 protein family, involved in intra-Golgi transport as well as Autophagy. It is conjugated to autophagosomal membranes similarly to LC3 and GABARAP.
context.zh-TW: GATE-16（GABARAPL2）是 Atg8 蛋白家族中與 Golgi 關聯的成員，參與 Golgi 內運輸以及 Autophagy。它與 LC3 及 GABARAP 類似地被接附到 autophagosome 膜上。

context.en-US: GATE-16 is required for Autophagosome formation as well as intra-Golgi transport. Its Atg8-family role in mammals mirrors yeast Atg8, and it can promote Atg1 kinase activity alongside LC3 and GABARAP.
context.zh-TW: GATE-16 對 Autophagosome 形成以及 Golgi 內運輸皆為必需。它在哺乳類中的 Atg8 家族角色對應酵母 Atg8，並可與 LC3 及 GABARAP 一同促進 Atg1 kinase 活性。

context.en-US: GATE-16 participates in Autophagy while also serving intra-Golgi transport. Because GATE-16 is lipidated onto autophagosomal membranes like LC3 and GABARAP, it links autophagosome biogenesis to Golgi membrane dynamics.
context.zh-TW: GATE-16 參與 Autophagy，同時也服務於 Golgi 內運輸。由於 GATE-16 與 LC3、GABARAP 類似會被脂質化接附到 autophagosome 膜上，它將 autophagosome 的生成與 Golgi 膜動態連結起來。

context.en-US: Glucosylation is one of the post-translational modifications that set TFEB activity and subcellular localization, alongside phosphorylation, acetylation, ubiquitination, PARylation, SUMOylation, oxidation and S-sulfhydration. SetA-mediated glucosylation of TFEB shifts it to the nucleus.
context.zh-TW: Glucosylation 是決定 TFEB 活性與細胞內定位的轉譯後修飾之一，與磷酸化、乙醯化、泛素化、PAR 化、SUMO 化、氧化及 S-硫氫化並列。SetA 媒介的 TFEB glucosylation 會使其轉移至細胞核。

context.en-US: HDACs (histone deacetylases) remove acetyl groups from histones and non-histone proteins, and their action on TFEB lowers its transcriptional output. Two enzyme classes acetylate TFEB (GCN5, ACAT1) while SIRT1 and HDACs deacetylate it, making the acetylation balance a key switch for lysosomal-autophagy transcription.
context.zh-TW: HDACs（histone deacetylases）移除組蛋白與非組蛋白上的乙醯基，其對 TFEB 的作用會降低其轉錄輸出。GCN5 與 ACAT1 兩類酵素可使 TFEB 乙醯化，而 SIRT1 與 HDACs 則使其去乙醯化，使乙醯化平衡成為 lysosome-自噬轉錄的關鍵開關。

context.en-US: SAHA (vorinostat) is an HDAC inhibitor; by blocking histone deacetylase activity it keeps TFEB acetylated and thereby enhances TFEB activity. HDAC inhibitors such as SAHA and Trichostatin A induce Autophagy through TFEB and FOXO activation.
context.zh-TW: SAHA（vorinostat）是 HDAC 抑制劑；藉由阻斷 histone 去乙醯化活性，它使 TFEB 維持乙醯化態，從而提升 TFEB 活性。像 SAHA 與 Trichostatin A 這類 HDAC 抑制劑會經由活化 TFEB 與 FOXO 誘導 Autophagy。

context.en-US: HDAC activity regulates Autophagy at several points: inhibitors induce Autophagy by activating TFEB and FOXO, while HDAC6 specifically governs autophagosome-lysosome fusion by deacetylating Cortactin, whose acetylated form blocks fusion.
context.zh-TW: HDAC 活性在數個層面調控 Autophagy：抑制劑藉由活化 TFEB 與 FOXO 誘導 Autophagy，而 HDAC6 則透過使 Cortactin 去乙醯化來調控 autophagosome-lysosome 融合，因為 Cortactin 的乙醯化型會阻斷融合。

context.en-US: Trichostatin A is a hydroxamate HDAC inhibitor used alongside SAHA to demonstrate that deacetylation restrains autophagy. Its inhibition of HDACs de-represses TFEB and FOXO targets, raising Autophagy activity.
context.zh-TW: Trichostatin A 是羥胺酸類的 HDAC 抑制劑，常與 SAHA 併用以證明去乙醯化會壓抑自噬。其對 HDACs 的抑制會解除 TFEB 與 FOXO 標的基因的壓抑，提高 Autophagy 活性。

context.en-US: METTL3 is the m6A writer that methylates two RRACU consensus sequences in the TFEB 3'-UTR. The m6A mark installed by METTL3 promotes association of the RNA-binding protein HNRNPD with TFEB pre-mRNA, leading to rapid degradation and reduced TFEB protein.
context.zh-TW: METTL3 是 m6A 寫入酵素，在 TFEB 3'-UTR 的兩段 RRACU 共識序列上進行甲基化。METTL3 安裝的 m6A 標記會促進 RNA 結合蛋白 HNRNPD 與 TFEB 前驅 mRNA 結合，導致其快速降解並使 TFEB 蛋白減少。

context.en-US: HNRNPD (AUF1) binds AU-rich elements in target mRNAs and, when the transcript carries m6A installed by METTL3, destabilizes TFEB pre-mRNA, lowering TFEB protein and attenuating lysosomal-autophagy transcription. Reader proteins such as YTHDF2 contribute to the m6A-dependent targeting.
context.zh-TW: HNRNPD（AUF1）會結合目標 mRNA 的 AU-rich 元素；當轉錄本帶有 METTL3 安裝的 m6A 標記時，它會使 TFEB 前驅 mRNA 去穩定，降低 TFEB 蛋白並削弱 lysosome-自噬轉錄。诸如 YTHDF2 等 reader 蛋白參與此 m6A 依賴的標定。

context.en-US: HNRNPD (AUF1) stabilizes ULK1 and Beclin1 transcripts, supporting the abundance of the autophagy initiation complex. The same protein therefore sits at a bidirectional post-transcriptional checkpoint: it promotes Autophagy initiation factors while suppressing TFEB-driven lysosomal-autophagy transcription.
context.zh-TW: HNRNPD（AUF1）會穩定 ULK1 與 Beclin1 的轉錄本，支持自噬起始複合體的豐度。因此同一蛋白位於雙向的轉錄後檢查點：它一方面促進自噬起始因子，另一方面抑制 TFEB 驅動的 lysosome-自噬轉錄。

context.en-US: HNRNPD dysregulation contributes to the age-related decline in Autophagy: reduced stabilization of ULK1/Beclin1 transcripts and enhanced TFEB mRNA decay erode the autophagic reserve implicated in Aging and Neurodegeneration. In Cancer, AUF1 often promotes proliferation and metastasis though context-dependent tumor-suppressive roles exist.
context.zh-TW: HNRNPD 的失調會促成 Autophagy 的老化相關衰退：ULK1/Beclin1 轉錄本穩定性下降與 TFEB mRNA 降解增加，侵蝕與 Aging 及 Neurodegeneration 相關的自噬儲備。在 Cancer 中，AUF1 常促進增殖與轉移，但亦存在依情境而定的腫瘤抑制角色。

context.en-US: HepG2 is a human hepatocellular carcinoma cell line widely used to model human liver metabolism, protein synthesis and Autophagy. It supports siRNA-mediated knockdown of TFEB and nutrient-deprivation protocols, making it a convenient human system for lysosomal-autophagy studies.
context.zh-TW: HepG2 是人類肝細胞癌細胞系，廣泛用於模擬人類肝臟代謝、蛋白質合成與 Autophagy。它支援 TFEB 的 siRNA 敲低與營養剝奪實驗流程，是研究 lysosome-自噬的便利人類系統。

context.en-US: TFEB transcriptionally upregulates LC3 together with Lysosomal Acid Lipase during nutrient stress, a conserved lipophagy response demonstrated in HepG2 cells. The same TFEB program links nutrient sensing to lysosomal capacity and autophagic flux.
context.zh-TW: 在營養壓力下，TFEB 會與 Lysosomal Acid Lipase 一同轉錄性上調 LC3，這是在 HepG2 細胞中證實的保守 lipophagy 反應。同一套 TFEB 計畫把營養感知與 lysosome 容量及自噬流連結起來。

context.en-US: Hypusination converts lysine K50 of eIF5A to hypusine through the sequential action of DHPS and DOHH. This unique post-translational modification is required for eIF5A to function in translation elongation, and it is the reason Spermidine can raise the synthesis of proteins such as TFEB.
context.zh-TW: Hypusination 透過 DHPS 與 DOHH 的連續作用，將 eIF5A 的 K50 離胺酸轉換為 hypusine。此獨特的轉譯後修飾是 eIF5A 執行轉譯延伸功能的必要條件，也是 Spermidine 能提高 TFEB 等蛋白質合成的原因。

context.en-US: Spermidine is a polyamine that feeds the deoxyhypusine pathway, thereby promoting Hypusination of eIF5A and the downstream synthesis of proteins such as TFEB. This is one route by which a polyamine supplement can influence lysosomal-autophagy transcription.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine 是多胺，可供給 deoxyhypusine 路徑，藉此促進 eIF5A 的 Hypusination 及其下游 TFEB 等蛋白質的合成。這是聚胺補充劑能影響 lysosome-自噬轉錄的途徑之一。

context.en-US: Hypusination of eIF5A is essential for eIF5A function in translation elongation and for Autophagy. Without the hypusine modification, de novo protein synthesis of autophagic components such as TFEB falls, blunting the autophagy response.
context.zh-TW: eIF5A 的 Hypusination 對 eIF5A 在轉譯延伸中的功能以及 Autophagy 皆為必要。若缺乏 hypusine 修飾，TFEB 等自噬成分的新生蛋白合成會下降，使自噬反應減弱。

context.en-US: Immunometabolism examines how metabolic pathways such as Autophagy, Glycolysis and OxPhos regulate immune cell function and differentiation. Selective Autophagy is central to it: it modulates immunity through metabolic reprogramming and facilitates energy metabolism during effector T Cell activation.
context.zh-TW: Immunometabolism 研究 Autophagy、Glycolysis 與 OxPhos 等代謝途徑如何調節免疫細胞功能與分化。Selective Autophagy 是其核心：它透過代謝重編程調節免疫，並在效應型 T Cell 活化期間促進能量代謝。

context.en-US: Immunometabolism is closely tied to Immune Aging, which involves transcriptional and metabolic reprogramming in individual immune cells. Pharmacological metabolic reprogramming is one strategy: Metformin improves memory immune responses by metabolically reprogramming memory CD8+ T cells.
context.zh-TW: Immunometabolism 與 Immune Aging 密切相關，後者涉及個別免疫細胞的轉錄與代謝重編程。藥理性的代謝重編程是策略之一：Metformin 透過代謝重編程記憶 CD8+ T cells，改善記憶性免疫反應。

context.en-US: Metformin improves memory T Cell responses by metabolically reprogramming memory CD8+ T cells. Within Immunometabolism this illustrates the general principle that altering a cell's metabolic program changes its immune fate and durability.
context.zh-TW: Metformin 透過代謝重編程記憶 CD8+ T cells 來改善記憶 T Cell 的反應。在 Immunometabolism 的脈絡中，這說明了改變細胞代謝程式即可改變其免疫命運與持久性的一般原理。

context.en-US: Ketogenesis is induced whenever glucose availability falls, as under Caloric Restriction, Intermittent Fasting or a Ketogenic Diet. During fasting the inhibition of mTORC1 (rising AMP/ATP) promotes Ketogenesis while inhibiting glycolysis and glutaminolysis in tumor cells.
context.zh-TW: 只要葡萄糖可得性下降就會誘導 Ketogenesis，例如在 Caloric Restriction、Intermittent Fasting 或 Ketogenic Diet 之下。禁食期間 mTORC1 的抑制（AMP/ATP 上升）會促進 Ketogenesis，同時在腫瘤細胞中抑制糖解與麩醯胺分解。

context.en-US: Ketogenesis stimulates Autophagy in tissues including brain and heart: beta-hydroxybutyrate inhibits HDACs and activates FOXO, both of which raise autophagic flux. Ketone bodies also serve as an alternative energy source during starvation, helping maintain Cellular Homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: Ketogenesis 會在包含腦與心臟的組織中刺激 Autophagy：β-hydroxybutyrate 抑制 HDACs 並活化 FOXO，兩者都會提高自噬流。酮體在禁食時也作為替代能量來源，協助維持 Cellular Homeostasis。

context.en-US: Ketogenesis is triggered by a Ketogenic Diet as well as by Caloric Restriction and Intermittent Fasting, because all three lower glucose availability and raise fatty acid delivery to the liver. Promoting Ketogenesis this way is investigated for Neurodegenerative Disease and for enhancing the tumoricidal properties of treatments in some Cancer contexts.
context.zh-TW: Ketogenesis 可由 Ketogenic Diet 觸發，與 Caloric Restriction、Intermittent Fasting 相同，因為三者都降低葡萄糖可得性並提高脂肪酸送抵肝臟。以此方式促進 Ketogenesis 正在被研究用於 Neurodegenerative Disease，以及在某些 Cancer 情境下增強治療的腫瘤殺傷特性。

context.en-US: Intermittent Fasting induces Ketogenesis by intermittently lowering glucose and depleting hepatic glycogen, so fatty acids are routed to ketone body production. The resulting ketogenic state couples Caloric Restriction-like metabolic stress to Autophagy stimulation.
context.zh-TW: Intermittent Fasting 藉由間歇性降低葡萄糖並耗盡肝醣，使脂肪酸被導向酮體生成，從而誘導 Ketogenesis。所 resulting 的生酮狀態把類似 Caloric Restriction 的代謝壓力與 Autophagy 刺激耦合起來。

context.en-US: LAMP1 is the most abundant protein on the lysosomal membrane and serves as the standard marker for Lysosome and Autolysosome. Heavily glycosylated, it protects the membrane from luminal hydrolases and maintains lysosomal stability and integrity.
context.zh-TW: LAMP1 是 lysosome 膜上最豐富的蛋白質，也是 Lysosome 與 Autolysosome 的標準標記。高度醣基化的 LAMP1 保護膜免受腔內水解酶作用，並維持 lysosome 的穩定性與完整性。

context.en-US: LAMP1 tethers Autophagosome to the lysosome through interactions with LC3 and PLEKHM1 during fusion, which is why lysosomal membrane microdomains enriched for LAMP1 are the meeting point for autophagosome-lysosome tethering.
context.zh-TW: LAMP1 透過與 LC3 及 PLEKHM1 的互動，在融合過程中將 Autophagosome 繫於 lysosome；因此富集 LAMP1 的 lysosome 膜微區正是 autophagosome-lysosome 繫合的交會點。

context.en-US: LAMP1 maintains Lysosome: as a heavily glycosylated integral membrane glycoprotein it forms the protective glycocalyx facing the lysosomal lumen, preserving organelle integrity so that hydrolases stay contained and degradation capacity is retained.
context.zh-TW: LAMP1 維持 Lysosome：作為高度醣基化的整合膜糖蛋白，它形成面向 lysosome 腔內的保護性醣萼，維持胞器完整性，使水解酶留在其中並保有降解能力。

context.en-US: LGG-2 is one of the C. elegans orthologues of the yeast Atg8 and mammalian LC3/GABARAP proteins. As the Atg8 family ortholog of GABARAP, LGG-2 performs the membrane-tethering role that mammalian GABARAP plays in autophagosome formation.
context.zh-TW: LGG-2 是酵母 Atg8 與哺乳類 LC3/GABARAP 在 C. elegans 中的直系同源物之一。作為 GABARAP 的 Atg8 家族直系同源物，LGG-2 執行哺乳類 GABARAP 在 autophagosome 形成中所扮演的膜繫留角色。

context.en-US: LGG-2 is required for Lipophagy: post-developmental inactivation of both LGG-1 and lgg-2 causes increased fat accumulation in C. elegans, showing the Atg8 family members degrade lipid droplets in the intestine.
context.zh-TW: LGG-2 對 Lipophagy 是必需的：在發育後使 LGG-1 與 lgg-2 失活，會導致 C. elegans 脂肪累積增加，顯示此 Atg8 家族成員可在腸道中分解脂滴。

context.en-US: HLH-30 transcriptionally upregulates LGG-2 during Fasting in an HLH-30-dependent manner, linking nutrient deprivation to autophagosome formation. The same TFEB-like transcription factor also induces lipid lipases such as LIPL-2.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 在 Fasting 期間以 HLH-30 依賴的方式轉錄性上調 LGG-2，把營養剝奪與 autophagosome 形成連結起來。同一個類 TFEB 轉錄因子也會誘導 LIPL-2 等脂肪酶。

context.en-US: LGG-2 plays a role in the formation and maturation of Autophagosome as an Atg8 family member. Losing LGG-1 and lgg-2 blocks autophagosome flux, causing lipid droplet accumulation and fat storage defects in C. elegans.
context.zh-TW: LGG-2 作為 Atg8 家族成員，在 Autophagosome 的形成與成熟中扮演角色。失去 LGG-1 與 lgg-2 會阻斷 autophagosome 流，在 C. elegans 中造成脂滴累積與脂肪儲存缺陷。

context.en-US: HLH-30 induces LIPL-2 during fasting, while MXL-3 represses it under well-fed conditions. The reciprocal transcriptional switch is the mechanism by which C. elegans couples nutrient status to Lipophagy, matching the ~12-fold rise in lipl-2 mRNA after six hours of fasting.
context.zh-TW: HLH-30 在禁食期間誘導 LIPL-2，而 MXL-3 在營養充足條件下抑制它。這種互補的轉錄開關是 C. elegans 將營養狀態與 Lipophagy 耦合的機制，對應禁食六小時後 lipl-2 mRNA 約 12 倍的上升。

context.en-US: MXL-3 represses LIPL-2, LIPL-1 and LIPL-3 under well-fed conditions; fasting removes this brake via HLH-30 so that lipases are expressed. MXL-3 therefore acts as the nutrient-replete metabolic repressor that keeps Lipophagy low until stress.
context.zh-TW: MXL-3 在營養充足條件下抑制 LIPL-2、LIPL-1 與 LIPL-3；禁食則透過 HLH-30 解除此煞車，使脂肪酶得以表現。因此 MXL-3 是營養充足時的代謝抑制因子，在壓力出現前將 Lipophagy 維持在低水位。

context.en-US: LIPL-2 is a C. elegans lysosomal lipase involved in Lipophagy and intestinal lipid droplet turnover, localized to the gut lumen or to vesicles within the intestine. Its fasting-induced upregulation is what lets lipophagy capacity track nutrient status.
context.zh-TW: LIPL-2 是參與 Lipophagy 與腸道脂滴周轉的 C. elegans lysosomal lipase，定位於腸腔或腸道內的囊泡。其禁食誘導的上調，使 lipophagy 容量得以隨營養狀態變動。

context.en-US: LIPL-2 is upregulated approximately 12-fold after six hours of Fasting in fertile adult worms, alongside other C. elegans triglyceride lipases. The fasting response depends on HLH-30 and is opposed by MXL-3 in well-fed animals.
context.zh-TW: 在生殖期成蟲中，LIPL-2 於 Fasting 六小時後上調約 12 倍，與其他 C. elegans 三酸甘油酯脂肪酶一致。此禁食反應依賴 HLH-30，並在營養充足個體中受到 MXL-3 對抗。

context.en-US: Torin1 is a potent, ATP-competitive and selective inhibitor of mTORC1 and mTORC2 used as a research tool for studying mTOR signaling. By blocking mTORC1 kinase activity it relieves the mTORC1-dependent suppression of autophagy, which is why Torin1 is widely used to probe mTOR-dependent autophagy and the CLEAR network.
context.zh-TW: Torin1 是一種強效、具 ATP 競爭性且選擇性的 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 抑制劑，作為研究 mTOR 訊號的工具藥。藉由阻斷 mTORC1 的激酶活性，它解除 mTORC1 對自噬的抑制，因此 Torin1 被廣泛用於研究 mTOR 依賴性自噬與 CLEAR 網絡。

context.en-US: Torin1 blocks the ATP-binding site of both mTORC1 and mTORC2, making it a dual-complex inhibitor rather than an mTORC1-specific agent. This dual action distinguishes Torin1 from rapamycin and is exploited in experiments that need complete mTOR pathway suppression, for instance when measuring TFEB nuclear translocation.
context.zh-TW: Torin1 會阻斷 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 的 ATP 結合位點，因此它是雙複合體抑制劑，而非 mTORC1 專一性藥物。這種雙重作用使 Torin1 有別於 rapamycin，並在需要完全抑制 mTOR 路徑的實驗（例如量測 TFEB 核轉位）中被利用。

context.en-US: Torin1 robustly induces Autophagy by inhibiting mTORC1, which leads to ULK1 activation and TFEB nuclear translocation. Because mTORC1 is the main brake on autophagy initiation, pharmacological mTORC1 blockade with Torin1 is a standard way to trigger the full autophagic program in cultured cells.
context.zh-TW: Torin1 藉由抑制 mTORC1 有效誘導 Autophagy，進而導致 ULK1 活化與 TFEB 核轉位。由於 mTORC1 是自噬起始的主要煞車，以 Torin1 進行 mTORC1 藥理阻斷，是在培養細胞中啟動完整自噬程式的標準方法。

context.en-US: TFEB is normally retained in the cytoplasm by mTOR-dependent phosphorylation, and Torin1 releases that repression to drive TFEB into the nucleus. Dephosphorylation of the Ser122 and Ser211 sites is required for this translocation, as shown by phosphomimetic S122D mutation of TFEB, which largely blocks the Torin1 effect on TFEB nuclear localization.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 原本因 mTOR 依賴性的磷酸化而被留在細胞質中，Torin1 解除此抑制後促使 TFEB 進入細胞核。TFEB 的 Ser122 與 Ser211 位點去磷酸化是此轉位所必需；TFEB 的 S122D 磷酸擬似突變可大幅阻斷 Torin1 對 TFEB 核定位的效應，即為證據。

context.en-US: Autophagy induction by Torin1 proceeds through activation of ULK1, the autophagy-initiating kinase that normally sits downstream of mTORC1. Removing mTORC1 kinase activity releases ULK1 from inhibition, allowing it to phosphorylate Atg14 and Beclin1 and to start phagophore formation.
context.zh-TW: Torin1 誘導的自噬經由 ULK1 這個自噬起始激酶的活化而進行；ULK1 原本位於 mTORC1 下游。移除 mTORC1 的激酶活性可解除對 ULK1 的抑制，使其得以磷酸化 Atg14 與 Beclin1 並啟動吞噬膜形成。

context.en-US: Translation Initiation depends on eIF4A, the ATP-dependent DEAD-box RNA helicase that unwinds secondary structure in 5' UTRs so the ribosome can scan to the AUG start codon. eIF4A acts within the eIF4F complex together with eIF4E and eIF4G, and its activity on TFEB mRNA is a node at which autophagy gene expression can be controlled.
context.zh-TW: Translation Initiation 依賴 eIF4A，即 ATP 依賴型 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶；它解开 5' UTR 的二級結構，使核糖體得以掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子。eIF4A 與 eIF4E、eIF4G 一起在 eIF4F 複合體中作用，其對 TFEB mRNA 的活性是調控自噬基因表現的關節點。

context.en-US: Cap-dependent Translation Initiation requires eIF4E, the cap-binding component of the eIF4F complex. eIF4E recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA, which is the first step of the pathway: 43S preinitiation complex recruitment followed by scanning to the AUG start codon. Because mTORC1 controls eIF4E availability through 4E-BP1 phosphorylation, Translation Initiation is a major point through which mTOR signaling modulates protein output.
context.zh-TW: 依賴帽的 Translation Initiation 需要 eIF4E，也就是 eIF4F 複合體中負責結合帽的成分。eIF4E 辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，這是該路徑的第一步：接著招募 43S 起始前複合體並掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子。由於 mTORC1 透過 4E-BP1 的磷酸化調控 eIF4E 的可用性，Translation Initiation 是 mTOR 訊號調節蛋白質產量的主要切入點。

context.en-US: Translation Initiation involves eIF5A in addition to the eIF4F subunits. eIF5A undergoes hypusination, a post-translational modification dependent on spermidine, and the modified form supports peptide bond formation at difficult motifs; it is also implicated in TFEB regulation, linking polyamine metabolism to autophagy control.
context.zh-TW: Translation Initiation 除了 eIF4F 次單元外還涉及 eIF5A。eIF5A 會進行 hypusination（一種依賴 spermidine 的轉譯後修飾），修飾後的形式可在困難的序列基序處支援肽鍵形成；它也參與 TFEB 的調控，將多胺代謝連結至自噬調控。

context.en-US: eIF4A regulates TFEB at the translational level: the RNA helicase unwinds secondary structure in the TFEB mRNA 5' UTR, allowing efficient translation of TFEB protein. Because TFEB is the master transcriptional activator of the lysosomal-autophagy network, eIF4A activity sets how much TFEB protein is available to drive that program.
context.zh-TW: eIF4A 在轉譯層級調控 TFEB：此 RNA 解旋酶解开 TFEB mRNA 5' UTR 的二級結構，使 TFEB 蛋白得以有效轉譯。由於 TFEB 是溶酶體－自噬網絡的轉錄總開關，eIF4A 的活性決定了有多少 TFEB 蛋白可用來驅動該程式。

context.en-US: XBP1, a member of the CEB/P family of transcription factors, binds the UPRE (unfolded protein response element) in the promoters of its target genes. During ER Stress this direct promoter occupancy switches on the unfolded protein response program, and the same XBP1-UPRE axis also contributes to transcriptional regulation of TFEB.
context.zh-TW: XBP1 是 CEB/P 轉錄因子家族的成員，它會與目標基因啟動子上的 UPRE（unfolded protein response element）結合。在 ER Stress 期間，這種直接的啟動子佔位會啟動非折疊蛋白反應程式；同一條 XBP1-UPRE 軸也參與 TFEB 的轉錄調控。

context.en-US: The UPRE is a DNA sequence present in the promoters of unfolded protein response target genes, including the promoter of TFEB. Occupation of this element by XBP1 during ER Stress links proteotoxic stress to the transcriptional control of the master lysosomal-autophagy regulator.
context.zh-TW: UPRE 是一段存在於非折疊蛋白反應目標基因啟動子中的 DNA 序列，包括 TFEB 的啟動子。ER Stress 期間 XBP1 佔據此元件，將蛋白質毒性壓力與溶酶體－自噬總調節因子的轉錄調控連結起來。

context.en-US: The V-ATPase is a multi-subunit proton pump with V0 membrane and V1 cytosolic domains that maintains the acidic lysosomal lumen at about pH 4.5-5.5. This low pH is what activates more than 50 intralysosomal hydrolases, so V-ATPase is the enzyme that makes lysosomal degradation chemistry possible.
context.zh-TW: V-ATPase 是由 V0 膜區與 V1 細胞質區構成的多次單元質子幫浦，負責將溶酶體腔維持在約 pH 4.5–5.5 的酸性環境。這個低 pH 正是活化超過 50 種溶酶體內水解酶的條件，因此 V-ATPase 是使溶酶體降解化學反應得以進行的酵素。

context.en-US: V-ATPase is required for Autophagy because lysosomal acidification is a prerequisite for degradation of autophagic cargo by acid hydrolases. Consequently, V-ATPase inhibitors such as Bafilomycin A1 and Concanamycin A block autophagy and are routinely used to assay autophagic flux: blocked degradation with accumulating autophagosomes is the signature of a late-stage block.
context.zh-TW: V-ATPase 對 Autophagy 而言是必需的，因為溶酶體酸化是酸性水解酶降解自噬貨物的先決條件。因此 V-ATPase 抑制劑如 Bafilomycin A1 與 Concanamycin A 會阻斷自噬，並被常規用來檢測自噬流：降解受阻而自噬體堆積，正是後期阻斷的特徵。

context.en-US: Beyond acidifying the lumen, the V-ATPase also supports recruitment of mTORC1 to the lysosome via Ragulator. In this way the same proton pump couples the physical property of lysosomal acidity to the spatial activation of mTORC1 and thus to the nutrient-dependent decision between growth and autophagy.
context.zh-TW: 除了酸化腔室之外，V-ATPase 也透過 Ragulator 支持 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體。同一個質子幫浦因此把溶酶體酸性的物理性質與 mTORC1 的空間性活化連結起來，進而連結到營養依賴的生長與自噬之間的取捨。

context.en-US: Bafilomycin A1 is a V-ATPase inhibitor that blocks the proton translocation step of the pump. By preventing lysosomal acidification it halts the activity of acid hydrolases, so autophagic cargo that has been sequestered and delivered normally accumulates undegraded inside autolysosomes.
context.zh-TW: Bafilomycin A1 是 V-ATPase 抑制劑，會阻斷該幫浦的質子轉運步驟。它藉由阻止溶酶體酸化而使酸性水解酶停止作用，因此正常被隔離並運送的自噬貨物會在自噬溶酶體內累積而無法降解。

context.en-US: Bafilomycin A1 blocks Autophagy at the lysosomal degradation step rather than at autophagosome formation, because the pathway up to cargo delivery still runs. This makes it a canonical tool for measuring autophagic flux: an increase in LC3-positive autophagosomes under Bafilomycin A1 reflects flux, while absence of that increase suggests an upstream block.
context.zh-TW: Bafilomycin A1 是在溶酶體降解步驟而非自噬體形成處阻斷 Autophagy，因為直到貨物運送為止的路徑仍可運行。這使它成為測量自噬流的標準工具：Bafilomycin A1 處理下 LC3 陽性自噬體增加代表自噬流通暢，而若無此增加則提示上游有阻斷。

context.en-US: Vps34 (PIK3C3), the class III phosphoinositide 3-kinase, requires Vps15 (PIK3R4) as its p150 regulatory subunit. Vps15 recruits Vps34 to membranes and stabilizes its active site, so loss of Vps15 cripples the production of PtdIns3P and everything downstream of it.
context.zh-TW: Vps34（PIK3C3）這項第三類磷脂肌醇 3-激酶，需要 Vps15（PIK3R4）作為其 p150 調節次單元。Vps15 將 Vps34 招募至膜上並穩定其活性位點，因此 Vps15 缺失會使 PtdIns3P 的產生及其下游所有事件癱瘓。

context.en-US: The Vps15-Vps34-Atg14 complex is required for Autophagosome formation. PtdIns3P generated by this complex recruits WIPI/Atg18 family proteins to the phagophore, which is what specifies the membrane domain that will expand into an autophagosome.
context.zh-TW: Vps15-Vps34-Atg14 複合體對 Autophagosome 的形成是必需的。該複合體產生的 PtdIns3P 會把 WIPI/Atg18 家族蛋白招募到吞噬膜上，藉此指定將膨脹成自噬體的膜區域。

context.en-US: As the regulatory subunit of the class III PI3K complex, Vps15 is required for Autophagy and for endosomal trafficking. Its presence in both contexts reflects that the same PtdIns3P-producing module is reused wherever membrane identity and trafficking need to be specified.
context.zh-TW: 作為第三類 PI3K 複合體的調節次單元，Vps15 對 Autophagy 與內體運輸而言都是必需的。它同時出現在這兩種情境中，反映出同一個產生 PtdIns3P 的模組會在需要指定膜身分與運輸的各處被重複使用。

context.en-US: Vps34 (Vacuolar Protein Sorting 34), also known as PIK3C3, is the class III phosphoinositide 3-kinase of the autophagy pathway. As a class III PI3K it phosphorylates phosphatidylinositol at the 3 position to make the lipid signaling messenger PtdIns3P, rather than generating the PIP2 and PIP3 lipids made by class I and class II PI3Ks.
context.zh-TW: Vps34（Vacuolar Protein Sorting 34，又稱 PIK3C3）是自噬路徑中的第三類磷脂肌醇 3-激酶。作為第三類 PI3K，它在磷脂肌醇的 3 位點加上磷酸以產生脂質訊號傳遞者 PtdIns3P，而非生成第一類與第二類 PI3K 所製造的 PIP2 與 PIP3。

context.en-US: Vps34 produces PtdIns3P, the key signaling lipid required for the nucleation and maturation of autophagosomes. PtdIns3P acts as a membrane-domain landmark that recruits WIPI/Atg18 and other PI3P-binding autophagy factors, converting a region of membrane into a phagophore assembly site.
context.zh-TW: Vps34 產生 PtdIns3P，這是自噬體成核與成熟所必需的關鍵訊號脂質。PtdIns3P 扮演膜區域的標誌，招募 WIPI/Atg18 及其他結合 PI3P 的自噬因子，把一段膜區域轉化為吞噬膜組裝位點。

context.en-US: Vps34 binds Atg14 to form the autophagy-specific class III PI3K complex, in which Atg14 stimulates Vps34 kinase activity. Vps34 also forms a distinct complex with UVRAG that supports endocytosis rather than autophagy, so partner choice determines which membrane-trafficking outcome the kinase serves.
context.zh-TW: Vps34 與 Atg14 結合形成自噬專一性的第三類 PI3K 複合體，其中 Atg14 會刺激 Vps34 的激酶活性。Vps34 亦與 UVRAG 形成支援胞吞而非自噬的不同複合體，因此選擇何種伴護蛋白決定了該激酶服務哪一種膜運輸結果。

context.en-US: Vps34 binds UVRAG in an alternative complex that acts on endosomes instead of autophagosomes. Because the same catalytic subunit is shared between an autophagy complex with Atg14 and an endocytic complex with UVRAG, Vps34 is a branch point where the cell decides between degradative fates for a given membrane.
context.zh-TW: Vps34 會與 UVRAG 結合形成作用於內體而非自噬體的另一個複合體。由於同一催化次單元被含 Atg14 的自噬複合體與含 UVRAG 的胞吞複合體共用，Vps34 構成分支點，由細胞決定某段膜的降解命運。

context.en-US: WHAMM is required for Autophagic Lysosome Reformation (ALR): during ALR it drives Arp2/3-dependent, actin-based tubulation of autolysosomes that scission proto-lysosomal tubules and rebuild the lysosomal pool after autophagic degradation. Loss of WHAMM disrupts lysosomal reformation and causes autolysosomal swelling.
context.zh-TW: WHAMM 對 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation（ALR）而言是必需的：在 ALR 過程中，它驅動依賴 Arp2/3 的、以肌動蛋白為基礎的自噬溶酶體管狀化，剪切出前溶酶體管並在自噬降解後重建溶酶體池。WHAMM 缺失會破壞溶酶體再形成並造成自噬溶酶體腫脹。

context.en-US: WHAMM supports Autophagosome biogenesis and trafficking by contributing actin dynamics at ER-phagophore contact sites, where the resulting pushing forces drive membrane expansion and the trafficking of isolation membranes. Its N-terminal membrane-binding region reads phosphoinositides such as PtdIns(4,5)P2 and PtdIns4P to position it at the right membrane.
context.zh-TW: WHAMM 透過在內質網－吞噬膜接觸處貢獻肌動蛋白動力學來支持 Autophagosome 的生成與運輸，所產生的推動力驅動膜膨脹與隔離膜的運送。它的 N 端膜結合區辨識 PtdIns(4,5)P2 與 PtdIns4P 等磷脂，將自身定位到正確的膜上。

context.en-US: WHAMM works together with AP2 during autophagic lysosome reformation: PtdIns(4,5)P2, clathrin and AP2 cooperate with WHAMM-dependent actin assembly to promote scission of proto-lysosomal tubules off autolysosomes. The coupling of a clathrin adaptor with actin nucleation is what makes tubule severing directional and efficient.
context.zh-TW: 在自噬溶酶體再形成過程中，WHAMM 與 AP2 協同作用：PtdIns(4,5)P2、clathrin 與 AP2 配合 WHAMM 依賴的肌動蛋白組裝，促進前溶酶體管自自噬溶酶體上被剪切下來。接合型蛋白與肌動蛋白成核的耦合，使管狀結構的切割具有方向性且高效率。

context.en-US: PDCD4 is a binding protein of eukaryotic initiation factor 4A (eIF4A) and inhibits its helicase activity. Because eIF4A is needed to unwind 5' UTR secondary structure, PDCD4 acts as a translation repressor, lowering output of its targets, among them TFEB and other autophagy regulators.
context.zh-TW: PDCD4 是真核起始因子 4A（eIF4A）的結合蛋白，並抑制其解旋酶活性。由於 eIF4A 必須解开 5' UTR 的二級結構，PDCD4 便作為轉譯抑制因子發揮作用，降低其目標（包括 TFEB 與其他自噬調節因子）的產量。

context.en-US: Translation Initiation requires eIF4A, the ATP-dependent DEAD-box RNA helicase of the eIF4F complex (eIF4E-eIF4A-eIF4G). It unwinds secondary structure in 5' UTRs so that the 43S preinitiation complex can scan to the AUG start codon and assemble the ribosome.
context.zh-TW: Translation Initiation 需要 eIF4A，也就是 eIF4F 複合體（eIF4E-eIF4A-eIF4G）中的 ATP 依賴型 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶。它解开 5' UTR 的二級結構，使 43S 起始前複合體得以掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子並組裝核糖體。

context.en-US: PDCD4 is a Tumor Suppressor that also functions as a general brake on protein synthesis. Its tumor-suppressive activity follows at least in part from repressing translation of growth- and survival-promoting transcripts, and from lowering TFEB protein levels, which curtails autophagy-lysosomal support of tumors.
context.zh-TW: PDCD4 既是 Tumor Suppressor，也是一般性的蛋白質合成煞車。其腫瘤抑制活性至少部分來自抑制促進生長與存活之轉錄本的轉譯，以及降低 TFEB 蛋白量，進而削弱自噬－溶酶體對腫瘤的支持。

context.en-US: eIF4E is the rate-limiting, cap-binding component of cap-dependent translation: it recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA and is therefore the initiation factor whose availability sets how much translation happens. Under mTORC1 inhibition eIF4E is sequestered and cap-dependent translation shuts down.
context.zh-TW: eIF4E 是依賴帽轉譯中具速率限制性、負責結合帽的成分：它辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，因此其可用性決定了有多少轉譯發生。在 mTORC1 受抑制時，eIF4E 被隔離而依賴帽的轉譯隨之關閉。

context.en-US: 4E-BP1 inhibits eIF4E by sequestering it away from the mRNA cap, blocking eIF4F assembly and thereby repressing cap-dependent translation. When mTORC1 is inhibited and 4E-BP1 is hypophosphorylated, this repression is lifted, which is one route by which mTOR blockade lowers protein synthesis and relieves autophagy suppression.
context.zh-TW: 4E-BP1 藉由將 eIF4E 隔離在遠離 mRNA 帽的位置來抑制它，阻斷 eIF4F 組裝並抑制依賴帽的轉譯。當 mTORC1 受抑制、4E-BP1 處於低磷酸化狀態時，此抑制便被解除，這也是 mTOR 阻斷降低蛋白質合成並解除自噬抑制的途徑之一。

context.en-US: mTORC1 regulates eIF4E indirectly through phosphorylation of 4E-BP1, its dedicated repressor. This is the main pathway by which nutrient and growth-factor availability is converted into a decision about whether proteins, including autophagy regulators, get synthesized.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 透過磷酸化 4E-BP1（eIF4E 專屬的抑制因子）間接調控 eIF4E。這是把營養與生長因子可用性轉換成「是否合成蛋白質（包括自噬調節因子）」之決策的主要路徑。

context.en-US: Targeted activation of TFEB has been used successfully as a therapeutic strategy in models of ischemic injury, where TFEB activation is protective in both cerebral and cardiac ischemia. Raising TFEB activity expands lysosomal capacity, which improves clearance of damaged mitochondria and protein aggregates during ischemia-reperfusion.
context.zh-TW: 以 TFEB 為標的的活化已在缺血性損傷的模型中作為治療策略成功應用，其中 TFEB 活化在腦缺血與心臟缺血中皆具保護作用。提升 TFEB 活性可擴充溶酶體容量，改善缺血再灌注期間對受損粒線體與蛋白聚集體的清除。

context.en-US: Autophagy protects against ischemic injury because ischemia-reperfusion injury involves ATP depletion, oxidative stress, Ca2+ overload and cell death upon reperfusion, and autophagy clears the damaged mitochondria that drive much of this damage. It also participates in ischemic preconditioning, whereby brief sublethal ischemic episodes render tissue resistant to a later insult.
context.zh-TW: Autophagy 對缺血性損傷具有保護作用，因為缺血再灌注損傷涉及 ATP 耗竭、氧化壓力、Ca2+ 過載以及再灌注時的細胞死亡，而自噬可清除驅動大部分損傷的受損粒線體。它也參與缺血預適應，也就是短暫的亞致死性缺血暴露使組織對之後的傷害產生抵抗力。

context.en-US: Mitophagy is the specific arm of autophagy that protects against ischemic injury by selectively removing damaged mitochondria, the main source of the reactive oxygen species and apoptotic mediators that kill cells on reperfusion. Loss of this selective quality control converts a reversible ischemic insult into irreversible injury.
context.zh-TW: Mitophagy 是自噬中特別負責對抗缺血性損傷的分支，它選擇性清除受損粒線體，而受損粒線體正是在再灌注時造成細胞死亡的活性氧與凋亡介質的主要來源。這項選擇性品質管制的喪失，會把可逆的缺血傷害轉為不可逆損傷。

context.en-US: Spermidine, like Trehalose and Melatonin, activates autophagy and protects against ischemia-reperfusion injury in preclinical models of heart, brain, liver and kidney. Since these agents converge on autophagy induction rather than on a single ischemic target, their protective effect in ischemic injury is thought to reflect improved clearance of damaged cargo.
context.zh-TW: Spermidine 與 Trehalose、Melatonin 一樣能活化自噬，並在心臟、腦、肝與腎的臨床前模型中對抗缺血再灌注損傷。由於這些藥物收斂於自噬誘導而非單一缺血標的，其在缺血性損傷中的保護作用被認為反映了对受損貨物的清除改善。

context.en-US: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFEB family of transcription factors, which together with the bZIP leucine zipper transcription factors share the basic leucine zipper DNA-binding motif. The motif contains a basic DNA-binding region plus a leucine zipper needed for dimerization, the structural basis of CLEAR-element recognition.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFEB 家族的轉錄因子；此家族與 bZIP 亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子共同具有 basic leucine zipper 的 DNA 結合基序。該基序包含負責結合 DNA 的鹼性區域，以及用於二聚化的亮胺酸拉鍊，後者正是辨識 CLEAR 元件的結構基礎。

context.en-US: XBP1 is a member of the bZIP leucine zipper transcription factors, which contain a basic region for DNA binding and a leucine zipper for dimerization. As a member of this class XBP1 can act as an activating or a repressing heterodimer partner depending on its splice variant, and it occupies the UPRE during ER Stress.
context.zh-TW: XBP1 是 bZIP 亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子家族的成員，該家族含有負責結合 DNA 的鹼性區域與用於二聚化的亮胺酸拉鍊。作為此類成員，XBP1 依其剪接變體可作為活化型或抑制型的異二聚體夥伴，並在 ER Stress 期間佔據 UPRE。

context.en-US: ATF4 is a member of the bZIP leucine zipper transcription factors, the structural class defined by a basic DNA-binding region and a leucine zipper for dimerization. ATF4, CHOP, CREB, FOS and JUN are members of the same family, and several of them, including ATF4, control autophagy gene transcription under stress.
context.zh-TW: ATF4 是 bZIP 亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子家族的成員，該結構類別由鹼性 DNA 結合區域與用於二聚化的亮胺酸拉鍊所定義。ATF4、CHOP、CREB、FOS 與 JUN 都是同一家族的成員，其中數個成員（包括 ATF4）在壓力下控制自噬基因的轉錄。

context.en-US: CHOP is a member of the bZIP leucine zipper transcription factors, sharing the basic region plus leucine zipper architecture with ATF4, XBP1, CREB, FOS and JUN. This family is relevant to autophagy because its members are activated by stress signals such as ER Stress and nutrient deprivation, where they rewire transcription.
context.zh-TW: CHOP 是 bZIP 亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子家族的成員，與 ATF4、XBP1、CREB、FOS、JUN 共用「鹼性區域加亮胺酸拉鍊」的架構。此家族與自噬相關，因為其成員會被 ER Stress 與營養剝奪等壓力訊號活化，並在其中改寫轉錄程式。

context.en-US: METTL3, together with METTL14 and WTAP, is the writer complex that installs N6-methyladenosine (m6A), the most abundant internal RNA modification. m6A placement controls mRNA stability and translation, so which transcripts get marked determines how long they persist and how efficiently they are translated into protein.
context.zh-TW: METTL3 與 METTL14、WTAP 共同構成 writer 複合體，安裝 N6-甲基腺苷（m6A），即最豐富的 RNA 內部修飾。m6A 的位置控制 mRNA 的穩定性與轉譯，因此哪些轉錄本被標記，就決定了它們能維持多久以及被轉譯成蛋白質的效率。
