context.en-US: MuRF1 (Muscle RING Finger 1, also known as TRIM63) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression rises during muscle wasting and atrophy; it tags sarcomeric proteins so they can be degraded through the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
context.zh-TW: MuRF1（Muscle RING Finger 1，又稱 TRIM63）是一種肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，在肌肉消耗與萎縮時表現上升；它標記肌節蛋白，使其經由泛素-蛋白酶體系統被降解。

context.en-US: Urolithin A downregulates the muscle-specific atrophy ligase MuRF1 (and its partner Atrogin-1), reducing sarcomeric protein degradation to mitigate muscle atrophy and promote hypertrophy.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 下調肌肉特異性的萎縮相關 E3 連接酶 MuRF1（及其夥伴 Atrogin-1），減少肌節蛋白降解，以減輕肌肉萎縮並促進肌肥大。

context.en-US: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a well-characterized and abundant member of the Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) class, formed by oxidative degradation of Amadori products or by reaction of glyoxal with lysine residues.
context.zh-TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是被充分刻畫且含量豐富的晚期糖基化終產物（AGEs）類成員，由 Amadori 產物的氧化降解或乙二醛與離胺酸殘基反應而形成。

context.en-US: CML is a significant biomarker of glycation stress; its serum concentration correlates with arterial stiffness in the elderly, and CML accumulates in heart and kidney tissue during aging.
context.zh-TW: CML 是糖化壓力的重要生物標記；其血清濃度與老年人的動脈僵硬相關，並在老化過程中累積於心臟與腎臟組織。

context.en-US: Neffy is a needle-free intranasal epinephrine spray approved for emergency treatment of anaphylaxis; its stabilized formulation reduces epinephrine autoxidation and thus limits formation of Adrenochrome and related aminochromes.
context.zh-TW: Neffy 是免針式鼻內 [[Epinephrine]] 噴劑，核准用於過敏性休克的緊急治療；其穩定配方減少 [[Epinephrine]] 的自氧化，因而抑制 [[Adrenochrome]] 及相關 aminochrome 的生成。

context.en-US: Nicotinamide, the amide form of vitamin B3, is condensed with PRPP by the rate-limiting salvage enzyme NAMPT to form NMN, which NMNAT then converts to NAD+; this salvage route accounts for roughly 85% of cellular NAD+ production.
context.zh-TW: [[Nicotinamide]]（维生素 B3 的醯胺型）由補救途徑中的限速酵素 [[NAMPT]] 與 PRPP 縮合形成 [[NMN]]，再由 [[NMNAT]] 轉為 [[NAD+]]；此補救途徑約佔細胞 [[NAD+]] 生成的 85%。

context.en-US: Nicotinamide is an endogenous non-competitive feedback inhibitor of sirtuins: after release of the O-acetyl-ADP-ribose intermediate it binds a conserved pocket in the sirtuin catalytic domain, blocking NAD+ re-binding. SIRT1-SIRT3 are potently inhibited at physiological NAM concentrations (IC50 ~30-200 uM), while SIRT5 and SIRT6 are relatively resistant.
context.zh-TW: [[Nicotinamide]] 是 sirtuin 內生性的非競爭性回饋抑制劑：在 O-乙醯-ADP-核糖中間產物釋放後，它結合 sirtuin 催化區的保守口袋，阻斷 [[NAD+]] 再結合。[[SIRT1]]–[[SIRT3]] 在生理濃度下被顯著抑制（IC50 約 30–200 µM），而 [[SIRT5]] 與 [[SIRT6]] 相對具有抗性。

context.en-US: CD38 and CD157 are NAD+ consumers that cleave NAD+ to yield nicotinamide and cADPR, competing with sirtuins for the same NAD+ pool and thereby raising nicotinamide levels that feedback-inhibit sirtuin activity.
context.zh-TW: [[CD38]] 與 CD157 是消耗 [[NAD+]] 的酵素，切割 [[NAD+]] 產生 [[Nicotinamide]] 與 cADPR，與 sirtuin 競爭同一 [[NAD+]] 池，因而提高 [[Nicotinamide]] 濃度並回饋抑制 sirtuin 活性。

context.en-US: During caloric restriction intracellular nicotinamide concentrations fall, relieving feedback inhibition of sirtuins and contributing to sirtuin activation and the associated stress-resistance and longevity effects.
context.zh-TW: 在熱量限制期間，細胞內 [[Nicotinamide]] 濃度下降，解除對 sirtuin 的回饋抑制，促成 sirtuin 活化及其相關的抗逆境與延壽效應。

context.en-US: Nicotinic acid (niacin) enters the Preiss-Handler Pathway, where NAPRT forms NaMN, NMNAT adenylates it to NaAD, and NAD+ synthetase amidates NaAD to NAD+. This route bypasses NAMPT, the rate-limiting and NAD+-sensitive step of the salvage pathway.
context.zh-TW: [[Nicotinic acid]]（niacin）經由 Preiss-Handler Pathway 進入 [[NAD+]] 合成：NAPRT 形成 NaMN，[[NMNAT]] 將其腺苷酸化為 NaAD，再由 NAD+ 合成酶醯胺化生成 [[NAD+]]。此途徑繞過補救途徑中的限速步驟 [[NAMPT]]。

context.en-US: As the obligate precursor of NAD+ and, through NAD+ kinase, of NADPH, nicotinic acid underlies reductive biosynthesis and antioxidant defense, including glutathione reduction and thioredoxin reductase activity.
context.zh-TW: 作為 [[NAD+]] 及其經 NAD+ kinase 生成的 [[NADPH]] 的必然前驅物，[[Nicotinic acid]] 支撐還原性生合成與抗氧化防禦，包括麩胱甘肽還原與 thioredoxin reductase 活性。

context.en-US: Hoffer and Osmond proposed within the Adrenochrome Hypothesis that niacin could attenuate adrenochrome formation by raising NADPH availability and supporting reductive detoxification systems that convert adrenochrome back to leuco-adrenochrome; the hypothesis has not been validated clinically.
context.zh-TW: Hoffer 與 Osmond 在 Adrenochrome Hypothesis 中提出，niacin 可藉由提升 [[NADPH]] 可用性、支持將 [[Adrenochrome]] 還原回 [[Leuco-adrenochrome]] 的解毒系統來減少其生成；但此假說未獲臨床驗證。

context.en-US: Nitrobenzene is industrially reduced to aniline, the precursor of aniline dyes; the shared reductive metabolism explains why nitrobenzene and aniline dyes produce the same methemoglobinemia profile.
context.zh-TW: Nitrobenzene 在工業上被還原為 aniline，後者是 aniline 染體的前驅物；共同的還原代謝解釋了 nitrobenzene 與 aniline 染體為何具有相同的 methemoglobinemia 毒性特徵。

context.en-US: Because leuco-adrenochrome and epinephrine intermediates are extremely oxidation-sensitive, they are stored and handled under an inert atmosphere of nitrogen gas (or argon) to prevent catecholamine autoxidation.
context.zh-TW: 由於 [[Leuco-adrenochrome]] 與 [[Epinephrine]] 中間產物對氧化極度敏感，它們在 [[Nitrogen gas]]（或 [[Argon]]）的惰性氣氛下儲存與操作，以防止兒茶酚胺自氧化。

context.en-US: Nitrotyrosine, most commonly the 3-nitro form, is the nitrated derivative of the amino acid tyrosine and the stable, accumulated footprint of tyrosine nitration.
context.zh-TW: Nitrotyrosine（最常見為 3-硝基型）是胺基酸 [[Tyrosine]] 的硝化衍生物，也是 tyrosine nitration 穩定累積的終產物痕跡。

context.en-US: Myeloperoxidase using nitrite and hydrogen peroxide nitrates protein-bound or free tyrosine to form nitrotyrosine; because the adduct resists turnover it serves as a durable biomarker of nitrosative and oxidative injury.
context.zh-TW: [[Myeloperoxidase]] 以 nitrite 與 [[Hydrogen Peroxide]] 硝化蛋白結合型或游離的 tyrosine，形成 nitrotyrosine；由於此加合物不易被 turnover，因此可作為硝化與氧化損傷的持久生物標記。

context.en-US: Free 3-nitrotyrosine is quantified by mass spectrometry and HPLC, while immunodetection localizes nitrated proteins in tissue; elevated levels track with atherosclerosis, neurodegeneration and sepsis.
context.zh-TW: 游離的 3-nitrotyrosine 以 [[Mass Spectrometry]] 與 HPLC 定量，抗體偵測則用於定位組織中被硝化的蛋白；其濃度升高與動脈粥狀硬化、神經退化與敗血症相關。

context.en-US: Beyond inhibiting fat absorption, orlistat decreases intestinal absorption of dietary Advanced Glycation End Products; in women with PCOS it lowered postprandial serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal compared with controls.
context.zh-TW: 除了抑制脂肪吸收外，[[Orlistat]] 還能減少飲食性 [[Advanced Glycation End Products]] 的腸道吸收；在 PCOS 女性中，相較對照組可降低高 AGE 餐後的血清 AGE 濃度。

context.en-US: Misfolded or aggregation-prone ornithine transcarbamylase variants imported into the matrix expose hydrophobic regions that activate the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, shifting transcription toward chaperones, matrix proteases and antioxidant defenses while slowing general protein translation.
context.zh-TW: 錯誤摺疊或易聚集的 [[Ornithine transcarbamylase]] 變異體進入粒線體基質後暴露疏水區域，活化 [[Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response]]，使轉錄轉向 chaperone、基質蛋白酶與抗氧化防禦，並暫時降低一般蛋白質轉譯。

context.en-US: Ornithine transcarbamylase is the only urea-cycle enzyme located in the mitochondrion, where it condenses carbamoyl phosphate with ornithine to form citrulline; its deficiency is the most common inborn error of the urea cycle, causing hyperammonemia.
context.zh-TW: [[Ornithine transcarbamylase]] 是唯一位於 [[Mitochondria]] 的尿素循環酵素，在此將 carbamoyl phosphate 與 ornithine 縮合生成 citrulline；其缺乏是尿素循環最常見的先天性錯誤，導致高血氨。

context.en-US: A robust mitochondrial unfolded protein response blunts mitochondrial ROS production, supporting the mitohormesis buffering systems that limit catecholamine autoxidation; chronic folding overload can exhaust the response and tip redox balance toward epinephrine oxidation to adrenochrome.
context.zh-TW: 健全的 [[Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response]] 可抑制粒線體 ROS 生成，支撐 [[Mitohormesis]] 的緩衝系統並限制兒茶酚胺自氧化；長期摺疊過載則可能耗竭此反應，使氧化還原平衡偏向 [[Epinephrine]] 氧化生成 [[Adrenochrome]]。

context.en-US: Oxygen Consumption Rate is measured in real time with a Seahorse XF Analyzer, whose transient micro-chamber clamps track O2 flux while titrating oligomycin, FCCP and rotenone/antimycin A to resolve basal, ATP-linked, proton-leak and spare respiratory capacity.
context.zh-TW: Oxygen Consumption Rate 以 [[Seahorse XF Analyzer]] 即時測定；儀器利用瞬間微腔夾制追蹤 O₂ 通量，並以 [[Oligomycin]]、[[FCCP]] 與 rotenone/antimycin A 滴定，解析基礎呼吸、ATP 連結呼吸、質子漏與呼吸剩餘容量。

context.en-US: In mitohormesis and longevity studies an elevated oxygen consumption rate after mild stress indicates enhanced mitochondrial biogenesis and coupling, so OCR is a key pharmacodynamic marker for interventions that raise coupled respiration and thereby lower superoxide anion production.
context.zh-TW: 在 [[Mitohormesis]] 與長壽研究中，輕度壓力後升高的 [[Oxygen Consumption Rate]] 顯示粒線體生物合成與偶聯增加，因此 OCR 是評估提升偶聯呼吸、進而降低 [[Superoxide anion]] 生成的介入措施之關鍵藥效指標。

context.en-US: The oxygen-dissociation curve relates the partial pressure of oxygen to hemoglobin oxygen saturation; in methemoglobinemia ferric subunits cannot carry oxygen and cause a left shift in the curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, impairing oxygen release to tissues.
context.zh-TW: Oxygen-dissociation curve 描述氧分壓與 [[Hemoglobin]] 血氧飽和度的關係；在 [[Methemoglobinemia]] 中，鐵(III) 次單元無法攜氧，並使殘餘正常 [[Hemoglobin]] 的曲線左移，妨礙氧釋放至組織。

context.en-US: Oxyhemoglobin is in constant redox equilibrium with methemoglobin: spontaneous autoxidation lets bound O2 abstract an electron from Fe2+, yielding ferric heme and releasing superoxide anion at a slow rate (~0.5-3% of Hb per day), normally kept low by cytochrome b5 reductase and NADPH diaphorase.
context.zh-TW: Oxyhemoglobin 與 methemoglobin 處於持續的氧化還原平衡：自發自氧化使結合的 O₂ 從 Fe²⁺ 奪走電子，生成三價血基質並釋放 [[Superoxide anion]]，速率緩慢（每日約 0.5–3% Hb），通常由 cytochrome b5 reductase 與 NADPH diaphorase 維持在低值。

context.en-US: Superoxide and downstream H2O2 released by oxyhemoglobin autoxidation oxidize epinephrine and other catecholamines to quinone/semiquinone intermediates and ultimately to adrenochrome, so erythrocyte heme redox and plasma catecholamine redox are coupled through shared radical intermediates.
context.zh-TW: 由 oxyhemoglobin 自氧化釋出的 [[Superoxide anion]] 及其下游 H₂O₂ 會將 [[Epinephrine]] 等兒茶酚胺氧化為 quinone/semiquinone 中間體，最終生成 [[Adrenochrome]]，使紅血球血基質氧化還原與血漿兒茶酚胺氧化還原透過共享的自由基中間體相互耦合。

context.en-US: PARK7 (DJ-1) functions primarily as a glutathione-independent glyoxalase, stereospecifically detoxifying free glyoxal to glycolic acid and methylglyoxal to L-lactate, which prevents these dicarbonyls from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine and arginine residues.
context.zh-TW: PARK7（DJ-1）主要作為穀胱甘肽非依賴性 glyoxalase 作用，立體專一地將游離的 [[Glyoxal]] 解毒為 [[Glycolic acid]]、將 [[Methylglyoxal]] 解毒為 [[L-lactate]]，避免這些二碳醣基化合物在 [[Cysteine]]、[[Lysine]] 與 [[Arginine]] 殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。

context.en-US: By clearing dicarbonyl precursors, PARK7 occupies line 1 of a three-layer enzymatic AGE defense system; loss-of-function mutations cause tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs and are strongly linked to early-onset familial Parkinson's Disease.
context.zh-TW: 藉由清除二碳醣基前驅物，PARK7 佔據三層酵素性 AGE 防禦體系的第一線；其功能喪失突變會造成組織特異性的新 AGE 累積，並與早發型家族性 [[Parkinson's Disease]] 密切相關。

context.en-US: The canonical glyoxalase system (GLO1/GLO2) consumes glutathione, so under oxidative stress - when glutathione is depleted and methylglyoxal is highest - DJ-1 becomes the last line of defense, whereas adrenochrome-driven oxidative stress both depletes glutathione and activates DJ-1 via Cys106 oxidation.
context.zh-TW: 典型 glyoxalase 系統（[[GLO1]]/[[GLO2]]）會消耗 [[Glutathione]]；因此在 [[Oxidative Stress]] 下（glutathione 耗竭、methylglyoxal 最高時），DJ-1 成為最後一道防線，而 [[Adrenochrome]] 驅動的氧化壓力既耗竭 glutathione，又經 Cys106 氧化活化 DJ-1。

context.en-US: Pentosidine is a well-known fluorescent cross-link of the Advanced Glycation End Products family, formed by reaction of ribose, glucose or other sugars with lysine and arginine residues, and used to measure the extent of protein glycation and cross-linking in tissues.
context.zh-TW: Pentosidine 是 [[Advanced Glycation End Products]] 家族中著名的螢光性交聯產物，由核糖、葡萄糖等糖類與 [[Lysine]]、[[Arginine]] 殘基反應形成，用於衡量組織中蛋白質的糖化與交聯程度。

context.en-US: Pentosidine concentrations rise with age in heart, lung collagen, skin, patellar tendon, vitreous body, oocytes and intervertebral disk, and were about 200% higher in older adults (mean age 78) than in young counterparts (mean age 25).
context.zh-TW: Pentosidine 濃度隨年齡在心臟、肺部 [[Collagen]]、皮膚、髕韌帶、玻璃體、卵母細胞與椎間盤中升高；older 成人（平均 78 歲）約比年輕對照組（平均 25 歲）高 200%。

context.en-US: Peptide deformylase is a metal-dependent hydrolase that removes the N-formyl group from initiator N-formylmethionine; actinonin, a hydroxamate natural product, blocks deformylation, causing accumulation of formylated, misfolding-prone precursors that engage the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
context.zh-TW: [[Peptide deformylase]] 是金屬依賴性水解酶，移除新生多肽起始 N-甲醯甲硫胺酸的甲醯基；[[Actinonin]]（一種羥肟酸類天然產物）阻斷去甲醯化，使甲醯化且易錯誤摺疊的前驅物累積，進而啟動 [[Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response]]。

context.en-US: Within the mitochondrion, endosymbiotic remnants retain a formylmethionine-based translation system, so peptide deformylase activity is required for maturation of a subset of matrix and inner-membrane proteins, including core respiratory-chain subunits whose assembly shapes superoxide anion output.
context.zh-TW: 在 [[Mitochondria]] 內，內共生細菌保留了以甲醯甲硫胺酸為基礎的轉譯系統，因此 [[Peptide deformylase]] 活性是部分基質與內膜蛋白（含核心呼吸鏈次單體）成熟的必要條件，而其組裝狀況會影響 [[Superoxide anion]] 的產出。

context.en-US: Persulfates (peroxydisulfates, S2O8^2-) are strong oxidizing agents used to oxidize epinephrine in aqueous medium, often with bismuth or other metal salts as catalysts, in industrial synthesis of adrenochrome.
context.zh-TW: Persulfates（過二硫酸鹽，S₂O₈²⁻）是強氧化劑，在水溶液中用於氧化 [[Epinephrine]]，常以 [[Bismuth]] 等金屬鹽為催化劑，進行 [[Adrenochrome]] 的工業合成。

context.en-US: Persulfates is the chemical class containing the peroxydisulfate anion; its common members include potassium persulfate, ammonium persulfate and sodium persulfate, all strong oxidizers used in polymerization and catecholamine oxidation chemistry.
context.zh-TW: Persulfates 為含過二硫酸根陰離子的化學類別；其常見成員包括 [[Potassium Persulfate]]、[[Ammonium Persulfate]] 與 [[Sodium Persulfate]]，皆為用於聚合與兒茶酚胺氧化化學的強氧化劑。

context.en-US: Adrenochrome is a highly unstable aminochrome intermediate that readily undergoes oxidative polymerization to form melanin-like pigments, which accounts for the brown discoloration of degraded epinephrine solutions.
context.zh-TW: [[Adrenochrome]] 是高度不穩定的 aminochrome 中間體，容易經氧化性聚合形成類似 [[Melanins]] 的色素，這正是降解的 [[Epinephrine]] 溶液呈褐色的原因。

context.en-US: Catecholamine polymerization proceeds by oxidative coupling of quinoid intermediates through semiquinone radical chain propagation, yielding the dark brown neuromelanin that accumulates with age in catecholaminergic neurons of the Substantia Nigra and Locus Coeruleus.
context.zh-TW: 兒茶酚胺的聚合經由 quinoid 中間體的氧化偶聯、以 semiquinone 自由基作為鏈傳播物進行，最終生成深褐色 [[Neuromelanin]]，在人一生中累積於 [[Substantia Nigra]] 與 [[Locus Coeruleus]] 的兒茶酚胺神經元。

context.en-US: When neuromelanin granules become saturated with metals they can release pro-oxidant iron, and extracellular neuromelanin released from dying neurons activates microglia, perpetuating neuroinflammation and dopaminergic cell loss in Parkinson's Disease.
context.zh-TW: 當 neuromelanin 顆粒被金屬飽和時會釋出促氧化態的 [[Iron]]；而死亡神經元釋出的細胞外 [[Neuromelanin]] 會活化 [[Microglia]]，在 [[Parkinson's Disease]] 中 perpetuate 神經發炎與多巴胺能細胞流失。

context.en-US: Potassium persulfate (K2S2O8) is one of the strongest known peroxygen oxidizers (E° = 2.01 V for S2O8^2-/2SO4^2-) and is a preferred laboratory oxidant that converts epinephrine to adrenochrome by a clean two-electron oxidation, giving the red chromophore with lambda max near 480 nm.
context.zh-TW: Potassium persulfate（K₂S₂O₈）是已知最強的過氧氧化劑之一（S₂O₈²⁻/2SO₄²⁻ 標準電位 E° = 2.01 V），為實驗室偏好的氧化劑，可藉乾淨的雙電子氧化將 [[Epinephrine]] 轉為 [[Adrenochrome]]，產生吸收峰約 480 nm 的紅色發色團。

context.en-US: Beyond adrenochrome chemistry, potassium persulfate is widely used as a free-radical initiator in emulsion polymerizations for acrylics and styrene-butadiene rubber, and as an etching agent and bleaching oxidant.
context.zh-TW: 除 [[Adrenochrome]] 化學外，[[Potassium Persulfate]] 也廣泛用作丙烯酸類與苯乙烯-丁二橡膠乳化聚合的自由基起始劑，並作為蝕刻劑與漂白氧化劑。

context.en-US: Potassium ferricyanide (K3[Fe(CN)6]) is a bright red salt classically used to oxidize adrenaline or its salts in aqueous medium to prepare adrenochrome; commercial use is limited by the large quantities required and effluent disposal problems relative to persulfates.
context.zh-TW: [[Potassium ferricyanide]]（K₃[Fe(CN)₆]）是鮮紅色鹽類，傳統上用於在水溶液中氧化 adrenaline 或其鹽類以製備 [[Adrenochrome]]；相較於 persulfates，其商業應用受限於用量龐大與廢液處理問題。

context.en-US: Prilocaine is an amino-amide local anesthetic with a well-characterized dose-dependent capacity to induce acquired methemoglobinemia: hydrolysis to o-toluidine and related aromatic amines oxidizes hemoglobin Fe2+ to Fe3+, with onset delayed relative to direct oxidants such as benzocaine.
context.zh-TW: Prilocaine 是胺基-醯胺類局部麻醉劑，具有已知的劑量依賴性後天性 [[Methemoglobinemia]] 誘發能力：水解產生的 o-toluidine 等芳香胺將 [[Hemoglobin]] 的 Fe²⁺ 氧化為 Fe³⁺，其起效時間較 [[Benzocaine]] 等直接氧化劑延後。

context.en-US: Prilocaine is structurally related to lidocaine and is frequently combined with it, as in EMLA cream, for topical analgesia; both amide anesthetics block voltage-gated sodium channels to arrest nerve impulse propagation.
context.zh-TW: Prilocaine 與 [[Lidocaine]] 結構相關，並常與其合併使用（如 EMLA 乳膏）以進行表面鎮痛；兩者皆為醯胺類麻醉劑，藉阻斷電壓閘控鈉離子通道來阻斷神經衝動傳導。

context.en-US: Infants and patients with G6PD deficiency or preexisting methemoglobinemia are at greater risk of prilocaine-induced methemoglobinemia, with the classic sign being cyanosis refractory to oxygen and chocolate-brown blood; neonates are especially vulnerable because of immature methemoglobin-reductase capacity.
context.zh-TW: 嬰兒與患有 [[G6PD deficiency]] 或既有 methemoglobinemia 的患者較易發生 prilocaine 引發的 [[Methemoglobinemia]]，典型表現為對氧氣無反應的發紺與巧克力色血液；新生兒因 methemoglobin 還原酶能力未成熟而風險特別高。

context.en-US: Pyridoxamine, a vitamin B6 vitamer, acts as a potent carbonyl trap: its amine reversibly binds reactive dicarbonyls such as methylglyoxal, glyoxal and 3-deoxyglucosone in stable Schiff bases, preventing protein crosslinking and the AGE adducts such as pentosidine that follow.
context.zh-TW: Pyridoxamine（维生素 B6 的一種 vitamer）是強效羰基捕捉劑：其胺基可逆地與 [[Methylglyoxal]]、glyoxal 與 3-deoxyglucosone 等高反應性二碳醣基化合物形成相對穩定的 Schiff 鹼，防止蛋白質交聯及隨後的 [[Advanced Glycation End Products]]（如 pentosidine）加合物形成。

context.en-US: By intercepting carbonyls before they crosslink proteins, pyridoxamine reduces AGE-RAGE signaling, a major source of inflammation and oxidative stress in aging tissues, complementing enzymatic defenses such as the Glyoxalase System and dampening lipid and metal-catalyzed oxidation.
context.zh-TW: 藉由在羰基化合物交聯蛋白質之前攔截它們，[[Pyridoxamine]] 減少 AGE–[[RAGE]] 訊號傳遞（老化組織中 [[Inflammation]] 與 [[Oxidative Stress]] 的主要來源），並與 [[Glyoxalase System]] 等酵素性防禦互補，同時抑制脂質與金屬催化的氧化。

context.en-US: Pyrraline is an advanced glycation end product formed by reaction of glucose with lysine residues in proteins; it is abundant in heat-processed foods such as pretzel sticks and is absorbed in the intestine via transporters such as hPEPT1.
context.zh-TW: Pyrraline 是由 [[Glucose]] 與蛋白質中 [[Lysine]] 殘基反應形成的晚期糖基化終產物；它富含於烘焙加工食品（如 pretzel sticks），並經由 [[hPEPT1]] 等轉運蛋白在小腸被吸收。

context.en-US: In pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality control tests epinephrine drug products for purity, potency and degradation products, using HPLC and LC-MS with reference standards to assay impurities such as leuco-adrenochrome and adrenochrome.
context.zh-TW: 在藥品製造中，品質管控以 [[HPLC]] 與 [[LC-MS]] 搭配 [[Reference standard]] 檢測 [[Epinephrine]] 藥品的純度、效價與降解產物，測定如 [[Leuco-adrenochrome]] 與 [[Adrenochrome]] 等雜質。

context.en-US: QueE-like enzymes are radical S-adenosylmethionine proteins discovered by metagenomic screening that cleave glucosepane, the exceptionally stable lysine-arginine imidazolium AGE crosslink; they can grow on synthetic glucosepane as sole nutrient and degrade it in vitro.
context.zh-TW: QueE-like 酵素是經由 metagenomic 篩選發現的 radical S-adenosylmethionine 蛋白，可切割 [[Glucosepane]]——一種極穩定的離胺酸-精胺酸 imidazolium AGE 交聯；它們能以合成 glucosepane 為唯一營養源生長，並在體外降解之。

context.en-US: Glucosepane is exceptionally resistant to the mammalian Glyoxalase System and other endogenous repair pathways despite accumulating relentlessly in collagen and elastin with age, which is why QueE-like biocatalysts are explored as AGE crosslink breakers complementary to carbonyl traps such as pyridoxamine.
context.zh-TW: [[Glucosepane]] 對哺乳類 [[Glyoxalase System]] 及其他內源性修復途徑極具抗性，卻仍隨年齡在 [[Collagen]] 與 elastin 中持續累積；這正是 QueE-like 酵素被開發為 AGE 交聯破壞劑、並與 [[Pyridoxamine]] 等羰基捕捉劑互補的原因。

context.en-US: Isobutyl nitrite is a volatile alkyl nitrite ('poppers') whose nitrite species oxidize the ferrous (Fe2+) iron of hemoglobin to the ferric (Fe3+) state. The resulting methemoglobin cannot bind or transport oxygen, so nitrite-driven one-electron oxidation of heme iron is the shared chemical basis for isobutyl nitrite toxicity and, in parallel, for the redox/autoxidation chemistry of catecholamine quinones.
context.zh-TW: Isobutyl nitrite 是一種易揮發的烷基亞硝酸酯（「poppers」），其亞硝酸鹽物種可將血基質的鐵由二價鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+）。所形成的 methemoglobin 無法結合或運送氧氣，因此亞硝酸鹽驅動的單電子血基質氧化，正是 isobutyl nitrite 毒性的化學基礎，也與兒茶酚胺醌類的氧化／自氧化化學平行。

context.en-US: Inhalation of isobutyl nitrite can trigger severe acquired methemoglobinemia, presenting with cyanosis, hypoxia and characteristic chocolate-brown blood. Because the underlying defect is oxidatively impaired hemoglobin, antidotes must restore the ferrous heme state rather than improve oxygen delivery capacity.
context.zh-TW: 吸入 isobutyl nitrite 可誘發嚴重的後天性 methemoglobinemia，表現為發紺、缺氧以及特有的巧克力色血液。由於其缺陷在於血基質被氧化而無法正常運氧，解毒劑必須還原鐵離子狀態，而非單純改善氧氣運送。

context.en-US: Isourolithin A, the gut-microbial isomer of urolithin A, can stimulate mitophagy, the selective clearance of damaged mitochondria. By improving mitochondrial quality control it is of interest for muscle health and healthspan, though its potency is generally somewhat lower than that of urolithin A.
context.zh-TW: Isourolithin A 是 urolithin A 的腸道菌叢異構體，可刺激 Mitophagy，即可選擇性清除受損粒線體。藉由改善粒線體品質管制，它對肌肉健康與 healthspan 具意義，但效價通常略低於 urolithin A。

context.en-US: Isourolithin A is produced by gut bacteria such as Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens from dietary ellagic acid and ellagitannins present in pomegranate, walnuts and berries. Individuals who make isourolithin A rather than urolithin A define metabotype B, so gut microbiome composition determines which urolithin metabolite a person can produce at all.
context.zh-TW: Isourolithin A 由 Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 等腸道菌， 以飲食中的 ellagic acid 與存在於石榴、核桃、漿果中的 ellagitannin 產生。產生 isourolithin A 而非 urolithin A 的人被定義為 metabotype B，因此腸道菌叢組成決定了個人究竟能製造哪一種 urolithin 代謝物。

context.en-US: Jeanho Yun co-authored the 2014 landmark 'Mitohormesis' paper in Cell Metabolism with Toren Finkel. That study showed that mild mitochondrial stress in Caenorhabditis elegans extends lifespan through an adaptive response dependent on the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, providing the mechanistic framework for the mitohormesis concept.
context.zh-TW: Jeanho Yun 與 Toren Finkel 共同作者了 2014 年《Cell Metabolism》的里程碑論文「Mitohormesis」。該研究顯示，Caenorhabditis elegans 中輕度的粒線體壓力可透過依賴粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的適應反應延長壽命，為 mitohormesis 概念提供了機轉框架。

context.en-US: Low levels of reactive oxygen species generated during mild mitochondrial stress function as second messengers in stress-adaptation signaling rather than purely as toxic byproducts. In Caenorhabditis elegans this ROS signal engages the UPRmt and the SKN-1/Nrf2 axis to upregulate chaperones, proteases and detoxification enzymes, the mechanistic core of mitohormesis.
context.zh-TW: 輕度粒線體壓力期間產生的低量 Reactive Oxygen Species，在壓力適應訊號中作為第二訊使，而非純粹的有毒副產物。在 Caenorhabditis elegans 中，此 ROS 訊號啟動 UPRmt 與 SKN-1/Nrf2 軸，上調伴護蛋白、蛋白酶與解毒酵素，這正是 mitohormesis 的機轉核心。

context.en-US: PARK7 (DJ-1), a peroxiredoxin-like protein, stereospecifically converts the glycating dicarbonyl methylglyoxal into L-lactate in a glutathione-independent manner. By detoxifying methylglyoxal without consuming the principal antioxidant buffer, this route complements the glutathione-dependent glyoxalase system and the fructosyl-amino acid oxidase/PARK7 family of anti-glycation defenses.
context.zh-TW: PARK7（DJ-1）是一種 peroxiredoxin 類蛋白質，會以不依賴 glutathione 的方式立體專一性地將醣化二羰基 methylglyoxal 轉換為 L-lactate。由於可在不消耗主要抗氧化緩衝的情況下解毒 methylglyoxal，這條途徑補足依賴 glutathione 的 glyoxalase system 以及 fructosyl-amino acid oxidase／PARK7 這類抗醣化防禦。

context.en-US: L-lactate is the physiological enantiomer of lactate and is produced predominantly by glycolysis and anaerobic metabolism. Once dismissed as a mere waste product, it is now recognized as a signaling metabolite, an energy substrate shuttled between cells via the Cori cycle and monocarboxylate transporters, and an epigenetic modulator through histone lactylation.
context.zh-TW: L-lactate 是 lactate 的生理性對映異構體，主要由 glycolysis 與無氧代謝產生。它過去被視為單純的廢物，如今則被認為是訊號代謝物、經由 Cori cycle 與單羧酸運輸蛋白在細胞間運送的能量底物，以及透過組蛋白 lactylation 作用的表觀遺傳調節者。

context.en-US: LC-MS combines the physical separation of liquid chromatography with mass analysis to identify catecholamine metabolites and impurities such as leuco-adrenochrome with high sensitivity and specificity. Adrenochrome analytics rely on it both to verify the purity of commercial epinephrine against a reference standard and to quantify trace degradation products in biological or pharmaceutical samples.
context.zh-TW: LC-MS 結合液相層析的物理分離能力與質譜分析能力，可高專一性地鑑別兒茶酚胺代謝物與 leuco-adrenochrome 等雜質。Adrenochrome 的分析同時倚賴它，藉以比對商業 epinephrine 樣品與參考標準以確認純度，並定量生物或藥物樣品中的微量降解產物。

context.en-US: Mass spectrometry measures the mass-to-charge ratio of ions and, when coupled to liquid chromatography as LC-MS, identifies and quantifies trace adrenochrome species from their unique molecular weights and fragmentation patterns. The same technique also serves as a Certificate of Analysis verification method for synthetic adrenochrome batches, which readily degrade if handled improperly.
context.zh-TW: Mass spectrometry 測量離子的質荷比；與液相層析偶聯成 LC-MS 時，便可依據獨特的分子量與碎片圖譜鑑別並定量微量 adrenochrome 物種。同一技術也用作合成 adrenochrome 批號的 Certificate of Analysis 驗證方法，因為這類批次若處理不當極易降解。

context.en-US: Lidocaine, an amide-type local anesthetic and Class IB antiarrhythmic that blocks voltage-gated sodium channels, is a recognized cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, particularly with high-dose infusion, topical mucosal application, or use in infants. The pathogenesis is metabolic: lidocaine and its aromatic amine metabolites oxidize ferroheme (Fe2+) of hemoglobin to ferriheme (Fe3+), shifting the oxygen-dissociation curve leftward and producing cyanosis refractory to oxygen.
context.zh-TW: Lidocaine 是一種阻斷電壓門控鈉離子通道的醯胺類局部麻醉藥與 IB 類抗心律不整藥，被認為是後天性 methemoglobinemia 的已知病因，尤其見於高劑量輸注、黏膜局部使用或嬰兒族群。其致病機轉為代謝性：lidocaine 及其芳香胺代謝物將血基質由二價鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+），使氧解離曲線左移，產生對氧氣無反應的發紺。

context.en-US: Ligand-conjugated nanoparticles are nanoparticle cores decorated with ligands that bind specific cell-surface markers, concentrating the particle and its payload at the desired site while sparing non-target tissue. Applied to senescence, this ligand-receptor interaction directs senolytics or senomorphics selectively to senescent cells, potentially improving their therapeutic index over untargeted formulations.
context.zh-TW: Ligand-conjugated nanoparticles 是以可結合特定細胞表面標記的配體修飾的奈米顆粒核心，能將顆粒與其負載物集中於目標部位，同時減少非標靶組織的暴露。應用於衰老領域時，這種配體—受體作用可將 senolytics 或 senomorphics 選擇性導向 senescent cells，相較未標靶配方有潛力提升治療指數。

context.en-US: Because adrenochrome is notoriously unstable and subject to metal- and oxygen-dependent non-enzymatic autoxidation, encapsulation inside ligand-conjugated nanoparticles shields it from the extracellular environment of blood and plasma. The same platform therefore serves dual utility: selectivity for targeting senescent cells and stabilization of oxidation-prone catecholamine derivatives.
context.zh-TW: 由於 adrenochrome 極不穩定，且會發生金屬與氧依賴性的非酵素性自氧化，將其包埋於 ligand-conjugated nanoparticles 內可隔絕血液與血漿的細胞外環境。同一平台因此具有雙重效用：對 senescent cells 的選擇性標靶，以及對易氧化兒茶酚胺衍生物的穩定化。

context.en-US: Lipase inhibitors suppress pancreatic and gastric lipases that hydrolyze dietary triglycerides, blocking fat digestion and lowering caloric uptake. Because lipophilic advanced glycation end products and their precursors co-travel with dietary fat, inhibiting lipase limits their micellar solubilization and intestinal uptake, lowering systemic AGE burden - a mechanistic link between fat digestion and the glycation axis of vascular and metabolic aging.
context.zh-TW: Lipase inhibitor 抑制分解飲食三酸甘油酯的胰臟與胃脂肪酶，阻斷脂肪消化並降低熱量攝取。由於親脂性的 advanced glycation end products 及其前驅物與飲食脂肪共運送，抑制脂肪酶會限制其微膠粒溶解與腸道吸收，降低全身 AGE 負載——這是脂肪消化與血管及代謝性老化之醣化軸之間的機轉連結。

context.en-US: Orlistat, derived from Streptomyces toxytricini, is the prototypical lipase inhibitor: an irreversible inhibitor of gastric and pancreatic lipase used for weight management. Its mechanism extends beyond caloric restriction, since blocking fat digestion also reduces uptake of dietary advanced glycation end products; chronic use nonetheless requires fat-soluble vitamin monitoring because of malabsorption.
context.zh-TW: Orlistat 源自 Streptomyces toxytricini，是脂肪酶抑制劑的原型：不可逆地抑制胃與胰臟脂肪酶，用於體重管理。其機轉不侷限於熱量限制，因為阻斷脂肪消化也會減少飲食性 advanced glycation end products 的攝取；但長期使用仍須監測脂溶性維生素以防吸收不良。

context.en-US: Liposome encapsulation sequesters compounds within or anchored to a phospholipid bilayer, exploiting the amphipathic nature of phospholipids to solubilize both hydrophilic cargo in the aqueous core and hydrophobic cargo within the lipid. Adrenochrome and related aminochromes and quinones are chemically unstable, redox-active and poorly soluble, so encapsulation shields them from rapid autoxidation, limits tissue oxidative stress, and stabilizes labile analytical reference standards.
context.zh-TW: Liposome encapsulation 將化合物隔離或錨定於磷脂雙層內，利用磷脂的兩親性同時溶解水溶性負載物（水相核心中）與脂溶性負載物（脂質層中）。Adrenochrome 及相關 aminochrome 與醌類化學上不穩定、具有氧化還原活性且溶解度差，因此包埋可 shields 其免於快速自氧化、限制組織的氧化壓力，並穩定易降解的分析用參考標準品。

context.en-US: Low-density lipoprotein is the principal cholesterol-transporting lipoprotein, carrying ApoB-100 with a core of cholesteryl esters and triglycerides. The unmodified particle is relatively inert; pathogenicity emerges once LDL is retained in the arterial intima and chemically modified by oxidation or glycation, after which scavenger-receptor uptake by macrophages seeds foam cells and fatty streaks. Small, dense LDL subspecies are especially prone to both modifications, so particle number and quality matter beyond total cholesterol.
context.zh-TW: Low-Density Lipoprotein 是運送膽固醇的主要脂蛋白，攜帶 ApoB-100 及膽固醇酯與三酸甘油酯核心。未經修飾的顆粒相對惰性；致病性出現在 LDL 滯留於動脈內膜並受到氧化或醣化修飾之後，此時經由清道夫受體被巨噬細胞攝取，形成泡沫細胞與脂肪斑塊。體積小而密的 LDL 次族群特別容易被這兩種修飾，因此顆粒數量與品質比總膽固醇更關鍵。

context.en-US: Glycation of ApoB-100 on retained LDL converts the particle into a high-uptake, pro-inflammatory form, and the resulting advanced glycation end products on LDL engage RAGE, amplifying inflammation and oxidative stress within the plaque. Lowering LDL and limiting dietary AGEs both reduce this atherogenic modification, a core cardiovascular-aging intervention.
context.zh-TW: 滯留 LDL 上 ApoB-100 的醣化會把顆粒轉變為高攝取、促發炎的形式，而 LDL 上形成的 advanced glycation end products 會接合 RAGE，在斑塊內放大 inflammation 與 oxidative stress。降低 LDL 與限制飲食 AGE 都可減少這種致粥樣硬化修飾，是心血管老化的核心介入點。

context.en-US: The lungs are a significant site of the oxidative metabolism of epinephrine into adrenochrome, particularly during acute respiratory conditions. During pneumonia, ARDS or COPD exacerbations, infiltrating neutrophils release large amounts of reactive oxygen species and myeloperoxidase, and the resulting oxidative environment converts local or circulating adrenaline to adrenochrome, whose presence further exacerbates lung injury through redox cycling.
context.zh-TW: 肺部是 epinephrine 氧化代謝為 adrenochrome 的重要場所，在急性呼吸道狀況下尤其明顯。於肺炎、ARDS 或 COPD 惡化期間，浸潤的 neutrophils 釋放大量 reactive oxygen species 與 myeloperoxidase，形成的氧化環境將局部或循環中的 adrenaline 轉為 adrenochrome，而其存在又透過 redox cycling 進一步加重肺部損傷。

context.en-US: Neutrophils flooding lung tissue and alveolar spaces during pneumonia, ARDS or COPD exacerbations undergo a respiratory burst that releases massive amounts of reactive oxygen species and myeloperoxidase. This creates the highly oxidative pulmonary environment that drives adrenaline oxidation and marks adrenochrome formation as an indicator of neutrophil-mediated tissue damage.
context.zh-TW: 在肺炎、ARDS 或 COPD 惡化期間，湧入肺組織與肺泡腔的 neutrophils 會進行 respiratory burst，釋放大量 reactive oxygen species 與 myeloperoxidase。這造就了高度氧化的肺部環境，驅動 adrenaline 氧化，也使 adrenochrome 的形成成為嗜中性球介導組織損傷的指標。

context.en-US: Lysine is one of the primary amino acids that reacts with reducing sugars in the Maillard Reaction. Glucose first attaches non-enzymatically to a free lysine (or arginine) residue of a protein, lipid or DNA to form a Schiff base, which progresses to advanced glycation end products such as pyrraline. Because lysine residues are abundant and surface-exposed, they are the dominant glycation sites in long-lived matrix proteins.
context.zh-TW: Lysine 是與還原糖在 Maillard Reaction 中反應的主要胺基酸之一。葡萄糖先以非酵素方式附著於蛋白質、脂質或 DNA 上游離的 lysine（或 arginine）殘基形成 Schiff base，進而生成 pyrraline 等 advanced glycation end products。由於 lysine 殘基數量多且易暴露於表面，它們是長壽命基質蛋白的主要醣化位點。

context.en-US: Monoamine oxidase catalyzes the oxidative deamination of monoamines including catecholamines such as dopamine and epinephrine, removing the amine group to yield an aldehyde plus hydrogen peroxide. MAO catalysis proceeds via FAD, whose reoxidation by molecular oxygen makes hydrogen peroxide a stoichiometric by-product, linking MAO activity directly to mitochondrial oxidative stress and redox signaling.
context.zh-TW: Monoamine oxidase 催化包括 dopamine 與 epinephrine 等兒茶酚胺在內的單胺之氧化脫氨作用，移除胺基後產生醛與 hydrogen peroxide。MAO 的催化經由 FAD 進行，FAD 被分子氧再氧化使 hydrogen peroxide 成為化學計量副產物，將 MAO 活性直接與粒線體 oxidative stress 及 redox 訊號連結。

context.en-US: Monoamine oxidase couples substrate oxidation to oxygen reduction: reduced FADH2 is reoxidized by molecular oxygen, generating hydrogen peroxide as a stoichiometric by-product of every oxidative deamination reaction. This obligatory H2O2 output is the mechanistic reason that MAO activity is counted as a direct source of mitochondrial oxidative stress, and it also explains why MAO inhibition redirects catecholamine substrate toward non-enzymatic oxidation pathways.
context.zh-TW: Monoamine oxidase 將底物氧化與氧還原偶聯：被還原的 FADH2 由分子氧再氧化，使每次氧化脫氨反應都產生化學計量的 hydrogen peroxide。這不可避免的 H2O2 輸出是 MAO 活性被視為粒線體 oxidative stress 直接來源的機轉理由，也解釋了抑制 MAO 為何會將兒茶酚胺底物轉向非酵素性氧化途徑。

context.en-US: Under normal physiology MAO and COMT cooperatively degrade epinephrine to metanephrine, vanillylmandelic acid and other inert metabolites. When MAO is inhibited, catecholamine levels rise and the substrate flux shifts toward non-enzymatic oxidation, so epinephrine cyclizes to adrenochrome - especially in oxidative environments such as smoking or inflammation - raising the risk of cardiotoxicity and neurotoxicity.
context.zh-TW: 在正常生理下，MAO 與 COMT 協同將 epinephrine 降解為 metanephrine、vanillylmandelic acid 等惰性代謝物。當 MAO 被抑制時，兒茶酚胺濃度上升、底物流向轉向非酵素性氧化，epinephrine 便環化形成 adrenochrome——在 smoking 或 inflammation 等氧化環境中尤為明顯——並提高 cardiotoxicity 與神經毒性的風險。

context.en-US: When retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors detect viral RNA they interact with MAVS, activating it to form large prion-like aggregates on the outer mitochondrial membrane. Those aggregates recruit the signaling components TRAF2, TRAF6 and RIPK1 to drive innate immune signaling and interferon production, linking mitochondria to antiviral defense.
context.zh-TW: 當 retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors 偵測到病毒 RNA 時，會與 MAVS 交互作用，活化 MAVS 使其在粒線體外膜上形成大型類普里昂聚集體。這些聚集體招募 TRAF2、TRAF6 與 RIPK1 等訊號元件以啟動先天免疫訊號與 interferon 生成，將粒線體與抗病毒防禦相連結。

context.en-US: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors (RLRs) detect unique RNA structures generated during viral infection and then activate MAVS on the outer mitochondrial membrane. MAVS acts as the signaling platform that converts that detection event into prion-like aggregate formation and downstream interferon production, making the organelle an internal sensor of external danger.
context.zh-TW: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors（RLRs）偵測病毒感染過程中產生的特殊 RNA 結構，隨後在粒線體外膜上活化 MAVS。MAVS 作為訊號平台，將此偵測事件轉換為類普里昂聚集體形成與下游 interferon 生成，使胞器成為對外來危險的內部感測器。

context.en-US: MITF is the master bHLH-Zip transcription factor of melanocyte development and pigment production, driving expression of the melanin synthesis machinery including tyrosinase, TRP1 and DCT. These enzymes convert tyrosine into dopaquinone and downstream dopachrome and 5,6-dihydroxyindole intermediates that polymerize into melanins; because melanogenesis is redox-intensive and generates ortho-quinones and ROS, MITF indirectly governs the cell's capacity to buffer oxidative stress.
context.zh-TW: MITF 是黑色素細胞發育與色素產生的關鍵 bHLH-Zip 轉錄因子，驅動 tyrosinase、TRP1 與 DCT 等黑色素合成機制基因的表現。這些酵素將 tyrosine 轉為 dopaquinone，及其下游的 dopachrome 與 5,6-dihydroxyindole 中間體，再聚合為 melanins；由於黑色素生成屬氧化還原密集且會產生鄰醌與 ROS，MITF 間接支配細胞緩衝 oxidative stress 的能力。

context.en-US: MITF belongs to the MiT/TFE transcription factor family and, under lysosomal stress, translocates to the nucleus to induce lysosomal and autophagy genes. It shares the conserved helical periodicity motif that couples lysosomal biogenesis to cellular stress adaptation, and its activity is modulated by phosphorylation from MAPK, PI3K/AKT and AMPK pathways plus nutrient-sensing inputs via mTOR and PGC-1a.
context.zh-TW: MITF 屬於 MiT/TFE 轉錄因子家族，在溶小體壓力下會轉位入核，誘導溶小體與自噬相關基因表現。它保有將 lysosome biogenesis 與細胞壓力適應相連結的保守螺旋週期性基序，其活性則受 MAPK、PI3K/AKT、AMPK 路徑的磷酸化，以及經由 mTOR 與 PGC-1α 的營養感測輸入所調節。

context.en-US: Matrix metalloproteinases are calcium-dependent, zinc-containing endopeptidases responsible for degradation and remodeling of extracellular matrix components. MMP-1 and MMP-2 act on collagen that has been stiffened and crosslinked by advanced glycation end products, and under high-AGE conditions MMP expression and activity become dysregulated, contributing to pathological remodeling and vascular complications.
context.zh-TW: Matrix Metalloproteinases 是鈣依賴性、含鋅的內肽酶，負責細胞外基質成分的降解與重塑。MMP-1 與 MMP-2 作用於已被 advanced glycation end products 硬化並交聯的 collagen；在高 AGE 條件下 MMP 的表現與活性會失調，造成病理性重塑與血管併發症。

context.en-US: Advanced glycation end products stiffen and crosslink structural proteins such as collagen, and this altered substrate then becomes the target of dysregulated matrix metalloproteinase remodeling. The AGE-collagen axis therefore links dietary and metabolic glycation to pathological extracellular matrix turnover and vascular complications of aging.
context.zh-TW: Advanced glycation End Products 會使 collagen 等結構蛋白硬化並交聯，而改變後的基質隨即成為 matrix metalloproteinase 重塑失調的目標。AGE–collagen 軸因此將飲食與代謝性醣化連結到病理性的細胞外基質周轉與老化血管併發症。

context.en-US: Mdl1 is a type I ABC exporter in the budding yeast inner mitochondrial membrane that transports 6-20 amino acid peptides generated by matrix proteases such as ClpXP and Lon out of the matrix. Loss-of-function mdl1 mutants show blunted induction of UPRmt target genes upon mitochondrial proteotoxic stress, indicating that peptide egress is an early, necessary step in relaying organelle folding status to the nucleus.
context.zh-TW: Mdl1 是出芽酵母粒線體內膜上的 type I ABC 輸出器，將由 ClpXP 與 Lon 等基質蛋白酶產生的 6–20 胺基酸胜肽運出基質。mdl1 失功能突變株在粒線體蛋白毒性壓力下呈現 UPRmt 目標基因誘導鈍化，顯示胜肽外排是將胞器摺疊狀態傳遞至細胞核的早期且必要步驟。

context.en-US: HAF-1 is the functional homolog of Mdl1 in Caenorhabditis elegans, exporting matrix-derived peptides to activate ATFS-1-dependent mitochondrial unfolded protein response signaling. Disruption of HAF-1 impairs UPRmt and shortens lifespan under mitochondrial stress, so Mdl1 and HAF-1 together define a conserved peptide-based mitokine axis transducing mitochondrial stress into nuclear adaptive responses and organismal longevity.
context.zh-TW: HAF-1 是 Caenorhabditis elegans 中 Mdl1 的功能同源物，負責輸出基質衍生的胜肽以活化 ATFS-1 依賴性的粒線體未折疊蛋白反應訊號。破壞 HAF-1 會削弱 UPRmt 並在粒線體壓力下縮短壽命，因此 Mdl1 與 HAF-1 共同界定一條保守的胜肽型 mitokine 軸，將粒線體壓力轉導為細胞核適應反應與生物體延壽。

context.en-US: Melanins arise from polymerization of the pigment intermediates dopaquinone and its downstream dopachrome and 5,6-dihydroxyindole species, which couple spontaneously to form the brown-black polymers. The same quinone-driven polymerization underlies neuromelanin deposition and adrenochrome conversion to melanin-like products, linking all three pigment routes through shared electrophilic catechol-quinone chemistry.
context.zh-TW: Melanins 由色素中間體 dopaquinone 及其下游的 dopachrome 與 5,6-dihydroxyindole 物種聚合而成，這些物種會自發偶聯形成棕黑色聚合物。同樣的醌類驅動聚合機轉 underlie 神經黑素的沉積與 adrenochrome 轉為類黑色素產物，將三條色素途徑以共享的親電性兒茶酚—醌化學連結起來。

context.en-US: Menadione (vitamin K3) is a synthetic naphthoquinone whose principal activity is redox cycling: it is one-electron reduced by NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase or mitochondrial NADH dehydrogenase to a semiquinone radical, which rapidly transfers the electron to molecular oxygen, regenerating the parent quinone while generating superoxide anion and downstream hydrogen peroxide. The result is a sustained burst of oxidative stress; at high doses menadione depletes glutathione, oxidizes thiols and triggers necrotic or apoptotic death, which is why it is no longer used clinically as a vitamin K source.
context.zh-TW: Menadione（vitamin K3）是合成萘醌，主要活性來自 redox cycling：它被 NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase 或粒線體 NADH dehydrogenase 單電子還原成半醌自由基，後者迅速將電子轉移給分子氧，在再生母體醌的同時產生 superoxide anion 與下游 hydrogen peroxide。結果是持續的 oxidative stress；高劑量下 menadione 會耗盡 glutathione、氧化硫醇並引發壞死或凋亡，因此已不再作為 vitamin K 補充品臨床使用。

context.en-US: At low subtoxic concentrations menadione acts as a mitohormetic agent: mild exposure activates the mitochondrial retrograde response and stress-resistance pathways that extend replicative lifespan in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Menadione therefore serves as an experimental probe for the redox threshold that separates toxic oxidative damage from adaptive hormesis, a usage that made it a tool in the 2014 mitohormesis work.
context.zh-TW: 在低濃度亞毒性劑量下，menadione 扮演 mitohormetic 角色：輕度暴露會活化粒線體逆行反應與抗壓路徑，在 Saccharomyces cerevisiae 中延長複製性 lifespan。Menadione 因此成為探測 toxic 氧化損傷與適應性 hormesis 之間氧化還原門檻的實驗工具，也是 2014 年 mitohormesis 研究中的方法之一。

context.en-US: In the context of catecholamine metabolism, adrenochrome is often viewed as metabolic waste or a chemical mishap that arises when the primary enzymatic pathways via MAO and COMT are overwhelmed or when antioxidant defenses fail. Under this framing adrenochrome serves as a marker of failed homeostasis rather than as a physiologically necessary metabolite.
context.zh-TW: 在兒茶酚胺代謝的脈絡下，adrenochrome 常被視為 metabolic waste 或化學意外，當經由 MAO 與 COMT 的主要酵素途徑被淹沒、或抗氧化防禦失效時便會生成。在此架構下，adrenochrome 是恆定失效的標記，而非生理上必需的代謝物。

context.en-US: COMT (catechol-O-methyltransferase) transfers a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to the 3-hydroxyl of epinephrine's catechol ring, yielding metanephrine, the O-methylated metabolite of epinephrine; normetanephrine arises analogously from norepinephrine. Metanephrine is further deaminated and oxidized to vanillylmandelic acid, the terminal urinary catecholamine metabolite, and much of it is made continuously within chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla independent of catecholamine release.
context.zh-TW: COMT（catechol-O-methyltransferase）將 S-adenosylmethionine 的甲基轉移至 epinephrine 兒茶酚環的 3-羥基，生成 epinephrine 的 O-甲基化代謝物 metanephrine；normetanephrine 則同樣由 norepinephrine 衍生。Metanephrine 進一步脫氨與氧化成為終末尿中兒茶酚胺代謝物 vanillylmandelic acid，且其相當一部分在 adrenal medulla 的 chromaffin cells 內持續生成，與兒茶酚胺釋放無關。

context.en-US: Because metanephrines are produced steadily by chromaffin tumor tissue rather than in pulses with catecholamine release, plasma-free and 24-hour urinary metanephrines are the most sensitive biochemical test for pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma. COMT genotype (Val158Met) influences the rate of catecholamine O-methylation and therefore metabolite levels.
context.zh-TW: 由於 metanephrine 由嗜鉻細胞腫瘤組織持續生成，而非隨兒茶酚胺釋放呈脈衝式分泌，血漿游离與 24 小時尿 metanephrine 是偵測 pheochromocytoma 與副神經節瘤最靈敏的生化檢測。COMT 基因型（Val158Met）會影響兒茶酚胺 O-甲基化速率，進而影響代謝物濃度。

context.en-US: Mithridatism, the practice of protecting oneself against a poison by gradually self-administering non-lethal amounts and popularized by Mithridates VI of Pontus with the Antidotum Mithridaticum, is the historical precursor to the scientific concept of hormesis. It illustrates the same underlying principle - that low-dose exposure to a stressor can induce an adaptive, protective response - which mitohormesis extends to mild mitochondrial perturbation.
context.zh-TW: Mithridatism 指透過逐步自行攝取非致死劑量來保護自己免於毒害的做法，因龐特國王 Mithridates VI 與 Antidotum Mithridaticum 而聞名，是科學上 hormesis 概念的前身。它呈現了相同的底層原理——低劑量接觸壓力源可誘發適應性保護反應——而 mitohormesis 將此原理延伸至輕度粒線體擾動。

context.en-US: The mitochondrial calcium uniporter is a highly selective pore-forming channel of the inner mitochondrial membrane, the central subunit of a holocomplex including MCUb, EMRE and the calcium-sensing gatekeepers MICU1 and MICU2. Under basal cytosolic calcium MICU1/2 keep the pore closed; when local calcium rises at endoplasmic-reticulum-mitochondria contact sites they relieve inhibition, permitting cooperative high-capacity influx that shapes cytosolic calcium transients.
context.zh-TW: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter 是粒線體內膜上高度選擇性的成孔通道，為包含 MCUb、EMRE 與鈣感受性守門者 MICU1、MICU2 的整體複合體之核心次單元。在基礎細胞質鈣濃度下 MICU1/2 使孔道關閉；當內質網—粒線體接觸處局部鈣上升時，它們解除抑制，允許協同的高容量內流，藉以塑形細胞質鈣的暫態變化。

context.en-US: Matrix calcium taken up through the uniporter is a potent allosteric activator of pyruvate, isocitrate and alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenases, coupling excitatory or hormonal signals to ATP production. Sustained overload goes the other way: it depolarizes the inner membrane, elevates mitochondrial reactive oxygen species and can open the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. The uniporter and its regulators are themselves redox-sensitive, with oxidant stress promoting S-glutathionylation and altered gating.
context.zh-TW: 經由 uniporter 進入基質的鈣是 pyruvate、isocitrate 與 alpha-ketoglutarate 去氫酶的強效別構活化劑，將興奮性或荷爾蒙訊號與 ATP 生成偶聯。但持續過載則相反：它會去極化內膜、升高粒線體 reactive oxygen species，並可開啟粒線體通透性轉變孔。Uniporter 及其調節因子本身具氧化還原敏感性，氧化壓力會促進 S-glutathionylation 與改變的閘控行為。

context.en-US: Mrps5 encodes a small subunit of the mammalian mitoribosome, whose knockdown reduces mitochondrial translation capacity and produces a mild respiratory deficiency that is sensed as proteotoxic stress. This activates the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, in which ATF5/ATFS-1 relocalizes to the nucleus and induces mitochondrial chaperones, proteases and antioxidant defenses; sublethal inhibition of Mrps5 phenocopies pharmacological translation blockers such as doxycycline and actinonin.
context.zh-TW: Mrps5 編碼哺乳類粒線體核糖體的小次單元，其敲低會降低粒線體轉譯能力，產生被感知為蛋白毒性壓力的輕度呼吸缺陷。這會活化粒線體未折疊蛋白反應：ATF5/ATFS-1 轉位入核並誘導粒線體伴護蛋白、蛋白酶與抗氧化防禦；Mrps5 的亞致死抑制可 phenocopy doxycycline 與 actinonin 等藥理學轉譯抑制劑。

context.en-US: Mrps5 belongs to a class of mitohormetic longevity genes - including cco-1, isp-1 and clk-1 - whose calibrated impairment prolongs healthspan. Because the induced UPRmt program raises chaperone, protease and antioxidant capacity, reduced mitoribosomal function yields a longevity phenotype rather than simply a defect, underscoring the dosage sensitivity of mitoribosome function also seen in human MRPS5 mitochondrial disorders.
context.zh-TW: Mrps5 屬於 mitohormetic 長壽基因一類——包括 cco-1、isp-1 與 clk-1——其經校準的損傷可延長 healthspan。由於被誘發的 UPRmt 程式提升伴護蛋白、蛋白酶與抗氧化能力，粒線體核糖體功能降低反而產生延壽表型而非單純缺陷，這也呼應人類 MRPS5 粒線體疾病所顯現的劑量敏感性。

context.en-US: Ligand-conjugated nanoparticles concentrate senotherapeutics at senescent cells by engaging senescence-associated surface markers, sparing non-target tissue; the protective function instead exploits encapsulation to shield labile cargos such as adrenochrome from metal- and oxygen-dependent autoxidation in blood and plasma. The two roles differ only in purpose, not in platform.
context.zh-TW: Ligand-conjugated nanoparticles 藉由結合與衰老相關的表面標記，將 senotherapeutics 集中於 senescent cells 並減少非標靶組織暴露；而保護性功能則利用包埋，隔絕 adrenochrome 等易降解負載物免受血液與血漿中金屬與氧依賴性的自氧化。兩種角色的差別僅在用途，而非平台本身。

context.en-US: Quorum sensing, in which bacteria release diffusible autoinducers whose concentration reports population density and coordinates collective gene expression, has been proposed as a conceptual model for mitochondrial-to-nuclear communication: stressed mitochondria release peptides or metabolites that act as retrograde signals engaging SKN-1/NRF2 and Rtg1/Rtg3. Both systems rely on a threshold-dependent signal that integrates the status of many cells or many organelles rather than acting as an all-or-none single-cell switch.
context.zh-TW: 群體感應（quorum sensing）是細菌釋放可擴散的自誘導物、其濃度反映族群密度並協調集體基因表現的細胞間通訊系統，已被提出作為粒線體-to-細胞核通訊的概念模型：受壓的粒線體釋放胜肽或代謝物作為逆行訊號，啟動 SKN-1/NRF2 與 Rtg1/Rtg3。兩者都依賴閾值依賴型訊號，該訊號整合的是多數細胞或多數胞器（而非單一細胞）的狀態，而非全有或全無的單一細胞開關。

context.en-US: Racemization of L-epinephrine to the D-isomer, promoted by heat and pH changes during storage, is a pharmaceutical stability problem: the D-isomer is significantly less biologically active, so racemization reduces the therapeutic potency of epinephrine products and is a monitored quality-control parameter.
context.zh-TW: L-型 Epinephrine 在儲存過程中受熱與 pH 變化而發生外消旋化轉為 D 型，是藥物穩定性問題：D 型異構物的生物活性顯著較低，因此外消旋化會降低 Epinephrine 製劑的治療效力，並成為受監測的品質管制參數。

context.en-US: Racemization and glycation are synergistic processes that compromise protein integrity with age. Introduction of D-amino acids disrupts α-helices and β-sheets, increases backbone flexibility, and exposes formerly buried residues to glycating agents such as Glucose and Methylglyoxal, accelerating Advanced Glycation End Products formation; conversely AGE crosslinks rigidify proteins and can alter racemization kinetics.
context.zh-TW: 外消旋化與糖化是隨老化共同損害蛋白質完整性的協同過程。D-胺基酸的引入破壞 α-螺旋與 β-摺板、增加主鏈柔性，使原本被埋藏的殘基暴露於 Glucose、Methylglyoxal 等醣化試劑，從而加速 Advanced Glycation End Products 的形成；反之，AGE 交聯使蛋白質僵硬，也可能改變外消旋化動力學。

context.en-US: Cataract — opacification of the lens — is the most thoroughly characterized pathology of racemization. Human lens γ-crystallins accumulate D-aspartic acid at defined positions (Asp-58, Asp-151) with age, and the extent of racemization correlates directly with cataract severity because D-Asp promotes protein unfolding, aggregation, and light scattering.
context.zh-TW: Cataract（水晶體混濁）是外消旋化最被充分描述的病理表現。人類水晶體 γ-crystallin 隨年齡在特定位置（Asp-58、Asp-151）累積 D-天門冬胺酸，且外消旋化程度與白內障嚴重度直接相關，因 D-Asp 促進蛋白質解摺、聚集與光散射。

context.en-US: Tel1p, the yeast ortholog of human ATM, is the upstream kinase that phosphorylates and activates Rad53p. Tel1p responds to DNA double-strand breaks and telomere dysfunction in the canonical checkpoint pathway, and in a non-canonical context it senses mitochondrial reactive oxygen species and relays the signal to Rad53p, so the same Tel1p/Rad53p module serves both DNA damage control and mitohormetic adaptation.
context.zh-TW: Tel1p（人類 ATM 的酵母直系同源物）是磷酸化並活化 Rad53p 的上游激酶。Tel1p 在典型檢查點路徑中回應 DNA 雙股斷裂與端粒功能異常；在非典型情境中它感知粒線體活性氧並將訊號傳給 Rad53p，因此同一 Tel1p/Rad53p 模組同時服務於 DNA 損傷防禦與線粒體 hormesis 適應。

context.en-US: Rad53p is a serine/threonine protein kinase of Saccharomyces cerevisiae and the functional homolog of human CHK2. It is the central checkpoint kinase of the DNA damage response, coordinating cell cycle arrest, transcriptional induction of repair genes, and replication fork stabilization upon genotoxic stress.
context.zh-TW: Rad53p 是 *Saccharomyces cerevisiae* 的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，為人類 CHK2 的功能性同源物。它是 DNA 損傷反應的中樞檢查點激酶，在基因毒性壓力下協調細胞週期停滯、修復基因的轉錄誘導以及複製叉穩定化。

context.en-US: Rad53p is a required mediator of mitohormetic longevity in yeast. Mild mitochondrial dysfunction (deletion of clk-1 or cco-1) elevates mitochondrial ROS, activating Tel1p/Rad53p and driving reduced H3K4me3 and increased H4K16ac; deletion of RAD53 or TEL1 abolishes both these epigenetic changes and the resulting lifespan extension.
context.zh-TW: Rad53p 是酵母菌中線粒體 hormesis 性延壽的必要媒介。輕度粒線體功能障礙（clk-1 或 cco-1 缺失）升高粒線體活性氧，啟動 Tel1p/Rad53p 並造成 H3K4me3 下降與 H4K16ac 上升；刪除 RAD53 或 TEL1 會同時消除這些表觀遺傳變化與隨後的壽命延長。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial dysfunction — loss of respiratory complex subunits or cofactors — elevates superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production at complexes III and I. The resulting ROS are sensed by a Tel1p-dependent signaling module that phosphorylates Rad53p, which then translocates to the nucleus and interfaces with chromatin-modifying complexes, illustrating how a core DNA damage signaling module is co-opted as a redox-responsive longevity regulator.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體功能障礙——呼吸鏈次單元或輔因子的喪失——會在複合體 III 與 I 處升高超氧陰離子與過氧化氫的生成。由此產生的活性氧被 Tel1p 相依的訊號模組感知並磷酸化 Rad53p，後者轉位至細胞核與染色質修飾複合體作用，說明核心 DNA 損傷訊號模組如何被徵用為氧化還原反應性的延壽調控者。

context.en-US: Rasburicase, a recombinant PEGylated urate oxidase, is a recognized cause of acquired methemoglobinemia. Catalysis of uric acid to allantoin generates hydrogen peroxide as a byproduct; in erythrocytes that peroxide oxidizes Hemoglobin's ferrous (Fe²⁺) heme iron to ferric (Fe³⁺) Methemoglobin, impairing oxygen carriage.
context.zh-TW: Rasburicase 是重組 PEG 化尿酸氧化酶，是後天性 Methemoglobinemia 的公認病因。其催化尿酸生成 allantoin 的過程會產生過氧化氫副產物；在紅血球中，該過氧化物將 Hemoglobin 的二價（Fe²⁺）血基質鐵氧化為三價（Fe³⁺）Methemoglobin，損害氧的運送。

context.en-US: The peroxide byproduct of rasburicase-catalyzed urate oxidation acts on Hemoglobin in erythrocytes, oxidizing the heme iron from ferrous to ferric state. The same peroxide-mediated oxidative stress that converts hemoglobin to methemoglobin also drives catecholamine autoxidation, converting Epinephrine into Adrenochrome under oxidative challenge — a microcosm of the heme-versus-catechol redox coupling central to adrenochrome research.
context.zh-TW: Rasburicase 催化尿酸氧化所產生的過氧化物副產物作用於紅血球中的 Hemoglobin，將血基質鐵由二價氧化為三價。同一種過氧化物媒介的氧化壓力既使血紅素轉為 methemoglobin，也驅動兒茶酚胺自氧化，在氧化挑戰下將 Epinephrine 轉為 Adrenochrome——正是 adrenochrome 研究核心的血基質與兒茶酚氧化還原耦合的縮影。

context.en-US: Patients with G6PD deficiency cannot adequately regenerate reduced Glutathione to detoxify the peroxides generated by rasburicase, so they are at markedly increased risk of rasburicase-induced Methemoglobinemia and Hemolysis. Rasburicase is therefore contraindicated in G6PD-deficient individuals, and alternatives such as febuxostat or allopurinol are preferred.
context.zh-TW: G6PD 缺乏患者無法充分再生還原型 Glutathione 以解毒 rasburicase 產生的過氧化物，因此對 rasburicase 所致的 Methemoglobinemia 與 Hemolysis 的易感性顯著升高。故 G6PD 缺乏者禁用 rasburicase，並優先改用 febuxostat 或 allopurinol 等替代藥物。

context.en-US: The Redox Battery is a conceptual construct in the adrenochrome handling protocol representing the reservable store of cellular reducing equivalents that absorbs the oxidative load generated during catecholamine autoxidation. Adrenochrome and its quinone derivatives (Aminochrome, o-quinone) discharge the battery by draining electrons through redox cycling; a collapsed battery converts transient oxidation into persistent oxidative damage, protein alkylation, NLRP3 Inflammasome activation, and Senescence.
context.zh-TW: Redox Battery 是 Adrenochrome 處理.protocol 中的概念性建構，代表細胞還原等量物的儲備池，用以吸收兒茶酚胺自氧化產生的氧化負荷。Adrenochrome 及其醌衍生物（Aminochrome、o-quinone）透過氧化還原循環抽走電子而「放電」；電池崩潰會把短暫的氧化轉為持續性氧化損傷、蛋白質烷基化、NLRP3 Inflammasome 活化與 Senescence。

context.en-US: The two principal 'cells' of the Redox Battery are the NAD+/NADH and Glutathione (GSH/GSSG) couples. Sustained adrenochrome flux oxidizes GSH to GSSG and shifts NAD+/NADH toward NAD+, depleting the reserve; the GSH/GSSG thiol couple provides the battery's rapid-response capacity against electrophilic aminochromes.
context.zh-TW: Redox Battery 的兩個主要「電池芯」是 NAD+/NADH 與 Glutathione（GSH/GSSG）偶對。持續的 adrenochrome 通量會將 GSH 氧化為 GSSG 並使 NAD+/NADH 偏向 NAD+，耗盡儲備；GSH/GSSG 硫醇偶對提供電池對親電子性 aminochrome 的快速反應容量。

context.en-US: NAD+ is the primary reducing-equivalent couple of the Redox Battery. Recharge of the battery depends on NADPH-generating metabolism and precursor availability (e.g., Nicotinamide), so protocol design monitors battery state and replenishes NAD+/NADH capacity in step with the adrenochrome load it must absorb.
context.zh-TW: NAD+ 是 Redox Battery 的主要還原等量物偶對。電池的「充電」仰賴 NADPH 生成的代謝與前驅物供應（例如 Nicotinamide），因此 protocol 設計會監測電池狀態，並依其必須吸收的 adrenochrome 負荷同步補充 NAD+/NADH 容量。

context.en-US: Redox Optimization is the active maintenance side of the Redox Battery concept: the deliberate upkeep of cellular reducing potential while processing redox-active indolequinones. It targets the NAD+/NADH and Glutathione (GSH/GSSG) buffering capacity, monitoring the GSH/GSSG ratio and NAD+/NADH balance and adjusting them as catecholamine load and quinone flux change, keeping the reservable reducing-equivalent reserve charged.
context.zh-TW: Redox Optimization 是 Redox Battery 概念中「維持」的一面：在處理氧化還原活性 indolequinone 時主動維持細胞還原勢能。它以 NAD+/NADH 與 Glutathione（GSH/GSSG）的緩衝容量為目標，依兒茶酚胺負荷與醌通量的變化監測 GSH/GSSG 比值與 NAD+/NADH 平衡，使可儲備的還原等量物儲備維持在「充電」狀態。

context.en-US: By keeping cytosolic and mitochondrial compartments sufficiently reduced to neutralize the electrophilic and ROS-generating species produced as Adrenochrome autoxidizes to Aminochrome, Redox Optimization limits aminochrome accumulation and protein carbonylation. Effective optimization suppresses the downstream NF-κB and NLRP3 Inflammasome activation that would otherwise drive Senescence and inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Redox Optimization 藉由讓細胞質與粒線體區室維持足夠的還原狀態，以中和 Adrenochrome 自氧化為 Aminochrome 時產生的親電子性與產 ROS 物種，進而限制 aminochrome 累積與蛋白質羰基化。有效的優化會抑制下游的 NF-κB 與 NLRP3 Inflammasome 活化，避免其推動 Senescence 與 inflammation。

context.en-US: Nicotinamide is used as an NAD+ precursor within the adrenochrome protocol. Because Adrenochrome's semiquinone and quinone forms redox-cycle and drain reducing equivalents, NAD+ precursor supplementation is combined with GSH-supporting thiol donors so the NAD+/NADH couple stays biased toward NADH and aminochrome electrophiles can be neutralized.
context.zh-TW: Nicotinamide 在 adrenochrome protocol 中作為 NAD+ 前驅物使用。由於 Adrenochrome 的半醌與醌型態會進行氧化還原循環並抽走還原等量物，因此 NAD+ 前驅物補充會與支持 GSH 的硫醇供體併用，使 NAD+/NADH 偶對維持偏向 NADH，並使 aminochrome 的親電子性物種被中和。

context.en-US: Adrenochrome and its immediate precursor Leuco-adrenochrome serve as reference standards in HPLC and LC-MS assays used to identify and quantify impurities in pharmaceutical Epinephrine products. Their well-established, homogeneous chromatographic and mass-spectral properties make them usable for calibration and for assigning values in epinephrine quality control.
context.zh-TW: Adrenochrome 及其直接前驅物 Leuco-adrenochrome 被用作 HPLC 與 LC-MS 分析的對照標準品，用於鑑定與定量藥用 Epinephrine 產品中的雜質。兩者性質均一且層析與質譜行為確立，因此可用於校正並為 Epinephrine 品質管制數值定值。

context.en-US: When RLRs (RIG-I, MDA5, LGP2) engage viral RNA, their exposed CARD domains interact with MAVS (VISA/IPS-1), the mitochondrial outer-membrane adaptor, nucleating a prion-like MAVS filament that recruits TRAF6 and TRAF2 as well as TBK1/IKKε and the IKK complex. Anchoring MAVS to mitochondria places innate immune sensing at the organelle central to energy and Oxidative Stress homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: 當 RLR（RIG-I、MDA5、LGP2）結合病毒 RNA 後，其暴露的 CARD 區域會與粒線體外膜轉接蛋白 MAVS（VISA/IPS-1）作用，形成類普恩蛋白的 MAVS 纖維並招募 TRAF6、TRAF2 以及 TBK1/IKKε 與 IKK 複合體。MAVS 錨定於粒線體，使先天免疫感知落在能量與 Oxidative Stress 恆定的核心胞器上。

context.en-US: RLR signaling bifurcates after MAVS filament formation: IRF3/IRF7 activation drives type-I interferon production while NF-κB activation drives pro-inflammatory cytokines. Viral infection and the ensuing interferon/cytokine storm amplify oxidative burden, with activated immune cells generating ROS, Nitric Oxide, and peroxynitrite that accelerate catecholamine autoxidation.
context.zh-TW: MAVS 纖維形成後 RLR 訊號分岔：IRF3/IRF7 活化驅動第一型干擾素的產生，而 NF-κB 活化則驅動促發炎細胞激素。病毒感染及其後的干擾素／細胞激素風暴會放大氧化負荷，活化的免疫細胞產生 ROS、Nitric Oxide 與過氧亞硝酸鹽，加速兒茶酚胺自氧化。

context.en-US: Retinoid X receptor α (RXRA, NR2B1) is a key effector of the mammalian Retrograde Response. Mitochondrial stress — electron transport chain impairment, Mitochondrial ROS accumulation, loss of membrane potential — converges on RXRα via calcium-dependent calcineurin, which dephosphorylates and activates the receptor, promoting nuclear translocation and transcription of metabolic adaptation, antioxidant defense, Mitochondrial Biogenesis, and Mitochondrial Dynamics genes.
context.zh-TW: Retinoid X receptor α（RXRA、NR2B1）是哺乳類 Retrograde Response 的關鍵效應者。粒線體壓力——電子傳遞鏈受損、Mitochondrial ROS 累積、膜電位喪失——經由鈣離子依賴的 calcineurin 匯聚於 RXRα；calcineurin 使其去磷酸化並活化，促進核轉位與代謝適應、抗氧化防禦、Mitochondrial Biogenesis 與 Mitochondrial Dynamics 等基因的轉錄。

context.en-US: Retinoid X receptor α acts in obligate heterodimers with a wide array of nuclear receptors, which is how it integrates hormonal, nutritional, and metabolic signals. In the mitochondrial stress arm it partners with PGC-1α to drive antioxidant defense and mitochondrial biogenesis programs, while obligate permissive heterodimers with PPAR family members regulate lipid and glucose metabolism.
context.zh-TW: Retinoid X receptor α 與多種核受體形成必然性異二聚體，藉此整合荷爾蒙、營養與代謝訊號。在粒線體壓力這一支，它與 PGC-1α 配對以驅動抗氧化防禦與粒線體生物合成程式；而與 PPAR 家族成員形成的必然型 permissive 異二聚體則調節脂質與葡萄糖代謝。

context.en-US: Retrograde signaling is a key mediator of Mitohormesis, the phenomenon whereby mild mitochondrial stress extends lifespan and enhances stress resistance. Interventions that activate mitochondrial stress responses in a controlled manner — mild respiratory chain inhibition, NAD+ precursors such as Nicotinamide Riboside and Nicotinamide Mononucleotide, or Metformin, Rapamycin, and Urolithin A — all engage retrograde and UPRmt components, with benefit requiring an optimal activation window between insufficient and excessive activation.
context.zh-TW: 逆行訊號傳遞是 Mitohormesis 的關鍵媒介，即輕度粒線體壓力可延長壽命並提升抗壓能力。以受控方式活化粒線體壓力反應的介入手段——輕度呼吸鏈抑制、NAD+ 前驅物如 Nicotinamide Riboside 與 Nicotinamide Mononucleotide，或 Metformin、Rapamycin、Urolithin A——皆會徵用逆行與 UPRmt 的組成元件，其效益需要介於活化不足與過度活化之間的最佳活化窗。

context.en-US: The Retrograde Response overlaps functionally with the Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response (UPRmt). In C. elegans, mitochondrial proteotoxic stress activates ATFS-1, which imports into mitochondria under normal conditions but accumulates in the nucleus upon import impairment; in mammals ATF5 is the closest functional analog. The two programs share transcription factors and overlapping target gene sets (mitochondrial chaperones and proteases).
context.zh-TW: Retrograde Response 與 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response（UPRmt）在功能上重疊。在 *C. elegans* 中，粒線體蛋白毒性壓力活化 ATFS-1，該因子在正常情況下輸入粒線體，但在輸入受阻時累積於細胞核；在哺乳類中 ATF5 是最接近的功能類比物。兩套程式共用轉錄因子與重疊的標的基因集（粒線體伴護蛋白與蛋白酶）。

context.en-US: Rtg1 is a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor of S. cerevisiae and, with its bHLH/leucine-zipper partner Rtg3, forms the DNA-binding engine of the yeast Retrograde Response. Under basal conditions the heterodimer is phosphorylated and sequestered in the cytoplasm by 14-3-3 proteins Bmh1/2 and the inhibitory protein Mks1p; mitochondrial dysfunction releases the retention signal so the dimer enters the nucleus and drives citrate–isocitrate shuttle genes (CIT2, ACO1, IDH1/2).
context.zh-TW: Rtg1 是 *S. cerevisiae* 的 basic helix-loop-helix 轉錄因子，與其 bHLH／leucine-zipper 搭檔 Rtg3 共同構成酵母 Retrograde Response 的 DNA 結合引擎。在基礎狀態下，該異二聚體被磷酸化並由 14-3-3 蛋白 Bmh1/2 與抑制蛋白 Mks1p 扣留在細胞質；粒線體功能障礙會解除滞留訊號，使二聚體進入細胞核並啟動檸檬酸－異檸檬酸穿梭基因（CIT2、ACO1、IDH1/2）。

context.en-US: Rtg1 forms a heterodimer with Rtg3; the bHLH/leucine-zipper dimer is the DNA-binding engine of the retrograde (RTG) response in S. cerevisiae, binding R-box sequences in target promoters after nuclear translocation. The shared logic — a mitonuclear retrograde signal reprogramming nuclear transcription toward stress resistance and metabolic flexibility — is conserved from yeast to mammals.
context.zh-TW: Rtg1 與 Rtg3 形成異二聚體；此 bHLH／leucine-zipper 二聚體是 *S. cerevisiae* 逆行（RTG）反應的 DNA 結合引擎，在核轉位後結合標的啟動子上的 R-box 序列。其共享邏輯——將核轉錄重新編程以朝向抗壓與代謝彈性的粒線體至細胞核逆行訊號——從酵母到哺乳類皆保守。

context.en-US: Rtg3 carries the bHLH/ZIP DNA-binding domain and, together with Rtg1, drives the Retrograde Response in S. cerevisiae. In healthy cells it is phosphorylated via the Mks1–Ptc1 axis and held in the cytoplasm bound to 14-3-3 proteins; when mitochondrial respiration is impaired the retention signal is lost and the Rtg1–Rtg3 heterodimer enters the nucleus to activate nuclear-encoded genes, prominently the citrate–isocitrate shuttle enzymes CIT2, ACO1, and IDH1/IDH2.
context.zh-TW: Rtg3 帶有 bHLH/ZIP DNA 結合區域，並與 Rtg1 一起驅動 *S. cerevisiae* 的 Retrograde Response。在健康細胞中它經由 Mks1–Ptc1 軸被磷酸化，並與 14-3-3 蛋白結合而留在細胞質；當粒線體呼吸受損時滞留訊號喪失，Rtg1–Rtg3 異二聚體進入細胞核，活化核編碼基因，尤以檸檬酸－異檸檬酸穿梭酵素 CIT2、ACO1 與 IDH1/IDH2 為主。

context.en-US: The Rtg3-driven program sustains citrate flux and α-ketoglutarate/glutathione precursor supply, which supports cellular antioxidant capacity and thereby buffers the Oxidative Stress that otherwise drives catecholamine autoxidation — the conversion of Epinephrine to Adrenochrome. Rtg3 thus illustrates how a mitonuclear redox signal can be co-opted for cytoprotection.
context.zh-TW: Rtg3 驅動的程式維持檸檬酸通量與 α-ketoglutarate／glutathione 前驅物供應，支持細胞抗氧化能力，因而緩衝原本會驅動兒茶酚胺自氧化（Epinephrine 轉為 Adrenochrome）的 Oxidative Stress。Rtg3 因此說明粒線體至細胞核的氧化還原訊號如何被徵用於細胞保護。

context.en-US: The Rossmann fold is a highly conserved structural motif found in many nucleotide-binding proteins, particularly those that bind NAD+/NADH. In the sirtuin family this large domain is the primary binding site for the NAD+ cofactor required for enzymatic activity.
context.zh-TW: Rossmann fold 是許多核苷酸結合蛋白中高度保守的結構模體，特別常見於結合 NAD+/NADH 的蛋白。在 sirtuin 家族中，這一大型結構域是酵素活性所需 NAD+ 輔因子的主要結合位。

context.en-US: The Rossmann fold is the conserved structural motif that provides the primary binding site for NAD+/NADH in sirtuins. Because sirtuin enzymatic activity requires the NAD+ cofactor, the Rossmann fold is the structural determinant linking sirtuin catalysis to cellular NAD+ availability and thus to redox state.
context.zh-TW: Rossmann fold 是 sirtuin 中提供 NAD+/NADH 主要結合位的高度保守結構模體。由於 sirtuin 的酵素活性需要 NAD+ 輔因子，Rossmann fold 便是將 sirtuin 催化與細胞 NAD+ 可用性、進而是與氧化還原狀態連結起來的結構決定因子。

context.en-US: S-D-lactoylglutathione is the intermediate metabolite of the Glyoxalase System. It is synthesized by GLO1 (glyoxalase I) from the hemithioacetal adduct formed by the spontaneous reaction of the dicarbonyl Methylglyoxal with Glutathione, positioning the glyoxalase pathway as the principal route for detoxifying methylglyoxal.
context.zh-TW: S-D-lactoylglutathione 是 Glyoxalase System 的中間代謝物。它由 GLO1（glyoxalase I）自二羰基 Methylglyoxal 與 Glutathione 自發反應所形成的半硫縮醛加合物合成，使 glyoxalase 路徑成為解毒 methylglyoxal 的主要途徑。

context.en-US: S-D-lactoylglutathione sits at the center of the Glyoxalase System: GLO1 forms it from the Methylglyoxal–Glutathione hemithioacetal, and GLO2 hydrolyzes it to release D-lactate while regenerating Glutathione. Regeneration of the glutathione pool is what lets the pathway recycle reductant continuously while methylglyoxal is being detoxified.
context.zh-TW: S-D-lactoylglutathione 位於 Glyoxalase System 的核心：GLO1 將 Methylglyoxal 與 Glutathione 的半硫縮醛轉為它，GLO2 則將其水解釋出 D-lactate 並再生 Glutathione。正是 Glutathione 的再生讓此路徑在解毒 methylglyoxal 的同時能持續回收還原力。

context.en-US: GLO2 (glyoxalase II) hydrolyzes S-D-lactoylglutathione to yield D-lactate and regenerate Glutathione. The D-lactate product is the benign endpoint of methylglyoxal detoxification, and the regenerated Glutathione re-enters the Glyoxalase System as the nucleophile for the next round of hemithioacetal formation.
context.zh-TW: GLO2（glyoxalase II）水解 S-D-lactoylglutathione，產生 D-lactate 並再生 Glutathione。D-lactate 是 methylglyoxal  detox 的良性終點，而再生的 Glutathione 會重新進入 Glyoxalase System，作為下一輪半硫縮醛形成的親核試劑。

context.en-US: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (baker's yeast) is the preeminent eukaryotic model organism for dissecting aging, metabolism, and redox homeostasis. Its short replicative lifespan is highly tractable genetically, and conserved longevity pathways first mapped in yeast — TOR/Sch9, Sir2, AMPK/Snf1, and the mitochondrial Retrograde Response — translate directly to mammalian biology.
context.zh-TW: *Saccharomyces cerevisiae*（烘焙酵母）是剖析老化、代謝與氧化還原恆定的首選真核 Model Organisms。其短複製壽命在遺傳上高度可操作，而在酵母首先被繪製的保守延壽路徑——TOR/Sch9、Sir2、AMPK/Snf1 以及粒線體 Retrograde Response——可直接轉譯到哺乳類生物學。

context.en-US: The Rtg1/Rtg3 retrograde response was originally characterized in S. cerevisiae, where mitochondrial dysfunction triggers nuclear translocation of the transcription factor heterodimer, allowing the cell to sense mitochondrial compromise and reconfigure metabolism (TCA anaplerosis, glutamate synthesis, glycolytic ATP). Yeast RTG activation is required for the lifespan-extending effects of mild mitochondrial dysfunction and dietary restriction.
context.zh-TW: Rtg1/Rtg3 逆行反應最初是在 *S. cerevisiae* 中被描述的：粒線體功能障礙會觸發轉錄因子異二聚體的核轉位，使細胞得以感知粒線體受損並重新配置代謝（TCA 補充反應、glutamate 合成、糖解 ATP）。酵母 RTG 的活化是輕度粒線體功能障礙與飲食限制之延壽效果所必需。

context.en-US: Yeast sirtuins (Sir2 and the Hst family) couple NAD+ availability to chromatin silencing and stress resistance, anchoring the Sirtuins field, and sirtuin biology was traced from yeast Sir2 to mammals. Together with TOR and retrograde signaling, sirtuin function was first linked to longevity in yeast before mammalian validation.
context.zh-TW: 酵母 sirtuin（Sir2 與 Hst 家族）將 NAD+ 可用性與染色質靜默及抗壓能力相耦聯，奠定了 Sirtuins 領域，而 sirtuin 生物學正是從酵母 Sir2 追溯至哺乳類。與 TOR 及逆行訊號一起，sirtuin 的功能最早在酵母中被連結到延壽，其後才在哺乳類獲得驗證。

context.en-US: SKN-1 is the Caenorhabditis elegans ortholog of mammalian NRF2, a cap'n'collar basic leucine zipper transcription factor governing the conserved antioxidant and detoxification response. Under basal conditions SKN-1 is retained in the cytoplasm by the BTB–Kelch repressor WDR-23, the homolog of Keap1; upon oxidative or electrophilic insult the repressor is inactivated and SKN-1 translocates to the nucleus.
context.zh-TW: SKN-1 是哺乳類 NRF2 在 *Caenorhabditis elegans* 的直系同源物，屬於 cap'n'collar 型基本白胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，調控保守的抗氧化與解毒反應。在基礎狀態下 SKN-1 受 BTB–Kelch 抑制蛋白 WDR-23（Keap1 的同源物）扣留於細胞質；遭遇氧化或親電性攻擊時抑制蛋白失活，SKN-1 轉位至細胞核。

context.en-US: Keap1's homolog WDR-23 restrains SKN-1 by tethering it in the cytoplasm under basal conditions. Oxidative or electrophilic stress inactivates the BTB–Kelch repressor, releasing SKN-1 so it can accumulate in the nucleus and induce phase-II enzymes, xenobiotic transporters, and proteostasis genes.
context.zh-TW: Keap1 的同源物 WDR-23 在基礎狀態下將 SKN-1 繫留於細胞質而抑制它。氧化或親電性壓力使 BTB–Kelch 抑制蛋白失活，釋放 SKN-1 使其得以在細胞核累積，並誘導第二期解毒酵素、異生物轉運蛋白與蛋白質恆定基因。

context.en-US: SKN-1 is a central node in the Mitohormesis framework: mild mitochondrial dysfunction or low-level Oxidative Stress, including the modest Superoxide anion leak from compromised respiration, activates SKN-1 and drives a cytoprotective transcriptional program. Genetic studies show SKN-1 activity is required for the longevity conferred by mitochondrial mutants (isp-1, clk-1) and by dietary restriction.
context.zh-TW: SKN-1 是 Mitohormesis 框架的中樞節點：輕度粒線體功能障礙或低度 Oxidative Stress（包括受損呼吸所洩漏的少量 Superoxide anion）會活化 SKN-1，驅動細胞保護性的轉錄程式。遺傳研究顯示，SKN-1 活性是粒線體突變株（isp-1、clk-1）與飲食限制所賦予延壽所必需的。

context.en-US: SKN-1/NRF2 target genes include glutathione biosynthesis, glutathione-dependent reductases, and quinone reductases. By boosting the cellular reducing environment and electrophile-detoxifying capacity, the SKN-1 program buffers precisely the oxidative load that drives aminochrome formation, making it a key endogenous defense against Adrenochrome accumulation.
context.zh-TW: SKN-1/NRF2 的標的基因包括 glutathione 生合成、glutathione 依賴的還原酶與醌還原酶。透過提升細胞還原環境與親電子性解毒能力，SKN-1 程式緩衝的正是驅動 aminochrome 形成的氧化負荷，使其成為對抗 Adrenochrome 累積的關鍵內源性防禦。

context.en-US: Sarcopenia, the progressive and generalized loss of skeletal muscle mass and strength, is a serious problem among older populations and is associated with increased Oxidative Stress and Inflammation. It may be exacerbated by the accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products in muscle tissue, linking it to dietary and endogenous AGE exposure.
context.zh-TW: Sarcopenia（骨骼肌量與肌力逐漸普遍性的流失）是老年族群中的嚴重問題，並與升高的 Oxidative Stress 及 Inflammation 相關；肌肉組織中 Advanced Glycation End Products 的累積可能使其惡化，將它與飲食性及內源性 AGE 暴露連結起來。

context.en-US: A Schiff base is an unstable chemical adduct produced in the initial stage of the Maillard Reaction, when a free amino group of a protein, lipid, or DNA nucleophilically attacks the reactive carbonyl group of a reducing sugar such as Glucose. The adduct is highly reversible and quickly rearranges to the more stable Amadori product.
context.zh-TW: Schiff base 是在 Maillard Reaction 初始階段產生的不穩定化學加合物，由蛋白質、脂質或 DNA 的游離胺基對還原糖（如 Glucose）的反應性羰基進行親核攻擊而形成。該加合物高度可逆，並迅速重排為較穩定的 Amadori product。

context.en-US: Because the Schiff base is highly reversible, it quickly undergoes the Amadori rearrangement to form the more stable Amadori product, the committed step of the non-enzymatic glycation cascade that ultimately yields Advanced Glycation End Products.
context.zh-TW: 由於 Schiff base 高度可逆，它會迅速進行 Amadori 重排，形成較穩定的 Amadori product——這是非酵素性糖化級聯反應中邁向 Advanced Glycation End Products 的關鍵步驟。

context.en-US: The Seahorse XF Analyzer is a specialized instrument that simultaneously monitors Oxygen Consumption Rate and Extracellular Acidification Rate in real time, resolving the two major energy-producing pathways of the cell — mitochondrial respiration and glycolysis. This makes it the standard tool for flux-resolving assays of mitochondrial function and redox-handling capacity.
context.zh-TW: Seahorse XF Analyzer 是一種專業儀器，可即時同時監測 Oxygen Consumption Rate 與 Extracellular Acidification Rate，用以區分細胞的兩大產能途徑——粒線體呼吸與糖解。這使它成為解析粒線體功能與氧化還原處理能力之通量分析的標準工具。

context.en-US: Extracellular Acidification Rate is one of the two readouts the Seahorse XF Analyzer collects simultaneously with Oxygen Consumption Rate; taken together, the paired measurements separate mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation from glycolytic ATP production in the same live-cell sample.
context.zh-TW: Extracellular Acidification Rate 是 Seahorse XF Analyzer 與 Oxygen Consumption Rate 同時收集的兩項讀值之一；兩者配對量測可在同一活細胞樣本中區分粒線體氧化磷酸化與糖解產生的 ATP。

context.en-US: Adrenochrome is very unstable owing to its o-quinone structure and is conventionally stabilized by derivatization with hydrazines such as aminoguanidine, phenylhydrazine, and Semicarbazide. Semicarbazide condenses with the reactive o-quinone to give a more stable, isolable adduct, which is the principle behind the classical adrenochrome stabilization chemistry.
context.zh-TW: Adrenochrome 因其 o-quinone 結構而非常不穩定，傳統上以 hydrazine 類試劑（如 aminoguanidine、phenylhydrazine 與 Semicarbazide）衍生化來穩定。Semicarbazide 與反應性 o-quinone 縮合形成較穩定、可分離的加合物，這正是經典 adrenochrome 穩定化化學的原理。

context.en-US: Semicarbazide reacts with the o-quinone structure of Adrenochrome to form Carbazochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone). The semicarbazone adduct is markedly more stable than the parent quinone, and carbazochrome has medical applications as a hemostatic agent.
context.zh-TW: Semicarbazide 與 Adrenochrome 的 o-quinone 結構反應生成 Carbazochrome（adrenochrome monosemicarbazone）。此 semicarbazone 加合物比母體醌顯著穩定，而 carbazochrome 在醫學上具有止血劑的應用。

context.en-US: Carbazochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone), the adduct of Semicarbazide with the o-quinone of Adrenochrome, is used as a hemostatic. Its stability is what makes the otherwise labile adrenochrome pharmacologically useful, converting a transient quinone into a compound that can be dosed to promote hemostasis.
context.zh-TW: Carbazochrome（adrenochrome monosemicarbazone）是 Semicarbazide 與 Adrenochrome 的 o-quinone 所形成的加合物，被用作止血劑。正是它的穩定性使原本不穩定的 adrenochrome 具有藥理用途，把短暫存在的醌轉成可給藥以促進止血的化合物。

context.en-US: Serum is the most widely used sample type in clinical laboratory medicine, chosen over plasma for chemistry panels because it is prepared simply by allowing blood to clot and centrifuging. Key analytes include Glucose (fasting, postprandial, HbA1c) for diagnosing Diabetes Mellitus, Creatinine and urea for renal function, and transaminases for hepatocellular injury.
context.zh-TW: Serum 是臨床實驗醫學中最常用的樣本類型，因為製備簡單——只需讓血液凝固後離心——故在化學檢驗套組中優於血漿。主要檢測包括用於診斷 Diabetes Mellitus 的 Glucose（空腹、餐後、HbA1c）、評估腎功能的 Creatinine 與尿素，以及評估肝細胞損傷的轉氨酶。

context.en-US: Serum is preferred for serological assays, and acute-phase reactants such as C-reactive protein measured in serum are the standard laboratory marker of Inflammation. Serum complement components also support complement-based diagnostics, while serum is generally chosen over plasma for these tests even though clotting time can alter labile analytes such as cytokines.
context.zh-TW: Serum 適合用於血清學檢驗，而以 serum 測量的急性期反應物（如 C-reactive protein）是 Inflammation 的標準實驗室標記。Serum 中的補體成分也支援補體相關診斷；儘管凝固時間可能改變 cytokines 等不穩定分析物，這類檢驗一般仍選擇 serum 而非血漿。

context.en-US: Silver(I) oxide (Ag2O) is a mild oxidizing reagent used in preparative adrenochrome chemistry. It mediates oxidation of the catechol (dihydroxybenzene) moiety of Epinephrine through leuco-adrenochrome to the corresponding ortho-quinone, providing controlled, acid-free oxidation stoichiometry that avoids the strong-acid conditions which can degrade sensitive quinone products.
context.zh-TW: Silver(I) oxide（Ag2O）是製備性 adrenochrome 化學中使用的溫和氧化試劑。它媒介 Epinephrine 的兒茶酚（dihydroxybenzene）部分經 leuco-adrenochrome 氧化為相應的 ortho-quinone，提供受控且不含酸的氧化計量，避免會降解敏感醌產物的強酸條件。

context.en-US: Ag2O is the oxidant that yields Adrenochrome from Epinephrine (adrenaline), the parent catecholamine: epinephrine is oxidized through leuco-adrenochrome to adrenochrome. It is principally a synthetic/analytical tool rather than a physiological agent and is not implicated in endogenous adrenochrome formation, which proceeds via enzymatic and metal-catalyzed autoxidation.
context.zh-TW: Ag2O 是由 Epinephrine（adrenaline）這對母體兒茶酚胺製得 Adrenochrome 的氧化劑：epinephrine 經 leuco-adrenochrome 氧化為 adrenochrome。它主要是合成／分析工具而非生理作用劑，也未被認為參與內源性 adrenochrome 的形成——後者經由酵素與金屬催化的自氧化途徑進行。

context.en-US: Smoking, including cigarettes, cigars, and wood smoke, is a major exogenous source of Oxidative Stress. Tobacco smoke carries roughly 10^17 free radical molecules per puff, and smoking additionally depletes antioxidant defenses such as vitamin C and Glutathione, leaving Reactive Oxygen Species unneutralized. Wood and campfire smoke, rich in particulates and reactive compounds, induces systemic Inflammation with the same biochemical consequences.
context.zh-TW: Smoking（包含香菸、雪茄與木柴煙）是 Oxidative Stress 的主要外源性來源。菸霧每 puff 約含 10^17 個自由基分子，吸菸並會耗竭維生素 C 與 Glutathione 等抗氧化防禦，使 Reactive Oxygen Species 無法被中和。木柴與營火煙富含微粒與反應性化合物，會誘發全身性 Inflammation，造成相同的生化後果。

context.en-US: Smoking promotes Adrenochrome formation through several convergent mechanisms: exogenous ROS in smoke directly oxidize Epinephrine; nicotine and the stress of smoking trigger adrenal release of adrenaline, supplying more substrate for oxidation; and antioxidant depletion prevents the cell from clearing the oxidant load. Adrenochrome production is therefore significantly increased by smoking.
context.zh-TW: Smoking 透過幾個協同機制促進 Adrenochrome 形成：煙中的外源性 ROS 直接氧化 Epinephrine；nicotine 與吸菸帶來的壓力觸發腎上腺釋放 adrenaline，提供更多可被氧化的受質；抗氧化能力耗竭則使細胞無法清除氧化負荷。因此吸菸會顯著增加 Adrenochrome 的生成。

context.en-US: Nicotine and the physiological stress of smoking trigger release of adrenaline from the adrenal glands, raising circulating Epinephrine levels. Because Epinephrine is the parent catecholamine substrate for aminochrome formation, this surge in substrate directly increases the rate at which Adrenochrome can be generated.
context.zh-TW: Nicotine 與吸菸造成的生理壓力會觸發腎上腺釋放 adrenaline，使循環中的 Epinephrine 濃度上升。由於 Epinephrine 是 aminochrome 生成的母體兒茶酚胺受質，這一波受質增加會直接提高 Adrenochrome 的生成速率。

context.en-US: The C. elegans gene nuo-6 (NADH-Ubiquinone Oxidoreductase 6) encodes a subunit of Complex I, the NADH dehydrogenase arm of the mitochondrial electron transport chain, where it contributes to the machinery that transfers electrons from NADH to Ubiquinone.
context.zh-TW: 秀麗隱桿線蟲的 nuo-6（NADH-Ubiquinone Oxidoreductase 6）基因編碼 Complex I（電子傳遞鏈中的 NADH 去氫酶）的次單元，參與將電子由 NADH 轉移至 Ubiquinone 的機制。
