context.en-US: The ATLAS trial (Singh et al., 2022, NCT03464500) is a randomized controlled test of Urolithin A at 500 or 1000 mg/day versus placebo over 4 months in 88 middle-aged adults. It produced roughly a 12% hamstring-strength increase at 500 mg/day, improved peak VO2 and 6-minute walk distance, and reduced plasma acylcarnitines and C-reactive protein, providing core human functional evidence for the compound.
context.zh-TW: ATLAS 試驗（Singh 等，2022，NCT03464500）是一項隨機對照試驗，在 88 名中年成人中以 Urolithin A 每日 500 或 1000 mg 對比安慰劑、持續 4 個月。結果顯示 500 mg/日組腿後肌力量增加約 12%，尖峰 VO2 與 6 分鐘步行距離改善，血漿 acylcarnitines 與 C 反應性蛋白下降，為該化合物提供了核心的人體功能性證據。

context.en-US: ATLAS is the first demonstration that oral Urolithin A engages the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy axis in human muscle: biopsies showed Parkin-mediated ubiquitin-proteasome enrichment at 500 mg and OXPHOS upregulation at 1000 mg, together with strength, endurance and anti-inflammatory benefits. Urolithin A is positioned as the selective-Mitophagy arm of the four-compound longevity framework, acting on depolarized mitochondria to stabilize PINK1 and activate the downstream Parkin E3 ligase.
context.zh-TW: ATLAS 首次證明口服 Urolithin A 在人體肌肉中啟動 PINK1/Parkin 的 mitophagy 軸：活檢顯示 500 mg 組有 Parkin 媒介的泛素-蛋白酶體富集、1000 mg 組有 OXPHOS 上調，並伴隨力量、耐力與抗發炎效益。Urolithin A 被定位為四化合物長壽框架中的選擇性 Mitophagy 分支，作用於去極化的粒線體以穩定 PINK1 並活化下游的 Parkin E3 連接酶。

context.en-US: ATM (Ataxia-Telangiectasia Mutated), a ~350 kDa PIKK-family serine/threonine kinase, phosphorylates Bid at Ser61 and Ser78, leading to S phase arrest in response to DNA Damage. Biallelic ATM loss-of-function mutations cause ataxia-telangiectasia with cerebellar degeneration, immunodeficiency, radiation sensitivity and cancer predisposition, whereas monoallelic carriers show intermediate phenotypes including increased DNA Damage accumulation and potentially accelerated epigenetic aging.
context.zh-TW: ATM（Ataxia-Telangiectasia Mutated）是約 350 kDa 的 PIKK 家族絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，它在 Ser61 與 Ser78 磷酸化 Bid，進而因應 DNA Damage 造成 S 期停滯。ATM 的雙等位功能喪失突變造成伴隨小腦退化、免疫缺陷、放射性敏感與癌症易感的 ataxia-telangiectasia；單等位帶因者則呈現中間表型，包括 DNA Damage 累積增加與可能的表觀遺傳加速老化。

context.en-US: ATM is the master initiator of the DNA Damage Response to DNA double-strand breaks. In undamaged cells it is an inactive dimer; DSB detection recruits it via the MRN complex, whose binding promotes monomerization and autophosphorylation at Ser1981. Active ATM then phosphorylates H2AX at Ser139 to form γH2AX, recruiting MDC1, 53BP1 and BRCA1 to amplify the damage signal, and phosphorylates CHK2 at Thr68 to propagate checkpoint signalling to p53, CDC25A and CDC25C, enforcing G1/S and G2/M arrest.
context.zh-TW: ATM 是回應 DNA double-strand breaks 的 DNA Damage Response 主啟動因子。在未受損細胞中它以不活化二聚體存在；DSB 被偵測後經 MRN complex 招募，其結合促進 ATM 單體化與 Ser1981 自體磷酸化。活化的 ATM 接著磷酸化 H2AX 的 Ser139 形成 γH2AX，招募 MDC1、53BP1 與 BRCA1 以放大損傷訊號；並磷酸化 CHK2 的 Thr68，把檢查點訊號傳遞給 p53、CDC25A 與 CDC25C，執行 G1/S 與 G2/M 停滯。

context.en-US: ATM phosphorylates p53 at Ser15, disrupting MDM2 binding and thereby stabilizing p53. Stabilized p53 drives CDKN1A/p21 transcription and senescence entry, so the ATM-p53 axis is a principal route by which a DNA Damage Response is converted into a durable cell-cycle arrest. If damage proves irreparable, this same signalling commits the cell to Apoptosis instead.
context.zh-TW: ATM 在 Ser15 磷酸化 p53，破壞其與 MDM2 的結合，藉此穩定 p53。穩定後的 p53 驅動 CDKN1A/p21 轉錄與衰老進入，因此 ATM-p53 軸線是把 DNA Damage Response 轉換為持久細胞週期停滯的主要途徑。若損傷證實不可修復，同一訊號便會使細胞走向 Apoptosis。

context.en-US: In Senescence, ATM is required for the DDR-induced senescence program, yet chronic ATM signaling paradoxically also contributes to the SASP via NF-κB activation. ATM activity declines with age in human tissues, correlating with increased genomic instability. Because inhibiting ATM in aged mice reduces sterile inflammation and improves tissue function, ATM modulation has a therapeutic window in aging, and the downstream consequence of repair failure includes persistent inflammatory output.
context.zh-TW: 在 Senescence 中，ATM 是 DDR 誘發衰老程式所必需，但慢性 ATM 訊號又反常地透過 NF-κB 活化促成 SASP。ATM 活性在人類組織中隨年齡下降，與基因體不穩定性增加相關。由於在老化小鼠中抑制 ATM 可減少無菌性發炎並改善組織功能，ATM 調控在老化領域具有治療窗口；修復失敗的下游後果之一即是持續的發炎輸出。

context.en-US: ATP Synthase (Complex V) is a large multi-subunit enzyme embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane that catalyzes the terminal, defining step of Oxidative Phosphorylation: synthesis of ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. It harnesses the proton gradient, i.e. the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential, established by the Electron Transport Chain. Loss of ΔΨm in Senescence impairs ATP synthase function, reducing ATP production and contributing to bioenergetic failure.
context.zh-TW: ATP Synthase（Complex V）是嵌入粒線體內膜的大型多次單元酵素，催化 Oxidative Phosphorylation 最終且具決定性的一步：由 ADP 與無機磷酸合成 ATP。它利用由 Electron Transport Chain 建立的分子供子梯度，也就是 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential。Senescence 中 ΔΨm 的流失會損害 ATP synthase 功能，降低 ATP 生成並促成生物能量衰竭。

context.en-US: ATR (Ataxia Telangiectasia and Rad3-related) is a serine/threonine kinase that senses replication stress and single-stranded DNA lesions. RPA-coated ssDNA recruits ATR through its obligate partner ATRIP, with TopBP1 and ETAA1 providing additional cofactors. ATR phosphorylates substrates on SQ/TQ motifs, acting on CHK1 at Ser317 and Ser345; active CHK1 then phosphorylates CDC25 phosphatases, causing their degradation or cytoplasmic sequestration and thereby inhibiting CDK activation to halt cell cycle progression.
context.zh-TW: ATR（Ataxia Telangiectasia and Rad3-related）是感測複製壓力與單股 DNA 損傷的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶。由 RPA 覆蓋的 ssDNA 透過其必需伴護蛋白 ATRIP 招募 ATR，TopBP1 與 ETAA1 提供額外輔因子。ATR 以 SQ/TQ 為基序磷酸化受質，作用於 CHK1 的 Ser317 與 Ser345；活化的 CHK1 接著磷酸化 CDC25 磷酸酶，使其降解或被滯留於細胞質，因而抑制 CDK 活化並使細胞週期進程停止。

context.en-US: ATR is one of the earliest checkpoint kinases activated during the DNA Damage Response in Replicative Senescence, alongside ATM, and persistent ATR/CHK1 signaling maintains the DDR signal that sustains cell cycle arrest. Oncogene activation causes DNA hyper-replication and stalled forks that generate the ssDNA activating ATR, and chemotherapeutic agents that cause replication stress do the same. ATR signals through CHK1 to p53 to p21 and through CDC25 degradation to CDK inhibition and Rb hypophosphorylation, contributing to SAHF formation.
context.zh-TW: ATR 是 Replicative Senescence 中 DNA Damage Response 期間最早被活化的檢查點激酶之一（與 ATM 並列），而持續的 ATR/CHK1 訊號維持使細胞週期停滯得以持久的 DDR 訊號。致癌基因活化造成 DNA 過度複製與複製叉停滯，產生活化 ATR 的 ssDNA；造成複製壓力的化療藥物亦然。ATR 經 CHK1 傳訊至 p53 再到 p21，並經 CDC25 降解導致 CDK 抑制與 Rb 去磷酸化，促成 SAHF 形成。

context.en-US: ATR and ATM are partner checkpoint kinases whose division of labour is lesion type: ATM responds to DNA double-strand breaks while ATR responds to ssDNA and stalled replication forks. When telomeres shorten to a critical length they are recognized as DNA lesions, activating ATM for DSBs and ATR for uncapped telomeres with ssDNA overhangs. Both phosphorylate CHK2, which transmits DDR signals by phosphorylating p53, so the two kinases converge on overlapping downstream effectors.
context.zh-TW: ATR 與 ATM 是分工依損傷類型的夥伴檢查點激酶：ATM 回應 DNA double-strand breaks，而 ATR 回應 ssDNA 與停滯的複製叉。端粒縮短至臨界長度時會被視為 DNA 損傷，於是 ATM 處理 DSB、ATR 處理帶有 ssDNA 突出端的未封帽端粒。兩者皆磷酸化 CHK2，而 CHK2 再藉由磷酸化 p53 傳遞 DDR 訊號，因此這兩種激酶在下游效應器上會合。

context.en-US: ATRX is a ~280 kDa ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler of the SWI/SNF superfamily that cooperates with the histone chaperone DAXX to assemble the histone variant H3.3 into chromatin at telomeres, pericentric and centromeric heterochromatin, endogenous retroviruses and other repetitive elements, and imprinted loci. Its ADD domain binds H3 tails specifically when H3 is unmethylated at Lys9 (H3K4me0), linking ATRX activity to transcriptional silencing, while an HP1-interacting region anchors it at heterochromatin.
context.zh-TW: ATRX 是 SWI/SNF 超家族中約 280 kDa 的 ATP 依賴性染色質重塑蛋白，與組蛋白伴護蛋白 DAXX 協同將組蛋白變異體 H3.3 組裝進端粒、周中節與著絲點異染色質、內源性反轉錄病毒與其他重複元素，以及印跡基因座的染色質。其 ADD 區域在 H3 的 Lys9 未甲基化（H3K4me0）時專一性結合 H3 尾端，將 ATRX 活性與轉錄沉默連結起來；HP1 交互作用區則將其錨定於異染色質。

context.en-US: ATRX is a chromatin-based Tumor Suppressor Gene and one of six X-linked EXITS genes (Escape from X-Inactivation Tumor Suppressors) preferentially loss-of-function mutated in male tumors. Across 21 tumor types these six genes show significantly more loss-of-function mutations in males than the 18,055 autosomal and pseudoautosomal genes examined. Because females express ATRX biallelically, they need two hits to lose function, whereas hemizygous males need only one, producing ATRX's male-biased mutation enrichment and its loss of telomeric chromatin integrity with ALT activation.
context.zh-TW: ATRX 是以染色質為基礎的 Tumor Suppressor Gene，也是六個 X 聯鎖 EXITS 基因（Escape from X-Inactivation Tumor Suppressors）之一，在男性腫瘤中偏好性地發生功能喪失突變。在 21 種腫瘤中，這六個基因在男性的功能喪失突變顯著多於所檢視的 18,055 個體染色體與偽體染色體基因。由於女性以雙等位方式表現 ATRX，功能喪失需要兩次Hits，而半合子的男性只需一次，這造成 ATRX 突變的男性偏倚，以及其端粒染色質完整性喪失與 ALT 活化。

context.en-US: Loss of ATRX causes telomere decondensation, replication stress and DNA damage at telomeric repeat sequences, yet paradoxically extends telomeres in tumors by activating the alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT) pathway, a recombination-based maintenance mechanism seen in 10-15% of cancers. ALT is template-directed rather than telomerase-mediated and is associated with more aggressive tumor behavior, making ATRX loss a diagnostic marker (about 30% of adult diffuse IDH-mutant gliomas) and a therapeutic vulnerability.
context.zh-TW: ATRX 缺失會造成端粒去凝縮、複製壓力與端粒重複序列處的 DNA 損傷，卻又在腫瘤中反常地透過活化替代性端粒延長（ALT）路徑延長端粒；ALT 是一種以重組為基礎的維持機制，見於 10-15% 的癌症。ALT 是模板導向而非端粒酶介導的，並與更侵襲性的腫瘤行為相關，因此 ATRX 缺失既是診斷標記（約 30% 成人瀰漫性 IDH 突變膠質瘤），也是治療弱點。

context.en-US: AUF1 (AU-rich element RNA-binding protein 1, hnRNP D) is a post-transcriptional brake on the SASP. Its four isoforms (p37, p40, p42, p45) each carry two RNA-recognition motifs that bind AUUUA-type AU-rich elements in the 3' UTR; once bound, AUF1 recruits the exonuclease XRN1 and the deadenylase PARN and collaborates with the exosome to drive rapid transcript decay, including decay of transcripts for pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines such as IL-6 and IL-8.
context.zh-TW: AUF1（AU-rich element RNA-binding protein 1，hnRNP D）是 SASP 的轉錄後煞車。其四個異型（p37、p40、p42、p45）各帶兩個 RNA 辨識基序，結合 3' UTR 中 AUUUA 型的 AU-rich element；結合後 AUF1 招募外切核酸酶 XRN1 與去腺苷化酶 PARN，並與 exosome 協同驅動快速的轉錄本降解，包含 IL-6、IL-8 等促發炎細胞激素與趨化因子轉錄本的降解。

context.en-US: The p38 MAPK-MAPKAPK2 (MK2) axis is the switch that relieves AUF1's brake on the SASP. In Senescent Cells, MK2 downstream of p38 MAPK phosphorylates AUF1, promoting its cytoplasmic relocalization away from target mRNAs and/or reducing its decay competence, which stabilizes and increases production of SASP factors such as IL-6 and IL-8. This converts chronic stress signalling into sustained SASP output at the level of mRNA half-life, acting in parallel with the NF-κB transcriptional program; restoring AUF1 or inhibiting MK2 can blunt SASP intensity as a senomorphic strategy.
context.zh-TW: p38 MAPK-MAPKAPK2（MK2）軸線是解除 AUF1 對 SASP 煞車的開關。在 Senescent Cells 中，位於 p38 MAPK 下游的 MK2 磷酸化 AUF1，促使其向細胞質重新定位而遠離目標 mRNA，和/或降低其降解能力，因而穩定並提高 IL-6、IL-8 等 SASP 因子的產量。這在 mRNA 半衰期層級把慢性壓力訊號轉為持續的 SASP 輸出，並與 NF-κB 的轉錄程式平行作用；恢復 AUF1 活性或抑制 MK2 皆可作為 senomorphic 策略以削弱 SASP 強度。

context.en-US: Acetate is the two-carbon short-chain fatty acid (CH3COO-) and the most abundant SCFA produced by gut fermentation, generated by anaerobic bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Bacteroides and by acetogens from dietary fiber. It is absorbed into portal blood and distributed systemically, crossing membranes as the protonated acid or via monocarboxylate transporters to reach the liver, brain and periphery. SCFA profiles including acetate are altered in aging and are modulated by diet, Caloric Restriction and NAD+ precursors such as Nicotinamide Riboside.
context.zh-TW: Acetate 是二碳短鏈脂肪酸（CH3COO-），也是腸道發酵產量最豐富的 SCFA，由 Bifidobacterium、Bacteroides 等厭氧菌與產乙酸菌從膳食纖維產生。它被吸收進入門脈血液並分布全身，以質子化酸形式或經單羧酸運輸蛋白跨越細胞膜，抵達肝臟、腦與周邊組織。包含 acetate 在內的 SCFA 譜會隨老化改變，並受飲食、Caloric Restriction 與 Nicotinamide Riboside 等 NAD+ 前驅物調控。

context.en-US: In the liver, absorbed acetate is activated to Acetyl-CoA and incorporated into lipids, cholesterol and ketone bodies, linking the Gut Microbiome to host Lipid Metabolism. Acetate also supplies the acetyl group pool used in Acetylation, including Histone Acetylation, and in the brain can be used by astrocytes for acetyl-CoA and neurotransmitter synthesis. Exogenous acetate can also bypass an SLC25A1 block via ACSS2, restoring acetylation in senescent cells.
context.zh-TW: 在肝臟中，吸收的 acetate 被活化為 Acetyl-CoA，並納入脂質、膽固醇與酮體，將 Gut Microbiome 與宿主 Lipid Metabolism 連結起來。Acetate 同時供應 Acetylation（含 Histone Acetylation）所需的乙醯基群池；在腦中可由星狀膠細胞用於 Acetyl-CoA 與神經傳遞物質合成。外源性 acetate 也能透過 ACSS2 繞過 SLC25A1 阻斷，恢復衰老細胞中的乙醯化。

context.en-US: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate acetyl donor for Histone Acetylation, catalysed by HATs; the opposing reaction is performed by NAD+-dependent Sirtuins and HDACs. Because acetyl-CoA availability therefore directly couples nutrient state to chromatin state and gene expression, high acetyl-CoA favours open, transcriptionally active chromatin while sirtuin-mediated deacetylation is energy- and Caloric Restriction-linked. This makes acetyl-CoA abundance a metabolic switch between anabolism and catabolism.
context.zh-TW: Acetyl-CoA 是 Histone Acetylation 不可或缺的乙醯基供體，由 HAT 催化；相反方向的反應則由 NAD+ 依賴性的 Sirtuins 與 HDAC 執行。因此 Acetyl-CoA 的可得性直接將營養狀態與染色質狀態、基因表現偶聯：Acetyl-CoA 偏高有利於開放且轉錄活躍的染色質，而 sirtuin 媒介的去乙醯化則與能量及 Caloric Restriction 相連結。這使 Acetyl-CoA 豐度成為同化與異化之間的代謝開關。

context.en-US: Nutrient sufficiency raises Acetyl-CoA, which can inhibit Autophagy via mTOR activation, whereas fasting lowers acetyl-CoA and promotes autophagic flux. This positions acetyl-CoA as a metabolic switch between anabolism and catabolism and links the nutrient state to autophagy output. Interventions that modulate acetyl-CoA availability, including Caloric Restriction, Nicotinamide Riboside and Mitohormesis, influence downstream acetylation and stress-resistance pathways relevant to longevity.
context.zh-TW: 營養充足會提高 Acetyl-CoA，進而可透過 mTOR 活化抑制 Autophagy；相反地，禁食會降低 Acetyl-CoA 並促進自噬流。這使 Acetyl-CoA 成為同化與異化之間的代謝開關，並把營養狀態與自噬輸出連結起來。調節 Acetyl-CoA 可得性的介入手段，包括 Caloric Restriction、Nicotinamide Riboside 與 Mitohormesis，會影響與長壽相關的下游乙醯化與抗壓力路徑。

context.en-US: In senescence, mitochondrial pyruvate entry via MPC feeds a citrate-acetyl-CoA export axis: the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 exports citrate to the cytoplasm where ACLY generates Acetyl-CoA, and that pool is used to place H3K27ac at SASP loci. Inhibiting SLC25A1 or MPC with CTPI2 collapses this pool, removes H3K27ac from SASP enhancers and selectively suppresses SASP expression while leaving viability and mtDNA-driven signalling intact; exogenous acetate bypasses the block via ACSS2. CTPI2-treated mice showed reduced Frailty and improved healthspan.
context.zh-TW: 在衰老中，經 MPC 進入的粒線體丙酮酸驅動檸檬酸-Acetyl-CoA 輸出軸：粒線體檸檬酸運輸蛋白 SLC25A1 將檸檬酸輸出至細胞質，由 ACLY 生成 Acetyl-CoA，而該乙醯基群池用於在 SASP 位點標記 H3K27ac。以 CTPI2 抑制 SLC25A1 或 MPC 會使此群池崩解、從 SASP 增強子移除 H3K27ac，並選擇性抑制 SASP 表現，同時保留細胞存活與 mtDNA 驅動的訊號；外源性 acetate 可經 ACSS2 繞過此阻斷。接受 CTPI2 處理的小鼠 Frailty 下降且健康壽命改善。

context.en-US: Acetyl-L-Carnitine (ALC) is the acetylated form of L-Carnitine, the naturally occurring L-enantiomer. It facilitates the transport of long-chain fatty acids into Mitochondria for beta-oxidation and supplies an acetyl group for energy metabolism and acetylcholine synthesis, so it inherits the mitochondrial transport function of its parent compound. It is also grouped with Carnosine and Aminoguanidine as a compound shown to help prevent Cross-linking associated with aging.
context.zh-TW: Acetyl-L-Carnitine（ALC）是天然存在的 L-映型 L-Carnitine 的乙醯化形式。它促進長鏈脂肪酸進入 Mitochondria 以進行 β-氧化，並供應乙醯基供能量代謝與乙醯膽鹼合成，因此承襲其母體化合物的粒線體運輸功能。它也與 Carnosine、Aminoguanidine 並列，被列為有助於預防老化相關 Cross-linking 的化合物。

context.en-US: ALC is investigated as an anti-aging and glycation-countering agent. Its proposed actions include maintaining Mitochondrial function and reducing age-related declines in energy production, buffering oxidative stress that would otherwise accelerate Glycation and AGE formation, and improving metabolic and cognitive outcomes in diabetic neuropathy, depression and age-related cognitive decline. In contrast, Alagebrium (ALT-711) is positioned as a breaker of existing cross-links rather than a preventive.
context.zh-TW: ALC 被研究作為抗老化與對抗糖基化的試劑。其提出的作用包括維持 Mitochondrial 功能、減少老化相關的能量生成衰退、緩衝原本會加速 Glycation 與 AGE 形成的氧化壓力，以及改善糖尿病神經病變、憂鬱與老化相關認知衰退的代謝與認知結果。相對地，Alagebrium（ALT-711）被定位為切斷既有交聯鍵的藥物，而非預防性藥物。

context.en-US: Acetylation is a reversible post-translational modification in which an acetyl group is transferred from Acetyl-CoA to a substrate, catalysed by HATs and removed by HDACs and Sirtuins. Because the donor is Acetyl-CoA, acetylation status directly links Metabolism to Epigenetics: Histone lysine acetylation such as H3K9ac, H3K27ac and H4K16ac regulates Chromatin structure and Gene Expression, while non-histone acetylation modulates the activity, stability and localization of p53, NF-κB, STAT3, α-Tubulin and PGC-1α.
context.zh-TW: Acetylation 是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，將乙醯基由 Acetyl-CoA 轉移至受質，由 HAT 催化，並由 HDAC 與 Sirtuins 移除。由於供體是 Acetyl-CoA，乙醯化狀態直接將 Metabolism 與 Epigenetics 連結：H3K9ac、H3K27ac、H4K16ac 等組蛋白離胺酸乙醯化調控 Chromatin 結構與 Gene Expression，而非組蛋白乙醯化則調節 p53、NF-κB、STAT3、α-Tubulin 與 PGC-1α 的活性、穩定性與定位。

context.en-US: Sirtuins are NAD+-dependent deacetylases that erase the marks written by acetylation, opposing HATs in a stoichiometric cycle that couples the NAD+/NADH ratio to chromatin and gene-expression state. Because deacetylation is energy- and Caloric Restriction-linked, sirtuin activity is a point at which nutrient state and NAD+ availability are converted into transcriptional output. Dysregulated acetylation is implicated in Cancer, Neurodegeneration, metabolic disease and Aging.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuins 是 NAD+ 依賴性的去乙醯化酶，可擦除乙醯化所寫下的標記，與 HAT 在化學計量循環中相拮抗，並將 NAD+/NADH 比例與染色質及基因表現狀態偶聯。由於去乙醯化與能量狀態及 Caloric Restriction 相連結，sirtuin 活性就是把營養狀態與 NAD+ 可得性轉換為轉錄輸出的節點。乙醯化失調與 Cancer、Neurodegeneration、代謝疾病與 Aging 均有關聯。

context.en-US: Acid hydrolases are a superfamily of about 60 hydrolytic enzymes that carry out the catabolic machinery of the Lysosome at the acidic pH 4.5-5.0 maintained there, cleaving proteins, lipids, carbohydrates, nucleic acids and phosphates. Each cleaves a specific bond type, and deficiency of any single enzyme produces a characteristic lysosomal storage disease in which the undigested substrate accumulates. Delivered by the mannose-6-phosphate pathway via GNPTAB tagging in the Golgi Apparatus, they also degrade autophagosomal cargo, so impaired activity causes autophagic stress.
context.zh-TW: Acid hydrolases 是約 60 種水解酵素的超家族，在 Lysosome 內維持的酸性 pH 4.5-5.0 條件下執行溶體的分解工作，分解蛋白質、脂質、醣類、核酸與磷酸基團。每一種切割特定化學鍵，缺少其中任一酵素即造成特定的 lysosomal storage disease，使未消化受質累積。它們經由 mannose-6-phosphate 路徑運送（由 Golgi Apparatus 中的 GNPTAB 加上標記），也分解自噬體貨載，因此活性受損會造成自噬壓力。

context.en-US: Acid ceramidase and Acid Sphingomyelinase are acid hydrolases that regulate the ceramide to sphingosine-1-phosphate rheostat, thereby influencing Apoptosis, inflammation and cell survival: ceramide accumulation pushes cells toward death whereas sphingosine-1-phosphate signalling favours survival. Relatedly, lysosomal membrane permeabilization releases acid hydrolases such as Cathepsin D and Cathepsin B into the cytoplasm, where they can trigger Inflammation and cell death. Enzyme replacement therapy exploits the M6P receptors to restore these activities.
context.zh-TW: Acid ceramidase 與 Acid Sphingomyelinase 是調節 ceramide 與 sphingosine-1-phosphate 平衡閘門的 acid hydrolases，藉此影響 Apoptosis、發炎與細胞存活：神經醯胺累積推動細胞走向死亡，而 sphingosine-1-phosphate 訊號則有利於存活。相關地，溶酶體膜通透化會將 Cathepsin D、Cathepsin B 等 acid hydrolases 釋放至細胞質，進而觸發 Inflammation 與細胞死亡。酵素替代療法即利用 M6P 受體恢復這些活性。

context.en-US: Beyond serving as the amyloid precursor, APP has a normal physiological role in lipid handling. Its copper-binding domain coordinates Cu2+ with nanomolar affinity and can reduce Cu2+ to Cu+, potentially protecting neurons from copper-mediated oxidative damage, and APP mediates cholesterol efflux by transferring cholesterol to apolipoprotein E (ApoE), helping regulate membrane lipid composition at synapses. Cholesterol also compartmentalises BACE1 and gamma-secretase in lipid rafts, so cholesterol depletion by statins redirects APP away from amyloidogenic processing and reduces A-beta production.
context.zh-TW: 除了作為類澱粉樣蛋白前驅物之外，APP 在脂質處理上也有正常的生理角色。其銅結合區域以奈莫耳級親和力協調 Cu2+，並可將 Cu2+ 還原為 Cu+，可能保護神經元免受銅介導的氧化損傷；APP 也藉由將膽固醇轉移給 apolipoprotein E（ApoE）來媒介膽固醇外流，協助調節突觸的膜脂質組成。膽固醇另會在 lipid rafts 中將 BACE1 與 gamma-secretase 區隔，因此以 statin 耗竭膽固醇會使 APP 偏離類澱粉樣處理並降低 A-beta 生成。

context.en-US: ARH1 and ARH3 divide residue-specific labour in ADP-ribosylation erasure. ARH1 is the Arg-specific hydrolase, with about 41% sequence similarity to ARH3, and shows less than 1% of ARH3's PAR activity; it has no activity on Cys, Asn or diphthamide linkages. ARH3 is the Ser-specific counterpart and the bulk PARase, and its vicinal-aspartate Mg2+ coordination architecture (Asp77/78, Asp314/316) is homologous to that of ARH1. PARG, the bulk PARase, provides no redundancy with ARH1's Arg activity, so the two are non-redundant erasers of distinct amino-acid marks.
context.zh-TW: ARH1 與 ARH3 在 ADP-ribosylation 的擦除上依胺基酸分工。ARH1 是精胺酸專一的水解酶，與 ARH3 有約 41% 序列相似度，對 PAR 的活性不到 ARH3 的 1%，且對 Cys、Asn 或 diphthamide 鍵結無活性。ARH3 則是絲胺酸專一的對應物與主要 PARase，其鄰位天門冬胺酸 Mg2+ 配位架構（Asp77/78、Asp314/316）與 ARH1 同源。作為主要 PARase 的 PARG 與 ARH1 的精胺酸活性並無冗餘，因此兩者是針對不同胺基酸標記的非冗餘擦除者。

context.en-US: The Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) is a bHLH-PAS ligand-activated transcription factor that acts as a cytosolic sensor; Kynurenine, the Tryptophan metabolite generated by IDO1 and TDO, is its principal endogenous ligand. Ligand binding releases AhR from its HSP90/p23/XAP2 complex, drives nuclear translocation and heterodimerization with ARNT, and activates xenobiotic response element (XRE) transcription.
context.zh-TW: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) 是一種配體活化的 bHLH-PAS 轉錄因子，作為細胞質內的感測器；Kynurenine 是由 IDO1 與 TDO 產生的 Tryptophan 代謝物，也是其主要的內源性配體。配體結合使 AhR 從 HSP90/p23/XAP2 複合體釋放，驱动核轉位並與 ARNT 形成異二聚體，進而活化 XRE 相關的轉錄。

context.en-US: IDO1 is the rate-limiting enzyme of the Kynurenine Pathway and generates Kynurenine from Tryptophan; Kynurenine then signals through the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor to promote Regulatory T cells and suppress Th17 responses, creating a feed-forward immunosuppressive loop when dendritic cells express IDO1.
context.zh-TW: IDO1 是 Kynurenine Pathway 的限速酵素，由 Tryptophan 生成 Kynurenine；Kynurenine 接著透過 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 訊號促進 Regulatory T cells 並抑制 Th17 反應，當樹突細胞表現 IDO1 時便形成前饋式的免疫抑制迴路。

context.en-US: In the Tumor Microenvironment, the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor mediates the immunosuppressive effects of Kynurenine, making the IDO1-Kyn-AhR axis an active target of cancer immunotherapy where blockade aims to restore antitumor immunity.
context.zh-TW: 在 Tumor Microenvironment 中，Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 介導 Kynurenine 的免疫抑制作用，使 IDO1-Kyn-AhR 軸成為癌症免疫治療的具體標靶；阻斷此軸的目標是恢復抗腫瘤免疫。

context.en-US: Interferon-gamma is the upstream inducer of IDO1 in dendritic cells and macrophages; by raising IDO1, it increases Kynurenine flux into the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor pathway, converting inflammatory interferon signaling into an immunoregulatory, IDO1-dependent tolerogenic program.
context.zh-TW: Interferon-gamma 是樹突細胞與巨噬細胞中 IDO1 的上游誘導因子；提升 IDO1 會增加 Kynurenine 流向 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 途徑，將發炎性的干擾素訊號轉換為依賴 IDO1 的免疫調節耐受程式。

context.en-US: Sustained cGAS-STING Pathway activation downstream of proteotoxic and mitochondrial stress drives Astrocyte Senescence, a stable growth-arrested, pro-inflammatory state with a SASP secretome that amplifies Neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration.
context.zh-TW: 在蛋白毒性與粒線體壓力之下持續活化的 cGAS-STING Pathway 會驅動 Astrocyte Senescence——一種穩定停滯生長、促發炎且具有 SASP 分泌表型的狀態，進而放大 Neuroinflammation 與神經退化。

context.en-US: Astrocyte Senescence is the glial instance of Senescence: astrocytes acquire a stable growth-arrested, pro-inflammatory phenotype with a cytokine- and protease-rich SASP, overlapping with Inflammaging and age-related glial dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: Astrocyte Senescence 是 Senescence 在神經膠細胞中的實例：星狀膠細胞獲得穩定停滯生長、促發炎的表型，並分泌富含細胞激素與蛋白酶的 SASP，與 Inflammaging 及年齡相關的膠細胞功能失調重疊。

context.en-US: Astrocyte-specific deletion of cGAS robustly attenuates neurotoxicity in neurodegeneration models, demonstrating that astrocytic cGAS acts non-cell-autonomously on neurons; pharmacological inhibition of cGAS or STING likewise reduces neurotoxic A1 astrocytes and promotes the neuroprotective A2 state.
context.zh-TW: 在神經退化模型中，星星狀膠細胞專一性剔除 cGAS 可顯著降低神經毒性，證明星狀膠細胞的 cGAS 以非細胞自主方式作用於神經元；cGAS 或 STING 的藥理抑制同樣能減少神經毒性的 A1 星狀膠細胞並促進具神經保護作用的 A2 狀態。

context.en-US: Astrocytes are the most abundant glial cell type of the Central Nervous System, providing metabolic, structural and homeostatic support to Neuron and contributing to formation and maintenance of the Blood-Brain Barrier.
context.zh-TW: Astrocytes 是 Central Nervous System 中最豐富的神經膠細胞類型，為 Neuron 提供代謝、結構與恆定維持上的支持，並參與 Blood-Brain Barrier 的形成與維持。

context.en-US: Astrocytic cGAS responds to extracellular pathological cues including Tau and Amyloid Beta as well as released mtDNA, engaging the same cytosolic DNA-sensing axis active in Microglia and thereby driving the neurotoxic A1 reactive astrocyte program.
context.zh-TW: 星狀膠細胞的 cGAS 會對細胞外的 Tau、Amyloid Beta 以及釋出的 mtDNA 產生反應，啟動與 Microglia 相同的細胞質 DNA 感測軸，進而驅動具神經毒性的 A1 反應性星狀膠細胞程式。

context.en-US: Reactive Astrocytes and Microglia engage in bidirectional paracrine signaling, propagating Type I Interferon and pro-inflammatory cytokine responses that reshape the glial landscape and sustain chronic inflammation and synaptic dysfunction in Alzheimer's Disease and Parkinson's Disease.
context.zh-TW: 反應性的 Astrocytes 與 Microglia 進行雙向的旁分泌訊號傳遞，傳播 Type I Interferon 與促發炎細胞激素反應，重塑神經膠細胞環境，並在 Alzheimer's Disease 與 Parkinson's Disease 中維持慢性發炎與突觸功能失調。

context.en-US: Astrocytic cGAS-STING Pathway activation promotes A1 reactive astrocytes and induces Senescence with a SASP that amplifies Neuroinflammation; inhibiting the pathway shifts astrocytes toward the neuroprotective A2 phenotype, uncoupling toxicity from beneficial astrocyte function.
context.zh-TW: 星狀膠細胞的 cGAS-STING Pathway 活化會促進 A1 反應性星狀膠細胞並誘發帶有 SASP 的 Senescence，放大 Neuroinflammation；抑制此途徑可將星狀膠細胞轉向具神經保護作用的 A2 表型，使毒性與有益功能分離。

context.en-US: Atg proteins are the evolutionarily conserved executors of Autophagy, spanning initiation (ULK1 complex), PI3K complex nucleation (Beclin1/Vps34), autophagosome formation via Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 conjugation, cargo handling (p62), and lysosomal fusion.
context.zh-TW: Atg 蛋白質是 Autophagy 中高度保守的執行者，涵蓋起始（ULK1 複合體）、PI3K 複合體成核（Beclin1/Vps34）、經由 Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 結合系統的自噬體形成、貨物辨識（p62）以及與溶酶體的融合。

context.en-US: mTORC1 is the nutrient-sensing kinase that suppresses Atg protein activity under nutrient-rich conditions, keeping Autophagy tonically inhibited; AMPK, the energy-stress sensor, acts in the opposite direction and activates Atg proteins when cellular energy is low.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 是營養感測激酶，在營養充足條件下抑制 Atg 蛋白質活性，使 Autophagy 維持張力性抑制；而能量壓力感測器 AMPK 則方向相反，在細胞能量偏低時活化 Atg 蛋白質。

context.en-US: LC3 is the mammalian Atg8 homolog and serves as the key autophagosome marker; p62 acts as a cargo receptor that binds LC3 and ubiquitinated targets, bridging selective cargo to the Atg-driven autophagosome.
context.zh-TW: LC3 是哺乳類的 Atg8 同源蛋白，並作為自噬體的關鍵標記；p62 則是貨物受體，結合 LC3 與泛素化的標的，將選擇性貨物橋接到 Atg 驅動的自噬體上。

context.en-US: Dysfunction of Atg proteins is linked to Neurodegeneration, Cancer, Metabolic Disease and Aging; nearly sixteen Atg proteins and two distinct ubiquitin-like conjugation systems are required to promote autophagosome formation during caloric restriction and fasting.
context.zh-TW: Atg 蛋白質的功能失調與 Neurodegeneration、Cancer、Metabolic Disease 及 Aging 皆有關；在熱量限制與禁食期間，促進自噬體形成需要近十六個 Atg 蛋白質與兩套不同的類泛素結合系統。

context.en-US: Starvation induces Autophagy through deacetylation of the Atg4B cysteine protease; deacetylated Atg4B then interacts with pro-LC3, licensing its processing and lipidation and thereby enabling autophagosome formation.
context.zh-TW: 禁食可透過 Atg4B 這 cysteine protease 的去乙醯化來誘導 Autophagy；去乙醯化的 Atg4B 隨後與 pro-LC3 互動，使其得以被加工與脂化，進而促成自噬體形成。

context.en-US: Aurora Kinase isozymes — Aurora-A, Aurora-B and Aurora-C — coordinate mitotic spindle assembly, chromosome alignment and segregation, and cytokinesis; Aurora-A acts at centrosomes and spindle poles, while Aurora-B is a chromosomal passenger complex component regulating kinetochore-microtubule attachments and the spindle assembly checkpoint.
context.zh-TW: Aurora Kinase 異構酶——Aurora-A、Aurora-B 與 Aurora-C——共同協調有絲分裂紡錘體的組裝、染色體的對齊與分離，以及胞質分裂；Aurora-A 作用於中心體與紡錘體極，Aurora-B 則是染色體乘客複合體成分，調控動粒—微管附著與紡錘體組裝檢查點。

context.en-US: SIRT2 is a Tubulin deacetylase that restrains cell-cycle mitotic regulators; disruption of SIRT2 raises Aurora-A and Aurora-B levels, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death, and SIRT2-deficient mice consequently develop gender-specific tumorigenesis including Hepatocellular Carcinoma in males.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 是調節細胞週期有絲分裂因子的 Tubulin 去乙醯化酶；SIRT2 遭破壞會使 Aurora-A 與 Aurora-B 濃度上升，導致非整倍體與有絲分裂性細胞死亡，而 SIRT2 缺失小鼠因此出現性別特異性的腫瘤發生，包含雄鼠的 Hepatocellular Carcinoma。

context.en-US: Overexpression or amplification of Aurora-A/Aurora-B is a hallmark of many solid tumors and predicts poor prognosis in breast, lung and pancreatic cancers; excess Aurora mitotic regulator activity in the setting of SIRT2 loss drives Aneuploidy and mitotic catastrophe.
context.zh-TW: Aurora-A／Aurora-B 的過度表現或擴增是許多實體腫瘤的特徵，並預測乳癌、肺癌與胰臟癌的不良預後；在 SIRT2 喪失的情境下，過量的 Aurora 有絲分裂調節因子活性會驅動 Aneuploidy 與有絲分裂災難。

context.en-US: Autoinflammation is dysregulated activation of the innate immune system — especially NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1β signaling — without the autoantibodies or autoreactive T cells that define autoimmune disease, distinguishing it as an innate-arm disease process.
context.zh-TW: Autoinflammation 指的是先天免疫系統——尤其是 NLRP3 發炎小體與 IL-1β 訊號——的失調活化，且不含定義自體免疫疾病的自體抗體或自體反應性 T 細胞，因此被視為屬於先天免疫臂的疾病歷程。

context.en-US: Uric Acid Crystals activate NLRP3 in joints, making gout the prototypical acquired autoinflammatory disease; the same inflammasome is triggered by other endogenous danger signals such as Silica, oxidized Cardiolipin and mitochondrial DNA in sterile inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Uric Acid Crystals 會在關節中活化 NLRP3，使痛風成為典型的後天性自體發炎疾病；相同的發炎小體也可被其他內源性危險訊號（例如 Silica、氧化態的 Cardiolipin 與粒線體 DNA）在無菌發炎中觸發。

context.en-US: Uncontrolled Caspase-1 activity within the hyperactivated NLRP3 inflammasome causes excessive cleavage and secretion of mature IL-1β; because endogenous IL-1Ra and IL-1R2 decoy receptor function normally counterbalance this signaling, loss of that anti-inflammatory regulation produces the runaway inflammation of Autoinflammation.
context.zh-TW: 過度活化的 NLRP3 發炎小體中，未受控制的 Caspase-1 活性導致成熟 IL-1β 的大量切割與分泌；由於內源性 IL-1Ra 與 IL-1R2 誘餌受體功能通常可抵銷此訊號，該抗發炎調節的喪失便造成 Autoinflammation 的失控發炎。

context.en-US: IL-1 blockade is the therapeutic mainstay of Autoinflammation: Canakinumab (anti-IL-1β) and Anakinra (IL-1Ra) treat CAPS, gout and other autoinflammatory conditions, while Rilonacept acts as an IL-1 trap. The CANTOS Trial showed that reducing IL-1β autoinflammation lowers cardiovascular events.
context.zh-TW: IL-1 阻斷是 Autoinflammation 的治療主軸：Canakinumab（抗 IL-1β 抗體）與 Anakinra（IL-1Ra）用於 CAPS、痛風及其他自體發炎疾病，Rilonacept 則作為 IL-1 陷阱分子。CANTOS Trial 顯示降低 IL-1β 造成的自體發炎可減少心血管事件。

context.en-US: Chronic low-grade Autoinflammation, driven by persistent NLRP3 activation from endogenous DAMPs such as oxidized Cardiolipin, mtDNA and Uric Acid Crystals, is a major component of Inflammaging and directly links inflammasome-driven IL-1β overproduction to age-related disease.
context.zh-TW: 由內源性 DAMP（如氧化態 Cardiolipin、mtDNA 與 Uric Acid Crystals）持續活化 NLRP3 所造成的慢性低度 Autoinflammation，是 Inflammaging 的重要組成，並將發炎小體驅動的 IL-1β 過量生成直接連結到年齡相關疾病。

context.en-US: Heart Rate Variability is the noninvasive physiological readout of Autonomic Nervous System balance, dominated by the tug-of-war between the sympathetic and parasympathetic branches rather than by conscious input — making HRV the practical proxy for recovery capacity.
context.zh-TW: Heart Rate Variability 是 Autonomic Nervous System 平衡狀態的非侵入性生理讀值，主要由交感與副交感分支之間的拉鋸決定，而非由意識輸入決定；因此 HRV 實務上可作為恢復能力的替代指標。

context.en-US: Axon Degeneration runs through a SARM1-dependent execution pathway: axonal injury causes NMNAT2 loss, the NMN/NAD+ ratio rises, SARM1 activates, NAD+ is catastrophically depleted, and energy failure produces fragmentation. Non-SARM1 routes such as Apoptosis or Autophagy-mediated pruning contribute in developmental and disease contexts.
context.zh-TW: Axon Degeneration 主要透過依賴 SARM1 的執行途徑進行：軸突損傷導致 NMNAT2 喪失，NMN／NAD+ 比值上升，SARM1 活化造成 NAD+ 災難性耗竭，導致能量衰竭與片段化。Apoptosis 或 Autophagy 介導的修剪等非 SARM1 途徑，則在發育與疾病情境中有所貢獻。

context.en-US: NMNAT2 is a protective NAD+ synthase whose loss from the distal axon after injury is the proximal event that triggers Axon Degeneration; because SARM1 consumes the NAD+ that NMNAT2 supplies, SARM1 inhibitors such as Disulfiram block the execution step.
context.zh-TW: NMNAT2 是具保護性的 NAD+ 合成酵素，損傷後自遠端軸突喪失是觸發 Axon Degeneration 的近端事件；由於 SARM1 消耗的正是 NMNAT2 供應的 NAD+，因此如 Disulfiram 等 SARM1 抑制劑可阻斷此執行步驟。

context.en-US: Wallerian Degeneration is the best-characterized acute form of Axon Degeneration, and Axon Degeneration itself underlies chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, traumatic brain and spinal cord injury, and neurodegeneration in ALS, Alzheimer's Disease and Glaucoma.
context.zh-TW: Wallerian Degeneration 是 Axon Degeneration 中研究最清楚的急性型態；而 Axon Degeneration 本身則是化療引起周邊神經病變、創傷性腦與脊髓損傷，以及 ALS、Alzheimer's Disease 與 Glaucoma 中神經退化的基礎。

context.en-US: B Cells are bone marrow–derived adaptive immune lymphocytes that differentiate into antibody-secreting plasma cells on antigen encounter, forming the humoral arm of the Adaptive Immune System alongside T Lymphocyte-mediated cellular immunity.
context.zh-TW: B Cells 是源自骨髓的適應性免疫淋巴球，在遇到抗原後分化為分泌抗體的漿細胞，與 T Lymphocyte 所介導的細胞免疫共同構成 Adaptive Immune System 的體液免疫臂。

context.en-US: Periphery-derived B Cells enter the Central Nervous System during neurodegeneration and contribute to Neuroinflammation through cytokine secretion and autoantibody production; the balance between protective regulatory subsets and pathogenic autoimmunity determines CNS outcome.
context.zh-TW: 源自周邊的 B Cells 在神經退化期間進入 Central Nervous System，並透過細胞激素分泌與自體抗體產生促成 Neuroinflammation；具保護性的調節性亞群與致病性自體免疫之間的平衡，決定了中樞神經系統的結局。

context.en-US: The cGAS-STING Pathway shapes B Cells responses: STING activation influences B-cell priming and can promote regulatory B-cell subsets with anti-inflammatory potential, whereas dysregulated cGAS-STING–driven autoimmunity favors pathogenic autoantibody generation and Autoimmune Disease.
context.zh-TW: cGAS-STING Pathway 會形塑 B Cells 的反應：STING 活化影響 B 細胞的起始，並可促進具抗發炎潛能的調節性 B 細胞亞群；反之，失調的 cGAS-STING 所驅動的自體免疫則有利於致病性自體抗體生成與 Autoimmune Disease。

context.en-US: B2M is the invariant light chain that forms all MHC class I molecules and, in particular, stabilizes HLA-E surface expression; HLA-E/B2M on senescent and tumor cells engages NKG2A/CD94 on Natural Killer Cells and CD8 T cells, blunting cytotoxic killing and enabling Immune Evasion.
context.zh-TW: B2M 是構成所有 MHC 第一類分子的不變輕鏈，特別能穩定 HLA-E 的表面表現；衰老細胞與腫瘤細胞上的 HLA-E/B2M 會接合 Natural Killer Cells 與 CD8 T cells 上的 NKG2A/CD94，削弱細胞毒殺殺傷並促成 Immune Evasion。

context.en-US: B2M is enriched on the surface of Senescent Cells and has been exploited for selective senolysis: anti-B2M antibodies conjugated to pyrrolobenzodiazepine payloads kill senescent fibroblasts while sparing proliferating cells, making B2M a targeted senolytic delivery marker.
context.zh-TW: B2M 在 Senescent Cells 表面高度表現，並已被用於選擇性 senolysis：以 pyrrolobenzodiazepine 毒素偶聯的抗 B2M 抗體可殺死衰老纖維母細胞而 sparing 增殖細胞，使 B2M 成為具靶向性的 senolytic 遞送標記。

context.en-US: B2M is one of twelve plasma protein surrogates incorporated into the DNAmGrimAge epigenetic clock, where DNA methylation patterns estimate B2M levels as part of a composite mortality predictor; elevated circulating B2M is associated with Inflammaging, Chronic Kidney Disease and Cardiovascular Disease.
context.zh-TW: B2M 是納入 DNAmGrimAge 表觀遺傳時鐘的十二種血漿蛋白替代指標之一，該時鐘以 DNA 甲基化型態推估 B2M 濃度並組成複合死亡預測指標；循環中的 B2M 升高則與 Inflammaging、Chronic Kidney Disease 及 Cardiovascular Disease 相關。

context.en-US: BAFF (TNFSF13B, BLyS) is an identified SASP cytokine secreted by senescent fibroblasts and monocytic leukaemia cells; it reinforces and broadens the pro-inflammatory secretome, notably upregulating IL-6, and thereby couples the senescent microenvironment to humoral immunity.
context.zh-TW: BAFF（TNFSF13B、BLyS）是已知的 SASP 細胞激素，由衰老纖維母細胞與單核細胞白血病細胞分泌；它會強化並擴大促發炎的分泌表型，尤其上调 IL-6，藉此將衰老微環境與體液免疫連結起來。

context.en-US: BAFF binds three TNF-receptor superfamily members — BAFF-R, BCMA and TACI — with distinct affinities; BAFF-R engages TRAF3→NIK to activate the non-canonical NF-κB pathway plus canonical NF-κB, MAPK and PI3K/Akt, promoting B-cell survival, maturation and immunoglobulin class-switching.
context.zh-TW: BAFF 會以不同親和力結合三個 TNF 受體超家族成員——BAFF-R、BCMA 與 TACI；BAFF-R 透過 TRAF3→NIK 活化非典型 NF-κB 途徑，並同時涉及典型 NF-κB、MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt，促進 B 細胞存活、成熟與免疫球蛋白類別轉換。

context.en-US: Within senescent cells BAFF acts in an autocrine/paracrine manner to amplify pro-inflammatory SASP components, raising IL-6 and other mediators; chronic BAFF exposure in aged tissue couples Inflammaging with autoantibody production and loss of B-cell tolerance.
context.zh-TW: 在衰老細胞中，BAFF 以自分泌／旁分泌方式放大促發炎的 SASP 成分，提高 IL-6 及其他介質；老化組織中長期的 BAFF 暴露則將 Inflammaging 與自體抗體生成及 B 細胞耐受性喪失連結起來。

context.en-US: BAFF is produced by Monocytes/Macrophages, dendritic cells, neutrophils and T cells, and in senescence additionally by senescent fibroblasts and monocytic leukaemia cells; elevated BAFF is associated with age-related immune dysfunction, autoimmune disease and B-cell malignancies.
context.zh-TW: BAFF 由單核球／Macrophages、樹突細胞、中性球與 T 細胞產生，在衰老情境下另由衰老纖維母細胞與單核細胞白血病細胞分泌；BAFF 升高與年齡相關的免疫功能失調、自體免疫疾病及 B 細胞惡性腫瘤相關。

context.en-US: BCR-ABL is the constitutively active tyrosine kinase produced by the t(9;22) Philadelphia translocation, which fuses BCR to the c-ABL kinase moiety; this fusion deregulates c-ABL and drives leukemia via RAS/MAPK, PI3K/AKT and STAT5 survival signaling.
context.zh-TW: BCR-ABL 是由 t(9;22) 費城染色體轉位所產生的持續活化酪胺酸激酶，該轉位將 BCR 與 c-ABL 激酶片段融合；此融合使 c-ABL 去調控，並透過 RAS/MAPK、PI3K/AKT 與 STAT5 存活訊號驅動白血病。

context.en-US: BCR-ABL drives Cancer through RAS/MAPK, PI3K/AKT and STAT5 survival signaling while suppressing Apoptosis; imatinib inhibition of BCR-ABL pioneered targeted Cancer therapy, and the T315I gatekeeper mutation requires ponatinib or asceminib instead.
context.zh-TW: BCR-ABL 透過 RAS/MAPK、PI3K/AKT 與 STAT5 存活訊號驅動 Cancer，同時抑制 Apoptosis；以 imatinib 抑制 BCR-ABL 開啟了標靶 Cancer 治療的先河，而 T315I 守門突變則須改用 ponatinib 或 asciminib。

context.en-US: BIRC2 encodes cIAP1, whose RING domain attaches K63 and linear ubiquitin chains to RIPK1 within TNFR1 complex I, building the IKK/NF-κB scaffold and inducing c-FLIP — the survival arm of the Caspase-8-c-FLIP rheostat.
context.zh-TW: BIRC2 編碼 cIAP1，其 RING 結構域在 TNFR1 complex I 中對 RIPK1 加上 K63 與線型泛素鏈，建立 IKK/NF-κB 支架並誘導 c-FLIP——即 Caspase-8-c-FLIP 恆定器的存活臂。

context.en-US: Smac mimetics bind the BIR2/BIR3 domains of cIAP1, dimerize RING domains and flip ligase activity onto cIAP1 itself, collapsing its half-life from hours to minutes; cIAP1 degradation is the proximal pharmacodynamic readout in every Smac-mimetic trial and licenses Ripoptosome assembly.
context.zh-TW: Smac mimetics 結合 cIAP1 的 BIR2/BIR3 結構域、使 RING 結構域二聚化，並將連接酶活性轉 onto cIAP1 自身，使其半衰期由數小時縮短至數分鐘；cIAP1 降解是所有 Smac-mimetic 試驗最接近的藥效學讀值，並使 Ripoptosome 得以組裝。

context.en-US: BIRC2 encodes cIAP1, the workhorse subunit of the cIAPs pair; 11q22 BIRC2/BIRC3 amplification marks apoptosis-resistant carcinomas and myeloma, and compensatory cIAP2 upregulation with RIPK3 silencing blunts Smac-mimetic efficacy.
context.zh-TW: BIRC2 編碼 cIAP1，是 cIAPs 配對中的主力次單元；11q22 的 BIRC2/BIRC3 擴增標記出抗凋亡的致癌腫瘤與骨髓瘤，而代償性的 cIAP2 上調加上 RIPK3 靜默會削弱 Smac-mimetic 的效力。

context.en-US: While BIRC2/cIAP1 is intact, Ripoptosome assembly is suppressed; its loss removes the survival signal and licenses spontaneous ripoptosome formation, making cIAP status the switch that decides whether TNFR1 signaling ends in survival or death.
context.zh-TW: 當 BIRC2/cIAP1 完整時，Ripoptosome 的組裝受到抑制；其喪失會移除存活訊號並使自發性 ripoptosome 形成得以發生，因此 cIAP 狀態是決定 TNFR1 訊號走向存活或死亡的開關。

context.en-US: BMAL1 (ARNTL) is a core component of the mammalian circadian clock that heterodimerizes with CLOCK to bind E-box elements and drive transcription of clock-controlled genes; SIRT1 amplifies BMAL1 and CLOCK expression by deacetylating PGC-1α.
context.zh-TW: BMAL1（ARNTL）是哺乳類晝夜節律時鐘的核心成分，與 CLOCK 形成異二聚體結合 E-box 元素並驅動時鐘受控基因的轉錄；SIRT1 則透過去乙醯化 PGC-1α 來放大 BMAL1 與 CLOCK 的表現。

context.en-US: A key transcriptional target of the BMAL1-CLOCK complex is NAMPT, the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway; rhythmic NAMPT expression gates the circadian oscillation of NAD+, which in turn sets the timing of SIRT1 activation.
context.zh-TW: BMAL1-CLOCK 複合體的關鍵轉錄標的是 NAMPT，也就是 NAD+ 回收途徑的限速酵素；NAMPT 的節律性表現塑造 NAD+ 的晝夜振盪，進而決定 SIRT1 活化的時序。

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates BMAL1, coupling cellular metabolic state (NAD+ availability) to circadian gene expression and forming a closed SIRT1-BMAL1/CLOCK-NAMPT loop; age-related SIRT1 decline disrupts this loop, generating circadian NAD+ oscillations that gate SIRT1 across the day.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化並活化 BMAL1，將細胞代謝狀態（NAD+ 可用性）與晝夜節律基因表現耦合，形成 SIRT1-BMAL1/CLOCK-NAMPT 的封閉迴路；SIRT1 隨年齡下降會破壞此迴路，而由 BMAL1 驅動的晝夜 NAD+ 振盪則在一天之中為 SIRT1 活性設定閘門。

context.en-US: BMP is a large subfamily of secreted growth factors within the TGFβ superfamily; synthesized as precursors and cleaved to mature C-terminal dimers stabilized by an intramolecular cystine knot, BMPs signal through type I/II serine-threonine kinase receptors to form morphogen gradients.
context.zh-TW: BMP 是 TGFβ 超家族中一大分泌型生長因子亞家族；它們先以前驅物合成，再被切割釋出由分子內 cystine knot 穩定的 C 端成熟二聚體，並透過第一型／第二型絲胺酸－蘇胺酸激酶受體傳訊，形成形態發生的濃度梯度。

context.en-US: BMP acts as a beneficial developmental SASP factor: programmed senescence during embryogenesis releases BMPs alongside Matrix Metalloproteinase and IGFBP5, contributing to patterning and growth; BMP signaling cooperates with developmental Senescence programs during morphogenesis and tissue remodeling.
context.zh-TW: BMP 是具益處的發育型 SASP 因子：胚胎發育期間的程式性衰老會連同 Matrix Metalloproteinase 與 IGFBP5 一起釋放 BMP，參與圖式形成與生長；BMP 訊號在形態發生與組織重塑期間與發育性 Senescence 程式協同作用。

context.en-US: On ligand binding, BMP receptors phosphorylate receptor-regulated SMAD1/5/8, which complex with SMAD4 and translocate to the nucleus to regulate transcription — the canonical BMP pathway; BMP also signals non-canonically through MAPK (p38, ERK) and is antagonized extracellularly by noggin, chordin and gremlin.
context.zh-TW: 配體結合後，BMP 受體會磷酸化受體調節型 SMAD1/5/8，後者與 SMAD4 形成複合體並轉位入核調控轉錄，即典型 BMP 途徑；BMP 亦透過 MAPK（p38、ERK）進行非典型訊號傳遞，並受 noggin、chordin 與 gremlin 在細胞外拮抗。

context.en-US: BNIP3 is a BH3-only outer mitochondrial membrane protein that directly binds LC3 through its LIR motif, acting as a receptor for ubiquitin-independent Mitophagy and triggering selective clearance of mitochondria independently of the PINK1/Parkin route.
context.zh-TW: BNIP3 是 BH3-only 次家族的粒線體外膜蛋白，透過其 LIR motif 直接結合 LC3，作為不依賴泛素的 Mitophagy 受體，獨立於 PINK1/Parkin 途徑觸發粒線體的選擇性清除。

context.en-US: Under hypoxic or ischemic stress, HIF-1α transcriptionally activates BNIP3 in neurons; BNIP3 then inserts into the mitochondrial membrane, causing loss of mitochondrial membrane potential and opening of the Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore, producing delayed neuronal death that BNIP3 knockout rescues.
context.zh-TW: 在缺氧或缺血壓力下，HIF-1α 於神經元中轉錄活化 BNIP3；BNIP3 隨後嵌入粒線體膜，造成粒線體膜電位喪失與 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟，引發延遲性神經元死亡，而 BNIP3 敲除可挽救此現象。

context.en-US: BNIP3 interacts with OPA1 to induce mitochondrial fragmentation and with DRP1 to facilitate fission, so the mitophagy receptor is mechanically coupled to the fusion/fission machinery; excessive or prolonged BNIP3 activation instead disrupts neuronal energy metabolism and triggers Apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: BNIP3 與 OPA1 互動以誘導粒線體片段化，並與 DRP1 互動以促進分裂，使此自噬受體在機制上與融合／分裂機制相連；過度或長期的 BNIP3 活化則反而破壞神經元能量代謝並觸發 Apoptosis。

context.en-US: BNIP3L (NIX) is a hypoxia-inducible outer mitochondrial membrane mitophagy receptor whose LIR motif binds LC3 on the phagophore; because it acts without ubiquitination, BNIP3L-mediated mitophagy is independent of PINK1 and Parkin and can compensate for loss of those pathways in Parkinson's Disease.
context.zh-TW: BNIP3L（NIX）是缺氧誘導的粒線體外膜自噬受體，其 LIR motif 結合吞噬膜上的 LC3；由於不需泛素化，BNIP3L 介導的 Mitophagy 獨立於 PINK1 與 Parkin，並可在 Parkinson's Disease 中補償這些途徑的喪失。

context.en-US: BNIP3L expression is transcriptionally upregulated under hypoxia through HIF-1α stabilization, linking oxygen sensing to mitophagy induction; the same induction occurs in erythroid precursors, where BNIP3L drives programmed mitochondrial elimination during erythroblast maturation, and NIX knockout mice develop anemia.
context.zh-TW: BNIP3L 的表現在缺氧下經由 HIF-1α 穩定化而轉錄上調，將氧氣感測連結到自噬誘導；同樣的誘導也發生在紅血球前驅細胞，BNIP3L 在此驅動紅血球母細胞成熟時的程式性粒線體消除，而 NIX 敲除小鼠會出現貧血。

context.en-US: BRAF is a serine/threonine kinase in the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade that phosphorylates MEK1/2, which then activates ERK1/2 to regulate Cell Proliferation, Differentiation and Survival; the BRAF V600E mutation constitutively activates this kinase activity in ~50% of Melanoma.
context.zh-TW: BRAF 是 RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK 串聯中的絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶，會磷酸化 MEK1/2，後者再活化 ERK1/2 以調節 Cell Proliferation、Differentiation 與 Survival；BRAF V600E 突變使此激酶活性持續活化，見於約 50% 的 Melanoma。

context.en-US: RAS is the upstream activator that relieves BRAF inhibition and engages the RAF-MEK-ERK cascade; BRAF inhibitors such as Vemurafenib and Dabrafenib are approved for BRAF-mutant melanoma and are combined with MEK inhibitors to improve response and reduce resistance.
context.zh-TW: RAS 是上游活化因子，可解除對 BRAF 的抑制並啟動 RAF-MEK-ERK 串聯；如 Vemurafenib 與 Dabrafenib 等 BRAF 抑制劑已獲准用於 BRAF 突變型 Melanoma，並常與 MEK 抑制劑合併以提升反應率並降低抗藥性。

context.en-US: The BRAF V600E driver mutation occurs in roughly half of Melanoma and also in Colorectal Cancer, Thyroid Cancer, non-small-cell lung cancer and Langerhans cell histiocytosis, making BRAF status a defining molecular feature of these tumors and a validated drug target.
context.zh-TW: BRAF V600E 這個驅動突變出現於約半數的 Melanoma，也見於大腸癌、甲狀腺癌、非小細胞肺癌與朗格漢斯細胞組織球增生症，使 BRAF 狀態成為這些腫瘤的定義性分子特徵並成為已驗證的藥物標的。

context.en-US: BRCA2 is the Tumor Suppressor protein that loads RAD51 onto single-stranded DNA at resected Double-Strand Breaks, enabling strand exchange during Homologous Recombination; with BRCA1 and PALB2 it forms a complex essential for genome maintenance through DNA Repair.
context.zh-TW: BRCA2 是將 RAD51 載 onto 切除後的 Double-Strand Breaks 所產生的單股 DNA 上的 Tumor Suppressor 蛋白，使 Homologous Recombination 過程中的股交換得以進行；它與 BRCA1 及 PALB2 共同形成對透過 DNA Repair 維持基因體完整性所必需的複合體。

context.en-US: PARP inhibitors exploit synthetic lethality in BRCA2-deficient tumors, which depend on PARP-mediated repair of single-strand lesions and cannot tolerate its loss; germline BRCA2 mutations confer high lifetime risk for Breast Cancer, ovarian cancer, Pancreatic Cancer, Prostate Cancer and Melanoma.
context.zh-TW: PARP inhibitors 藉由合成致死在 BRCA2 缺乏的腫瘤中發揮作用——這類腫瘤依賴 PARP 介導的單股損傷修復而無法承受其喪失；BRCA2 的種系突變則帶有 Breast Cancer、ovarian cancer、Pancreatic Cancer、Prostate Cancer 與 Melanoma 的高終生風險。

context.en-US: BRCA2 is a classical Tumor Suppressor whose loss disables double-strand break repair by homologous recombination; because the pathway is cell-cycle regulated and mostly active in S/G2, loss is tolerated in slow-growing tissue but lethal in proliferating cells.
context.zh-TW: BRCA2 是典型的 Tumor Suppressor，其喪失會使經由同源重組的雙股斷裂修復失效；由於該途徑受細胞週期調控且主要在 S/G2 期活躍，BRCA2 喪失在緩慢生長的組織中尚可耐受，但在增殖細胞中則是致死的。

context.en-US: BRG1 powers Nucleosome Remodeling as the ATPase engine of SWI-SNF; SMARCA4 loss defines small-cell carcinoma of the ovary (hypercalcemic type) and subsets of non-small-cell lung cancer, and sensitizes them to EZH2 and CDK4/6 inhibition.
context.zh-TW: BRG1 作為 SWI-SNF 的 ATPase 引擎驅動 Nucleosome Remodeling；SMARCA4 喪失定義了卵巢小細胞癌（高血鈣型）與部分非小細胞肺癌，並使這些腫瘤對 EZH2 與 CDK4/6 抑制更加敏感。

context.en-US: Gut Bacteroidetes ferment dietary fiber, resistant starch and host glycans that host enzymes cannot digest into Short-chain Fatty Acids — principally acetate and propionate — plus succinate; these metabolites nourish colonocytes, modulate hepatic lipid metabolism, and engage enteroendocrine and immune cells.
context.zh-TW: 腸道 Bacteroidetes 會將宿主酵素無法消化的膳食纖維、抗性澱粉與宿主聚醣發酵成 Short-chain Fatty Acids（主要是乙酸與丙酸）以及琥珀酸；這些代謝物滋養結腸細胞、調節肝臟脂質代謝，並與腸泌神經細胞及免疫細胞互動。

context.en-US: Bacteroidetes is a major phylum of Gram-Negative Bacteria — typically non-spore-forming rods that are obligate or facultative anaerobes — distinguished from Firmicutes by cell-wall architecture and a lipopolysaccharide-rich outer membrane; Bacteroides and Prevotella dominate the human Gut Microbiome.
context.zh-TW: Bacteroidetes 是 Gram-Negative Bacteria 的一個主要門類——典型為不形成芽孢的桿菌，專性或兼性厭氧——並在細胞壁架構與富含脂多醣的外膜上與 Firmicutes 區隔；Bacteroides 與 Prevotella 在人類 Gut Microbiome 中佔優勢。

context.en-US: The Bacteroidetes-to-Firmicutes ratio is a widely used, if debated, marker of gut community structure in aging, and Bacteroidetes taxa are recurrently profiled in studies linking the Gut Microbiome to Longevity; dietary Nicotinamide Riboside and related NAD+ precursors have been reported to modulate Bacteroidetes abundance, suggesting host metabolic–microbial crosstalk.
context.zh-TW: Bacteroidetes 與 Firmicutes 的比例是評估老化時腸道群落結構的常用（但有爭議的）指標，而 Bacteroidetes 類群在連結 Gut Microbiome 與 Longevity 的研究中反覆被檢測；膳食Nicotinamide Riboside 及相關 NAD+ 前驅物被報告可調整 Bacteroidetes 的豐度，顯示宿主代謝與微生物的交互作用。

context.en-US: Bacteroidetes are among the dominant constituents of the human Gut Microbiome, where they help maintain the intestinal barrier against pathogens through competitive colonization resistance; when translocated, members such as Bacteroides fragilis can cause intra-abdominal abscesses and sepsis.
context.zh-TW: Bacteroidetes 是人類 Gut Microbiome 的主要組成成員之一，並藉由競爭性定殖抗性協助維持腸道屏障對病原菌的防禦；當發生轉位時，Bacteroides fragilis 等成員可造成腹腔內膿腫與敗血症。

context.en-US: Loss of the negative immune regulators that hold T Cell in a quiescent state makes T cells hypersensitive to activation signals, decreasing self-tolerance and thereby increasing Autoimmune Disease; quiescence is thus an active brake on autoimmunity rather than passive inactivity.
context.zh-TW: 喪失使 T Cell 維持在靜止狀態的負向免疫調節因子，會讓 T 細胞對活化訊號過度敏感，降低自身耐受性並因而增加 Autoimmune Disease；因此靜止狀態是抑制自體免疫的主動煞車，而非被動的不活動。

context.en-US: CXCL3 (GROγ/MIP-2β) is the third member of the ELR+ growth-regulated oncogene cluster and signals through CXCR2 at high affinity, with CXCR1 engaged only weakly. Receptor engagement activates Gαi → PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+, PI3K/Akt and p38 MAPK/ERK cascades, and CXCL3 is a conserved component of the SASP, completing the core ELR+ CXC chemokine cluster with CXCL1 and CXCL2. Because senescent cells secrete CXCL3 and bystander cells express CXCR2, this axis forms a feed-forward loop that reinforces senescence and spreads the phenotype paracrine through tissue.
context.zh-TW: CXCL3（GROγ/MIP-2β）是 ELR+ growth-regulated oncogene 群聚的第三個成員，以高親和力結合 CXCR2，而對 CXCR1 的親和力較弱。受體活化後啟動 Gαi → PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+、PI3K/Akt 與 p38 MAPK/ERK 級聯反應；CXCL3 亦是 SASP 的保守成分，與 CXCL1、CXCL2 共同構成核心 ELR+ CXC 趨化因子群。由於衰老細胞會分泌 CXCL3，而旁觀細胞表現 CXCR2，此軸形成前饋迴路，強化衰老並以旁分泌方式在組織中擴散該表型。

context.en-US: CXCL3 acts as a neutrophil chemoattractant, driving chemotaxis, degranulation and ROS generation in recruited neutrophils. In the liver and pancreas, senescent activated stellate cells secrete CXCL3 to sustain the neutrophilic inflammatory infiltrate implicated in fibrogenesis, which is why CXCR2 antagonists are being evaluated to dampen SASP-driven inflammation and senescence spread. Chronically, this supports inflammaging and tissue dysfunction, although acutely it helps clear damaged cells.
context.zh-TW: CXCL3 作為嗜中性球趨化因子，可驅動被招募嗜中性球的趨化、脫顆粒與 ROS 生成。在肝臟與胰臟中，衰老的活化星狀細胞分泌 CXCL3，以維持與纖維化生成相關的嗜中性球發炎浸潤；因此 CXCR2 拮抗劑正被評估用於抑制 SASP 驅動的發炎與衰老擴散。長期而言，此路徑助長 inflammaging 與組織功能失調，儘管短暫來看它有助於清除受損細胞。

context.en-US: CXCL5 (ENA-78) is an ELR+ C-X-C chemokine that engages CXCR2 with high affinity and CXCR1 only weakly, activating Gαi-coupled PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+, PI3K/Akt and p38 MAPK/ERK signaling. It is a SASP component co-induced with CXCL1, CXCL2 and CXCL3 in senescent cells and recruits neutrophils; in reproductive aging, blastocysts derived from aged oocytes secrete CXCL5, which is detrimental to pre-implantation embryo development.
context.zh-TW: CXCL5（ENA-78）是 ELR+ C-X-C 趨化因子，以高親和力結合 CXCR2，對 CXCR1 親和力較弱，啟動 Gαi 偶聯的 PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+、PI3K/Akt 與 p38 MAPK/ERK 訊號。它是 SASP 成分，在衰老細胞中與 CXCL1、CXCL2、CXCL3 共同被誘導，並招募嗜中性球；在生殖老化情境中，來自老化卵母細胞的囊胚會分泌 CXCL5，對著床前胚胎發育造成不利影響。

context.en-US: CXCR2 is the dominant receptor for the ELR+ C-X-C chemokines (CXCL1-3, CXCL5, IL-8) and is the node through which the neutrophil-directed arm of the SASP acts. Senescent cells secrete IL-8/CXCL1-3 that signal back through CXCR2 in an autocrine/paracrine manner, sustaining senescent growth arrest and amplifying the SASP — a feed-forward loop — and factors from one senescent cell engaging CXCR2 on neighbours drive bystander senescence. Chronic CXCR2 signaling sustains inflammaging, and antagonists such as navarixin and AZD5069 are in trials.
context.zh-TW: CXCR2 是 ELR+ C-X-C 趨化因子（CXCL1-3、CXCL5、IL-8）的主要受體，也是 SASP 中嗜中性球導向分支的作用節點。衰老細胞分泌 IL-8/CXCL1-3，經由 CXCR2 以自分泌／旁分泌方式回饋，維持衰老的生長阻滯並放大 SASP，形成前饋迴路；而某個衰老細胞釋出的因子作用在鄰近細胞的 CXCR2 上，則驅動旁觀者衰老。慢性 CXCR2 訊號會維持 inflammaging，navarixin 與 AZD5069 等拮抗劑已進入臨床試驗。

context.en-US: CXCR3 (CD183) is the G-protein-coupled receptor for the ELR− interferon-inducible chemokines CXCL9, CXCL10 (IP-10) and CXCL11 (I-TAC), with CXCL11 binding at highest affinity. These ligands are induced by type I/II interferons via JAK/STAT1 and by NF-κB, and receptor engagement activates PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK/ERK and Ca2+ flux to drive polarized chemotaxis and inside-out integrin activation. CXCR3 is constitutively high on Th1 and CD8+ T cells and NK cells.
context.zh-TW: CXCR3（CD183）是 ELR− 干擾素誘導型趨化因子 CXCL9、CXCL10（IP-10）與 CXCL11（I-TAC）的 G 蛋白偶聯受體，其中 CXCL11 的結合親和力最高。這些配體由 I 型／II 型干擾素經 JAK/STAT1 以及 NF-κB 誘導；受體接合後活化 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ flux，驅動極化趨化與 inside-out 型整合素活化。CXCR3 在 Th1 與 CD8+ T 細胞及 NK 細胞上持續高表現。

context.en-US: CXCR4 (CD184) is the primary GPCR for CXCL12 (SDF-1) and governs hematopoietic stem cell homing, angiogenesis, metastasis and immune cell trafficking. CellChat analysis of senescent endothelial cells showed CXCR4 mRNA rising with aging while functional Cxcl12-Cxcr4 interaction strength fell, shifting the balance toward ACKR3 signaling; this defective intercellular communication may contribute to age-related endothelial dysfunction. Fisetin restored both signaling patterns to young-like levels.
context.zh-TW: CXCR4（CD184）是 CXCL12（SDF-1）的主要 GPCR，調控造血幹細胞歸巢、血管生成、轉移與免疫細胞運輸。對衰老內皮細胞的 CellChat 分析顯示，隨老化 CXCR4 mRNA 上升，但功能性 Cxcl12-Cxcr4 交互作用強度下降，使訊號平衡轉向 ACKR3；這種細胞間溝通缺陷可能促成與年齡相關的內皮功能失調。Fisetin 將兩種訊號模式皆恢復至近似年輕的狀態。

context.en-US: CZ-48 (sulfo-ara-F-NMN) is a cell-permeant NMN analog that acts as an NMN mimetic binding the SARM1 ARM domain, relieving autoinhibition and driving NADase activation. Activated SARM1 produces cyclic ADP-ribose, depletes NAD+ and ATP, and induces non-apoptotic cell death. CZ-48 is the only known molecule with opposite effects on the two principal NAD+ glycohydrolases: it activates SARM1 while inhibiting CD38, pharmacologically separating two enzymes that share substrate and products.
context.zh-TW: CZ-48（sulfo-ara-F-NMN）是可穿透細胞膜的 NMN 類似物，作為 NMN 擬態結合 SARM1 的 ARM 結構域，解除其自體抑制並驅動 NADase 活化。活化的 SARM1 會產生環腺苷二磷酸核糖（cADPR），耗竭 NAD+ 與 ATP，並誘發非凋亡性細胞死亡。CZ-48 是已知唯一對兩種主要 NAD+ 糖苷水解酶作用相反的分子：它活化 SARM1 卻抑制 CD38， pharmacological 上將這兩個共享底物與產物的酵素區分開來。

context.en-US: Whereas CZ-48 activates SARM1, it inhibits the ecto-enzymatic NADase activity of CD38, reducing extracellular NAD+/NMN consumption. This pharmacological divergence is proof of concept that the two NADases can be separated despite sharing the NAD+ substrate and the same products, and it underpins the NMN-sensitization paradox: raising NMN/NAD+ precursors to inhibit CD38 and feed sirtuins could in principle sensitize SARM1, the tension addressed by combined CD38 + SARM1 inhibition.
context.zh-TW: CZ-48 雖然活化 SARM1，卻會抑制 CD38 的胞外 NADase 活性，降低胞外 NAD+/NMN 的消耗。這種藥理學上的分歧證明了兩個 NADase 雖共享 NAD+ 底物與相同產物仍可被區分開來，也是 NMN 敏化悖論的基礎：為了抑制 CD38 並供應 sirtuin 而提高 NMN/NAD+ 前驅物，原則上可能反而使 SARM1 敏化；此張力正是 CD38 與 SARM1 聯合抑制所要處理的問題。

context.en-US: Cachexia is a metabolic syndrome of involuntary skeletal muscle and adipose loss that nutritional support cannot fully reverse, driven by catabolic inflammation (TNF-α, IL-6) through NF-κB/STAT signaling with impaired mTORC1. NAD+ deficiency is implicated in both cancer- and chemotherapy-induced cachexia, with repletion (e.g. niacin) therapeutic in both settings; Nrk2 downregulation alongside skeletal muscle NAD+ loss is an early robust signature, with cisplatin producing the most severe phenotype.
context.zh-TW: Cachexia 是一種無法單靠營養支持完全逆轉的代謝症候群，表現為骨骼肌與脂肪的非自願性流失，由促分解的發炎（TNF-α、IL-6）經 NF-κB/STAT 訊號並伴隨 mTORC1 受损所驅動。NAD+ 缺乏同時涉入癌症引發與化療引發的 cachexia，補充 NAD+（如菸酸）在兩種情境中都具治療效果；Nrk2 下調並伴隨骨骼肌 NAD+ 流失是早期且穩健的特徵，其中 cisplatin 造成最嚴重的表型。

context.en-US: Calcium signaling — the spatiotemporal regulation of intracellular calcium — influences mitochondrial dynamics most importantly at the ER–mitochondria interface (MAMs), where calcium is transferred from the endoplasmic reticulum to mitochondria. Calcium flux at MAMs and calcium-dependent inner-membrane constriction modulate the constrictive machinery executing fission, with INF2 and actin mediating ER-initiated fission. By shifting the fusion/fission equilibrium, calcium signaling integrates ER stress, bioenergetic demand and organelle morphology, and dysregulated handling at MAMs is implicated in neurodegeneration and metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: 鈣訊號（細胞內鈣濃度的時空調控）對粒線體動態學的影響最集中於內質網—粒線體介面（MAMs），鈣離子在此由內質網轉移至粒線體。MAMs 處的鈣flux 與依賴鈣的內膜收縮會調節執行分裂的收縮機構，其中 INF2 與肌動蛋白介導由內質網發起的分裂。藉由改變融合／分裂平衡，鈣訊號整合了內質網壓力、能量需求與胞器形態，而 MAMs 處鈣處理失調與神經退化及代謝疾病有關。

context.en-US: Ca2+ overload is the sustained rise of cytosolic free calcium from ~100 nM toward micromolar levels after ATP-dependent extrusion fails, via reverse-mode Na+/Ca2+ exchange, voltage-gated channels and ER release. It is a point-of-no-return intermediate in necrosis: calcium activates calpain cysteine proteases, opens the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, stimulates phospholipases and loads mitochondria until membrane potential collapses. Calcium chelation protects renal ischemia-reperfusion and H2O2 models but not MNNG parthanatos, making the step context-obligatory rather than universal.
context.zh-TW: Ca2+ overload 是 ATP 依賴性排出失效後，經由 Na+/Ca2+ 交換體反向模式、電壓閘控通道與內質網釋放，使胞質游離鈣由約 100 nM 上升至微莫耳濃度。它是壞死過程中無法回頭的中間步驟：鈣會活化 calpain 半胱胺酸蛋白酶、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔、刺激磷脂酶並使粒線體負載鈣，直至膜電位崩潰。鈣螯合可保護腎臟缺血再灌流與 H2O2 模型，但無法保護 MNNG 引發的 parthanatos，顯示此步驟依情境而定並非普遍必要。

context.en-US: Calpain-2 (m-calpain; CAPN2 with CAPNS1) is a millimolar-Ca2+-dependent cytosolic cysteine protease that acts as the motility effector of the pro-survival Caspase-8 state. Src-family-phosphorylated Caspase-8 scaffolds FAK–Calpain-2–PI3K complexes at focal adhesions, where localized Calpain-2 cleaves talin, vinculin and FAK itself, accelerating adhesion disassembly/reassembly cycles that power mesenchymal migration. Adhesion turnover feeds PI3K/AKT and ERK signaling, creating a feed-forward migration–survival loop in colon cancer and glioblastoma; the same pY-Caspase-8 switch therefore makes Calpain-2 a downstream target of Src inhibition.
context.zh-TW: Calpain-2（m-calpain；CAPN2 搭配 CAPNS1）是毫莫耳 Ca2+ 依賴的胞質半胱胺酸蛋白酶，作為促存活型 Caspase-8 狀態的運動效應器。被 Src 家族磷酸化的 Caspase-8 在焦點黏附處支架化 FAK–Calpain-2–PI3K 複合體，局部化的 Calpain-2 切割 talin、vinculin 與 FAK 本身，加速黏附解體／重組循環以驅動間質細胞遷移。黏附周轉再回饋 PI3K/AKT 與 ERK 訊號，在大腸癌與膠質母細胞瘤中形成遷移—存活的正饋迴路；因此同一個 pY-Caspase-8 轉換使 Calpain-2 成為 Src 抑制的下游標的。

context.en-US: Canakinumab (Ilaris) is a human monoclonal antibody that binds free IL-1β with high affinity and prevents it from engaging the IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP complex, without affecting IL-1α or other IL-1 family members — making it more selective than anakinra, which blocks both ligands. By neutralizing extracellular IL-1β it inhibits MyD88-dependent signaling, reducing NF-κB activation and transcription of IL-6, TNFα and COX-2. The long-acting antibody (half-life ~26 days) is dosed subcutaneously and is degraded proteolytically without CYP-mediated metabolism.
context.zh-TW: Canakinumab（Ilaris）是一種人類單株抗體，以高親和力結合游離 IL-1β，阻止其與 IL-1R1/IL-1RAcP 受體複合體接合，且不影響 IL-1α 或其他 IL-1 家族成員——因此比同時阻斷兩者的 anakinra 更具選擇性。藉由中和胞外 IL-1β，它抑制 MyD88 依賴的訊號，減少 NF-κB 活化以及 IL-6、TNFα、COX-2 的轉錄。此長效抗體（半衰期約 26 天）以皮下注射給藥，經蛋白水解分解代謝，不經 CYP 代謝。

context.en-US: The CANTOS Trial gave the first clinical proof that targeting inflammation alone, independent of lipid lowering, reduces cardiovascular events: in 10,061 patients with prior myocardial infarction and hs-CRP ≥ 2 mg/L, canakinumab 150 mg every 3 months cut the composite of nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke or cardiovascular death (HR 0.85, p=0.021), cut hs-CRP ~37% and IL-6 ~28%, while LDL cholesterol was not reduced. Because IL-1β links oxidative stress to inflammation, attenuating it with canakinumab also dampens inflammaging.
context.zh-TW: CANTOS Trial 首次在臨床上證明：僅針對發炎本身（獨立於降脂）即可降低心血管事件。在 10,061 名有心肌梗塞病史且 hs-CRP ≥ 2 mg/L 的患者中，每 3 個月 150 mg 的 canakinumab 使非致死性 MI、非致死性中風或心血管死亡的複合終點下降（HR 0.85，p=0.021），hs-CRP 下降約 37%、IL-6 下降約 28%，而 LDL 膽固醇並未下降。由於 IL-1β 連結了氧化壓力與發炎，以 canakinumab 阻斷 IL-1β 同時也減輕 inflammaging。

context.en-US: Cardiolipin is a diphosphatidylglycerol lipid almost exclusively localized to the inner mitochondrial membrane, where it stabilizes ETC supercomplexes and contributes to the membrane potential. During mitochondrial dysfunction, ROS oxidizes cardiolipin, which translocates to the outer membrane or is released on mPTP opening; cytosolic oxidized cardiolipin then binds and activates NLRP3, which recruits ASC and Caspase-1 to cleave pro-IL-1β. Cardiolipin is thus a key endogenous DAMP bridging mitochondrial damage to sterile inflammation and NLRP3-driven inflammaging.
context.zh-TW: Cardiolipin 是一種幾乎專一存在於粒線體內膜的雙磷酸甘油酯脂質，在該處穩定 ETC 超複合體並貢獻於膜電位。發生粒線體功能障礙時，ROS 會氧化 cardiolipin，使其轉位至外膜或於 mPTP 開啟時釋出；隨後胞質中的氧化 cardiolipin 結合並活化 NLRP3，NLRP3 再招募 ASC 與 Caspase-1 以切割 pro-IL-1β。因此 cardiolipin 是連結粒線體損傷與無菌性發炎、以及 NLRP3 驅動之 inflammaging 的重要內源性 DAMP。

context.en-US: Cardiolipin is an obligate cofactor for inner-membrane fusion: L-OPA1 binds cardiolipin on liposomes and GTP hydrolysis by OPA1 drives fusion, and removing cardiolipin abolishes fusion even when L-OPA1 is present on both membranes. Cardiolipin also interacts with DRP1 to stimulate its oligomerization and GTPase activity, promoting fission, so the same lipid bidirectionally regulates mitochondrial dynamics. It is additionally required for mitophagy receptor recruitment.
context.zh-TW: Cardiolipin 是內膜融合的必需輔因子：L-OPA1 在脂質體上結合 cardiolipin，OPA1 的 GTP 水解驅動融合；即使兩側膜上都有 L-OPA1，只要移除 cardiolipin 融合即被廢除。Cardiolipin 也與 DRP1 互動以促進其寡聚化與 GTPase 活性而促進分裂，因此同一種脂質對粒線體動態學具有雙向調控作用。它同時也是 mitophagy 受體招募所必需。

context.en-US: Carmofur (1-hexylcarbamoyl-5-fluorouracil, HCFU) is a 5-fluorouracil prodrug approved in Japan since 1981 for colorectal cancer, but its key pharmacological action is covalent carbamoylation of the catalytic Cys143 of acid ceramidase (IC50 29 nM on rat recombinant enzyme, ~100 nM cellular), a property underlying its anti-proliferative effect and distinct from 5-FU. It also inhibits FAAH, NAAA and SARS-CoV-2 Mpro, and its BBB penetration plus glioblastoma stem-like cell killing (IC50 11-104 µM, >50-fold more potent than temozolomide) supports repurposing as a senolytic candidate.
context.zh-TW: Carmofur（1-hexylcarbamoyl-5-fluorouracil，HCFU）是 1981 年起在日本獲准用於大腸癌的 5-氟尿嘧啶前驅物，但其關鍵藥理作用是對 acid ceramidase 催化位 Cys143 的共價氨甲醯化（鼠重組酵素 IC50 為 29 nM，細胞層級約 100 nM），此性質構成其抗增殖作用的基礎，與 5-FU 的作用不同。它同時抑制 FAAH、NAAA 與 SARS-CoV-2 Mpro；其血腦障壁穿透能力加上對神經膠母細胞瘤幹樣細胞的殺傷（IC50 11–104 µM，效力比 temozolomide 強逾 50 倍），支持其作為 senolytic 候選藥物的再利用。

context.en-US: Catalase is a tetrameric heme-containing enzyme (each ~60 kDa subunit with a ferriprotoporphyrin IX active site, CAT gene at 11p13) that decomposes Hydrogen Peroxide via a two-step peroxidatic cycle: Fe3+ heme reacts with H2O2 to form oxyferryl Compound I plus water, then a second H2O2 donates two electrons, regenerating the resting enzyme and releasing O2. Overall 2H2O2 → 2H2O + O2 with a near-diffusion-limited kcat of ~10^7 s-1, it uses H2O2 as both oxidant and reductant and needs no NADPH or glutathione, and it also shows peroxidatic activity on ethanol, methanol and nitrite.
context.zh-TW: Catalase 是一種四聚體血基質酵素（每個約 60 kDa 次單元含 ferriprotoporphyrin IX 活性位，CAT 基因位於 11p13），透過兩步的過氧化循環分解 Hydrogen Peroxide：Fe3+ 血基質與 H2O2 反應生成氧鐵牴基 Complex I 與水，接著第二個 H2O2 供給兩個電子，回復靜止態酵素並釋出 O2。總反應為 2H2O2 → 2H2O + O2，kcat 約 10^7 s-1、接近擴散極限；它以 H2O2 同時作為氧化劑與還原劑，不需 NADPH 或穀胱甘肽，並對乙醇、甲醇與亞硝酸鹽呈現過氧化酶活性。

context.en-US: Within the mitohormesis framework, mild increases in mitochondrial ROS act as an adaptive signal that upregulates catalase expression, raising antioxidant capacity and protecting against subsequent, more severe oxidative insults. Catalase cooperates with mitochondrial SOD2 (MnSOD) as a coordinated antioxidant network, and catalase overexpression in mitochondria-targeted MCAT mice extends median lifespan ~20% with delayed cardiac and cataract pathology — evidence that mitochondrial H2O2 contributes directly to aging.
context.zh-TW: 在 mitohormesis 框架下，粒線體 ROS 的輕度上升作為適應性訊號，上調 catalase 表現、提高抗氧化能力，以抵抗後續更嚴重的氧化傷害。Catalase 與粒線體 SOD2（MnSOD）協同構成協調的抗氧化網絡；而在粒線體靶向的 MCAT 小鼠中過量表現人類 catalase 可使中位壽命延長約 20%，並延緩心臟與白內障病變——顯示粒線體 H2O2 直接促成老化。

context.en-US: Catalase activity is reduced by glycation: intracellular accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products impairs the enzyme's function, raising cellular oxidative stress and contributing to the Aging process. Additional inactivation comes from oxidation of critical cysteine residues and proteolytic cleavage, and ROS-mediated damage to catalase creates a feed-forward loop in which oxidative stress further impairs antioxidant capacity. Loss of function causes acatalasemia (Takahara's disease), most frequent in Japanese and Korean populations.
context.zh-TW: Catalase 活性會被糖化抑制：細胞內 Advanced Glycation End Products 的累積會損害此酵素功能，升高細胞氧化壓力並促成 Aging 過程。其他失活來源還包括關鍵半胱胺酸殘基的氧化與蛋白水解切割，而 ROS 對 catalase 的損傷會形成正饋迴路，使氧化壓力進一步削弱抗氧化能力。功能喪失會造成 acatalasemia（Takahara's disease），在日本人與韓國人群中最為常見。

context.en-US: Carnosine (beta-alanyl-L-histidine) is a dipeptide concentrated in muscle and brain with antioxidant, pH-buffering and anti-glycation activity. In the Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield strategy it acts as a synergist for metal chelation and AGE inhibition, stabilizing the proteostatic environment against oxidative damage to the extracellular matrix, alongside aminoguanidine and the autophagy inducer spermidine — the GOPS protocol pairing a carnosine-stabilized adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine hybrid with spermidine-driven autophagy.
context.zh-TW: Carnosine（beta-alanyl-L-histidine）是高度濃縮於肌肉與腦部的二胜肽，具有抗氧化、pH 緩衝與抗糖化活性。在 Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield 策略中，它作為金屬螯合與 AGE 抑制的協同劑，與 aminoguanidine 及自噬誘導物 spermidine 一同穩定蛋白質穩態環境、對抗細胞外基質的氧化損傷——GOPS 方案 以 carnosine 穩定的 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 雜交分子搭配 spermidine 驅動的自噬。

context.en-US: Caloric Restriction elevates NAD+ levels (or the NAD+/NADH ratio), which directly enhances the deacetylase activity of SIRT1 — one of the sirtuins it upregulates, alongside SIRT3, while downregulating SIRT4. Activated SIRT1 deacetylates histones to tighten chromatin into heterochromatin, silences pro-inflammatory and pro-senescence genes including p16INK4a, suppresses NF-κB, deacetylates PGC-1α to drive mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative phosphorylation, and promotes fat mobilization via the PPAR-γ/NCoR/SMRT axis. Because CR-mediated lifespan extension requires SIR2 in yeast, sirtuins are central — though not exclusive — mediators, since TOR acts as a sirtuin-independent route.
context.zh-TW: Caloric Restriction 會提高 NAD+ 濃度（或 NAD+/NADH 比值），直接提升 SIRT1 的去乙醯化酶活性——SIRT1 是 CR 上調的 sirtuin 之一（同時也上調 SIRT3、下調 SIRT4）。活化的 SIRT1 對組蛋白去乙醯化，使染色質緊密形成異染色質，沉默包括 p16INK4a 在內的促發炎與促衰老基因，抑制 NF-κB，並對 PGC-1α 去乙醯化以驅動粒線體生物新生與氧化磷酸化，經 PPAR-γ/NCoR/SMRT 軸促進脂肪動員。由於 CR 介導的壽命延長在酵母中需要 SIR2，sirtuin 是（但非唯一）核心介導者，因為 TOR 提供 sirtuin 非依賴的途徑。

context.en-US: Caloric Restriction is a potent inducer of Autophagy: it lowers ATP and raises the AMP/ATP ratio, which activates AMPK, and AMPK in turn induces autophagy to compensate for energy limitation and maintain Cellular Homeostasis. Short or moderate restriction produces beneficial adaptive autophagy, whereas prolonged or extreme restriction can push into excessive autophagy and potentially Autophagic Cell Death — the same induction that makes CR a therapeutic target in cancer and a cardioprotective strategy in Ischemia-reperfusion Injury.
context.zh-TW: Caloric Restriction 是 Autophagy 的強效誘導者：它降低 ATP 並提高 AMP/ATP 比值，進而活化 AMPK，而 AMPK 又誘導自噬以補償能量限制並維持 Cellular Homeostasis。短期或中等程度的限制會產生有益的適應性自噬，而長期或極端的限制則可能造成過度自噬，甚至引發 Autophagic Cell Death——正是同一種自噬誘導使 CR 成為癌症治療與缺血再灌流傷害心臟保護的策略標的。

context.en-US: Cardiac Fibrosis is excessive extracellular matrix (collagen) deposition in the myocardium produced by cardiac fibroblast activation and differentiation into myofibroblasts. TGF-beta is the central profibrotic cytokine, driving myofibroblast differentiation via Smad signaling in response to chronic injury — pressure overload, ischemia, inflammation and Angiotensin II. Sustained fibrosis impairs myocardial compliance and electrical conduction, progressing toward heart failure and arrhythmia. Resveratrol-mediated activation of SIRT1 and SIRT3 attenuates it by inhibiting the TGF-beta/Smad3 pathway, whereas SIRT6 knockout induces it.
context.zh-TW: Cardiac Fibrosis 是心肌中過量的細胞外基質（膠原蛋白）沉積，由心臟纖維母細胞活化並分化為肌成纖維細胞所造成。TGF-beta 是核心促纖維化細胞激素，藉由 Smad 訊號在壓力超載、缺血、發炎與 Angiotensin II 等慢性傷害訊號下驅動肌成纖維細胞分化。持續的纖維化會損害心肌順應性與電氣傳導，進展為心衰竭與心律不整。以 resveratrol 活化 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 可透過抑制 TGF-beta/Smad3 路徑減輕纖維化，而 SIRT6 剔除則會誘發纖維化。

context.en-US: SIRT6 has a dual, context-dependent role in cardiac fibrosis: systemic SIRT6 knockout induces fibrosis through TGF-beta/Smad3 activation, whereas SIRT6 prevents Angiotensin II-mediated fibrosis by engaging AMPK–ACE2 signaling. SIRT2 overexpression is likewise protective, promoting AMPK activation via LKB1 deacetylation, and SIRT5 knockout increases fibrosis versus age-matched wild-type mice. SIRT4 instead contributes to fibrosis, since global knockout confers resistance to Ang II infusion, making the NAD+–sirtuin network an appealing antifibrotic target.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 在心臟纖維化中具有依情境而異的雙重角色：全身性剔除 SIRT6 會經 TGF-beta/Smad3 活化誘發纖維化，而 SIRT6 則透過 AMPK–ACE2 訊號防止 Angiotensin II 介導的纖維化。SIRT2 的過量表現同樣具保護作用，經 LKB1 去乙醯化促進 AMPK 活化；SIRT5 剔除相較同齡野生型小鼠會增加纖維化。相對地，SIRT4 促成纖維化（全身剔除可抵抗 Ang II 輸注），使 NAD+–sirtuin 網絡成為具吸引力的抗纖維化標的。

context.en-US: Cardiomyocytes are striated, terminally differentiated heart muscle cells with densely packed mitochondria occupying ~25-35% of cell volume, making them among the most energetically demanding cells in the body and largely post-mitotic in adults. Sustained ATP from oxidative phosphorylation is essential and they are exquisitely sensitive to ischemia, so mitochondrial Dysfunction, oxidative and metabolic stress and Autophagy dysregulation drive Cardiomyopathy, Cardiac Hypertrophy and ultimately Heart Failure. Gap junctions and desmosomes in intercalated discs couple cells into a functional syncytium, and calcium flux through ryanodine receptors and the sarcoplasmic reticulum underlies excitation–contraction coupling.
context.zh-TW: 心肌細胞是具橫紋、終末分化的心臟肌肉細胞，粒線體密集排列佔細胞體積約 25–35%，使其成為體內能量需求最高的細胞之一，且在成人期大多為終末分裂後狀態。來自氧化磷酸化的大量 ATP 不可或缺，且對缺血極為敏感，因此粒線體功能障礙、氧化與代謝壓力以及自噬失調會驅動 Cardiomyopathy、Cardiac Hypertrophy，最終導向 Heart Failure。闰盤中的間隙連結與橋粒將細胞偶聯成功能性合胞體，而經由 ryanodine 受體與肌漿網的鈣離子 flux 則構成興奮—收縮偶聯的基礎。

context.en-US: Cardiomyopathy is a heterogeneous group of disorders in which the myocardium becomes structurally and functionally abnormal without coronary artery disease, hypertension or valvular disease sufficient to explain it, caused by inherited sarcomere mutations, metabolic and mitochondrial defects, toxins, infection or neurohormonal overstimulation. Common pathways include Cardiomyocyte injury, contractile dysfunction and Cardiac Fibrosis driven by Oxidative Stress and inflammation; persistent adrenergic drive and reactive oxygen species drive remodeling and progression toward Heart Failure. Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy is a distinct stress-related form in which excess catecholamine causes myocyte calcium overload, contraction-band necrosis and transient ventricular dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: Cardiomyopathy 是一類異質性疾患，心肌在沒有足以解釋其變化的冠狀動脈疾病、高血壓或瓣膜病的情況下發生結構與功能異常，成因包括遺傳性肌小節蛋白突變、代謝與粒線體缺陷、毒素、感染或神經荷爾蒙過度刺激。常見途徑包含心肌細胞損傷、收縮功能障礙，以及由 Oxidative Stress 與發炎驅動的 Cardiac Fibrosis；持續的腎上腺素能張力與活性氧驅動重塑並朝 Heart Failure 進展。Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy 则是壓力相關的獨特型態，過量兒茶酚胺造成肌細胞鈣過載、收縮帶壞死與暫時性心室功能障礙。

context.en-US: Cardiomyocyte Toxicity is damage or dysfunction of heart muscle cells that is the major dose-limiting adverse effect of Chemotherapy, particularly the anthracyclines Doxorubicin and Daunorubicin. Doxorubicin redox-cycles at Mitochondrial Complex I, generating superoxide and hydroxyl radical that damage cardiomyocyte DNA, proteins and lipids; cardiotoxic agents also impair Oxidative Phosphorylation, open the mitochondrial permeability transition pore and deplete ATP, while TOP2B poisoning triggers p53-dependent apoptosis, disrupted SERCA and ryanodine receptor calcium handling adds calcium overload, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation adds IL-1β-mediated damage. Dexrazoxane is the FDA-approved iron-chelating cardioprotectant.
context.zh-TW: Cardiomyocyte Toxicity 指心臟肌肉細胞的損傷或功能障礙，是 Chemotherapy（尤其是 anthracyclines 類的 Doxorubicin 與 Daunorubicin）最主要的劑量限制性不良反應。Doxorubicin 在 Mitochondrial Complex I 進行氧化還原循環，產生 superoxide 與 hydroxyl radical 損傷心肌細胞的 DNA、蛋白質與脂質；具心毒性的藥物也會損害 Oxidative Phosphorylation、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔並耗竭 ATP，而 TOP2B 中毒引發 p53 依賴的凋亡，SERCA 與 ryanodine 受體的鈣處理失調加上鈣過載，NLRP3 發炎小體活化再加上 IL-1β 介導的損傷。Dexrazoxane 是 FDA 核准的鐵螯合型心臟保護劑。

context.en-US: Cardiovascular Disease encompasses disorders of the heart and blood vessels, with coronary artery disease such as Atherosclerosis often preceded by Endothelial Dysfunction and exacerbated by chronic Oxidative Stress. Epigenetic change bridges environment and genotype in cardiovascular aging: age-related global DNA hypomethylation produces Genomic Instability, hypermethylation silences atheroprotective genes, and declining Sirtuins such as SIRT1 raise histone acetylation to activate pro-inflammatory and pro-fibrotic programs contributing to cardiac hypertrophy and vascular stiffening. Individuals with accelerated epigenetic aging (e.g. by DNAmGrimAge) carry significantly higher risk of myocardial infarction, stroke and heart failure.
context.zh-TW: Cardiovascular Disease 泛指心臟與血管的疾患，其中冠狀動脈疾病如 Atherosclerosis 常以 Endothelial Dysfunction 為前驅，並受慢性 Oxidative Stress 加劇。表觀遺傳改變在心血管老化中介連環境與基因型：與年齡相關的全面 DNA 低甲基化造成 Genomic Instability，高甲基化則沉默抗動脈粥樣硬化基因，而 SIRT1 等 Sirtuins 的衰退使組蛋白乙醯化上升，活化促發炎與促纖維化程序，促成心肌肥厚與血管僵硬。表觀遺傳老化加速者（例如以 DNAmGrimAge 評估）心肌梗塞、中風與心衰竭的風險顯著較高。

context.en-US: Intermittent Fasting and Caloric Restriction exert cardioprotective roles largely by promoting Autophagic Flux: IF reduces infarct area in mouse models of Ischemia-reperfusion Injury, and in aged models of acute Myocardial infarction it upregulates Atg5 and reduces cardiac injury markers. In ischemic conditions AMPK activation and the resulting Autophagy protect injured cells, whereas deficient Autophagy is linked to Ventricular Remodeling and Cardiomyocyte Toxicity — which is why Autophagic Flux is considered crucial for cardiomyocyte homeostasis and heart function.
context.zh-TW: Intermittent Fasting 與 Caloric Restriction 主要藉由促進 Autophagic Flux 發揮心臟保護作用：IF 在缺血再灌流傷害的小鼠模型中縮小梗死面積，並在老化急性 Myocardial infarction 模型中上調 Atg5、減少心臟損傷標記。在缺血條件下 AMPK 活化及其後續的 Autophagy 保護受損細胞，而 Autophagy 不足則與 Ventricular Remodeling 及 Cardiomyocyte Toxicity 相關——因此 Autophagic Flux 被視為維持心肌細胞恆定與心臟功能的關鍵。

context.en-US: CCCP is a protonophore mitochondrial uncoupler that collapses the mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm) and shuttles protons across the inner membrane, decoupling respiration from ATP synthesis. Sustained uncoupling marks mitochondria for degradation, so CCCP induces Parkin-mediated Mitophagy and effectively depletes the cell of functional mitochondria rather than merely inhibiting their metabolism.
context.zh-TW: CCCP 是一種質子載體型的粒線體解偶聯劑，會崩潰粒線體膜電位（ΔΨm），將質子運送穿過內膜，使呼吸鏈與 ATP 合成脫鉤。持續的解偶聯會將粒線體標記為待分解，因此 CCCP 會誘發 Parkin 媒介的 Mitophagy，實際上是清空細胞內的功能性粒線體，而不只是抑制其代謝。

context.en-US: Used as a causality test in irradiated senescent fibroblasts, CCCP depleted mitochondria and nearly abolished secretion of the SASP factors IL-6, IL-8, GRO and MCP-1, while also lowering p16, p21, SA-β-gal and SAHF. The same effect occurred in replicative, oncogene-induced and oxidative-damage senescence, showing that the inflammatory output of mitochondria is central to the SASP.
context.zh-TW: 在輻射誘導的衰老纖維母細胞中作為因果性測試，CCCP 清除粒線體後，幾乎完全中止了 SASP 因子 IL-6、IL-8、GRO 與 MCP-1 的分泌，並同時降低 p16、p21、SA-β-gal 與 SAHF。同樣的效果也見於複製性、癌基因誘導與氧化損傷型衰老，顯示粒線體的發炎輸出是 SASP 的核心。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial depletion with CCCP significantly reduced the senescence marker p16INK4A, together with p21, SA-β-gal and Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci, as well as cell size and ROS. This ties the p16/RB senescence arm to mitochondrial abundance rather than treating the marker as a purely autonomous cell-intrinsic program.
context.zh-TW: 以 CCCP 耗竭粒線體可顯著降低衰老標記 p16INK4A，並同時降低 p21、SA-β-gal 與 Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci，以及細胞大小與 ROS。這把 p16/RB 衰老軸與粒線體數量連結起來，而非僅將此標記視為完全由細胞內在自主程式決定。

context.en-US: CCL18 (PARC) is a CC chemokine produced constitutively by dendritic cells and by alternatively activated (M2-like) macrophages, with plasmacytoid/dendritic cells as additional sources. In aging it appears in the secretome of senescent stromal and immune cells, and its induction is driven by IL-4/IL-13 rather than a single senescence master transcription factor.
context.zh-TW: CCL18（PARC）是由樹突細胞與交替活化（M2 型）巨噬細胞持續分泌的 CC 趨化因子，漿細胞樣樹突細胞亦是來源。在老化時它出現在衰老基質與免疫細胞的分泌組中，其誘導主要由 IL-4/IL-13 驅動，而非單一衰老主控轉錄因子。

context.en-US: CCL18 is one of five circulating SASP factors (with GDF15, RAGE, VEGFA and MMP-2) whose levels strongly predict all-cause mortality independently of chronological age. Rather than driving the inflammatory chemotactic wave directly, CCL18 serves as a quantitative readout of senescent-cell burden and of Inflammaging, and is being evaluated as an endpoint in senolytic trials.
context.zh-TW: CCL18 是五種循環 SASP 因子之一（與 GDF15、RAGE、VEGFA、MMP-2 同列），其濃度可獨立於實際年齡預測全因死亡。CCL18 並非直接驅動發炎性趨化波，而是作為衰老細胞負荷與 Inflammaging 的定量讀值，並被用作 senolytic 試驗的終點評估。

context.en-US: CCL2 (MCP-1) signals chiefly through CCR2, a Gαi-coupled GPCR, with minor activity at CCR4. Engagement activates PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK/ERK and Ca2+ flux to drive chemotaxis and adhesion of monocytes, making the CCL2–CCR2 axis the principal monocyte and macrophage recruitment route in the SASP.
context.zh-TW: CCL2（MCP-1）主要透過 CCR2（屬 Gαi 偶聯的 GPCR）傳遞訊號，並在 CCR4 有較弱的活性。其結合會活化 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ 通量，驅動單核球趨化與黏附，使 CCL2–CCR2 軸成為 SASP 中招募單核球與巨噬細胞的主要途徑。

context.en-US: CCL2 is one of the most conserved and best-characterized components of the SASP. Its transcription is driven by NF-κB, AP-1, STAT1/STAT3 and the C/EBP family, and is potently induced by the SASP cytokines IL-1α and IL-1β, creating a feed-forward loop in which recruited macrophages further inflame tissue.
