context.zh-TW: Gut Microbiome 中較高的 Christensenellaceae 豐度，與較低的 Body Mass Index、瘦體組成及 successful aging 高度相關，且此菌科在 Centenarians 中被富集。在人類 Gut Microbiome 中，它是遺傳性最高的類群之一，與宿主基因型的關聯強於多數其他微生物。

context.en-US: Chromaffin cells are neuroendocrine cells that form the principal secretory population of the Adrenal medulla, with extra-adrenal populations in the paraganglia and sympathetic ganglia of the Autonomic Nervous System. Embryologically neural crest-derived, they are modified postganglionic sympathetic neurons that lost their axons and release hormones directly into the circulation.
context.zh-TW: Chromaffin cells 是神經內分泌細胞，構成 Adrenal medulla 的主要分泌細胞群，並在 Autonomic Nervous System 的副神經節與交感神經節中存在腎上腺外族群。其胚胎來源為神經脊，實質上是失去軸突的交感節後神經元修飾型，直接將激素釋放至循環中。

context.en-US: Chromaffin cells synthesize and store Catecholamines, principally Epinephrine and Norepinephrine, in dense-core granules. When Epinephrine released from these cells is oxidized by oxidants or metal-catalyzed reactions, it can form Adrenochrome, an aminochrome product that links chromaffin cell biology to the oxidative-stress chemistry of the adrenochrome hypothesis.
context.zh-TW: Chromaffin cells 在緻密核心顆粒中合成並儲存 Catecholamines，主要為 Epinephrine 與 Norepinephrine。當由這些細胞釋放的 Epinephrine 被氧化劑或金屬催化反應氧化時，可形成 Adrenochrome——一種 aminochrome 產物，將嗜鉻細胞生物學與腎上腺紅素假說中的氧化應化學相連。

context.en-US: Chromaffin cells of the Adrenal medulla package Catecholamines with chromogranins and ATP into dense-core secretory granules. Preganglionic sympathetic acetylcholine release triggers calcium influx and granule exocytosis, driving the systemic fight-or-flight response of increased heart rate, bronchodilation and glycogenolysis.
context.zh-TW: Adrenal medulla 的 Chromaffin cells 將 Catecholamines 與 chromogranin 及 ATP 一同包裝進緻密核心分泌顆粒。節前交感神經釋放乙醯膽鹼引發鈣離子內流與顆粒胞吐，驅動心跳加快、支氣管擴張與肝醣分解的全身性戰或逃反應。

context.en-US: During Aging, Chromatin undergoes remodeling described as epigenetic drift: global loss of Heterochromatin with leaky centromeric and repetitive regions, reduced total core Histone abundance, diminished repressive marks such as H3K9me3, and blunting of the three-dimensional compartment separation between active and inactive genome.
context.zh-TW: 在 Aging 過程中，Chromatin 會發生被稱為表觀遺傳漂變的重塑：Heterochromatin 全域性流失，使著絲點與重複序列區域「漏出」，核心 Histone 總量下降，抑制性標記（如 H3K9me3）減少，基因組活性區與非活性區之間的三維區室分隔亦變得模糊。

context.en-US: SAHF (Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci) are dense, localized Chromatin clusters that form paradoxically while global heterochromatin declines with age. By compacting these foci over cell-cycle genes, SAHF permanently silence their transcription, locking senescent cells out of the cell cycle.
context.zh-TW: SAHF（senescence-associated heterochromatin foci）是隨年齡全域 heterochromatin 下降而反常形成的緻密局部 Chromatin 團塊。SAHF 將這些 foci 壓實覆蓋於細胞週期基因之上，永久沉默其轉錄，使衰老細胞被鎖定於細胞週期之外。

context.en-US: Predictable age-related shifts in DNA Methylation — global hypomethylation that reactivates repetitive elements alongside focal promoter hypermethylation of tumour suppressor genes — form the basis of the Epigenetic Clock, which uses these methylation patterns to estimate biological age accurately.
context.zh-TW: 與年齡相關、可預測的 DNA Methylation 變化——包含重新活化重複序列的全域去甲基化，以及腫瘤抑制基因啟動子區的局部高甲基化——構成 Epigenetic Clock 的基礎，該時鐘利用這些甲基化模式準確估算生物學年齡。

context.en-US: A Chromosome is a single long DNA molecule wrapped around histones into Chromatin and then condensed for segregation. Humans carry 46 chromosomes in somatic cells, so Chromatin is the packaging material from which every chromosome is built.
context.zh-TW: Chromosome 是單一長 DNA 分子纏繞於 histone 而形成 Chromatin，再經凝縮以利分離的結構。人類體細胞具有 46 條染色體，因此 Chromatin 正是構成每一條染色體的包裝材質。

context.en-US: Cell Division checkpoints verify DNA Replication and Chromosome alignment before anaphase, with control through Cyclin/CDK, Rb/E2F and p53. When this surveillance fails, mis-segregation produces aneuploidy such as Trisomy 21 (Down Syndrome) via meiotic nondisjunction.
context.zh-TW: Cell Division 的檢查點在後期之前驗證 DNA Replication 與 Chromosome 對位，並透過 Cyclin/CDK、Rb/E2F 與 p53 加以控制。當此監控失效時，分離錯誤會透過減數分裂不分離產生非整倍體，例如 Trisomy 21（Down Syndrome）。

context.en-US: The Centromere is the specialized region of a Chromosome at which the kinetochore assembles, capturing spindle microtubules so the chromosome can be moved during Mitosis and Meiosis. Its integrity is therefore a prerequisite for accurate chromosome segregation.
context.zh-TW: Centromere 是 Chromosome 上負責組裝 kinetochore 的特化區域，藉由捕捉紡錘絲微管，使染色體得以在 Mitosis 與 Meiosis 中被移動。因此其完整性是染色體正確分離的前提條件。

context.en-US: Although the Etiology of Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS) remains unknown, impaired cellular energy metabolism and Mitochondrial Dysfunction are among the leading proposed mechanisms, alongside immune dysfunction and autonomic and endocrine disturbance. Lower Brain creatine in the left parietal cortex and altered creatine-normalized metabolite ratios support a central energy-metabolism lesion.
context.zh-TW: 雖然 Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS) 的 Etiology 仍不明確，細胞能量代謝受損與 Mitochondrial Dysfunction 是最受關注的假說機制之一，與免疫功能失調、自主神經及內分泌障礙並列。左頂葉皮質 Brain creatine 降低與肌酸標準化代謝物比值改變，支持中樞能量代謝病灶的存在。

context.en-US: Creatine Supplementation, and alternatively Guanidinoacetate (GAA) supplementation, improved functional capacity, pain, depression, sleep and quality of life in small open-label studies of Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS) and fibromyalgia. The benefits waned after supplementation stopped, and the evidence remains preliminary pending larger trials.
context.zh-TW: Creatine Supplementation（或替代的 Guanidinoacetate (GAA) 補充）在針對 Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS) 與 fibromyalgia 的小型開放性研究中，改善了功能容量、疼痛、憂鬱、睡眠與生活品質。停止補充後效益減退，且在更大型試驗前證據仍屬初步性質。

context.en-US: In Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia, SIRT3 enables metabolic adaptation that confers chemoresistance through ROS buffering. By boosting mitochondrial antioxidant capacity — via MnSOD deacetylation and IDH2-driven NADPH production — SIRT3 protects leukemic cells from the oxidative damage imposed by cytotoxic chemotherapy, a tumour-supportive role that contrasts with its tumour-suppressive action elsewhere.
context.zh-TW: 在 Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia 中，SIRT3 透過 ROS 緩衝促成代謝適應並賦予化療抗藥性。SIRT3 藉由提升粒線體抗氧化能力——經由 MnSOD 去乙醯化與 IDH2 驅動的 NADPH 生成——保護白血病細胞免受細胞毒性化療所造成的氧化傷害，這種促腫瘤作用與其在其他情境下的抑腫作用形成對比。

context.en-US: Cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 protein interaction, diminishing SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of the NF-κB subunit RelA. With RelA left more acetylated and transcriptionally active, inflammatory mediator expression rises in airway and other smoke-exposed cells — a direct mechanistic bridge between smoking, impaired sirtuin function and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
context.zh-TW: Cigarette-smoke extract 會破壞 SIRT1 與 RelA/p65 的蛋白質交互作用，使 SIRT1 對 NF-κB 次單元 RelA 的去乙醯化減少。RelA 因此維持較高乙醯化與轉錄活化狀態，導致氣道及其他煙霧暴露細胞的發炎介質表現上升——這在吸菸、sirtuin 功能受損與慢性發炎性肺病之間提供了直接機制橋樑。

context.en-US: Cigarette Smoke delivers thousands of chemicals including semiquinone, hydroxyl and nitric-oxide Free Radicals. Tar-phase semiquinones redox-cycle to generate sustained Reactive Oxygen Species long after inhalational exposure, so the oxidant burden outlasts the acute event and chronically erodes tissue antioxidant defences.
context.zh-TW: Cigarette Smoke 含有數千種化學物質，其中包括 semiquinone、hydroxyl 與 nitric-oxide 等 Free Radicals。焦油相的 semiquinone 可進行氧化還原循環，在吸入事件結束後仍持續產生 Reactive Oxygen Species，因此氧化負荷會超出急性暴露期，長期侵蝕組織抗氧化防禦。

context.en-US: NAMPT is the rate-limiting NAD+ salvage enzyme and a transcriptional target of BMAL1/CLOCK. By generating rhythmic NAD+ oscillations it closes the SIRT1 circadian loop, gating SIRT1 activity and thereby setting the timing of downstream clock-controlled output.
context.zh-TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ salvage 途徑的速率限制酵素，同時是 BMAL1/CLOCK 的轉錄標的。藉由產生節律性的 NAD+ 振盪，它閉合了 SIRT1 的晝夜迴路，門控 SIRT1 活性並因而設定下游時鐘受控輸出的時序。

context.en-US: BMAL1 and CLOCK form the heterodimer at the centre of the Circadian Rhythm transcriptional-translational feedback loop. The pair drives clock-controlled genes including NAMPT, and their acetylation state set by SIRT1 links the ~24-hour oscillator to cellular energy state.
context.zh-TW: BMAL1 與 CLOCK 組成異二聚體，位於 Circadian Rhythm 轉錄—轉譯回饋迴路的核心。該二聚體驅動包括 NAMPT 在內的時鐘受控基因，而其由 SIRT1 設定的乙醯化狀態則將約 24 小時的振盪器與細胞能量狀態相連結。

context.en-US: Cisplatin induces Autophagy in cancer cells as a resistance mechanism, so inhibiting Autophagy enhances cisplatin cytotoxicity. The drug also damages Mitochondria and triggers Mitophagy, and SIRT1-driven upregulation of VEGF-A further promotes cisplatin resistance in non-small-cell lung cancer.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 在癌細胞中誘發 Autophagy 作為抗藥機制，因此抑制 Autophagy 可增強 cisplatin 的細胞毒性。該藥亦損傷 Mitochondria 並誘發 Mitophagy；此外 SIRT1 介導的 VEGF-A 上調會進一步促進非小細胞肺癌的 cisplatin 抗藥性。

context.en-US: Cisplatin is a platinum-based chemotherapy drug that crosslinks DNA via intra- and interstrand adducts, triggering apoptosis. It is used against testicular, ovarian, cervical, head and neck, bladder and lung cancers, and its chemotherapeutic response can be enhanced by Intermittent Fasting.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 是鉑類化療藥物，透過鏈內與鏈間 DNA 加合物造成交聯，進而誘發 Apoptosis。它被用於睪丸癌、卵巢癌、子宮頸癌、頭頸癌、膀胱癌與肺癌的治療，而其化療反應可由 Intermittent Fasting 增強。

context.en-US: melittin, the honeybee venom peptide, shows additive and synergistic anticancer effects with Cisplatin in cervical and laryngeal malignancies, with docetaxel in lung cancer cells, and additive effects with EGFR-targeting and HER2-enriched breast cancer strategies.
context.zh-TW: melittin（蜂毒胜肽）與 Cisplatin 在子宮頸癌與喉癌中呈現加成及協同抗癌效果，與 docetaxel 在肺癌細胞中亦具協同作用，並對抗 EGFR 與 HER2 高度表現的乳癌策略產生加成效果。

context.en-US: Citrate Synthase is a mitochondrial matrix enzyme that catalyses the first committed step of the TCA cycle, condensing Acetyl-CoA with oxaloacetate to form Citrate. Its activity is also used as a standard biochemical marker of mitochondrial density and tissue oxidative capacity.
context.zh-TW: Citrate Synthase 是粒線體基質酵素，催化 TCA cycle 的第一個committed步驟，將 Acetyl-CoA 與 oxaloacetate 縮合形成 Citrate。其活性同時被用作粒線體密度與組織氧化能力的標準生化指標。

context.en-US: Prolonged Exercise training raises Citrate Synthase and cytochrome-c oxidase activity in tissues linked to the training, such as Skeletal Muscle and heart. The elevated oxidative-enzyme activity indicates higher metabolic rate per unit tissue mass, supporting training-induced gains in Resting Metabolic Rate beyond what lean-mass accretion alone predicts.
context.zh-TW: 長時間的 Exercise 訓練會提升 Skeletal Muscle 與心臟等受訓組織中的 Citrate Synthase 與 cytochrome-c oxidase 活性。氧化酵素活性升高代表單位組織量的代謝率提高，支持訓練所帶來的 Resting Metabolic Rate 增益超出單純瘦體組織增加的預期。

context.en-US: In senescent cells the mitochondrial Citrate–acetyl-CoA axis is upregulated, and the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 exports Citrate to the cytosol, where ACLY regenerates the Acetyl-CoA pool used for H3K27ac deposition at SASP loci. SLC25A1 inhibition reduces citrate, isocitrate and cis-aconitate, and in vivo improves healthspan and reduces frailty in aged mice.
context.zh-TW: 在衰老細胞中，粒線體 Citrate–acetyl-CoA 軸受到上調，粒線體柠檬酸載體 SLC25A1 將 Citrate 輸出至細胞質，在該處 ACLY 重新生成供 SASP 位點 H3K27ac 沉積所用的 Acetyl-CoA 池。抑制 SLC25A1 會降低 citrate、isocitrate 與 cis-aconitate 濃度，並在活體中改善老年小鼠的健康壽命與降低虛弱程度。

context.en-US: In the cytosol ACLY cleaves Citrate into Acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate. The acetyl-CoA thereby released supplies de novo Lipid Synthesis and histone acetylation, while pharmacological disruption of citrate export or ACLY depletes cytosolic acetyl-CoA and selectively suppresses the SASP without affecting cell viability.
context.zh-TW: 在細胞質中 ACLY 將 Citrate 切割為 Acetyl-CoA 與 oxaloacetate。由此釋出的 acetyl-CoA 供應 de novo Lipid Synthesis 與 histone acetylation；而以藥理方式阻斷柠檬酸輸出或 ACLY，會耗竭細胞質 acetyl-CoA 並選擇性抑制 SASP，同時不影響細胞存活。

context.en-US: The Citric Acid Cycle generates NADH at several steps (isocitrate dehydrogenase, α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, malate dehydrogenase) and FADH2 via succinate dehydrogenase. These reducing equivalents are the principal source of matrix NAD+ regeneration when they are oxidised back during Oxidative Phosphorylation.
context.zh-TW: Citric Acid Cycle 在數個步驟（isocitrate dehydrogenase、α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase、malate dehydrogenase）產生 NADH，並經由 succinate dehydrogenase 產生 FADH2。這些還原型等當物在 Oxidative Phosphorylation 中被氧化回 NAD+ 時，是基質 NAD+ 再生的主要來源。

context.en-US: During senescence reduced electron-transport-chain efficiency and lowered NAD+ levels depress the NAD+/NADH ratio generated by the Citric Acid Cycle, lowering ATP and raising AMP/ATP to activate AMPK. Restoring the ratio, via NAMPT upregulation or Methylene blue redox cycling, modulates senescence and the SASP, placing the cycle upstream of the senescence program.
context.zh-TW: 在衰老過程中，電子傳遞鏈效率下降與 NAD+ 水平降低會壓低由 Citric Acid Cycle 產生的 NAD+/NADH 比值，使 ATP 下降、AMP/ATP 上升並活化 AMPK。藉由 NAMPT 上調或 Methylene blue 氧化還原循環恢復該比值，可調節衰老與 SASP，顯示此循環位於衰老程式之上游。

context.en-US: Within the Citric Acid Cycle, Malate Dehydrogenase catalyses the reversible conversion of Oxaloacetate to Malate, interconverting NAD+ and NADH as it does so. This malate–oxaloacetate node also feeds the Malate-Aspartate Shuttle, coupling cytosolic and mitochondrial redox state.
context.zh-TW: 在 Citric Acid Cycle 內，Malate Dehydrogenase 催化 Oxaloacetate 與 Malate 之間的可逆轉換，並在此過程中轉換 NAD+ 與 NADH。這個 malate–oxaloacetate 節點同時供應 Malate-Aspartate Shuttle，將細胞質與粒線體的氧化還原狀態偶聯起來。

context.en-US: Cl-amidine is a covalent pan-peptidylarginine deiminase inhibitor with a chloro-acetamidine warhead that blocks citrullination by PAD4 and related deiminases. In NETosis assays it suppresses histone citrullination (cit-H3) and NET extrusion, making it — with DNase digestion and NE/MPO inhibition — the standard blockade panel proving PAD-dependent NET formation.
context.zh-TW: Cl-amidine 是具有 chloro-acetamidine 親電子基團的共價廣譜 peptidylarginine deiminase 抑制劑，可阻斷 PAD4 及相關 deiminase 的 citrullination 作用。在 NETosis 分析中，它抑制 histone citrullination（cit-H3）與 NET 挤出，因此與 DNase 消化及 NE/MPO 抑制並列，構成證明 PAD 依賴性 NET 形成的標準阻斷組合。

context.en-US: By inhibiting PAD4-dependent Protein Citrullination, Cl-amidine blocks the NETosis program and the resulting neutrophil extracellular trap extrusion, which is why PAD4 inhibitors such as Cl-amidine are listed as blocking agents in NETosis death-pathway comparisons and studied in models such as Sepsis.
context.zh-TW: 透過抑制 PAD4 依賴性的 Protein Citrullination，Cl-amidine 阻斷 NETosis 程式及隨後的中性球胞外陷阱挤出。因此在 NETosis 死亡路徑比較中，諸如 Cl-amidine 的 PAD4 抑制劑被列為阻斷劑，並在 Sepsis 等模型中接受研究。

context.en-US: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma is a subtype of Renal Cell Carcinoma whose reprogrammed redox metabolism makes it exquisitely dependent on Glutathione and the GPX4 antioxidant axis to prevent Lipid Peroxidation and death. Inhibiting Glutathione synthesis collapses this defence and induces Ferroptosis with tumour growth suppression.
context.zh-TW: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma 是 Renal Cell Carcinoma 的一個亞型，其重編程的氧化還原代謝使它極度依賴 Glutathione 與 GPX4 抗氧化軸來防止 Lipid Peroxidation 與細胞死亡。抑制 Glutamine 合成會瓦解此防禦並誘發 Ferroptosis，同時抑制腫瘤生長。

context.en-US: System Xc- (SLC7A11) supplies cystine, one of the two precursors required for Glutathione synthesis in Clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Because ccRCC depends so heavily on Glutathione/GPX4 defence, blocking System Xc- collapses cystine availability and tips the tumour cells into iron-dependent Ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: System Xc-（SLC7A11）供應 cystine，而 cystine 是 Clear cell renal cell carcinoma 合成 Glutathione 所需的兩種前驅物之一。由於 ccRCC 高度依賴 Glutathione/GPX4 防禦，阻斷 System Xc- 會使 cystine 可用性崩潰，迫使腫瘤細胞進入鐵依賴性的 Ferroptosis。

context.en-US: Clostridium sporogenes is an anaerobic, spore-forming gut commensal and the best-characterized producer of Indole-3-propionic acid, reducing Tryptophan through indole-pyruvate to indole-3-lactate and then IPA. IPA is a circulating radical-scavenging metabolite acting on host Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor and Pregnane X Receptor signalling.
context.zh-TW: Clostridium sporogenes 是厭氧、能形成芽孢的腸道共生菌，也是 Indole-3-propionic acid 最具表征的產生菌，經由 indole-pyruvate 將 Tryptophan 還原為 indole-3-lactate 再生成 IPA。IPA 是循環中的自由基清除代謝物，作用於宿主 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 與 Pregnane X Receptor 的訊息傳遞。

context.en-US: Indole-3-propionic acid produced by Clostridium sporogenes mediates the microbiota–heart axis in HFpEF: cardiac SIRT3 restoration and NAD-salvage enhancement depend on this metabolite, and reduced proportions of IPA-producing bacteria are observed in type 2 diabetes and aging.
context.zh-TW: 由 Clostridium sporogenes 產生的 Indole-3-propionic acid 在 HFpEF 中中介微生物群—心臟軸：心臟 SIRT3 的恢復與 NAD salvage 增強皆依賴此代謝物，而在第二型糖尿病與老化族群中可觀察到 IPA 產生菌比例下降。

context.en-US: The Prefrontal Cortex mediates executive function and working memory, underpinning planning, inhibitory control, cognitive flexibility and abstract reasoning. It operates within an inverted-U dose-response curve for Dopamine signalling, so both excess and deficiency impair performance, and its volume declines with normal aging.
context.zh-TW: Prefrontal Cortex 中介執行功能與工作記憶，是計畫、抑制控制、認知彈性與抽象推理的基礎。其運作遵循 Dopamine 訊號的倒 U 型劑量反應曲線，過多與過少皆會損害表現，且其體積會隨正常老化而減少。

context.en-US: BDNF is secreted in the late phase of long-term potentiation and promotes dendritic branching, spine formation and survival of existing neurons, particularly in the Hippocampus. Physical exercise raises BDNF, one of the non-pharmacological interventions that contribute to cognitive resilience and may delay cognitive impairment.
context.zh-TW: BDNF 在長期增強的晚期被分泌，促進樹突分支、棘突形成與既有神經元存活，在 Hippocampus 尤其明顯。體能運動可提升 BDNF，是有助認知韌性並可能延緩認知障礙的非藥物介入手段之一。

context.en-US: Cognition declines progressively in Alzheimer's Disease, the most common cause of dementia worldwide, beginning with early episodic memory loss as amyloid-β plaques and hyperphosphorylated Tau neurofibrillary tangles damage the entorhinal cortex and Hippocampus before spreading to association cortices. Cholinesterase inhibitors give modest symptomatic benefit and Memantine-like NMDA receptor antagonism reduces excitotoxicity.
context.zh-TW: 在 Alzheimer's Disease（全球最常見的失智症病因）中，Cognition 會逐步衰退：從早期的情節記憶喪失開始，類澱粉-β 斑塊與過度磷酸化的 Tau 神經纖維纏結損傷內嗅皮質與 Hippocampus，之後擴散至聯合皮質。膽鹼酯酶抑制劑提供溫和的症狀性效益，而 NMDA receptor 拮抗作用可降低興奮性毒性。

context.en-US: Dopamine is critical for reward-based learning, motivation and working memory, and the Prefrontal Cortex follows an inverted-U dose-response curve to dopaminergic signalling so that both excess and deficiency impair cognitive performance. Dopaminergic tone declines with age, contributing to age-related cognitive decline.
context.zh-TW: Dopamine 對獎賞式學習、動機與工作記憶至關重要，且 Prefrontal Cortex 對多巴胺能訊號呈倒 U 型劑量反應曲線，過量與不足皆會損害認知表現。多巴胺張力隨年齡下降，是促成老化相關認知衰退的因素之一。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits proliferation of Colorectal Cancer cell lines including DLD1 and LS174T and promotes Apoptosis by blocking the Wnt signalling pathway, reducing downstream genes such as AXIN2, LGR5 and ASCL2. It also reverses multidrug resistance to vincristine by repressing P-gp via the EGFR/ERK/Akt/NF-κB pathway and enhances anti-EGFR agents such as cetuximab.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制 Colorectal Cancer 細胞株（含 DLD1 與 LS174T）的增殖，並藉由阻斷 Wnt 訊息路徑促進 Apoptosis，使下游基因如 AXIN2、LGR5 與 ASCL2 下降。它亦透過 EGFR/ERK/Akt/NF-κB 路徑抑制 P-gp 以逆轉對 vincristine 的多藥抗藥性，並增強 cetuximab 等抗 EGFR 藥物的作用。

context.en-US: SIRT3 acts as an oncogene in Colorectal Cancer by deacetylating SHMT2 at Lys95, activating Serine metabolism. The SIRT3–SHMT2 axis increases serine consumption and NADPH levels, fuelling nucleotide biosynthesis and tumour cell proliferation, a mechanism distinct from SIRT3's protective antioxidant role elsewhere.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 在 Colorectal Cancer 中作為致癌基因，透過在 Lys95 去乙醯化 SHMT2 而活化 Serine 代謝。SIRT3–SHMT2 軸增加 serine 消耗與 NADPH 濃度，為核苷酸生合成與腫瘤細胞增殖提供燃料，此機制與 SIRT3 在其他情境下的保護性抗氧化作用不同。

context.en-US: SHMT2 is significantly upregulated in Colorectal Cancer tissue and high SHMT2 expression marks poorer survival. It catalyses the mitochondrial conversion of Serine to glycine, supplying one-carbon units for nucleotide biosynthesis and NADPH for redox defence; 5-Fluorouracil-resistant CRC cells depend on this axis, so interfering with Serine availability or SHMT2 activity can revert resistance.
context.zh-TW: SHMT2 在 Colorectal Cancer 組織中顯著上調，且高 SHMT2 表現者存活率較差。它催化 Serine 在粒線體中轉為 glycine，提供核苷酸生合成所需的一碳單位與支持氧化還原防禦的 NADPH；對 5-Fluorouracil 抗藥性的 CRC 細胞仰賴此軸，因此干擾 Serine 可用性或 SHMT2 活性可逆轉抗藥性。

context.en-US: Autophagy has a dual role in Colorectal Cancer, acting as a tumour suppressor in early stages and as a survival mechanism for established tumours. Inhibiting Atg4B sensitises CRC cells such as HCT116 to injury and induces apoptotic death, while Caloric Restriction suppresses tumour growth in part through autophagy induction and reduced macrophage M2 polarisation.
context.zh-TW: Autophagy 在 Colorectal Cancer 中具有雙重角色：於早期扮演抑癌者，對已建立的腫瘤則是存活機制。抑制 Atg4B 可使 HCT116 等 CRC 細胞對損傷更加敏感並誘發凋亡性死亡；Caloric Restriction 則透過誘發自噬與減少巨噬細胞 M2 極化來抑制腫瘤生長。

context.en-US: Complex III (the cytochrome bc1 complex) is a major source of Reactive Oxygen Species in the inner Mitochondria membrane: electron leakage at the Qo site during the Q-cycle generates Superoxide. Its activity therefore couples electron transport from Coenzyme Q10 to Cytochrome c to both proton translocation and mitochondrial oxidant production.
context.zh-TW: Complex III（cytochrome bc1 複合體）是內膜 Mitochondria 中 Reactive Oxygen Species 的主要來源之一：Q-cycle 過程中在 Qo 位點的電子洩漏會產生 Superoxide。因此其活性將電子由 Coenzyme Q10 傳遞至 Cytochrome c 的過程，與質子轉位及粒線體氧化產物的生成相互耦聯。

context.en-US: Complex III is the third complex of the Electron Transport Chain in the inner Mitochondria membrane, catalysing electron transfer from Coenzyme Q10 to Cytochrome c coupled to proton translocation via the Q-cycle. Its 11-subunit core includes the catalytic Cytochrome b and Rieske iron-sulfur centre.
context.zh-TW: Complex III 是內膜 Mitochondria 中 Electron Transport Chain 的第三個複合體，透過 Q-cycle 耦聯質子轉位，催化電子由 Coenzyme Q10 傳遞至 Cytochrome c。其 11 個次單體的核心包含具催化功能的 Cytochrome b 與 Rieske 鐵硫中心。

context.en-US: Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) is the terminal enzyme of the mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain, receiving electrons from reduced Cytochrome c and reducing molecular oxygen to water. It is the ultimate electron sink of aerobic respiration and a major determinant of Oxidative Phosphorylation capacity.
context.zh-TW: Complex IV（cytochrome c oxidase）是粒線體 Electron Transport Chain 的末端酵素，接受還原態 Cytochrome c 的電子並將分子氧還原成水。它是有氧呼吸的最終電子受體，也是決定 Oxidative Phosphorylation 能力的主要因素。

context.en-US: Complex IV pumps four protons from the matrix to the intermembrane space per O2 reduced, contributing to the proton-motive force that drives ATP Synthase. This makes Complex IV indirectly responsible for ATP production through oxidative phosphorylation, and its impairment elevates Mitochondrial ROS.
context.zh-TW: Complex IV 每還原一個 O2 便從基質向膜間腔泵出四個質子，協助建立驅動 ATP Synthase 的質子動力勢。這使 Complex IV 透過氧化磷酸化間接負責 ATP 生成，而其功能受損會升高 Mitochondrial ROS。

context.en-US: Methylene Blue acts as an electron cycler that can bypass proximal Electron Transport Chain blocks downstream of Complex IV, restoring redox tone. Complex IV activity also integrates with Mitohormesis, where mild respiratory inhibition triggers adaptive stress responses, and inherited COX deficiencies contribute to neurodegenerative disease and aging.
context.zh-TW: Methylene Blue 作為電子循環劑，可繞過 Complex IV 上游的 Electron Transport Chain 阻斷，恢復氧化還原張力。Complex IV 活性亦與 Mitohormesis 相互整合——輕度呼吸抑制可誘發適應性壓力反應——而遺傳性 COX 缺乏則促成神經退化疾病與老化。

context.en-US: In both oncogene-induced and replicative senescence, the Condensin SMC2-SMC4 complex shows increased binding at B-to-A compartment-switching regions, which are enriched for SASP genes and coincide with their upregulation. Condensin therefore couples compartment repositioning to SASP transcription, placing it in the 3D-genome rewiring that licenses the secretory phenotype.
context.zh-TW: 在致癌基因誘導與複製性衰老中，Condensin 的 SMC2-SMC4 複合體在 B-to-A 區室轉換區域的結合增加，而這些區域富含 SASP 基因並與其上調同步。因此 Condensin 將區室重定位與 SASP 的轉錄相偶聯，使其位於授權分泌表型的三維基因組重塑之中。

context.en-US: Condensin is a structural maintenance of chromosomes complex built around an SMC2-SMC4 heterodimer. ATP-dependent conformational changes at the hinge and head let it extrude DNA loops, compact chromosomes during mitosis and shape interphase chromatin architecture, organizing topologically associating domains.
context.zh-TW: Condensin 是以 SMC2-SMC4 異二聚體為核心的染色體結構維持複合體。hinge 與 head 的 ATP 依賴性構形變化使其能擠出 DNA 迴圈、在有絲分裂期間凝縮染色體，並塑造間期染色質架構以組織拓撲關聯結構域。

context.en-US: Condensin operates alongside enhancer-promoter looping driven by the METTL3-METTL14 methyltransferase complex and the TAD-boundary activity of HMGB2. Together these factors coordinate the 3D-genome reorganization that licenses SASP transcription, with the NF-κB master SASP locus residing in an active A compartment.
context.zh-TW: Condensin 與由 METTL3-METTL14 甲基轉移酶複合體驅動的 enhancer–promoter 迴圈作用，以及 HMGB2 的拓撲關聯結構域邊界活性協同運作。這些因子共同協調授權 SASP 轉錄的三維基因組重塑，而 NF-κB 這項 SASP 主控基因座則位於活性 A 區室中。

context.en-US: Conjugated dienes are the early products of lipid peroxidation: they form when polyunsaturated fatty acids in lipoproteins such as LDL and HDL are oxidized by copper or free radicals. Their appearance at 234 nm absorbance (extinction coefficient 27,000 M-1/cm) is the standard way to quantify the extent of lipoprotein oxidation, with a kinetic profile of lag phase, propagation phase, and decomposition phase.
context.zh-TW: Conjugated Dienes 是 Lipid Peroxidation 的早期產物：當 LDL、HDL 等脂蛋白中的多不飽和脂肪酸被銅或自由基氧化時便會形成。以 234 nm 吸光度（消光係數 27,000 M-1/cm）測量是量化脂蛋白氧化程度的標準方法，其動力學曲線包含 lag phase、propagation phase 與 decomposition phase。

context.en-US: In copper-induced LDL oxidation, resveratrol at 0-1 µM inhibits conjugated diene formation by extending the lag phase and lowering V_max of peroxidation, without substantially changing OD_max at low concentrations. This antioxidant effect on lipoprotein oxidation underlies part of resveratrol's proposed atheroprotective action.
context.zh-TW: 在銅誘發的 LDL 氧化中，0-1 µM 的 Resveratrol 可抑制 Conjugated Dienes 形成，延長 lag phase 並降低過氧化作用的 V_max，而在低濃度時大致不影響 OD_max。這種對脂蛋白氧化的抗氧化作用構成 Resveratrol 被認為具有保護血管作用的部分機制。

context.en-US: CTGF (CCN2), a ~36-38 kDa matricellular protein of the CCN family, is a major secreted component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. Senescent cells release it in response to DNA damage, and CTGF secreted by senescent fibroblasts in the tumor microenvironment promotes paracrine tumor progression and fibrosis (Coppé et al., 2010).
context.zh-TW: CTGF（CCN2）是 CCN 家族中約 36-38 kDa 的 matricellular 蛋白，也是 SASP 的主要分泌組成。衰老細胞在 DNA 損傷時會釋放 CTGF，而腫瘤微環境中衰老纖維母細胞分泌的 CTGF 會促進旁分泌型腫瘤進展與 Fibrosis（Coppé et al., 2010）。

context.en-US: CTGF is a central mediator of fibrotic tissue remodeling: it cooperates with TGFβ to amplify TGF-β/Smad signaling, drives fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation, and stimulates fibronectin and collagen deposition. Elevated CTGF is implicated in pulmonary, hepatic, and renal fibrosis, and CTGF-neutralizing antibodies reduce fibrosis in preclinical models.
context.zh-TW: CTGF 是纖維化組織重塑的核心介導者：它與 TGFβ 協同放大 TGF-β/Smad 訊號、促進纖維母細胞向肌纖維母細胞分化，並刺激 fibronectin 與 collagen 沉積。CTGF 升高與肺部、肝臟及腎臟 Fibrosis 有關，而 CTGF 中和抗體在臨床前模型中可減少纖維化。

context.en-US: CTGF transcription is induced downstream of TGFβ as well as IL-6, IL-8, and mechanical stress, and the resulting CTGF protein cooperates back with TGFβ to enhance fibrotic responses through integrin αvβ3, α5β1, and α6β4 signaling, MAPK/ERK, and PI3K/Akt. CTGF thus sits in a positive feedback loop with TGFβ.
context.zh-TW: CTGF 的轉錄會在 TGFβ、IL-6、IL-8 與機械性壓力下游被誘導，而所產生的 CTGF 蛋白再回頭與 TGFβ 協同，透過 integrin αvβ3、α5β1、α6β4 訊號、MAPK/ERK 與 PI3K/Akt 增強纖維化反應。因此 CTGF 與 TGFβ 之間形成正回饋迴路。

context.en-US: CpG islands are genomic regions enriched in CpG dinucleotides, usually in gene promoters. Methylation of these islands typically silences the associated gene, and age-associated hypermethylation of specific CpG islands is used to build DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks that estimate biological age.
context.zh-TW: CpG Island 是富含 CpG 二核苷酸（通常位於基因啟動子）的基因體區域。這些 island 的甲基化通常會使相關基因沉默，而特定 CpG Island 隨年齡增加的過甲基化則被用於建立以 DNA 甲基化為基礎、估算生理年齡的 Epigenetic Clock。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial DNA retains unmethylated CpG islands that resemble bacterial DNA sequences. Because of this, mtDNA released into the cytosol or endosomes is read as a pathogen-associated molecular pattern, activating TLR9 and p38 MAPK/NF-κB signaling, and cGAS-STING to produce type I interferons and the SASP.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體 DNA 保留了類似細菌 DNA 的未甲基化 CpG Islands。因此釋放至細胞質或內體的 mtDNA 會被視為病原相關分子模式，啟動 TLR9 與 p38 MAPK/NF-κB 訊號，以及 cGAS-STING 以產生第一型干擾素與 SASP。

context.en-US: Endosomal TLR9 recognizes unmethylated CpG motifs. In senescent cells, low-grade apoptotic stress causes minority mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, releasing mtDNA containing unmethylated CpG islands into the cytosol; these act as DAMP signals that activate TLR9-p38 MAPK-NF-κB and drive the pro-inflammatory SASP. Circulating CpG-bearing mtDNA rises with age, linking CpG sensing to inflammaging.
context.zh-TW: 內體中的 TLR9 會辨識未甲基化的 CpG motif。在衰老細胞中，低程度的凋亡壓力造成 minority MOMP，使含有未甲基化 CpG Islands 的 mtDNA 釋放至細胞質；這些作為 DAMP 訊號啟動 TLR9-p38 MAPK-NF-κB 並推動促發炎 SASP。帶有 CpG 的循環 mtDNA 隨年齡上升，將 CpG 感知與 inflammaging 連結起來。

context.en-US: The creatine phosphate (phosphocreatine/creatine kinase) shuttle is built on compartmentalized creatine kinase isoforms: mitochondrial CK sits on the outer mitochondrial membrane near the adenine nucleotide translocator and uses exported matrix ATP to phosphorylate creatine, while cytosolic, sarcomeric, and brain-type CK isoforms regenerate ATP from phosphocreatine plus ADP at the sites of ATP consumption.
context.zh-TW: creatine phosphate（phosphocreatine/creatine kinase）shuttle 建立在分區化的 creatine kinase 異型酶之上：粒線體型 CK 定位於外膜、靠近 adenine nucleotide translocator，利用外排的基質 ATP 磷酸化 creatine；而細胞質型、sarcomeric 與腦型 CK 異型酶則在 ATP 消耗位點以 phosphocreatine 加上 ADP 重新生成 ATP。

context.en-US: By shuttling high-energy phosphate as diffusible phosphocreatine rather than ATP, and by keeping matrix ADP low near the electron transport chain, the creatine phosphate shuttle suppresses mitochondrial reactive oxygen species generation and buffers ATP/ADP ratios at ATP-consuming sites. This gives creatine an indirect antioxidant role.
context.zh-TW: 藉由以可擴散的 phosphocreatine（而非 ATP）運送高能磷酸，並在電子傳遞鏈附近維持低濃度 ADP，Creatine Phosphate Shuttle 會抑制粒線體 Reactive Oxygen Species 的生成，並在 ATP 消耗位點緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值。這賦予 creatine 間接的抗氧化角色。

context.en-US: Long-term creatine supplementation raises total cellular phosphocreatine stores and thereby increases the capacity of the creatine phosphate shuttle to resynthesize ATP during bursts of demand. This is the metabolic basis for creatine's ergogenic and therapeutic effects in muscle, brain, and heart.
context.zh-TW: 長期 creatine 補充會提高細胞總 phosphocreatine 儲量，進而增強 Creatine Phosphate Shuttle 在需求爆发時重新合成 ATP 的能力。這是 creatine 在肌肉、腦與心臟產生運動增益與治療效果的代謝基礎。

context.en-US: One form of cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome arises from mutations in arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT), the enzyme that catalyzes the first committed step of creatine synthesis, producing guanidinoacetate. The resulting cerebral creatine and phosphocreatine depletion produces intellectual disability, speech delay, epilepsy, and myopathy.
context.zh-TW: 腦型 creatine 缺乏症候群的一種形式源自 arginine:glycine amidinotransferase（AGAT）突變，該酵素催化 creatine 合成第一個committed步驟以產生 guanidinoacetate。由此造成的腦部 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 缺乏會導致智能障礙、語言延遲、epilepsy 與肌病變。

context.en-US: GAMT deficiency results from loss of guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase, the enzyme that methylates guanidinoacetate to creatine. Guanidinoacetate accumulates to toxic levels, cerebral creatine falls, and patients present with developmental delay, epilepsy, autism-like features, and movement disorders.
context.zh-TW: GAMT 缺乏源自 guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase 的缺失，該酵素將 guanidinoacetate 甲基化為 creatine。guanidinoacetate 累積至毒性濃度、腦部 creatine 下降，患者出現發育遲緩、epilepsy、自閉症樣特徵與動作障礙。

context.en-US: High-dose, long-term creatine monohydrate supplementation (0.3-0.8 g/kg/day) is the standard therapy for AGAT and GAMT deficiencies: it can normalize brain creatine and phosphocreatine and improve or stabilize neurodevelopmental outcomes, especially when started early. SLC6A8 transporter deficiency responds poorly because cellular uptake itself is blocked.
context.zh-TW: 高劑量、長期的 creatine monohydrate 補充（0.3-0.8 g/kg/day）是 AGAT 與 GAMT 缺乏的標準療法：可使腦部 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 恢復正常，並改善或穩定神經發育結果，尤其在早期開始時。SLC6A8 transporter 缺乏因細胞攝取本身受阻而反應較差。

context.en-US: In creatine synthesis or transport deficiency, tissue creatine and phosphocreatine fall, most severely in the brain. Because the creatine phosphate shuttle underpins neuronal energy buffering, the cerebral deficit manifests as intellectual disability, speech and language delay, epilepsy, autism-like features, and movement disorders with myopathic weakness.
context.zh-TW: 在 creatine 合成或運輸缺陷中，組織的 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 下降，以 Brain 最為嚴重。由於 Creatine Phosphate Shuttle 是神經元能量緩衝的基礎，腦部缺陷表現為智能障礙、語言發育延遲、epilepsy、自閉症樣特徵，以及伴隨肌無力的動作障礙。

context.en-US: Creatine transporters are sodium- and chloride-dependent symporters of the SLC6 family, of which SLC6A8 (CT1) is the principal isoform mediating cellular creatine uptake. SLC6A8 is expressed in brain, muscle, heart, and at the blood-brain and blood-CSF barriers, and imported creatine feeds the creatine phosphate shuttle via creatine kinase.
context.zh-TW: creatine transporter 是 SLC6 家族的鈉與氯依賴性同向運輸體，其中 SLC6A8（CT1）是負責細胞攝取 creatine 的主要異型酶。SLC6A8 表現於腦、肌肉、心臟以及 blood-brain 與血腦脊髓液屏障，而攝入的 creatine 透過 creatine kinase 供應 Creatine Phosphate Shuttle。

context.en-US: Non-synonymous mutations in SLC6A8 cause creatine transporter deficiency, a form of cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome accounting for roughly 2% of intellectual disability in boys. Reduced uptake lowers brain creatine and phosphocreatine, causing developmental delay, epilepsy, autism-like features, and speech deficits, and oral creatine is less effective because the uptake step itself is blocked.
context.zh-TW: SLC6A8 的非同義突變造成 creatine transporter deficiency，屬於腦型 creatine 缺乏症候群，約占男性智能障礙的 2%。攝取下降使腦部 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 減少，造成發育遲緩、epilepsy、自閉症樣特徵與語言缺陷；由於攝取步驟本身受阻，口服 creatine 的效果較差。

context.en-US: The creatine transporter gene SLC6A8 is markedly upregulated in tumor-infiltrating immune cells, and creatine uptake through it is required for effective CD8 T cell antitumor function (Di Biase et al., 2019). This links the creatine transport system to cancer immunotherapy.
context.zh-TW: creatine transporter 基因 SLC6A8 在腫瘤浸潤免疫細胞中顯著上调，透過它攝取 creatine 對 CD8 T cells 有效的抗腫瘤功能是必要的（Di Biase et al., 2019）。這將 creatine 運輸系統與癌症免疫治療連結起來。

context.en-US: Creatinine is a cyclic nitrogenous waste product generated spontaneously and non-enzymatically by dehydration of creatine and phosphocreatine in muscle, at roughly 1-2% of the total creatine pool per day. Because production is proportional to muscle mass, sarcopenia lowers creatinine levels, and dietary creatine intake transiently elevates serum creatinine without indicating renal injury.
context.zh-TW: Creatinine 是肌肉中 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 經非酵素性脫水自發產生的環狀含氮廢物，每日約佔總 creatine 儲量的 1-2%。由於生成量與肌肉量成正比，sarcopenia 會降低 creatinine 濃度，而飲食攝取 creatine 會暫時升高 serum creatinine，卻不表示腎臟損傷。

context.en-US: Serum creatinine is freely filtered by the glomeruli and is the cornerstone of routine renal function assessment, used to estimate GFR via Cockcroft-Gault, MDRD, and CKD-EPI equations. Its main limitation is dependence on muscle mass, protein intake, and drugs such as cimetidine or trimethoprim that inhibit tubular secretion.
context.zh-TW: Serum creatinine 由腎小球自由濾過，是常規腎功能評估的基石，用於透過 Cockcroft-Gault、MDRD 與 CKD-EPI 公式估算 GFR。其主要限制是受肌肉量、蛋白質攝取，以及 cimetidine 或 trimethoprim 等抑制腎小管分泌的藥物影響。

context.en-US: Cystatin C is freely filtered at the glomerulus and independent of muscle mass, making it a superior marker of estimated GFR than creatinine in sarcopenia and aging. It is also built into GrimAge epigenetic clocks via methylation surrogates, rises with acute kidney injury, and predicts mortality.
context.zh-TW: Cystatin C 由腎小球自由濾過且與肌肉量無關，因此在 sarcopenia 與老化人群中是比 creatinine 更佳的 estimated GFR 指標。它的甲基化代理也被納入 GrimAge 表觀遺傳時鐘，並在 acute kidney injury 時上升且可預測死亡。

context.en-US: Cristae are the infoldings of the inner mitochondrial membrane that greatly increase its surface area and provide the confined compartment housing the respiratory chain complexes I-IV, ATP synthase, and TCA-cycle intermediates. They are the primary site of ATP synthesis and also contribute to calcium sequestration.
context.zh-TW: Cristae 是粒線體內膜的內褶，極大增加其表面積，並提供容納呼吸鏈複合體 I-IV、ATP synthase 與 TCA 循環中間產物的受限空間。它們是 ATP 合成的主要場所，也參與鈣的封存。

context.en-US: OPA1 is a dynamin-related GTPase that regulates cristae morphology and inner membrane fusion, with OPA1 oligomers maintaining cristae junction tightness. Disruption of cristae architecture impairs ATP production in cardiomyocytes and neurons, contributing to cardiac dysfunction and neurodegeneration.
context.zh-TW: OPA1 是 dynamin 相關的 GTPase，調節 cristae 形態與內膜融合，OPA1 寡聚體維持 cristae junction 的緊密性。Cristae 結構遭破壞會損害心肌細胞與神經元中的 ATP 生成，促成心臟功能失調與神經退化。

context.en-US: Cardiolipin, the unique mitochondrial phospholipid, is essential for cristae assembly and stability, contributing to the curvature and mechanical integrity of the inner membrane folds on which oxidative phosphorylation depends.
context.zh-TW: Cardiolipin 是粒線體特有的磷脂，對 cristae 的組裝與穩定至關重要，並促成內膜褶皺（Oxidative Phosphorylation 依賴其上）的曲率與機械完整性。

context.en-US: Cristae remodeling during apoptotic mitochondrial permeabilization liberates cytochrome c from the intermembrane space into the cytosol, where it activates the apoptosome and the caspase cascade. Cristae are therefore the structural compartment whose remodeling couples cristae integrity to cell death signaling.
context.zh-TW: 凋亡性粒線體通透化過程中的 cristae 重塑會將 cytochrome c 從膜間腔釋放至細胞質，在該處活化 apoptosome 與 caspase 级聯。因此 cristae 是將其結構完整性與細胞死亡訊號連結起來的功能區室。

context.en-US: Deletion of Caspase-8 or FADD from intestinal epithelium triggers spontaneous RIPK3-dependent necroptosis, and the resulting pathology is morphologically similar to inflammatory bowel disease, especially Crohn's disease (Günther et al., Nature 2011; Welz et al., Nature 2011). The Caspase-8-FADD-c-FLIP complex is therefore the principal anti-necroptotic brake in the epithelium.
context.zh-TW: 在腸道上皮中刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會誘發自發性的 RIPK3 依賴性 Necroptosis，其病理形態與發炎性腸病（尤其 Crohn's Disease）相似（Günther et al., Nature 2011；Welz et al., Nature 2011）。因此 Caspase-8-FADD-c-FLIP 複合體是上皮中主要的抗 necroptosis 煞車。

context.en-US: Crohn's disease serves as the clinical archetype for spontaneous necroptotic intestinal disease: RIPK3-dependent epithelial necroptosis after FADD/caspase-8 deletion reproduces lesions 'morphologically similar to those seen in inflammatory bowel diseases, especially Crohn's disease'. Necrotic epithelial death releases DAMPs and destroys the mucosal barrier, feeding chronic inflammation, and the phenotype is fully rescued on a RIPK3-deficient background.
context.zh-TW: Crohn's Disease 是自發性 necroptotic 腸道疾病的臨床原型：FADD/caspase-8 刪除後 RIPK3 依賴性的上皮 necroptosis 會重現「形態上類似發炎性腸病、尤其 Crohn's Disease 所見」的病灶。壞死性上皮死亡釋放 DAMPs 並破壞黏膜屏障，助長慢性發炎，而該表型在 RIPK3 缺乏背景下完全被挽救。

context.en-US: The dominant pathological form of protein cross-linking in aging and metabolic disease is non-enzymatic: reducing sugars react continuously with free amino groups of proteins through Schiff-base and Amadori intermediates to form stable cross-links such as glucosepane and pentosidine. Because sugar-protein adducts persist for months to years, cross-linking accumulates progressively with age.
context.zh-TW: 在老化與代謝疾病中，蛋白質 cross-linking 的主要病理形式是非酵素性的：還原糖持續與蛋白質的游離胺基反應，經 Schiff base 與 Amadori 中間產物形成如 glucosepane 與 pentosidine 的穩定交聯。由於糖-蛋白加合物可持續數月至數年，cross-linking 隨年齡逐步累積。

context.en-US: Non-enzymatic cross-links between structural proteins such as collagen and elastin reduce tissue elasticity, stiffening the extracellular matrix. This matrix stiffening is a leading mechanism behind arterial stiffness, cardiac hypertrophy, and senile cataract, and AGE cross-linking of vessel-wall matrix together with glycation of LDL promotes atherosclerosis.
context.zh-TW: collagen 與彈性纖維等結構蛋白之間的非酵素性交聯降低組織彈性、使細胞外基質僵硬。這種基質僵硬是 Arterial Stiffness、Cardiac Hypertrophy 與老年性 Cataract 背後的主要機制，而血管壁基質的 AGE cross-linking 連同 LDL 的 glycation 會促進 Atherosclerosis。

context.en-US: Crown-like structures (CLS) are histological formations in obese adipose tissue in which macrophages, predominantly of the pro-inflammatory M1 phenotype, form a ring around a single dead or dying adipocyte. CLS form after adipocyte hypertrophy and death, and their density in biopsies reports the inflammatory status of the tissue.
context.zh-TW: Crown-like Structures（CLS）是肥胖脂肪組織中的組織學構造，巨噬細胞（以促發炎 M1 表型為主）環繞單一死亡或瀕死 adipocyte 形成環狀排列。CLS 在 adipocyte肥大與死亡後形成，其在活檢中的密度可反映組織的發炎狀態。

context.en-US: Macrophages in crown-like structures secrete TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6 and MCP-1, and these cytokines impair insulin signaling through activation of NF-κB, JNK, and IKKβ. CLS density therefore correlates with insulin resistance, with worse glycemic control in type 2 diabetes, and with metabolic dysfunction severity.
context.zh-TW: Crown-like Structures 中的巨噬細胞分泌 TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6 與 MCP-1，這些細胞激素透過 NF-κB、JNK 與 IKKbeta 的活化損害胰島素訊號。因此 CLS 密度與胰島素阻抗相關，並與 type 2 diabetes 中較差的血糖控制及代謝功能失調的嚴重程度相關。

context.en-US: SIRT1 exerts anti-inflammatory effects in adipose tissue by inhibiting NF-κB signaling, reducing macrophage infiltration, and promoting polarization toward the anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype; SIRT6 acts similarly by suppressing inflammatory signaling. Loss of SIRT3, in contrast, activates the NLRP3 inflammasome and enhances adipose tissue inflammation.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過抑制 NF-κB 訊號、減少巨噬細胞浸潤並促進向抗發炎 M2 表型的極化，在脂肪組織中發揮抗發炎作用；SIRT6 也藉由抑制發炎訊號產生類似效果。相反地，SIRT3 缺失會活化 NLRP3 發炎小體並加劇脂肪組織發炎。

context.en-US: SIRT6 deacetylates CtIP (RBBP8) as one of its specific protein substrates, alongside H3K9Ac, H3K56Ac, and GCN5. This deacetylation is one route through which SIRT6 maintains genomic stability, metabolic homeostasis, and inflammatory control (Giblin et al. 2014).
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 將 CtIP（RBBP8）去乙醯化，與 H3K9Ac、H3K56Ac 及 GCN5 並列為其特定蛋白質受質。此去乙醯化是 SIRT6 維持基因體穩定性、代謝恆定與發炎調控的途徑之一（Giblin et al. 2014）。

context.en-US: CtIP is the nuclear factor required for 5'-3' end resection of DNA double-strand breaks, the rate-limiting step that commits a cell to homologous recombination repair. Through this resection activity CtIP supports DNA repair and suppresses chromosomal instability.
context.zh-TW: CtIP 是 DNA 雙股斷裂 5'-3' 端切除所需的核因子，此步驟是將細胞導向同源重組修復的限速步驟。透過此切除活性，CtIP 支持 DNA Repair 並抑制染色體不穩定。

context.en-US: Cyanosis is the bluish or grayish discoloration of skin and mucous membranes that appears when the absolute concentration of deoxygenated hemoglobin in capillaries exceeds roughly 3-5 g/dL, because deoxygenated hemoglobin absorbs light differently from the oxygenated form. Anemic patients therefore may not appear cyanotic despite significant hypoxia, while polycythemic patients become cyanotic more readily.
context.zh-TW: Cyanosis 是皮膚與黏膜出現的藍色或灰色變色，當微血管中去氧 Hemoglobin 的絕對濃度超過約 3-5 g/dL 時出現，因為去氧血紅素與含氧型吸光特性不同。因此貧血患者即使有明顯 hypoxia 也可能不發紺，而紅血球增多症患者更容易出現發紺。

context.en-US: In methemoglobinemia, iron in hemoglobin is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state, producing methemoglobin that cannot bind oxygen and imparting a characteristic slate-gray or chocolate-brown discoloration that does not improve with supplemental oxygen. Pulse oximetry may read falsely normal, and methylene blue is the antidote for symptomatic cases.
context.zh-TW: 在 Methemoglobinemia 中，Hemoglobin 的鐵由亞鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+），生成無法結合氧氣的 Methemoglobin，並造成特有的石板灰或巧克力棕色變色，且不因補充氧氣而改善。脈搏血氧儀可能讀數偽裝正常，Methylene blue 則是症狀性病例的解毒劑。

context.en-US: cGAS synthesizes the endogenous cyclic dinucleotide messenger 2'3'-cGAMP from ATP and GTP upon sensing cytosolic DNA. cGAMP then binds STING in the endoplasmic reticulum, triggering STING translocation to the ERGIC and recruitment of TBK1 and IRF3 to drive type I interferon and ISG expression.
context.zh-TW: cGAS 在偵測到細胞質 DNA 後，以 ATP 與 GTP 合成內源性 Cyclic Dinucleotide 訊息傳遞者 2'3'-cGAMP。cGAMP 接著在內質網中結合 STING，促使 STING 易位至 ERGIC 並招募 TBK1 與 IRF3，進而驅動第一型干擾素與 ISG 的表現。

context.en-US: Cyclic dinucleotides are the direct ligands of STING. Exogenous bacterial CDNs such as c-di-GMP and c-di-AMP, like endogenous 2'3'-cGAMP, engage STING as potent agonists, and because CDNs can pass between cells through gap junctions, PANX1 channels, and extracellular vesicles, they act as intercellular alarm signals that spread cGAS-STING activation. Synthetic CDNs are exploited as vaccine adjuvants and STING-activating therapeutics.
context.zh-TW: Cyclic Dinucleotide 是 STING 的直接配體。細菌來源的 c-di-GMP 與 c-di-AMP 等外源性 CDN，與內源性 2'3'-cGAMP 一樣，都是 STING 的高效激動劑；由於 CDN 可經由 Gap Junction、PANX1 通道與 extracellular vesicles 在細胞間傳遞，它們充當細胞間警報訊號而擴散 cGAS-STING 活化。合成 CDN 則被用作疫苗佐劑與 STING 活化療法。

context.en-US: Dysregulated cyclic dinucleotide accumulation, whether from excessive cGAS activity or impaired CDN degradation, drives chronic inflammation and neuroinflammation. Sensing of CDNs is therefore a double-edged target, valuable for antiviral and antitumor therapy but harmful when chronically active.
context.zh-TW: Cyclic Dinucleotide 的失調累積——無論源自 cGAS 過度活化或 CDN 降解受阻——都會驅動慢性發炎與 Neuroinflammation。因此對 CDN 的感知是一個雙刃的標的：對抗病毒與抗腫瘤療法有價值，但慢性活化時則有害。

context.en-US: Soluble guanylyl cyclase, when activated by nitric oxide produced downstream of inducible nitric oxide synthase, generates cyclic GMP, which mediates smooth-muscle relaxation, vasodilation and platelet inhibition. Methylene blue blocks the pathway at soluble guanylyl cyclase while aminoguanidine blocks it upstream at inducible nitric oxide synthase.
context.zh-TW: Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase 在受到 inducible nitric oxide synthase 下游產生的 Nitric Oxide 活化後，生成 Cyclic Guanosine Monophosphate，後者介導平滑肌舒張、Vasodilation 與 Platelet 抑制。Methylene blue 在 Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase 層級阻斷此路徑，而 Aminoguanidine 則在上游的 inducible nitric oxide synthase 層級阻斷。

context.en-US: Cyclin A is an S/G2-phase cyclin whose complex with CDK2 initiates and executes S phase, with Cyclin A-CDK1 later contributing to mitotic entry. Cyclin A is then degraded via the APC/C at the metaphase-anaphase transition, enforcing irreversible cell-cycle progression.
context.zh-TW: Cyclin A 是 S/G2 期的 cyclin，與 CDK2 形成的複合體啟動並執行 S 期，之後 Cyclin A-CDK1 參與有絲分裂進入。Cyclin A 隨後在中期-後期轉換時經 APC/C 降解，使細胞週期進展不可逆。

context.en-US: In senescent or metabolically stressed cells, activated AMPK prevents the RNA-binding protein HuR from translocating from nucleus to cytosol. With less cytosolic HuR to stabilize and translate their mRNAs, the proliferative transcripts Cyclin A, Cyclin B, and c-Fos fall, contributing to the permanent cell-cycle arrest of senescence.
context.zh-TW: 在衰老或代謝壓力細胞中，活化的 AMPK 阻止 RNA 結合蛋白 HuR 由細胞核轉位至細胞質。細胞質 HuR 減少後，無法穩定並轉譯其 mRNA，增殖相關的 Cyclin A、Cyclin B 與 c-Fos 轉錄本下降，促成 Senescence 的永久性細胞週期停滯。

context.en-US: Cyclin B is the G2/M cyclin whose binding activates CDK1, forming the Cyclin B-CDK1 (formerly MPF) complex that phosphorylates substrates required for nuclear envelope breakdown, chromosome condensation, and spindle assembly. Its abrupt APC/C-mediated destruction at anaphase enforces the G2/M checkpoint.
context.zh-TW: Cyclin B 是 G2/M cyclin，其結合可活化 CDK1，形成 Cyclin B-CDK1（舊稱 MPF）複合體，磷酸化核膜崩解、染色質濃縮與紡錘體組裝所需的受質。Cyclin B 在後期被 APC/C 迅速降解，使 G2/M 檢查點得以維持。

context.en-US: Cyclin D is the regulatory partner of CDK4/6, and the Cyclin D-CDK4/6 complex drives G1 phase progression by phosphorylating retinoblastoma protein, releasing E2F to permit S-phase gene expression. High levels of Cyclin D/E with CDK4/6 therefore increase proliferation by driving passage through G1.
context.zh-TW: Cyclin D 是 CDK4/6 的調節性搭檔，Cyclin D-CDK4/6 複合體透過磷酸化 Retinoblastoma Protein 釋放 E2F，驅動 G1 Phase 进展並允許 S 期基因表現。因此 Cyclin D/E 與 CDK4/6 濃度高會藉由通過 G1 而增加增殖。

context.en-US: Cyclin E binds CDK2 to drive the G1-to-S transition: Cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylates retinoblastoma protein, completes E2F release, and fires replication origins. Cyclin E is degraded after S-phase entry by SCF-Fbw7 ubiquitination, and impaired turnover causes replication stress and genomic instability; CCNE1 amplification in ovarian, endometrial and triple-negative breast cancer confers CDK2 dependence.
context.zh-TW: Cyclin E 與 CDK2 結合以驅動 G1 到 S 的轉換：Cyclin E-CDK2 磷酸化 Retinoblastoma Protein、完成 E2F 釋放並啟動複製起始點。Cyclin E 在 S 期進入後由 SCF-Fbw7 泛素化降解，降解受阻會造成複製壓力與基因體不穩定；CCNE1 在卵巢癌、子宮內膜癌與三陰性乳癌中的放大使腫瘤依賴 CDK2。

context.en-US: The CDK inhibitor p27 (CDKN1B) binds and inhibits Cyclin E-CDK2 to enforce G1 arrest and quiescence, preventing premature firing of replication origins. Cyclin E activity is otherwise induced downstream of Cyclin D-CDK4/6 signaling.
context.zh-TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27（CDKN1B）結合並抑制 Cyclin E-CDK2，以維持 G1 停滯與 quiescence，防止複製起始點被提早啟動。Cyclin E 的活性則在 Cyclin D-CDK4/6 訊號下游被誘導。

context.en-US: Cyclodextrins are cyclic oligosaccharides of six to eight alpha-D-glucopyranose units with a hydrophobic cavity and hydrophilic exterior. They form inclusion complexes with lipophilic guests, raising their aqueous solubility and bioavailability; fisetin complexed with alpha-, beta- and gamma-CD and derivatives gained 1.6- to 161.9-fold in solubility, though the resulting bioactivity was inconsistent.
context.zh-TW: Cyclodextrins 是由六至八個 alpha-D-glucopyranose 單元組成、具有疏水性空腔與親水性外殼的環狀寡糖。它們與親脂性客体形成包埋複合物，提高其水溶性與 Bioavailability；fisetin 與 alpha-、beta-、gamma-CD 及其衍生物形成的複合物溶解度提升 1.6 至 161.9 倍，但產生的生物活性並不一致。

context.en-US: Cyclodextrins encapsulate poorly water-soluble hydrophobic drugs, and methyl-beta-cyclodextrin complexed 1:1 with fenbendazole reached 20.21 mg/ml water solubility with 75% release in 15 minutes, meeting thresholds for systemic anticancer use. Cyclodextrin derivatives are therefore common pharmaceutical solubilizers.
context.zh-TW: Cyclodextrin 會包埋水溶性差的疏水性藥物，Methyl-beta-cyclodextrin 與 fenbendazole 以 1:1 形成的複合物達到 20.21 mg/ml 的水溶性並在 15 分鐘內釋放 75%，符合全身性抗癌使用的門檻。因此 cyclodextrin 衍生物是常見的藥物增溶劑。

context.en-US: Cyclophilin D (PPIF) is a mitochondrial matrix peptidyl-prolyl isomerase and the primary positive regulator of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. It binds the pore and promotes its opening in response to matrix calcium overload and reactive oxygen species, thereby gating cytochrome c release upstream of the caspase cascade and making CypD a senolytic target in senescent cells.
context.zh-TW: Cyclophilin D（PPIF）是粒線體基質的 peptidyl-prolyl isomerase，也是 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 的主要正向調節者。它結合孔道並在基質鈣過載與 Reactive Oxygen Species 作用下促進孔道開啟，藉此在 caspase 级聯上游控制 Cytochrome c 釋放，並使 CypD 成為衰老細胞的 senolytic 標的。

context.en-US: SIRT3 deacetylates Cyclophilin D, diminishing its peptidyl-prolyl isomerase activity and dissociating it from the adenine nucleotide translocase, which raises the threshold for mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening and delays cytochrome c release. SIRT3 activation therefore attenuates apoptosis, and Sirt3-null cardiomyocytes show age-dependent swelling from spontaneous pore opening.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 Cyclophilin D，降低其 peptidyl-prolyl isomerase 活性並使其與腺嘌呤核苷酸轉位酶分離，因而提高 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟的門檻並延後 Cytochrome c 釋放。SIRT3 活化因此抑制 Apoptosis，而 Sirt3 缺失的心肌細胞會因自發性孔道開啟而出現與年齡相關的膨脹。

context.en-US: Upstream of the necroptotic program, RIPK3 upregulates PGAM5, which enhances Cyclophilin D phosphorylation, prolongs mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening, and drives endothelial necroptosis in cardiac microvascular ischemia-reperfusion. This makes CypD-mPTP the mitochondrial execution arm of necroptosis, complementary to the MLKL plasma-membrane pore arm.
context.zh-TW: 在 necroptosis 計畫的上游，RIPK3 上調 PGAM5，後者促進 Cyclophilin D 磷酸化、延長 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟時間，並在心肌微血管缺血再灌流中驅動內皮 necroptosis。這使 CypD-mPTP 成為 necroptosis 的粒線體執行臂，與 MLKL 質膜孔道臂互補。

context.en-US: In Alzheimer's disease, amyloid-beta pathology increases Cyclophilin D expression and promotes mitochondrial permeability transition pore formation, linking neuronal energy deficits and cytochrome c release to neurodegeneration. Elevated mPTP activity with transient flickering opening is also characteristic of senescent cells, where inhibiting CypD causes calcium accumulation and cell death.
context.zh-TW: 在 Alzheimer's Disease 中，類澱粉 beta 病理會提高 Cyclophilin D 表現並促進 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 形成，將神經元能量缺失與 Cytochrome c 釋放連結至神經退化。衰老細胞也特徵性地呈現升高的 mPTP 活性與暫時性 flickering 開啟，此時抑制 CypD 會導致鈣累積與細胞死亡。

context.en-US: Cysteine is the rate-limiting substrate for glutathione (GSH) biosynthesis: gamma-glutamylcysteine synthetase first condenses glutamate with cysteine, and glutathione synthetase then adds glycine. Because intracellular cysteine availability sets the size of the glutathione pool, cysteine supply through cystine uptake via the xc- antiporter (SLC7A11) and transsulfuration flux is the principal determinant of cellular redox capacity.
context.zh-TW: Cysteine 是 glutathione (GSH) 生合成的限速受質：gamma-glutamylcysteine synthetase 先將 glutamate 與 cysteine 縮合，再由 glutathione synthetase 加入 glycine。由於細胞內 cysteine 的可用量決定了 glutathione 的儲備量，因此透過 xc- 反向運輸蛋白 (SLC7A11) 的 cystine 攝取與 transsulfuration 通量所提供的 cysteine 供應，是細胞抗氧化能力的首要決定因子。

context.en-US: Cysteine is synthesized endogenously through the transsulfuration pathway, in which homocysteine — itself generated from methionine via S-adenosylmethionine and S-adenosylhomocysteine — is condensed with serine by cystathionine beta-synthase and then cleaved by cystathionine gamma-lyase to yield cysteine. Cysteine is therefore classified as a semi-essential amino acid whose dietary requirement rises when methionine is scarce or oxidative stress is high.
context.zh-TW: Cysteine 透過 transsulfuration 路徑在體內合成：homocysteine（本身由 methionine 經 S-adenosylmethionine 與 S-adenosylhomocysteine 產生）先由 cystathionine beta-synthase 與 serine 縮合成 cystathionine，再由 cystathionine gamma-lyase 裂解產出 cysteine。因此 cysteine 被歸類為半必需胺基酸，當 methionine 供應不足或氧化壓力升高時，其膳食需求會上升。

context.en-US: The cysteine thiol group coordinates zinc and other transition metals, making cysteine residues integral to zinc finger protein domains. The same chemistry allows cysteine to assemble [2Fe-2S] and [4Fe-4S] clusters in mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes and to buffer metals in metallothionein, so cysteine is a structural requirement for metalloprotein function rather than a purely structural residue.
context.zh-TW: Cysteine 的 thiol 基可配位 zinc 及其他過渡金屬，因此 cysteine 殘基是 zinc finger 蛋白結構域不可分割的一部分。相同的化學性質也使 cysteine 能在粒線體呼吸鏈複合體中組裝 [2Fe-2S] 與 [4Fe-4S] 群集，並在 metallothionein 中緩衝金屬；因此 cysteine 是金屬蛋白功能的結構性必要條件，而非單純的結構殘基。

context.en-US: In catabolism, cysteine is oxidized by cysteine dioxygenase to cysteine sulfinic acid, which can be decarboxylated to hypotaurine and then oxidized to taurine. Taurine is required for bile acid conjugation and osmoregulation, so cysteine catabolism feeds directly into the taurine pool.
context.zh-TW: 在分解代謝中，cysteine 經 cysteine dioxygenase 氧化形成 cysteine sulfinic acid，後者可脫羧生成 hypotaurine，再氧化為 taurine。Taurine 對 bile acid 結合與滲透壓調節皆有必要，因此 cysteine 的分解代謝直接供應 taurine 池。

context.en-US: N-acetylcysteine is a pharmacologically important derivative of cysteine in which the amino group is acetylated, which increases stability and oral bioavailability. After deacetylation in vivo it is readily converted to cysteine, thereby raising intracellular glutathione levels; this is why NAC is the established antidote for acetaminophen (paracetamol) hepatotoxicity and a mucolytic that cleaves disulfide bonds in mucus glycoproteins.
context.zh-TW: N-acetylcysteine 是 cysteine 的重要藥理衍生體，其胺基經乙醯化後穩定性與口服生體可用性提高。進入體內後很容易去乙醯化轉回 cysteine，進而提升細胞內 glutathione 濃度；這也是 NAC 成為 acetaminophen (paracetamol) 肝毒性既定解毒劑，以及能切断黏液醣蛋白雙硫鍵之 mucolytic 的原因。

context.en-US: Cytochrome b5 reductase, also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, is the enzyme that returns spontaneously formed methemoglobin (normally under 1-2% of total hemoglobin) to its functional ferrous Fe2+ state. By keeping hemoglobin in the ferrous state, this enzyme is what makes hemoglobin able to carry oxygen.
context.zh-TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase（又稱 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase）是將自發形成的 methemoglobin（正常情況下佔總 hemoglobin 的 1–2% 以下）還原回具功能的 Fe2+ 狀態的酵素。藉由讓 hemoglobin 維持於 ferrous 狀態，此酵素使 hemoglobin 能夠攜帶氧氣。

context.en-US: Cytochrome b5 reductase and NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase are two names for the same NADH- cytochrome b5 oxidoreductase. Mutations in the CYB5R gene therefore reduce the activity of this same enzyme and cause congenital methemoglobinemia.
context.zh-TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase 與 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase 是同一個 NADH-cytochrome b5 oxidoreductase 的兩種名稱。因此 CYB5R 基因突變會降低此同一酵素的活性，並造成先天性 methemoglobinemia。

context.en-US: Because its only role in red cells is to keep hemoglobin reduced, loss of cytochrome b5 reductase activity leaves hemoglobin in the oxidized methemoglobin state. Deficiency of this enzyme is the direct cause of congenital methemoglobinemia, in which blood cannot carry oxygen normally.
context.zh-TW: 由於它在紅血球中的唯一作用就是維持 hemoglobin 處於還原態，cytochrome b5 reductase 活性喪失會使 hemoglobin 停留在氧化的 methemoglobin 狀態。此酵素的缺乏是先天性 methemoglobinemia 的直接成因，使血液無法正常攜帶氧氣。

context.en-US: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments are the primary endogenous ligand that activates cGAS-STING signaling in senescent cells. cGAS binds the fragments in a sequence-independent manner, recognizing DNA longer than 20 bp, and synthesizes 2'3'-cGAMP, which activates STING and the downstream TBK1-IRF3-NF-kB cascade.
context.zh-TW: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 是 senescent cells 中活化 cGAS-STING 訊號的主要內源性配體。cGAS 以不依賴序列的方式結合這些片段，辨識長度超過 20 bp 的 DNA，並合成 2'3'-cGAMP，進而活化 STING 與下游的 TBK1-IRF3-NF-κB 級聯反應。

context.en-US: By engaging cGAS-STING, cytoplasmic chromatin fragments drive transcription of type-I interferons and SASP factors such as IL-6, IL-8, CXCL10 and IFN-beta. The fragments are a primary upstream trigger of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype, converting benign nuclear damage into chronic pro-inflammatory signaling.
context.zh-TW: 透過啟動 cGAS-STING，cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 驅動 type-I interferon 與 IL-6、IL-8、CXCL10、IFN-beta 等 SASP 因子的轉錄。這些片段是 senescence-associated secretory phenotype 的主要上游觸發因子，將良性的核內損傷轉化為慢性發炎訊號。

context.en-US: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments appear specifically in senescent cells, where downregulation of Lamin B1 destabilizes the nuclear lamina, allowing the nuclear envelope to herniate and 1-10 kb genomic fragments enriched for LINE-1 repeats and pericentromeric satellite DNA to be extruded into the cytosol. Their burden is therefore a hallmark of the senescent state and correlates with inflammaging.
context.zh-TW: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 專門出現於 senescent cells：此時 Lamin B1 下調使核纖層失穩，核膜因而向外疝出，並將富含 LINE-1 重複序列與周 centromeric 衛星 DNA 的 1–10 kb 基因組片段排入細胞質。因此其累積量是 senescent state 的特徵，並與 inflammaging 相關。

context.en-US: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments are normally cleared from the cytosol by the DNases DNASE2 and TREX1. In senescent cells both enzymes are transcriptionally downregulated via the E2F complex, so the fragments persist, accumulate and remain available to stimulate cGAS-STING and hence the SASP.
context.zh-TW: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 正常情況下由 DNase DNASE2 與 TREX1 從細胞質中清除。在 senescent cells 中這兩種酵素皆經 E2F 複合體被轉錄性下調，因此這些片段持續存在、逐漸累積，並得以持續刺激 cGAS-STING 進而促進 SASP。

context.en-US: Actin microfilaments are a core structural element of the cytoskeleton, alongside microtubules and intermediate filaments. Actin-based structures such as stress fibers are anchored to the extracellular matrix by integrin-FAK adhesions at focal adhesions, which is how the cytoskeleton couples matrix stiffness to migration and proliferation signals.
context.zh-TW: Actin 微絲是 cytoskeleton 的核心結構元件之一，與微管及 intermediate filaments 並列。以 actin 為基礎的結構（如 stress fiber）透過 integrin-FAK 黏附在 focal adhesion 處錨定至細胞外基質；這正是 cytoskeleton 將基質硬度轉換為 migration 與增殖訊號的方式。

context.en-US: Cell migration is driven by cytoskeletal dynamics: actin polymerization at the leading edge generates protrusion, myosin motors on actin tracks produce contractility, and focal-adhesion turnover couples the cytoskeleton to matrix. FAK signaling transduces adhesion and stiffness cues into these cytoskeletal remodeling programs.
context.zh-TW: Cell migration 由 cytoskeleton 的動態變化驅動：前緣的 actin 聚合產生突出，actin 上的 myosin 马達產生收縮力，而 focal adhesion 的更替則把 cytoskeleton 與基質耦合。FAK signaling 將黏附與硬度訊號轉譯為這些 cytoskeleton 重塑程式。

context.en-US: Focal adhesion kinase signaling targets the cytoskeleton: integrin-engaged FAK at focal adhesions couples the extracellular matrix to actin stress fibers, transducing matrix stiffness into cytoskeletal remodeling, cell migration and proliferation. This makes FAK signaling the main route by which adhesion state becomes a cytoskeletal signal.
context.zh-TW: Focal adhesion kinase signaling 以 cytoskeleton 為標的：focal adhesion 中 integrin 活化的 FAK 將細胞外基質與 actin stress fiber 耦合，把基質硬度轉譯為 cytoskeleton 重塑、cell migration 與增殖。這使 FAK signaling 成為黏附狀態轉為 cytoskeleton 訊號的主要途徑。

context.en-US: Glycolysis, the first stage of glucose catabolism yielding net ATP, takes place in the cytosol. Because the cytosol excludes the contents of membrane-bound organelles such as the mitochondria, cytosolic glycolysis and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation are anatomically distinct routes of glucose-derived ATP production.
context.zh-TW: Glycolysis（葡萄糖分解的第一階段，產生淨 ATP）在 cytosol 中進行。由於 cytosol 不包含 mitochondria 等膜狀胞器內的內容物，cytosolic glycolysis 與粒線體的 oxidative phosphorylation 在解剖位置上分屬兩條不同的葡萄糖供能途徑。

context.en-US: Stress granules are membrane-less organelles that assemble within the cytosol. The cytosol is a crowded, structured medium rather than a static fluid, and liquid-liquid phase separation in it drives the formation of stress granules and processing bodies that sequester untranslated mRNAs during stress.
context.zh-TW: Stress granules 是在 cytosol 中組裝形成的無膜胞器。Cytosol 並非靜態流體，而是擁擠且具結構的介質，其中的 liquid-liquid phase separation 驅動 stress granules 與 processing bodies 的形成，在壓力下隔離未轉譯的 mRNA。

context.en-US: The cytosol is a crowded aqueous solution of roughly 70% water containing ions, metabolites such as ATP, NADH and NADPH, and 20-40% of cellular protein mass. Small molecules diffuse freely through this compartment, so cytosol is the medium in which most metabolic intermediates such as glycolytic intermediates move between enzymes.
context.zh-TW: Cytosol 是約含 70% 水的擁擠水溶液，內含離子、ATP/NADH/NADPH 等代謝物，以及細胞蛋白質總量的 20–40%。小分子在此區室中自由擴散，因此 cytosol 是絕大多數代謝中間物（如 glycolytic intermediates）在酵素之間移動的介質。

context.en-US: The dopamine transporter DAT is highly abundant in dopaminergic terminals, where it mediates rapid uptake of dopamine from the synaptic cleft. Cleared dopamine is either packaged into storage vesicles or degraded by monoamine oxidase, so DAT sets both the amplitude and the duration of dopaminergic signaling.
context.zh-TW: Dopamine transporter DAT 在 dopaminergic terminal 中高度表現，負責將 dopamine 由突觸間隙快速攝回。被清除的 dopamine 要么被包裝進儲存囊泡，要么由 monoamine oxidase 代謝，因此 DAT 同時決定了 dopaminergic 訊號的強度與持續時間。

context.en-US: DAXX is the obligate histone-chaperone partner of ATRX. The ATRX-DAXX complex is functionally inseparable: loss of DAXX phenocopies ATRX loss for ALT activation, showing that DAXX directs ATRX remodeling activity specifically to heterochromatic repeats rather than acting independently.
context.zh-TW: DAXX 是 ATRX 不可或缺的 histone chaperone 搭檔。ATRX-DAXX 複合體在功能上無法分割：DAXX 的喪失會表型模擬 ATRX 喪失所致的 ALT 活化，顯示 DAXX 是將 ATRX 的重塑活性導向異染色質重複序列，而非獨立作用。

context.en-US: As the H3.3-specific chaperone of the ATRX-DAXX complex, DAXX deposits the histone variant H3.3 at telomeres, pericentric heterochromatin and endogenous retroviruses. This targeted deposition is how the complex establishes and maintains heterochromatin at those repeat-rich loci.
context.zh-TW: 作為 ATRX-DAXX 複合體中專一於 H3.3 的 chaperone，DAXX 將 histone variant H3.3 沉積到 telomere、pericentric heterochromatin 與內源性反轉錄病毒上。這種標的性沉積正是該複合體在這些重複序列豐富的位點建立並維持異染色質的方式。

context.en-US: Through H3.3 deposition at telomeres, DAXX maintains telomeric chromatin; conversely, its loss can drive the alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT) pathway. The DAXX-ATRX axis therefore links maintenance of telomere heterochromatin with the telomere attrition seen in aging and cancer.
context.zh-TW: 透過在 telomere 沉積 H3.3，DAXX 維持 telomeric chromatin；反之，其喪失可能啟動 telomere 的 ALT 途徑。因此 DAXX-ATRX 軸將 telomere 異染色質的維持與老化及癌症中所見的 telomere attrition 連結起來。

context.en-US: DDX3X activates Wnt signaling by promoting the nuclear accumulation of beta-catenin. Because nuclear beta-catenin is the transcriptional effector of the canonical Wnt pathway, DDX3X sits upstream of beta-catenin-dependent transcription, linking an RNA helicase to proliferative and developmental gene programs.
context.zh-TW: DDX3X 藉由促進 beta-catenin 在細胞核內累積而活化 Wnt 訊號。由於核內的 beta-catenin 是典型 Wnt 路徑的轉錄效應因子，DDX3X 位於 beta-catenin 依賴性轉錄的上游，將一個 RNA helicase 與增殖及發育相關的基因程式連結起來。

context.en-US: DDX3X acts as an RNA-processing tumor suppressor: recurrent loss-of-function mutations occur in medulloblastoma, melanoma and other tumors, and in WNT-subtype medulloblastoma (~5-10% of cases) it is among the most frequently mutated genes, gating proliferation. Haploinsufficiency may promote genomic instability through defective DNA damage repair and aberrant cell cycle progression.
context.zh-TW: DDX3X 扮演 RNA 處理的腫瘤抑制基因：在 medulloblastoma、melanoma 及其他腫瘤中反覆出現 loss-of-function 突變；在 WNT 次型 medulloblastoma（約 5–10% 病例）中更是突變率最高的基因之一，扮演增殖的守門員。單倍剂量不足可能透過缺陷的 DNA 損傷修復與異常細胞週期進展而促進基因體不穩定。

context.en-US: DDX3X regulates cap-dependent translation by associating with eIF4E and eIF2alpha, acting as either a translational activator or repressor depending on context. It also participates in the exon junction complex and facilitates mRNA nuclear export, and its depletion causes G1 arrest, so its translational role is tied directly to cell-cycle control.
context.zh-TW: DDX3X 透過與 eIF4E 及 eIF2alpha 結合來調控 cap-dependent 轉譯，並依情境充當轉譯活化因子或抑制因子。它同時參與 exon junction complex 並促進 mRNA 核輸出，且其耗竭會造成 G1 期停滯，因此其轉譯相關功能與細胞週期調控直接相連。

context.en-US: DDX3X engages the p53 pathway through its roles in translation regulation and cell cycle control, adding a second layer of sex-specific cancer biology on top of its own X-linkage. Because males are hemizygous for DDX3X, a single loss-of-function mutation can eliminate this p53-adjacent checkpoint activity in male tumors.
context.zh-TW: DDX3X 透過其轉譯調控與細胞週期調控功能與 p53 路徑相互關聯，在其自身的 X 連結性之外再疊加一層與性別相關的癌症生物學。由於男性對 DDX3X 為半合子，單一 loss-of-function 突變即可在男性腫瘤中消除這項鄰近 p53 的檢查點活性。

context.en-US: DDX3Y is the Y-chromosome homolog of DDX3X. The two share ATP-dependent RNA unwinding and translation initiation, stress granule and Wnt functions, but the overlap is not identical: X-X female compensation is stronger than X-Y male compensation (36% chrX loss vs 8.2% chrY loss among mutated tumors, P=0.0022), leaving a net female advantage.
context.zh-TW: DDX3Y 是 DDX3X 的 Y 染色體同源基因。兩者共享 ATP 依賴性 RNA 解旋、轉譯起始、stress granule 與 Wnt 功能，但重疊並非完全一致：女性 X-X 補償強於男性 X-Y 補償（在突變腫瘤中 chrX 喪失 36% 對 chrY 喪失 8.2%，P=0.0022），因而保留了淨的女性優勢。

context.en-US: Because males are hemizygous for DDX3X, DDX3Y provides the only backup against a single-hit loss of that X-linked tumor suppressor. Mosaic loss of chromosome Y, common with aging and smoking, removes this backup, and male tumors with EXITS-gene mutations including DDX3X showed a trend toward chrY loss (10.2% vs 5.8%, P=0.077), compounding male vulnerability.
context.zh-TW: 由於男性對 DDX3X 為半合子，DDX3Y 是抵抗此 X 連結腫瘤抑制基因單一擊失活的唯一備援。染色體 Y 的嵌合性喪失（常見於老化與吸菸）會移除此備援，而帶有包含 DDX3X 在內之 EXITS 基因突變的男性腫瘤呈現朝向 chrY 喪失的趨勢（10.2% 對 5.8%，P=0.077），進一步加重男性的脆弱性。

context.en-US: DDX3Y is the Y-homolog corollary to the EXITS (Escape from X-Inactivation Tumor Suppressors) framework. Because DDX3Y is not a fully equivalent tumor suppressor, its presence cannot erase the sex-biased mutation pattern that the EXITS genes show across 21 tumor types.
context.zh-TW: DDX3Y 是 EXITS（Escape from X-Inactivation Tumor Suppressors）框架的 Y 同源補充說明。由於 DDX3Y 並非完全等效的腫瘤抑制基因，其存在無法抹消 EXITS 基因在 21 種腫瘤中呈現的性別偏倚突變型態。

context.en-US: Activated HRI phosphorylates the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha, which globally attenuates cap-dependent protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of stress-adaptive mRNAs, most notably ATF4. Slowing protein production lowers the folding burden on stressed mitochondria and launches transcriptional programs for metabolic remodeling and redox defense.
context.zh-TW: 被活化的 HRI 磷酸化轉譯起始因子 eIF2alpha，全域性抑制 cap-dependent 蛋白質合成，同時選擇性促進壓力適應性 mRNA（最具代表性者為 ATF4）的轉譯。降低蛋白質產量可減輕受壓粒線體的摺疊負擔，並啟動代謝重塑與氧化還原防禦的轉錄程式。

context.en-US: DELE1 couples detection of mitochondrial dysfunction at the inner membrane to activation of the cytosolic integrated stress response. Depending on the intensity and duration of stress, the outcome of this OMA1-DELE1-HRI signaling ranges from adaptive recovery to induction of apoptosis, and the pathway is implicated in neurodegeneration, cardiomyopathy and metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: DELE1 將內膜對粒線體功能失調的偵測與細胞質 integrated stress response 的活化耦合起來。此 OMA1-DELE1-HRI 訊號的結果依壓力的強度與持續時間而定，可從適應性恢復一路延伸至 apoptosis 的誘導；該途徑與神經退化、心肌病變及代謝疾病皆有關聯。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial dysfunction is the upstream trigger that DELE1 senses and relays: loss of membrane potential, failed protein import, misfolded protein accumulation and heme depletion all lead to OMA1 activation and DELE1 cleavage. DELE1 thus functions as a mitochondrial stress sensor on the route from organelle damage to whole-cell translational reprogramming.
context.zh-TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction 是 DELE1 所感知並中繼的上游觸發因子：膜電位喪失、蛋白質輸入失敗、錯誤摺疊蛋白累積與 heme 耗竭都會導致 OMA1 活化與 DELE1 被切割。因此 DELE1 扮演粒線體壓力感測器，位於胞器損傷通往全細胞轉譯重編程的路徑上。

context.en-US: DMT1 (SLC11A2) is a proton-coupled symporter that moves Fe2+ - and also Mn2+, Zn2+ and Cd2+ - from endosomes into the cytosol down its electrochemical gradient in exchange for H+. It is the gateway that releases transferrin-derived iron into the cytosol and is essential for dietary iron absorption, erythroid iron supply and recycling from macrophages.
context.zh-TW: DMT1 (SLC11A2) 是質子共運輸對接蛋白，以 H+ 交換、順其電化學梯度將 Fe2+（以及 Mn2+、Zn2+、Cd2+）由內體運送至細胞質。它是將 transferrin 來源鐵釋放至細胞質的關口，且對膳食鐵吸收、紅血球前驅細胞鐵供應與巨噬細胞鐵回收皆不可或缺。

context.en-US: DMT1 expands the labile iron pool by importing STEAP3-reduced Fe2+ into the cytosol, and it is this labile iron that powers the Fenton reaction. DMT1 is therefore the downstream effector of the transferrin cycle for cytosolic iron delivery; blocking DMT1 or upstream TFR1/STEAP3 starves the Fenton reaction and protects against erastin-induced ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: DMT1 藉由將 STEAP3 還原後的 Fe2+ 送入細胞質而擴大 labile iron pool，而正是這些 labile iron 驅動 Fenton reaction。因此 DMT1 是 transferrin cycle 在細胞質鐵供應上的下游效應因子；阻斷 DMT4 或上游的 TFR1/STEAP3 會使 Fenton reaction 缺乏鐵源，並防止 erastin 誘發的 ferroptosis。

context.en-US: DMT1 sits on the iron-supply side of the ferroptotic cascade: the iron it delivers fuels Fenton chemistry that peroxidates PUFA-phospholipids, and when GPX4/FSP1 antioxidant capacity is exceeded ferroptosis is executed. Enhanced DMT1-mediated iron import therefore sensitizes cells and tumors to iron-dependent cell death.
context.zh-TW: DMT1 位於 ferroptosis 級聯的鐵供應端：其送入的鐵驅動 Fenton 化學反應，使 PUFA-phospholipids 過氧化；當 GPX4/FSP1 的抗氧化容量被超越時，ferroptosis 便被執行。因此 DMT1 介導的鐵輸入增強會使細胞與腫瘤對鐵依賴性細胞死亡更加敏感。

context.en-US: STEAP3 is required for DMT1: after transferrin-Fe3+ is endocytosed via transferrin receptor 1, STEAP3 reduces Fe3+ to Fe2+ on the endosomal membrane, and only this Fe2+ is the substrate DMT1 can import. STEAP3 thus sets the oxidation state of the iron that reaches the cytosol.
context.zh-TW: STEAP3 是 DMT1 的必要前提：transferrin-Fe3+ 經 transferrin receptor 1 內吞後，STEAP3 在內體膜上將 Fe3+ 還原為 Fe2+，而只有這種 Fe2+ 才是 DMT1 能輸入的受質。因此 STEAP3 決定了進入細胞質的鐵的氧化態。

context.en-US: Base excision repair is the primary pathway for repairing 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine, the signature oxidative DNA adduct produced by reactive oxygen species. Its efficiency directly sets how much oxidative DNA damage is converted into mutations, making it a key defense against the genomic instability that accompanies aging.
context.zh-TW: Base excision repair 是修復 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 的主要路徑；此物質是 reactive oxygen species 產生的代表性氧化 DNA 加合物。其效率直接決定多少氧化性 DNA 損傷會被轉化為突變，因此是對抗老化伴隨之 genomic instability 的關鍵防線。

context.en-US: Accumulation of unrepaired DNA damage is a primary hallmark of aging and a direct contributor to cellular senescence. Because persistent damage signalling cannot be resolved, damaged cells enter stable arrest, which links the DNA repair machinery's declining efficiency in aging to the senescent state and the SASP.
context.zh-TW: 未修復 DNA 損傷的累積是老化的主要特徵之一，也是 cellular senescence 的直接促成因素。由於持續的損傷訊號無法被解決，受損細胞會進入穩定停滯，這把老化中 DNA repair 機制效率下降與 senescent state 及 SASP 連結起來。

context.en-US: DNA-PK, together with ATM and ATR, phosphorylates histone H2AX to form gamma-H2AX foci at DNA double-strand breaks. Gamma-H2AX is therefore the experimental readout of DNA-PK kinase activity and of double-strand break damage, which is why gamma-H2AX elevation after fenbendazole treatment in A375 cells is interpreted as evidence of induced DNA damage.
context.zh-TW: DNA-PK 與 ATM、ATR 一起磷酸化 histone H2AX，在 DNA 雙股斷裂處形成 gamma-H2AX 焦點。因此 gamma-H2AX 是 DNA-PK kinase 活性與雙股斷裂損傷的實驗判讀指標；這也是 A375 細胞在 fenbendazole 處理後 gamma-H2AX 升高會被解讀為 DNA 損傷被誘發的證據的原因。

context.en-US: DNA-PK (catalytic subunit PRKDC) is a serine/threonine kinase central to the non-homologous end-joining pathway of DNA repair, where it provides the end recognition and kinase activity needed to rejoin broken chromosome ends. It is thus an essential member, with ATM and ATR, of the DNA damage response network.
context.zh-TW: DNA-PK（催化次單元 PRKDC）是 DNA repair 中 non-homologous end-joining 路徑的核心絲胺酸/蘇胺酸 kinase，在其中提供重新接合斷裂染色體末端所需的末端辨識與 kinase 活性。因此它是 DNA damage response 網路中與 ATM、ATR 並列的必要成員。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole elevates gamma-H2AX in A375 cells. Because gamma-H2AX foci are deposited by ATM, ATR and DNA-PK at double-strand breaks, this rise is read as a marker of fenbendazole-induced DNA damage rather than as a direct effect on any H2AX-directed enzyme.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 會使 A375 細胞中的 gamma-H2AX 升高。由於 gamma-H2AX 焦點是由 ATM、ATR 與 DNA-PK 在雙股斷裂處沉積而成，此升高應解讀為 fenbendazole 誘發 DNA 損傷的標記，而非對任何 H2AX 標的酵素的直接作用。

context.en-US: DNASE2 (deoxyribonuclease II) is the acid endolysosomal nuclease that degrades DNA within late endosomes and lysosomes, working optimally in the acidic lumen. It is the major enzyme clearing DNA from apoptotic bodies and from the cytosol after autophagic or endocytic clearance of chromatin, which is what normally prevents cytosolic DNA fragment accumulation.
context.zh-TW: DNASE2 (deoxyribonuclease II) 是在 late endosome 與 lysosome 內降解 DNA 的酸性核酸內切酶，在酸性腔內活性最佳。它是清除 apoptotic body 中 DNA，以及在自噬或內吞清除染色質後清除細胞質 DNA 的主要酵素，正是它防止了細胞質 DNA 片段的累積。

context.en-US: In senescent cells, DNASE2 is transcriptionally downregulated together with the cytosolic exonuclease TREX1. Persistent DNA damage therefore no longer resolves, the resulting cytosolic DNA activates cGAS-STING, and a type-I interferon plus NF-kB response emerges that is a major engine of the SASP - making DNASE2 loss a senescence-intrinsic mechanism rather than an extrinsic trigger.
context.zh-TW: 在 senescent cells 中，DNASE2 與細胞質外切核酸酶 TREX1 一同被轉錄性下調。因此持續存在的 DNA 損傷不再被解決，產生的細胞質 DNA 活化 cGAS-STING，並引發 type-I interferon 與 NF-κB 反應，成為 SASP 的主要動力來源；這使 DNASE2 的喪失成為一種 senescent 內在機制而非外在觸發因素。

context.en-US: TREX1 is the cytosolic exonuclease that, together with the endolysosomal DNASE2, degrades cytoplasmic DNA. Both are transcriptionally downregulated in senescence, so their joint loss is what allows cytosolic chromatin to persist; in humans, impaired DNASE2/TREX1 DNA clearance links cellular senescence to autoimmune and autoinflammatory disease.
context.zh-TW: TREX1 是細胞質外切核酸酶，與內體溶體的 DNASE2 一同降解細胞質 DNA。兩者在 senescence 中皆被下調，因此兩者的共同喪失才使細胞質染色質得以持續存在；在人類，DNASE2/TREX1 的 DNA 清除受損會將 cellular senescence 與自體免疫及自體發炎性疾病連結起來。

context.en-US: Through its effect on cytosolic DNA clearance, DNASE2 loss promotes the SASP: undegraded DNA is sensed by cGAS to activate STING, IRF3 and NF-kB. DNASE2 deficiency in mice causes severe chronic polyarthritis and lethal anemia from uncontrolled STING activation, which is why restoring nuclease function is a candidate anti-SASP strategy.
context.zh-TW: DNASE1 經由影響細胞質 DNA 清除而促進 SASP：未被降解的 DNA 被 cGAS 感知並活化 STING、IRF3 與 NF-κB。小鼠 DNASE2 缺乏會因 STING 失控活化造成嚴重慢性多發性關節炎與致死性貧血，因此恢復核酸酶功能是候選的 anti-SASP 策略。

context.en-US: DNASE2 normally restrains the cGAS-STING pathway by degrading the DNA that cGAS would otherwise sense. When DNASE2 is lost, DNA persists as micronuclei and cytosolic chromatin, is detected by cGAS, and activates STING, IRF3 and NF-kB - so the normal action of DNASE2 is suppression of this innate immune pathway.
context.zh-TW: DNASE2 正常情況下藉由降解否則會被 cGAS 感知的 DNA，抑制 cGAS-STING pathway。當 DNASE2 喪失時，DNA 以 micronuclei 與細胞質染色質的形式持續存在，被 cGAS 偵測並活化 STING、IRF3 與 NF-κB；因此 DNASE2 的正常作用就是抑制這條先天免疫路徑。

context.en-US: DNM2 is a dynamin-like GTPase recruited to the DRP1-constricted mitochondrion to assemble and complete the final membrane scission event of mitochondrial fission. While DRP1 initiates constriction at the outer mitochondrial membrane, DNM2 contributes to maturation and severing of the division furrow, so it is an accessory rather than essential fission GTPase.
context.zh-TW: DNM2 是一個 dynamin-like GTPase，會被招募至被 DRP1 收縮的粒線體上，組裝並完成 mitochondrial fission 最後的膜切割步驟。DRP1 在 outer mitochondrial membrane 啟動收縮，而 DNM2 協助分裂溝的成熟與切斷，因此它是輔助而非必要的 fission GTPase。

context.en-US: DNM2 is functionally related to DRP1: it is recruited to mitochondria already constricted by DRP1 and complements DRP1 and its adaptors MFF, MID49, MID51 and FIS1. This layered arrangement, with evidence that DRP1 alone can constrict and sever mitochondria, makes DNM2 often dispensable for fission and illustrates the redundancy of mitochondrial division control.
context.zh-TW: DNM2 與 DRP1 在功能上相關：它被招募至已被 DRP1 收縮的粒線體，並補足 DRP1 及其接應蛋白 MFF、MID49、MID51、FIS1 的作用。這種分層配置，加上 DRP1 本身即可收縮並切斷粒線體的證據，使 DNM2 在多數情況下對 fission 而言並非必要，也說明粒線體分裂調控的冗餘性。

context.en-US: DNM2 acts at the outer mitochondrial membrane, the site where DRP1 initiates constriction and where the division furrow must ultimately be severed. Its localization to this surface is what allows a cytosolic dynamin-like GTPase to participate in completing organelle division.
context.zh-TW: DNM2 作用於 outer mitochondrial membrane，此處是 DRP1 啟動收縮、以及分裂溝最終必須被切斷的部位。DNM2 定位於此表面，正是讓一個位於細胞質的 dynamin-like GTPase 能參與完成胞器分裂的關鍵。

context.en-US: DOT1L (KMT4), the sole H3K79 methyltransferase, is required for SASP emergence: knockdown prevents the senescence-associated secretory phenotype while leaving the senescence growth arrest intact. H3K79 methylation is thought to keep chromatin at SASP loci open and permissive, so DOT1L is a senomorphic target rather than a senolytic one.
context.zh-TW: DOT1L (KMT4) 是唯一的 H3K79 methyltransferase，為 SASP 的出現所必需：其 knockdown 可阻止 senescence-associated secretory phenotype，卻不影響 senescence 的生長停滯。H3K79 甲基化被認為能使 SASP 位點的染色質維持開放且具轉錄允許性，因此 DOT1L 是 senomorphic 而非 senolytic 標的。

context.en-US: MLL-fusion oncoproteins in leukemia recruit DOT1L to aberrantly activate HOXA gene expression. This makes DOT1L a druggable dependency of MLL-rearranged leukemia, and it is why the DOT1L inhibitor EPZ-5676 (pinometostat) is in Phase 1 trials for MLL-rearranged and other leukemias.
context.zh-TW: 白血病中的 MLL 融合致癌蛋白會招募 DOT1L，以異常活化 HOXA 基因表現。這使 DOT1L 成為 MFL 重排型白血病的可成藥依賴項，也是 DOT1L 抑制劑 EPZ-5676 (pinometostat) 進入 MLL 重排型及其他白血病第一期臨床試驗的原因。

context.en-US: DOT1L sits alongside MLL1, KDM4 and BRD4 in the class of senescence-epigenetic modulators that are selectively required for the secretome but dispensable for the arrest. Within this H3 methylation axis, DOT1L and MLL1 are the fellow H3 methyltransferases whose combined inhibition restricts SASP transcription without reversing growth arrest.
