context.zh-TW: DOT1L 與 MLL1、KDM4、BRD4 同屬一類 senescence 表觀遺傳調節因子：對分泌組為必要，但對停滯則可有可無。在這條 H3 甲基化軸上，DOT1L 與 MLL1 是同為 H3 methyltransferase 的搭檔，兩者的抑制可限制 SASP 的轉錄，卻不會逆轉生長停滯。

context.en-US: In colorectal cancer cells, p53 inhibits erastin-induced ferroptosis by blocking DPP4 activity - distinct from p53's ferroptosis-promoting role in other cancers. With p53 present, DPP4 is restrained; upon p53 loss, nuclear accumulation of DPP4 is inhibited and plasma-membrane-associated DPP4 becomes free to drive lipid peroxidation.
context.zh-TW: 在 colorectal cancer 細胞中，p53 藉由阻斷 DPP4 活性而抑制 erastin 誘發的 ferroptosis，這與 p53 在其他癌症中促進 ferroptosis 的角色相反。當 p53 存在時 DPP4 受到抑制；p53 喪失後 DPP4 的核內累積受阻，plasma-membrane-associated 的 DPP4 便得以自由驅動脂質過氧化。

context.en-US: DPP4 (CD26) is a positive regulator of ferroptosis in colorectal cancer: its plasma-membrane-associated form drives lipid peroxidation that leads to ferroptosis. This is a striking tissue-specific reversal, because in most tumors p53 instead promotes ferroptosis via SLC7A11 repression or SAT1/ALOX15 rather than restraining DPP4.
context.zh-TW: DPP4 (CD26) 在 colorectal cancer 中是 ferroptosis 的正向調節因子：其 plasma-membrane-associated 形式驅動導向 ferroptosis 的脂質過氧化。這是一種顯著的組織專一性逆轉，因為在多數腫瘤中 p53 反而藉由抑制 SLC7A11 或透過 SAT1/ALOX15 促進 ferroptosis，而非限制 DPP4。

context.en-US: Plasma-membrane-associated DPP4 is the proximal cause of lipid peroxidation in colorectal cancer: p53 loss blocks DPP4 nuclear accumulation, redistributing the protease to the plasma membrane where its activity generates the peroxidation that executes ferroptosis. DPP4 is thus a druggable node, already validated in diabetes by gliptins, for tuning ferroptotic therapy responses.
context.zh-TW: 在 colorectal cancer 中，plasma-membrane-associated 的 DPP4 是脂質過氧化的近端成因：p53 喪失阻斷 DPP4 的核內累積，使此蛋白酶重新分配至質膜，並由其活性產生導致 ferroptosis 的過氧化作用。因此 DPP4 是一個可成藥的節點（已由 gliptins 在糖尿病中驗證），可用於調節鐵死亡治療的反應。

context.en-US: The DPPH assay measures the hydrogen-donating ability of antioxidants. DPPH is a stable free radical dissolved in ethanol at 0.1 mM; when an antioxidant donates hydrogen, DPPH radical is reduced to DPPH-H and absorbance at 518 nm falls. Lower absorbance therefore means higher antioxidant capacity, reported as percent remaining DPPH or as IC50/IC20.
context.zh-TW: DPPH assay 測量抗氧化物的供氫能力。DPPH 為穩定自由基，溶於 ethanol 至 0.1 mM；當抗氧化物提供氫時，DPPH 自由基被還原為 DPPH-H，518 nm 處的吸光度隨之下降。因此吸光度越低代表抗氧化能力越高，結果以剩餘 DPPH 百分比或 IC50/IC20 表示。

context.en-US: Resveratrol significantly reduced DPPH free radical content in a concentration-dependent manner over 0-50 uM (r2 = 0.96, p = 0.0032), with over half the total activity occurring in the first 30 minutes. At identical concentrations resveratrol and vitamin E showed equivalent DPPH scavenging activity, with rapid kinetics for both.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 在 0–50 µM 範圍內以濃度依賴方式顯著降低 DPPH 自由基含量（r² = 0.96，p = 0.0032），且超過一半的活性在前 30 分鐘內出現。在相同濃度下，resveratrol 與 vitamin E 展現相等的 DPPH 清除活性，兩者的動力學皆十分快速。

context.en-US: Vitamin E scavenges DPPH radicals as effectively as resveratrol at identical concentrations, with more than 50% of activity within the first 30 minutes. This head-to-head equivalence is what supports interpreting both compounds as comparably potent chain-breaking or hydrogen-donating antioxidants under assay conditions.
context.zh-TW: Vitamin E 在相同濃度下清除 DPPH 自由基的效果與 resveratrol 相當，超過 50% 的活性出現在前 30 分鐘內。這項一對一的等效性，支持將兩者皆解讀為在 assay 條件下效力相當的鏈斷裂型或供氫型抗氧化劑。

context.en-US: DSRM-3716 is a second-generation SARM1 inhibitor, a non-covalent small molecule that blocks SARM1 NADase activity at low nanomolar IC50 with greater potency and selectivity than the covalent inhibitor disulfiram. By inhibiting SARM1 it protects axons from Wallerian degeneration, targeting chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, traumatic brain injury and chronic peripheral neuropathy.
context.zh-TW: DSRM-3716 是第二代的 SARM1 抑制劑，為非共價小分子，以低奈莫耳 IC50 阻斷 SARM1 的 NADase 活性，效力與選擇性皆優於共價抑制劑 disulfiram。透過抑制 SARM1，它可保護軸突免於 Wallerian degeneration，適應症涵蓋化療引發的周邊神經病變、traumatic brain injury 與慢性周邊神經病變。

context.en-US: DSRM-3716 binds by occupying the NAD+-binding pocket of the SARM1 TIR dimer without covalent modification. This non-covalent, adduct-forming uncompetitive mode of binding is the same inhibitor logic applied to the CD38 inhibitor 78c, since both SARM1 and CD38 are NAD+ glycohydrolases.
context.zh-TW: DSRM-3716 藉由佔據 SARM1 TIR 二聚體的 NAD+-binding pocket 而結合，且不進行共價修飾。這種非共價、形成加合物型的非競爭性結合模式，與 CD38 抑制劑 78c 所採用的抑制邏輯相同，因為 SARM1 與 CD38 都是 NAD+ glycohydrolase。

context.en-US: By blocking SARM1 NADase activity, DSRM-3716 protects axons from Wallerian degeneration. Because SARM1 is the principal effector of axon degeneration downstream of injury, its pharmacological blockade interrupts the self-executing degeneration program rather than merely slowing its progression.
context.zh-TW: 藉由阻斷 SARM1 的 NADase 活性，DSRM-3716 可保護軸突免於 Wallerian degeneration。由於 SARM1 是受損後軸突退化的主要效應因子，其藥理阻斷是直接中斷這個自我執行的退化程式，而不只是減緩其進展。

context.en-US: DSRM-3716 exists to overcome the promiscuity of disulfiram, the repurposed covalent inhibitor of SARM1. Because disulfiram reacts nonspecifically with protein thiols, DSRM-3716 was developed as a non-covalent, high-selectivity alternative occupying the same TIR NAD+ pocket without off-target adduct formation.
context.zh-TW: DSRM-3716 的存在是為了克服 disulfiram 這項被重新定位使用的 SARM1 共價抑制劑的選擇性不足問題。由於 disulfiram 會與蛋白質 thiol 非專一性地反應，DSRM-3716 因此被開發為非共價、高選擇性的替代物，佔據相同的 TIR NAD+ pocket 而不產生離靶加合物。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial damage-associated molecular patterns convert mitochondrial dysfunction into innate immune activation, making them the mechanistic bridge between metabolic defects and the SASP. Blocking mtDNA release, for example by BAX inhibition, reduces SASP expression in bone and improves healthspan measures, validating DAMPs as SASP drivers.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體的 damage-associated molecular patterns 將粒線體功能失調轉換為先天免疫活化，因此是代謝缺陷與 SASP 之間的機制性橋樑。例如藉由抑制 BAX 阻斷 mtDNA 釋放，可降低骨骼中的 SASP 表現並改善健康壽命指標，證實 DAMPs 確為 SASP 的驅動因子。

context.en-US: When released from mitochondria into the cytosol or extracellular space via minority MOMP, mtDNA carries unmethylated CpG islands that are recognized by TLR9 in endosomes. Circulating mtDNA rises with age and tracks inflammatory cytokines, and extracellular TFAM bound to mtDNA engages RAGE on plasmacytoid dendritic cells to enable internalization and subsequent TLR9 recognition.
context.zh-TW: 當 mtDNA 經 minority MOMP 由粒線體釋放至細胞質或細胞外空間時，其帶有未甲基化的 CpG islands，可被 endosome 中的 TLR9 辨識。循環中的 mtDNA 隨老化上升並與發炎細胞激素相關；此外，與 mtDNA 結合的胞外 TFAM 會接合 plasmacytoid dendritic cell 上的 RAGE，使其得以內吞並隨後被 TLR9 辨識。

context.en-US: Cardiolipin accumulates in senescent cells and can itself induce senescence while activating the NLRP3 inflammasome. This makes cardiolipin a self-amplifying DAMP: mitochondrial damage releases it, and the resulting inflammasome activation converts the same damage into IL-1beta-driven inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Cardiolipin 在 senescent cells 中累積，本身即可誘發 senescence，同時活化 NLRP3 inflammasome。這使 cardiolipin 成為自我增幅的 DAMP：粒線體損傷釋放它，而隨後的 inflammasome 活化又把同一份損傷轉化為 IL-1β 驅動的發炎反應。

context.en-US: Extracellular TFAM is pro-inflammatory, and when bound to mtDNA it engages RAGE on plasmacytoid dendritic cells. RAGE-mediated internalization then allows the TFAM-mtDNA complex to reach the endosomal TLR9, coupling TFAM release from dying mitochondria to nucleic acid sensing.
context.zh-TW: 胞外的 TFAM 具有促發炎作用，且在與 mtDNA 結合時會接合 plasmacytoid dendritic cell 上的 RAGE。經 RAGE 介導的內吞後，TFAM-mtDNA 複合體得以抵達 endosomal 的 TLR9，將死亡粒線體釋放 TFAM 與核酸感知耦合起來。

context.en-US: Dasatinib combined with quercetin is the lead senolytic combination in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, clearing senescent cells via BCL-2/PI3K-AKT signalling. A phase I pilot showed improved physical function and acceptable safety, which is why the pair rather than dasatinib alone is the clinically advanced senolytic regimen.
context.zh-TW: Dasatinib 與 quercetin 的組合是 idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis 中領先的 senolytic 組合，透過 BCL-2/PI3K-AKT 訊號清除 senescent cells。第一期先導試驗顯示體能功能改善且安全性可接受，因此臨床推進中的 senolytic 方案是這個藥對，而非單獨使用 dasatinib。

context.en-US: Dasatinib is a component of senolytic therapy: in the dasatinib plus quercetin combination it clears senescent cells through inhibition of BCL-2/PI3K-AKT-dependent anti-apoptotic survival signalling. As a tool compound it is also used to probe biological mechanisms beyond senescence.
context.zh-TW: Dasatinib 是 senolytic 療法的組成成分：在 dasatinib 加 quercetin 的組合中，它藉由抑制 BCL-2/PI3K-AKT 依賴的抗凋亡存活訊號來清除 senescent cells。作為工具化合物，它也被用於探討 senescence 之外的生物機制。

context.en-US: The dasatinib plus quercetin combination has been tested in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, where a phase I pilot showed improved physical function and acceptable safety. Because idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is accompanied by senescent cell accumulation, the trial frames this senolytic pair as a disease-modifying strategy for the fibrotic lung.
context.zh-TW: Dasatinib 加 quercetin 的組合曾在 idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis 中進行測試，第一期先導試驗顯示體能功能改善且安全性可接受。由於 idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis 伴隨 senescent cell 累積，該試驗將此 senolytic 藥對定位為纖維化肺部的疾病修正策略。

context.en-US: DddA-derived cytosine base editors target mitochondrial DNA, catalysing C-to-T conversions without introducing double-strand breaks. A split DddA cytidine deaminase, each half fused to a TALE array targeting opposite strands, reassembles its active site on adjacent target sites and so confines editing to the chosen mitochondrial locus.
context.zh-TW: DddA-derived cytosine base editors 以 mitochondrial DNA 為標的，在不產生雙股斷裂的情況下催化 C 轉 T。被切開的 DddA cytidine deaminase 兩半各自融合針對相反股鏈的 TALE 陣列，在相鄰標的位點重新組裝出活性位點，因而將編輯限制在所選定的粒線體位點。

context.en-US: DdCBE uses TALE repeat arrays as programmable DNA-binding domains: each half of the split DddA is fused to a TALE array, and binding of both monomers to adjacent half-sites brings the deaminase halves together. Because TALE position determines the target, bystander deamination of nearby cytosines remains a design constraint.
context.zh-TW: DdCBE 使用 TALE 重複陣列作為可程式化 DNA 結合結構域：split DddA 的每一半都融合一個 TALE 陣列，而兩個單體同時結合相鄰的半位點便將 deaminase 的兩半帶到一起。由於 TALE 的位置決定標的，附近 cytosine 的旁側脫氨仍是一項設計限制。

context.en-US: DdCBE fusions are imported into the mitochondrial matrix through a mitochondrial targeting sequence and the TOM/TIM translocase machinery, which is the delivery bottleneck for the strategy since large protein fusions must cross both mitochondrial membranes. Import of the editor is what places the DddA activity next to the mtDNA genome.
context.zh-TW: DdCBE 融合蛋白藉由 mitochondrial targeting sequence 與 TOM/TIM 轉位機器被輸入 mitochondrial matrix；由於大型融合蛋白必須穿越兩層粒線體膜，這正是此策略的遞送瓶頸。將編輯器輸入粒線體，會把 DddA 活性帶到 mtDNA 基因組旁邊。

context.en-US: DdCBE corrects pathogenic point mutations in mitochondrial disease, with correction demonstrated in patient-derived cybrids and, via AAV delivery, in vivo in mouse models such as the m.5024C>T MELAS model. Because the mutant sequence is corrected in situ rather than eliminated, DdCBEs remain effective at homoplasmic or high-heteroplasmy levels where selective genome destruction cannot work.
context.zh-TW: DdCBE 可矯正粒線體疾病中的致病點突變，已在患者來源 cybrid 以及透過 AAV 遞送、於活體小鼠模型（如 m.5024C>T MELAS 模型）中證實其矯正效果。由於突變序列是在原位被矯正而非被清除，DdCBE 在同型合子或高異質性（heteroplasmy）程度下仍有效，而選擇性破壞基因組的方法在此無能為力。

context.en-US: Deiodinases gatekeep thyroid hormone action at the tissue level by controlling local triiodothyronine availability independently of systemic thyroid status. DIO2 converts thyroxine (T4) to active T3, DIO3 inactivates T4 and T3 to reverse T3, and DIO1 contributes to both activation and inactivation.
context.zh-TW: Deiodinase 在組織層級守護 thyroid hormone 的作用，獨立於全身甲狀腺狀態地調控局部 triiodothyronine 的可用量。DIO2 將 thyroxine (T4) 轉換為活性 T3，DIO3 將 T4 與 T3 去活化為 reverse T3，而 DIO1 則同時參與活化與去活化。

context.en-US: The three iodothyronine deiodinases DIO1-DIO3 are selenoenzymes, meaning they are translated as proteins containing selenocysteine rather than cysteine. Their dependence on the Sec insertion machinery makes endocrine selenoprotein function contingent on the SECISBP2-dependent recoding system.
context.zh-TW: 三種 iodothyronine deiodinase（DIO1–DIO3）皆為 selenoenzyme，亦即它們被轉譯為含有 selenocysteine 而非 cysteine 的蛋白質。其對 Sec 插入機制的依賴，使內分泌 selenoprotein 的功能取決於 SECISBP2 依賴的 recoding 系統。

context.en-US: Each deiodinase contains an active-site selenocysteine whose selenol is essential for the reductase chemistry; loss of Sec abolishes enzymatic activity. This catalytic selenol is what makes deiodinases redox-sensitive members of the selenoenzyme family.
context.zh-TW: 每一種 deiodinase 都含有活性位點的 selenocysteine，其 selenol 對還原酶化學反應不可或缺；Sec 的喪失會使酵素活性消失。正是這個催化性 selenol，使 deiodinase 成為 selenoenzyme 家族中對氧化還原敏感的成員。

context.en-US: SECISBP2 is required for deiodinase expression: deficiency impairs deiodinase activity and causes abnormal thyroid hormone metabolism despite normal circulating thyroid hormone levels. This illustrates that the selenocysteine insertion machinery gates endocrine selenoprotein function, since deiodinases cannot be made without Sec recoding.
context.zh-TW: SECISBP2 對 deiodinase 的表現是必要的：其缺乏會損害 deiodinase 活性，並在循環 thyroid hormone 濃度正常的情況下造成異常的 thyroid hormone 代謝。這說明 selenocysteine 插入機制會把關內分泌 selenoprotein 的功能，因為沒有 Sec recoding 就無法製造 deiodinase。

context.en-US: Denham Harman proposed the free radical theory of aging in 1955, postulating that reactive oxygen species produced during aerobic respiration cause cumulative oxidative damage that drives aging. This theory made ROS the central agents of aging for the field and redirected ageing research toward antioxidant biology.
context.zh-TW: Denham Harman 於 1955 年提出 free radical theory of aging，主張 aerobic respiration 過程中產生的 reactive oxygen species 會造成累積性氧化損傷並驅動老化。此理論使 ROS 成為老化研究領域的核心因子，並將老化研究重新導向抗氧化生物學。

subject: Denham Harman
object: Mitochondrial Free Radical Theory of Aging

context.en-US: In 1972 Denham Harman refined his free radical theory into the mitochondrial free radical theory of aging, specifically implicating mitochondria as the primary source and the primary target of reactive oxygen species. This localisation sharpened the earlier theory by assigning both origin and damage site to one organelle.
context.zh-TW: 1972 年，Denham Harman 將其 free radical theory 精煉為 mitochondrial free radical theory of aging，明確指出 mitochondria 是 reactive oxygen species 的主要來源與主要標的。此項定位為較早的理論增加了精確度，把起源與損傷部位同時指派給同一胞器。

subject: Mitochondrial Free Radical Theory of Aging

context.en-US: The mitochondrial free radical theory of aging is a 1972 refinement of Harman's 1955 free radical theory of aging. The parent theory claimed that cumulative ROS damage drives aging in general; the mitochondrial version adds the specific claim that mitochondria are both the primary source and the primary target of that damage.
context.zh-TW: Mitochondrial free radical theory of aging 是 Harman 1955 年 free radical theory of aging 的 1972 年精煉版。母理論主張累積的 ROS 損傷普遍驅動老化；粒線體版本則加入了更具體的主張：mitochondria 同時是該損傷的主要來源與主要標的。

subject: Mitochondrial Free Radical Theory of Aging

context.en-US: The mitochondrial free radical theory of aging implicates mitochondria as both the primary source and the primary target of reactive oxygen species. Because mitochondrial ROS production and damage feedback on respiration itself, the theory turns organelle bioenergetics into the mechanistic centre of the oxidative theory of aging.
context.zh-TW: Mitochondrial free radical theory of aging 將 mitochondria 同時指為 reactive oxygen species 的主要來源與主要標的。由於粒線體的 ROS 產生與損傷會回饋影響呼吸作用本身，此理論把胞器生物能學置於氧化性老化理論的機制核心。

context.en-US: Gut bacteria, primarily Clostridium cluster XIVa, produce deoxycholic acid by 7alpha-dehydroxylating cholic acid in the colon. Obesity alters microbial ecology to favour DCA-producing bacteria, so the composition of the gut microbiome, not only diet, sets the level of this secondary bile acid.
context.zh-TW: 腸道細菌（主要為 Clostridium cluster XIVa）在大腸中對 cholic acid 進行 7α-去羥化而產生 deoxycholic acid。Obesity 會改變微生物生態以有利於產生 DCA 的細菌，因此 gut microbiome 的組成（不只是飲食）決定了此 secondary bile acid 的量。

context.en-US: Deoxycholic acid induces senescence in hepatic stellate cells by causing DNA damage through reactive oxygen species generation, direct genotoxic effects on nuclear DNA and activation of the DNA damage response. The resulting persistent damage signalling produces p16 and p21 upregulation, SA-beta-gal activity and SASP secretion, the hallmark features of senescence.
context.zh-TW: Deoxycholic acid 藉由產生 reactive oxygen species、對核 DNA 施加直接基因毒性作用並活化 DNA damage response 而在 hepatic stellate cell 中誘發 senescence。隨後持續的損傷訊號造成 p16 與 p21 上調、SA-β-gal 活性及 SASP 分泌，即 senescent 的典型特徵。

context.en-US: Deoxycholic acid delivered to the liver by portal circulation acts specifically on hepatic stellate cells, making them the critical target that converts an intestinal metabolite into a hepatic phenotype. Blocking DCA production lowers HCC incidence in mouse models.
context.zh-TW: 經門脈循環送達肝臟的 deoxycholic acid 專門作用於 hepatic stellate cell，使其成為把腸道代謝物轉換為肝臟表型的關鍵標的。阻斷 DCA 的生成可在小鼠模型中降低 HCC 發生率。

context.en-US: Elevated deoxycholic acid in obesity and high-fat-diet contexts promotes hepatocellular carcinoma through an indirect route: dysbiosis raises DCA, DCA senesces hepatic stellate cells, and the resulting SASP-driven inflammation (IL-1beta, COX-2/PGE2) via cGAS-STING creates a pro-tumorigenic microenvironment. Serum DCA is elevated in obese individuals and correlates with HCC risk.
context.zh-TW: 在肥胖與高脂飲食情境中升高的 deoxycholic acid 透過一條間接途徑促進 hepatocellular carcinoma：dysbiosis 升高 DCA，DCA 使 hepatic stellate cell 進入 senescence，隨後經 cGAS-STING 產生的 SASP 驅動發炎（IL-1β、COX-2/PGE2）營造促腫瘤的微環境。肥胖者的 serum DCA 升高並與 HCC 風險相關。

context.en-US: Deoxycholic acid causes DNA damage in hepatic stellate cells through reactive oxygen species generation, direct genotoxic effects on nuclear DNA, and activation of the DNA damage response. Because the damage persists rather than being resolved, it triggers senescence instead of repair or apoptosis, which is why DCA-senesced cells go on to secrete SASP factors.
context.zh-TW: Deoxycholic acid 透過產生 reactive oxygen species、對核 DNA 施加直接基因毒性作用，以及活化 DNA damage response 而在 hepatic stellate cell 中造成 DNA damage。由於損傷持續存在而未被解決，它觸發的是 senescence 而非修復或 apoptosis；這也是經 DCA 進入 senescent 的細胞會持續分泌 SASP 因子的原因。

context.en-US: Obesity increases deoxycholic acid levels both directly, by raising bile acid secretion under high-fat diets, and indirectly, by altering gut microbial ecology in favour of DCA-producing bacteria. Because DCA is then reabsorbed in the ileum and returned to the liver by enterohepatic circulation, obesity sets both production and delivery of the senescence-inducing metabolite.
context.zh-TW: Obesity 會提高 deoxycholic acid 的濃度：直接原因是高脂飲食下 bile acid 分泌增加，間接原因是 gut microbial ecology 改變而有利於產生 DCA 的細菌。由於 DCA 之後在 ileum 被再吸收並經 enterohepatic circulation 回到肝臟，Obesity 同時決定了這個誘發 senescence 代謝物的生成與運送。

context.en-US: EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate) is a catechin-class polyphenol and the most abundant polyphenol in green tea, giving the beverage its characteristic antioxidant and potential health-promoting properties.
context.zh-TW: EGCG（Epigallocatechin gallate）屬於兒茶素（catechin）類多酚，是綠茶中含量最豐富的多酚，為綠茶具備抗氧化與潛在健康促進特性的主要來源。

context.en-US: Green tea is the primary dietary source of EGCG, the dominant polyphenol of the beverage. EGCG is abundant in green tea, while its concentration is much lower in fermented teas such as black tea.
context.zh-TW: 綠茶是 EGCG 的主要膳食來源，EGCG 為綠茶中含量最高的多酚；在黑茶等發酵茶中，其濃度則大幅降低。

context.en-US: COMT is the enzyme that metabolizes EGCG. EGCG acts as a COMT inhibitor in animal and cell studies, but human trials at supplemental doses (e.g. 750 mg) show no significant impairment of COMT activity; it is simply broken down more slowly in carriers of the slow COMT variant.
context.zh-TW: COMT 是代謝 EGCG 的酵素。EGCG 在動物與細胞研究中被視為 COMT 抑制劑，但在人類補充劑量（如 750 mg）的研究中並未顯著損害 COMT 活性；帶有 slow COMT 變異者只是 EGCG 的分解速度較慢。

context.en-US: Quercetin can be taken together with EGCG to increase the bioactive levels of EGCG inside cells, a combination discussed in the context of hormetic polyphenols targeting AMPK and sirtuin pathways.
context.zh-TW: Quercetin 可與 EGCG 併用，以提高 EGCG 在細胞內的活性濃度；此組合在以 AMPK 與 sirtuin 為靶點的荷爾蒙樣多酚脈絡中被討論。

context.en-US: EGFR (epidermal growth factor receptor, also ErbB-1 or HER1) is a transmembrane receptor tyrosine kinase whose activation engages the PI3K/Akt and MAPK pathways, promoting cell proliferation, survival and differentiation. As a downstream effector, Akt lies beneath EGFR in this cascade.
context.zh-TW: EGFR（上皮生長因子受體，又稱 ErbB-1 或 HER1）是跨膜受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化會啟動 PI3K/Akt 與 MAPK 路徑，促進細胞增殖、存活與分化；Akt 在此級聯中位於 EGFR 下游。

context.en-US: Activation of EGFR drives the MAPK (RAS-ERK) arm of signalling, which couples growth factor perception at the plasma membrane to nuclear transcription programmes. Oncogenic EGFR overexpression therefore sustains both proliferative and survival signalling.
context.zh-TW: EGFR 的活化驅動 MAPK（RAS-ERK）訊號臂，將細胞膜上的生長因子感知連結至核內轉錄程序；因此 EGFR 的致癌性過度表現會同時維持增殖與存活訊號。

context.en-US: EGFR is overexpressed in roughly half of triple-negative breast cancers, and also in non-small-cell lung cancer, glioblastoma and colorectal cancer. This overexpression makes EGFR a major pharmacological target in these tumours.
context.zh-TW: EGFR 在約半數三陰性乳癌中過度表現，在非小細胞肺癌、膠質母細胞瘤與大腸癌中亦然；因此 EGFR 是這些腫瘤的重要藥理標的。

context.en-US: Honeybee venom component melittin suppresses EGFR (and HER2) activation by interfering with phosphorylation of these receptors at the plasma membrane of breast carcinoma cells, and ivermectin combined with the EGFR inhibitor erlotinib achieves synergistic killing.
context.zh-TW: 蜂毒成分 melittin 藉由干擾乳癌細胞膜上 EGFR（與 HER2）的磷酸化來抑制其活化；而 ivermectin 與 EGFR 抑制劑 erlotinib 併用可產生協同殺傷作用。

context.en-US: EGFR is a validated drug target in oncology: the tyrosine kinase inhibitors erlotinib and gefitinib block its kinase activity, while the monoclonal antibody cetuximab blocks extracellular ligand binding. These are used clinically in EGFR-amplified or mutant tumours.
context.zh-TW: EGFR 是腫瘤學中已驗證的藥物標的：酪胺酸激酶抑制劑 erlotinib 與 gefitinib 阻斷其激酶活性，單株抗體 cetuximab 則阻斷細胞外配體結合；這些藥物已臨床用於 EGFR 擴增或突變的腫瘤。

context.en-US: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor (TCF) subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4/SAP-1. It controls proliferation, differentiation and the early transcriptional response to growth factor and stress signals.
context.zh-TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子中三元複合因子（TCF）次家族的奠基成員，與 ELK3 及 ELK4/SAP-1 並列；它調控增殖、分化，以及生長因子與壓力訊號的早期轉錄反應。

context.en-US: ERK-mediated phosphorylation at ELK1's C-terminal transcriptional activation domain converts ELK1 from a passive DNA-binding factor into a transcriptional activator, driving rapid induction of immediate-early genes such as FOS and EGR1. Sumoylation of ELK1 can conversely convert it into a repressor.
context.zh-TW: ERK 對 ELK1 C 端轉錄活化區的磷酸化，會使 ELK1 由被動的 DNA 結合因子轉為轉錄活化因子，快速誘導 FOS 與 EGR1 等立即早期基因；相反地，ELK1 的 SUMO 化可將其轉為抑制因子。

context.en-US: RAS is the upstream oncogene that drives the RAS/MAPK/ERK cascade, terminating in ELK1 activation. Deregulated ELK1 activity downstream of constitutive MAPK signalling contributes to oncogenic transcription programmes in cancer.
context.zh-TW: RAS 是上游致癌基因，驅動 RAS/MAPK/ERK 級聯反應並最終活化 ELK1。在組成性 MAPK 訊號之下失調的 ELK1 活性，會促成癌症中的致癌轉錄程序。

context.en-US: Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy, also called electron spin resonance (ESR), is a technique that detects species bearing unpaired electrons — paramagnetic species including free radicals, transition metal ions and reactive oxygen species. It measures resonant absorption of microwave radiation by unpaired electrons in an external magnetic field.
context.zh-TW: 電子順磁共振（EPR）光譜，又稱電子自旋共振（ESR），是一種偵測帶有未成對電子的物種（順磁性物種）的技術，包括自由基、過渡金屬離子與活性氧物種；其原理是測量未成對電子在外加磁場中對微波輻射的共振吸收。

context.en-US: EPR spectroscopy is the most direct method for measuring reactive oxygen species in biological systems, quantifying ROS and antioxidant capacity in samples and detecting free radical production in mitochondria. Spin trapping with reagents such as DMPO, POBN or DEPMPO stabilizes short-lived radicals such as superoxide and hydroxyl radical for detection.
context.zh-TW: EPR 光譜是生物系統中測量活性氧物種最直接的方法，可定量樣品中的 ROS 與抗氧化能力，並偵測粒線體中的自由基生成；使用 DMPO、POBN 或 DEPMPO 等自旋捕捉試劑可穩定超氧陰離子與羥基自由基等短壽命自由基以便偵測。

context.en-US: Because EPR quantifies radical production directly at the spin level, it is used to track oxidative stress in disease models and ageing research, and to resolve oxidation states of metal centres such as iron-sulfur clusters, copper centres and manganese.
context.zh-TW: 由於 EPR 能在自旋層級直接定量自由基生成，因此可用於追蹤疾病模型中的氧化壓力與老化研究，並解析鐵硫簇、銅中心與錳等金屬中心的氧化態。

context.en-US: ER stress arises when misfolded or unfolded proteins accumulate in the endoplasmic reticulum lumen, overwhelming the organelle's folding capacity. The three proximal sensors activated are PERK, IRE1 and ATF6.
context.zh-TW: 當錯誤摺疊或未摺疊蛋白質累積於內質網腔內、超過胞器的摺疊能力時，即引發 ER 壓力；被活化的三個近端感受器為 PERK、IRE1 與 ATF6。

context.en-US: In the PERK arm of the unfolded protein response, PERK phosphorylates eIF2α, which paradoxically upregulates ATF4 translation while suppressing global protein synthesis. PERK-ATF4 signalling induces the autophagy genes LC3B and Atg5.
context.zh-TW: 在未摺疊蛋白反應的 PERK 分支中，PERK 磷酸化 eIF2α，看似矛盾地提升 ATF4 的轉譯同時抑制整體蛋白質合成；PERK-ATF4 訊號並誘導自噬基因 LC3B 與 Atg5。

context.en-US: IRE1 senses ER stress and splices XBP1 mRNA to produce the active transcription factor XBP1s. The IRE1-XBP1 arm then activates the autophagy genes Beclin1 and BAG3 as part of the UPR-autophagy intersection.
context.zh-TW: IRE1 感知 ER 壓力並剪接 XBP1 mRNA，產生具活性的轉錄因子 XBP1s；IRE1-XBP1 分支隨後活化自噬基因 Beclin1 與 BAG3，構成 UPR 與自噬的交會點。

context.en-US: All three UPR arms (PERK, IRE1, ATF6) converge on autophagy induction, and autophagic clearance of aggregated proteins and damaged ER fragments resolves the stress — a bidirectional relationship in which ER stress is both a signal that induces autophagy and a state modulated by it.
context.zh-TW: UPR 的三條分支（PERK、IRE1、ATF6）皆收斂於自噬的誘導，而自噬對聚集蛋白與受損內質網片段的清除可解除壓力——形成雙向關係：ER 壓力既是誘導自噬的訊號，其狀態也受自噬調節。

context.en-US: Chronic ER stress and dysregulated autophagy underpin neurodegeneration (Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's), type 2 diabetes beta-cell failure, cancer and ischaemia-reperfusion injury. Chemical chaperones such as TUDCA and 4-PBA and UPR modulators such as ISRIB are in preclinical development to relieve it.
context.zh-TW: 慢性 ER 壓力與失調的自噬是神經退行性疾病（阿茲海默、帕金森、亨廷頓）、第二型糖尿病 β 細胞衰竭、癌症與缺血再灌流損傷的基礎；以 TUDCA、4-PBA 等化學伴護分子與 ISRIB 等 UPR 調節劑緩解 ER 壓力，目前處於臨床前開發階段。

context.en-US: The ER-Golgi intermediate compartment (ERGIC) is a tubulovesicular membrane system situated between the endoplasmic reticulum and the Golgi apparatus, serving as a sorting and trafficking hub for newly synthesized secretory and membrane proteins. Because it originates from the ER, it also sits at the interface of ER stress and autophagic clearance.
context.zh-TW: 內質網—高基氏體中間區室（ERGIC）是位於內質網與高基氏體之間的管囊狀膜系統，作為新生分泌蛋白與膜蛋白的分選與運輸樞紐；由於源自內質網，它也位於 ER 壓力與自噬清除的交界面上。

context.en-US: Upon binding cGAMP, ER-resident STING translocates in COPII-coated vesicles to the ERGIC, where it oligomerizes and recruits TANK binding kinase 1 (TBK1). TBK1 then phosphorylates STING and IRF3, driving IRF3 nuclear translocation and expression of type I interferons and interferon-stimulated genes.
context.zh-TW: 在結合 cGAMP 後，位於內質網的 STING 會藉由 COPII 披覆囊泡轉位至 ERGIC，並在該處寡聚化、招募 TANK 結合激酶 1（TBK1）；TBK1 隨後磷酸化 STING 與 IRF3，促使 IRF3 核轉位並表現第一型干擾素與干擾素刺激基因。

context.en-US: TBK1, recruited to ERGIC-resident oligomerized STING, phosphorylates IRF3, driving its nuclear translocation and the expression of type I interferons and interferon-stimulated genes. STING-enriched ERGIC membranes also supply a source for LC3 lipidation, linking cGAS-STING activation to autophagy induction.
context.zh-TW: 被招募至 ERGIC 上 STING 寡聚體的 TBK1 會磷酸化 IRF3，促使其核轉位並表現第一型干擾素與干擾素刺激基因；富含 STING 的 ERGIC 膜同時提供 LC3 脂化的膜來源，將 cGAS-STING 活化與自噬誘導連結起來。

context.en-US: Because the ERGIC originates from the ER, it sits at the interface of ER stress and ER-phagy: organelle stress, including vesicular trafficking defects, can promote STING overactivation at the ERGIC independently of cGAS, and impaired STING degradation at this compartment prolongs signalling. The ERGIC thus integrates DNA sensing and cellular stress inputs into cGAS-STING output.
context.zh-TW: 由於 ERGIC 源自內質網，它位於 ER 壓力與 ER 噬體作用（ER-phagy）的交界：胞器壓力（包括囊泡運輸缺陷）可繞過 cGAS 而在 ERGIC 處促進 STING 過度活化，且該區室 STING 降解受損會延長訊號。因此 ERGIC 將 DNA 感知與細胞壓力訊號整合為 cGAS-STING 的輸出。

context.en-US: ERK2 (MAPK1) is a serine/threonine kinase in the MAPK cascade that phosphorylates TFEB at Ser142, promoting its cytosolic retention via 14-3-3 protein binding. This provides a growth factor signalling input to the CLEAR network that opposes calcineurin-mediated dephosphorylation and nuclear translocation.
context.zh-TW: ERK2（MAPK1）是 MAPK 級聯中的絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶，會在 Ser142 位點磷酸化 TFEB，經由 14-3-3 蛋白結合促進其滯留於細胞質；這提供了生長因子訊號對 CLEAR 網絡的輸入，與鈣調磷酸酶介導的去磷酸化及核轉位作用相反。

context.en-US: In response to survival cytokines such as GM-CSF, ERK2 phosphorylates BAX at Thr167, creating a pThr-Pro motif recognized by the peptidyl-prolyl isomerase Pin1. Pin1 binding locks BAX in an inactive state, preventing its mitochondrial translocation and oligomerization — a pro-survival switch.
context.zh-TW: 在 GM-CSF 等存活細胞激素刺激下，ERK2 會在 Thr167 位點磷酸化 BAX，形成可被肽脯氨醯順反異構酶 Pin1 辨識的 pThr-Pro 基序；Pin1 結合後將 BAX 鎖定於失活態，阻止其粒線體轉位與寡聚化——這是一個促存活開關。

context.en-US: The ERK2-Pin1 survival switch can be overridden by stress kinases JNK and p38 MAPK, which target the same residue of BAX. ERK2 thus sits in a context-dependent balance with JNK and p38 MAPK that decides whether pro-apoptotic BAX oligomerization proceeds.
context.zh-TW: ERK2-Pin1 的促存活開關可被壓力激酶 JNK 與 p38 MAPK 推翻，後兩者會攻擊 BAX 的同一殘基。因此 ERK2 與 JNK、p38 MAPK 之間存在情境依賴的平衡，用以決定促凋亡的 BAX 寡聚化是否進行。

context.en-US: ERK2 (Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2) is a member of the MAPK family that transmits signals from cell surface receptors to the nucleus, influencing cell proliferation and survival. It is activated by MEK1/2 upstream of the canonical RAF-MEK-ERK cascade.
context.zh-TW: ERK2（Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2）是 MAPK 家族的成員，負責將訊號由細胞表面受體傳至細胞核，影響細胞增殖與存活；它在典型的 RAF-MEK-ERK 級聯上游由 MEK1/2 活化。

context.en-US: ERMIT (erythroid mitophagy) is the developmentally programmed elimination of mitochondria during terminal differentiation of erythroblasts into mature erythrocytes — a specialized, hypoxia-independent form of mitophagy, unlike stress-induced HIF-1alpha-driven mitophagy.
context.zh-TW: ERMIT（紅系粒線體自噬）是紅血球母細胞終末分化為成熟紅血球過程中，以發育程式調控的粒線體清除——屬於缺氧無關的特化粒線體自噬形式，不同於 HIF-1α 驅動的壓力誘發型粒線體自噬。

context.en-US: ERMIT is primarily driven by BNIP3L/NIX, a hypoxia-inducible mitophagy receptor of the Bcl-2 family that is transcriptionally upregulated during erythroid differentiation and localizes to the outer mitochondrial membrane, docking via its LIR motif to LC3/GABARAP proteins on the phagophore. NIX knockout mice develop anemia, showing the requirement is non-redundant.
context.zh-TW: ERMIT 主要由 Bcl-2 家族的缺氧誘導型粒線體自噬受體 BNIP3L/NIX 驅動：它在紅系分化過程中轉錄上调，並定位於粒線體外膜，透過其 LIR 基序與吞噬膜上的 LC3/GABARAP 蛋白對接。NIX 敲除小鼠會發生貧血，顯示此需求不可替代。

context.en-US: Erythroid mitophagy removes mitochondria completely, leaving mature mammalian erythrocytes dependent solely on glycolysis for ATP. Physiological consequences include maximized oxygen delivery, prevention of ROS damage in the circulation, and the deformability needed to pass through narrow capillaries.
context.zh-TW: 紅系粒線體自噬將粒線體完全清除，使成熟哺乳類紅血球的全套 ATP 完全仰賴糖解作用。其生理後果包括最大化氧氣輸送、避免循環中的 ROS 傷害，以及通過狹窄微血管所需的變形能力。

context.en-US: Mitochondria retained in enucleated erythrocytes would generate damaging reactive oxygen species in the circulation, so their developmental elimination by ERMIT protects red cells from oxidative injury. Defective ERMIT instead causes incomplete mitochondrial retention and premature hemolysis.
context.zh-TW: 若去核紅血球中殘留粒線體，便會在循環中產生具損傷性的活性氧物種；因此 ERMIT 的發育性清除可保護紅血球免受氧化傷害。ERMIT 缺失則會造成粒線體殘留與過早溶血。

context.en-US: ERRalpha (estrogen-related receptor alpha, encoded by ESRRA) is an orphan nuclear receptor closely related to estrogen receptor alpha and beta, but unlike them it is not activated by estrogen. It is constitutively active once expressed and is controlled by PGC-1alpha coactivation and interaction with corepressors such as NRIP1/RIP140.
context.zh-TW: ERRalpha（estrogen-related receptor alpha，由 ESRRA 編碼）是孤立的核受體，與雌激素受體 alpha 及 beta 高度相關，但與其不同的是它不會被雌激素活化。它一旦表現即具組成型活性，並受 PGC-1α 共活化與 NRIP1/RIP140 等共抑制因子調控。

context.en-US: ERRalpha transcriptionally activates mitochondrial biogenesis genes, coactivated by PGC-1alpha, and regulates NRF1, NRF2 (GABPA) and TFAM to drive mitochondrial DNA replication and transcription. Metabolic stress such as exercise, caloric restriction and cold exposure upregulates ERRalpha via PGC-1alpha.
context.zh-TW: ERRalpha 在 PGC-1α 共活化下轉錄活化粒線體生物發生相關基因，並調控 NRF1、NRF2（GABPA）與 TFAM，以驅動粒線體 DNA 的複製與轉錄。運動、熱量限制與寒冷暴露等代謝壓力可經由 PGC-1α 上調 ERRalpha。

context.en-US: ERRalpha upregulates nuclear-encoded oxidative phosphorylation genes, including electron transport chain subunits NDUFS1, COXIV and ATP5B, as part of its master regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and fatty acid oxidation (MCAD, LCAD, CPT1b, PDK4).
context.zh-TW: ERRalpha 上調核基因編碼的氧化磷酸化基因，包括電子傳遞鏈次單元 NDUFS1、COXIV 與 ATP5B；這是其作為氧化磷酸化與脂肪酸氧化（MCAD、LCAD、CPT1b、PDK4）主控因子的一部分。

context.en-US: ERRalpha drives bioenergetic reprogramming in basal-like and triple-negative breast cancer and other high-energy-demand tumours; it is overexpressed in basal-like breast cancer and ERRalpha inhibition reduces tumour growth and metastasis. ERRalpha also mediates insulin sensitivity and hepatic gluconeogenesis.
context.zh-TW: ERRalpha 驅動基底樣與三陰性乳癌以及其他高能量需求腫瘤的生物能量重編程；在基底樣乳癌中 ERRalpha 過度表現，而抑制 ERRalpha 可減少腫瘤生長與轉移。ERRalpha 亦介導胰島素敏感度與肝糖質新生。

context.en-US: The EXITS framework (Dunford et al., Nature Genetics 2017) identifies X-chromosome tumor suppressor genes that escape X-inactivation and are therefore biallelically expressed in females, protecting them from single-hit loss. Across >4,100 cancers of 21 tumour types, exactly six of 783 non-pseudoautosomal X genes — ATRX, CNKSR2, DDX3X, KDM5C, KDM6A, MAGEC3 — showed significantly more male-biased loss-of-function mutation.
context.zh-TW: EXITS 架構（Dunford 等，Nature Genetics 2017）辨識出逃脫 X 染色體失活、在女性中呈雙等位表現的 X 染色體腫瘤抑制基因，使其免於單次突變的衝擊。在 21 種腫瘤逾 4,100 例癌症中，783 個非偽自動區 X 基因中恰有六個呈現顯著偏向男性的功能喪失突變：ATRX、CNKSR2、DDX3X、KDM5C、KDM6A、MAGEC3。

context.en-US: The mechanistic basis of EXITS is escape from X-chromosome inactivation. Because most X-linked genes are functionally haploid in females after XCI, a single mutation hits both sexes equally; only the escape subset retains two active alleles in females, requiring biallelic mutation or loss of the other chrX for complete inactivation. This was validated in tumors: 23.3% of female tumors with EXITS mutations had lost the other X chromosome versus 6.2% of controls (P = 0.0005).
context.zh-TW: EXITS 的機制基礎是逃脫 X 染色體失活。由於多數 X 連鎖基因在女性 XCI 後為功能單倍體，單次突變對兩性影響相同；唯有逃脫失活的子集在女性中保有兩個活化等位基因，需雙等位突變或失去另一條 chrX 才能完全失活。此點已在腫瘤中獲得驗證：帶有 EXITS 突變的女性腫瘤有 23.3% 失去另一條 X 染色體，對照組僅 6.2%（P = 0.0005）。

context.en-US: Three of the six EXITS genes have functional Y-chromosome homologs: DDX3X/DDX3Y, KDM5C/its Y partner, and KDM6A/UTY. UTY, the Y-encoded paralog of KDM6A, lacks H3K27 demethylase activity but retains non-catalytic tumor-suppressor function, so it can partially compensate for KDM6A loss in males. Mosaic chrY loss with aging and smoking removes that backup, and X-X compensation in females proved stronger than X-Y compensation in males (P = 0.0022).
context.zh-TW: 六個 EXITS 基因中有三個具有功能性的 Y 染色體同源基因：DDX3X/DDX3Y、KDM5C/其 Y 伴隨基因，以及 KDM6A/UTY。UTY 為 KDM6A 的 Y 編碼旁系基因，缺乏 H3K27 去甲基化酶活性但保留非催化性的腫瘤抑制功能，因此可在男性中部分補償 KDM6A 的缺失。隨老化與吸菸出現的鑲嵌式 chrY 喪失會移除此備援，而女性的 X-X 補償證實強於男性的 X-Y 補償（P = 0.0022）。

context.en-US: The EXITS model explains a portion of the male cancer excess: SEER 2008-2012 data show males carry ~20% excess risk of any cancer (516.6 vs 411.2 per 100,000 person-years) with >=2:1 male predominance for kidney/renal pelvis, bladder, oral cavity and HCC. The authors explicitly note EXITS is not the sole explanation, co-existing with hormonal biology, tobacco/alcohol exposure and other X/Y-linked mechanisms.
context.zh-TW: EXITS 模型解釋了男性癌症過剩的一部分：SEER 2008–2012 資料顯示男性罹患任何癌症的風險約多出 20%（每 10 萬人年 516.6 對 411.2），且腎臟/腎盂、膀胱、口腔與肝細胞癌的男性比率達 >=2:1。作者明確指出 EXITS 並非唯一解釋，它與荷爾蒙生物學、菸酒暴露及其他 X/Y 連鎖機制並存。

context.en-US: As an H3K27 methyltransferase, EZH2 deposits H3K27me3 at senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) loci, including IL-6 and IL-8. Depleting or inhibiting EZH2 removes H3K27me3 and derepresses SASP genes — a strategy proposed for cancer immunotherapy — while EZH2 cooperates with DNA methylation to silence the genome.
context.zh-TW: 作為 H3K27 甲基轉移酶，EZH2 會在衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）基因座（含 IL-6 與 IL-8）沉積 H3K27me3。移除或抑制 EZH2 會去除 H3K27me3 並解除對 SASP 基因的壓抑——此為癌症免疫治療提出的策略；EZH2 也與 DNA 甲基化協同以沉默基因組。

context.en-US: KDM4 opposes EZH2 at senescence-activated SASP loci by erasing repressive methylation marks, so the balance between the H3K27 methyltransferase EZH2 and the demethylase KDM4 sets the output of the senescence secretory programme. BRD4 is likewise antagonistic to EZH2 at SASP enhancers.
context.zh-TW: KDM4 在衰老活化的 SASP 基因座上藉由清除抑制性甲基化標記與 EZH2 相拮抗，因此 H3K27 甲基轉移酶 EZH2 與去甲基化酶 KDM4 之間的平衡決定了衰老分泌程序的輸出。BRD4 在 SASP 增強子上同樣與 EZH2 相拮抗。

context.en-US: EZH2 modulates cGAS-STING-driven senescence phenotypes: the pathway's SASP output depends on the EZH2/H3K27me3 repressive landscape, and EZH2 also restrains NF-kappaB-regulated SASP genes and helps silence LINE-1 retrotransposons whose derepression drives SASP.
context.zh-TW: EZH2 調節 cGAS-STING 驅動的衰老表型：此路徑的 SASP 輸出取決於 EZH2/H3K27me3 的抑制性表觀圖景；EZH2 也可限制 NF-κB 調控的 SASP 基因，並協助沉默 LINE-1 散轉子——其去抑制會驅動 SASP。

context.en-US: EZH2 participates directly in the SIRT1-centred cancer epigenome: SIRT1 reduces histone acetylation at the promoters of genes including AR, BRCA1, ESR1, ESR2, EZH2 and EP300, and the resulting chromatin state affects cancer cell apoptosis. EZH2 is therefore both a substrate-context partner of deacetylases and a writer of the same repressive chromatin they establish.
context.zh-TW: EZH2 直接參與以 SIRT1 為核心的癌症表觀基因組：SIRT1 會在 AR、BRCA1、ESR1、ESR2、EZH2 與 EP300 等基因的啟動子上降低組蛋白乙醯化，而所形成的染色質狀態會影響癌細胞凋亡。因此 EZH2 既是去乙醯化酶作用背景下的合作夥伴，也是其所建立抑制性染色質的寫入者。

context.en-US: MMP-12 (macrophage elastase) is the most potent elastinolytic MMP and the only one that can effectively degrade insoluble elastin at physiological concentrations, making it the principal elastase in macrophage-mediated tissue remodelling. MMP-12-deficient mice are protected from cigarette smoke-induced emphysema, and MMP-12-mediated elastin degradation is a central mechanism of both intrinsic and extrinsic skin ageing.
context.zh-TW: MMP-12（巨噬細胞彈性蛋白酶）是最強的彈性蛋白溶解 MMP，也是唯一能在生理濃度下有效降解不溶性彈性蛋白的 MMP，因此是巨噬細胞介導組織重塑中的主要彈性蛋白酶。MMP-12 缺失小鼠可免於菸草煙誘發的肺氣腫，而 MMP-12 介導的彈性蛋白降解也是內在與外在皮膚老化的核心機制。

context.en-US: Proteolytic degradation of elastin releases bioactive elastin-derived peptides (elastokines), including the hexapeptide VGVAPG. They bind the elastin-binding protein (EBP) receptor and upregulate MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12, creating a feed-forward loop — elastin fragmentation, elastokine generation, EBP signalling, MMP upregulation, further elastin degradation.
context.zh-TW: 彈性蛋白的蛋白水解降解會釋出具生物活性的彈性蛋白衍生胜肽（elastokines），其中包括六胜肽 VGVAPG。它們結合彈性蛋白結合蛋白（EBP）受體並上調 MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12，形成正向前饋迴路：彈性蛋白碎裂、elastokine 生成、EBP 訊號、MMP 上調、更多彈性蛋白降解。

context.en-US: Elastin degradation in alveolar walls by MMP-12 and neutrophil elastase is the defining pathological feature of emphysema. Loss of elastic recoil and airway collapse during expiration produce airflow limitation and air trapping, with protease-antiprotease imbalance overwhelming alpha-1 antitrypsin capacity.
context.zh-TW: 肺泡壁中的彈性蛋白經 MMP-12 與嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶降解，是肺氣腫的定義性病理特徵。彈性回縮喪失與呼氣時氣道塌陷造成氣流受限與空氣滯留，蛋白酶與抗蛋白酶失衡超過 alpha-1 antitrypsin 的容量。

context.en-US: Elastin fragmentation by MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12 reduces arterial elastic recoil, contributing to systolic hypertension, left ventricular hypertrophy and cardiovascular risk. Fragmentation is one of the earliest structural changes in atherosclerotic vessel remodelling, and elastin also accumulates AGE crosslinks with age that stiffen its fibres.
context.zh-TW: MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12 對彈性蛋白的碎裂會降低動脈的彈性回縮，促成收縮期高血壓、左心室肥厚與心血管風險。彈性蛋白碎裂是動脈粥狀硬化血管重塑最早的結構變化之一；隨老化彈性蛋白也累積 AGE 交聯，使其纖維變硬。

context.en-US: Elastin is among the longest-lived proteins in the human body, with an arterial half-life of 70+ years, so it is exceptionally vulnerable to cumulative damage from glycation, oxidation and proteolysis with no efficient repair. AGE crosslinks stiffen elastin fibres, reduce elasticity and make elastin resistant to normal remodelling.
context.zh-TW: 彈性蛋白是人體最長壽的蛋白質之一，在動脈中的半衰期超過 70 年，因此對糖化、氧化與蛋白水解所造成的累積傷害特別脆弱，且缺乏有效修復。AGE 交聯會使彈性蛋白纖維變硬、降低彈性，並使其抵抗正常重塑。

context.en-US: Elastokines (elastin-derived peptides, EDPs) are bioactive fragments of 6 to ~50 kDa generated by proteolytic cleavage of insoluble elastin. MMP-12 is the most potent generator, releasing fragments including the major elastokine VGVAPG and larger kappa-elastin peptides; MMP-2, MMP-9, MMP-3, neutrophil elastase and cathepsins S and L contribute.
context.zh-TW: Elastokines（彈性蛋白衍生胜肽，EDPs）是不溶性彈性蛋白經蛋白水解切割產生的 6 至約 50 kDa 生物活性片段。MMP-12 是最強的生成者，可釋出包括主要 elastokine VGVAPG 與較大 κ-elastin 胜肽在內的片段；MMP-2、MMP-9、MMP-3、嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶與 cathepsin S、L 亦有貢獻。

context.en-US: Elastokine signalling through the elastin-binding protein (EBP) receptor activates ERK1/2 and p38 MAPK and NF-kappaB, upregulating transcription of MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12. This creates the positive feedback loop elastin degradation to elastokine generation to EBP signalling to MMP upregulation to further elastin degradation, which accelerates tissue deterioration in ageing, COPD, atherosclerosis and photoageing.
context.zh-TW: Elastokine 經由彈性蛋白結合蛋白（EBP）受體的訊號會活化 ERK1/2、p38 MAPK 與 NF-κB，並上調 MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12 的轉錄。這形成彈性蛋白降解→elastokine 生成→EBP 訊號→MMP 上調→更多彈性蛋白降解的正向迴路，在老化、COPD、動脈粥狀硬化與光老化中加速組織劣化。

context.en-US: Elastokines are chemotactic for monocytes and macrophages, promoting inflammatory cell recruitment to degraded elastic tissue and macrophage activation, which in turn raises MMP-12 output. In the lung they amplify alveolar elastin degradation and contribute to the protease-antiprotease imbalance driving airspace enlargement.
context.zh-TW: Elastokines 對單核球與巨噬細胞具有趨化作用，促進發炎細胞被招募至降解的彈性組織並活化巨噬細胞，後者再提高 MMP-12 的產量。在肺部，它們放大肺泡彈性蛋白降解，並促成造成氣腔擴大的蛋白酶—抗蛋白酶失衡。

context.en-US: Elastokines promote developmental angiogenesis, where controlled elastin remodelling is required for vascular maturation, and in cancer they drive tumour angiogenesis via EBP-mediated VEGF upregulation while also enabling migration and invasion through degraded elastic barriers.
context.zh-TW: Elastokines 促進發育性血管新生（此時需受控的彈性蛋白重塑以完成血管成熟）；在癌症中，它們藉由 EBP 介導的 VEGF 上調驅動腫瘤血管新生，並透過降解的彈性屏障促進遷移與侵犯。

context.en-US: Elastokines promote paracrine senescence in neighbouring dermal fibroblasts, and their serum and urinary levels — particularly VGVAPG-containing peptides — serve as biomarkers of elastin degradation in COPD, atherosclerosis, skin ageing and rheumatoid arthritis.
context.zh-TW: Elastokines 會在鄰近的真皮纖維母細胞中誘發旁分泌性衰老；其血清與尿液濃度（尤其是含 VGVAPG 的胜肽）可作為 COPD、動脈粥狀硬化、皮膚老化與類風濕性關節炎中彈性蛋白降解的生物標記。

context.en-US: The Electron Transport Chain is a series of protein complexes (Complex I NADH dehydrogenase, Complex II succinate dehydrogenase, Complex III cytochrome bc1, Complex IV cytochrome c oxidase) plus the mobile carriers Coenzyme Q10 and cytochrome c, embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane.
context.zh-TW: 電子傳遞鏈是一系列蛋白質複合體（複合體 I 的 NADH 去氫酶、複合體 II 的琥珀酸去氫酶、複合體 III 的細胞色素 bc1、複合體 IV 的細胞色素 c 氧化酶）加上可移動載體 Coenzyme Q10 與細胞色素 c，嵌於粒線體內膜中。

context.en-US: Electron leakage from Complex I and Complex III of the ETC generates superoxide, the primary source of reactive oxygen species. Quiescent cells can limit this by lowering overall metabolism and favouring glycolysis over oxidative phosphorylation.
context.zh-TW: 電子傳遞鏈中複合體 I 與複合體 III 的電子漏溢會產生超氧陰離子，這是活性氧物種的主要來源。靜止期細胞可藉由降低整體代謝並偏好糖解作用而非氧化磷酸化來減少此產生量。

context.en-US: The ETC couples electron transfer to proton pumping, establishing the proton motive force across the inner membrane that ATP synthase uses to produce ATP. This coupling of the ETC to ATP synthesis is the process of oxidative phosphorylation.
context.zh-TW: 電子傳遞鏈將電子轉移與質子幫浦作用耦合，在內膜兩側建立質子動力勢，供 ATP 合成酶製造 ATP。電子傳遞鏈與 ATP 合成的這種耦合即為氧化磷酸化。

context.en-US: ETC dysfunction — including mutations in individual complexes — is implicated in mitochondrial disease, neurodegeneration and age-related decline, since complexes I and III are the dominant mitochondrial ROS sources whose leakage drives oxidative damage over time.
context.zh-TW: 電子傳遞鏈功能失調——包含個別複合體的突變——與粒線體疾病、神經退化及與年齡相關的衰退有關，因為複合體 I 與 III 是粒線體 ROS 的主要來源，其漏溢會隨時間造成氧化傷害。

context.en-US: Emphysema is a subtype of COPD defined by permanent enlargement of the airspaces distal to the terminal bronchioles with destruction of their walls and no obvious fibrosis. Cigarette smoking is the dominant risk factor, with occupational dusts, air pollution and alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency also predisposing.
context.zh-TW: 肺氣腫是 COPD 的一個型態，其定義為終末細支氣管遠端氣腔永久性擴大且其壁被破壞，並無明顯纖維化。吸菸是主要危險因子，職業粉塵、空氣污染與 alpha-1 antitrypsin 缺乏亦為易感因素。

context.en-US: The central mechanism of emphysema is a protease-antiprotease imbalance: cigarette smoke recruits neutrophils and macrophages that release elastase and other proteases that overwhelm local antiproteases and degrade elastin in the alveolar interstitium. Concomitant oxidative stress inactivates antiproteases and amplifies the inflammatory cascade, so loss of elastic recoil and airway collapse produce airflow limitation and air trapping.
context.zh-TW: 肺氣腫的核心機制是蛋白酶—抗蛋白酶失衡：香菸煙招募嗜中性球與巨噬細胞，釋放彈性蛋白酶等蛋白酶，超過局部抗蛋白酶的抑制能力並降解肺泡間質中的彈性蛋白。同時存在的氧化壓力會使抗蛋白酶失活並放大發炎級聯反應，導致彈性回縮喪失與呼氣時氣道塌陷，產生氣流受限與空氣滯留。

context.en-US: Experimental evidence reviewed in sirtuin literature indicates that SIRT1 protects against emphysema through FOXO3-mediated mechanisms, and that sirtuin modulation influences lung injury models — supporting the senolytic/stress-response rationale for protecting alveolar structure.
context.zh-TW: sirtuin 文獻回顧的實驗證據顯示，SIRT1 可經由 FOXO3 介導的機制對肺氣腫提供保護，且 sirtuin 調節可影響肺損傷模型——支持以 senolytic／壓力反應為策略保護肺泡結構。

context.en-US: Endogenous retroviruses are retroviral sequences that infected the germline of ancestors and became permanently integrated into host genomes, propagating vertically as inherited elements. They resemble proviruses with gag, pol and env genes but are typically defective and cannot complete replication, comprising roughly 8% of the human genome as HERVs.
context.zh-TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒是感染祖先生殖系並永久整合進宿主基因體的反轉錄病毒序列，以垂直方式作為遺傳元件傳遞。它們類似帶有 gag、pol 與 env 基因的前病毒，但通常已缺陷化而無法完成複製，在人類基因體中以 HERV 形式約占 8%。

context.en-US: ERVs are normally kept silent by DNA methylation and repressive histone marks, with the corepressor KAP1 and heterochromatin factor HP1alpha (supported by SIRT6 and RB1) packaging ERV/LINE-1 loci into heterochromatin. In senescence, epigenetic erosion — global and focal DNA hypomethylation, loss of H3K9me3 via shifts in SUV39H1/KDM4 and H3K27me3 via EZH2/JMJD3, and heterochromatin decompaction (SADS) — relieves this silencing and permits ERV transcription.
context.zh-TW: ERV 平時受 DNA 甲基化與抑制性組蛋白標記沉默，由共抑制因子 KAP1 與異染色質因子 HP1alpha（並由 SIRT6 與 RB1 支援）將 ERV/LINE-1 基因座包裝成異染色質。在衰老時，表觀遺傳侵蝕——全域與局部的 DNA 低甲基化、經 SUV39H1/KDM4 變化造成的 H3K9me3 喪失、經 EZH2/JMJD3 造成的 H3K27me3 喪失，以及異染色質去壓縮（SADS）——會解除此沉默並允許 ERV 轉錄。

context.en-US: ERV RNA is reverse-transcribed into cDNA in the cytoplasm, where it is sensed by cGAS-STING (and RIG-I-like receptors), triggering type I interferon and NF-kappaB-driven SASP. In humans, the HERV subset releases retrovirus-like particles that infect neighbouring cells, spreading senescence — making ERV derepression a conserved, cross-species engine of senescence-associated inflammation and inflammaging.
context.zh-TW: ERV RNA 在細胞質中被反轉錄成 cDNA，隨即由 cGAS-STING（以及 RIG-I 類受體）感知，觸發第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 驅動的 SASP。在人類中，HERV 子群可釋放類反轉錄病毒顆粒感染鄰近細胞，傳播衰老——使 ERV 去抑制成為跨物種保守的衰老相關發炎與 inflammaging 引擎。

context.en-US: Blocking ERV (and LINE-1) reverse transcription with nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors reduces interferon inflammation in vivo and SASP in cells, supporting repurposing of NRTIs such as emtricitabine as senomorphics targeting the retrotransposon axis.
context.zh-TW: 以核苷類反轉錄酶抑制劑阻斷 ERV（與 LINE-1）的反轉錄，可在體內降低干擾素發炎並在細胞中降低 SASP，支持將 emtricitabine 等 NRTI 重新定位為針對散轉子軸的 senomorphic 藥物。

context.en-US: The human subset of endogenous retroviruses is termed HERV. Present across vertebrates, HERVs are normally epigenetically silenced by DNA methylation and repressive histone marks and constitute about 8% of the human genome.
context.zh-TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒在人類的子群稱為 HERV。ERV 存在於所有脊椎動物中，平時受 DNA 甲基化與抑制性組蛋白標記的表觀遺傳沉默，約占人類基因體的 8%。

context.en-US: ER stress is a cellular condition in which the folding capacity of the endoplasmic reticulum is overwhelmed. In Parkinson's disease pathogenesis, reactive oxygen species and neuromelanin's toxic precursor aminochrome can trigger it; aminochrome adducts with alpha-synuclein generate neurotoxic oligomers that also trigger mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress.
context.zh-TW: ER 壓力是內質網摺疊能力被超越的細胞狀態。在帕金森氏症的致病過程中，活性氧物種與神經黑質的毒性前驅物 aminochrome 可誘發 ER 壓力；aminochrome 與 α-突觸核蛋白形成的加合物會產生具神經毒性的寡聚體，並可觸發粒線體功能失調與氧化壓力。

context.en-US: ER stress is implicated in Parkinson's disease as a convergent downstream consequence of reactive oxygen species, alpha-synuclein and dopamine-quinone (aminochrome) chemistry, linking proteostasis failure to the characteristic neurodegeneration of the disease.
context.zh-TW: 在帕金森氏症中，ER 壓力被認為是活性氧物種、α-突觸核蛋白與多巴胺醌（aminochrome）化學反應的聚合性下游後果，將蛋白穩定性失調與該病特有的神經退化連結起來。

context.en-US: The endoplasmic reticulum is the principal intracellular store of calcium, releasing it to drive muscle contraction, secretion and apoptosis. Its membrane forms close mitochondria-ER contacts (MAMs) that coordinate calcium and lipid transfer and redox signalling.
context.zh-TW: 內質網是細胞內主要的鈣儲存場所，釋放鈣以驅動肌肉收縮、分泌與凋亡。其膜形成緊密的粒線體—內質網接觸（MAM），協調鈣與脂質轉移以及氧化還原訊號。

context.en-US: Accumulation of misfolded proteins in the ER lumen triggers ER stress and the unfolded protein response. If unresolved, the UPR activates inflammation (via IRE1a-TRAF2-NF-kappaB), oxidative stress and apoptosis (CHOP/TRB3, caspase-12); ER-phagy is coordinated with autophagy through factors such as FAM134B to remove stressed ER compartments.
context.zh-TW: 內質網腔內錯誤摺疊蛋白的累積會誘發 ER 壓力與未摺疊蛋白反應（UPR）。若無法緩解，UPR 會活化發炎（經 IRE1α-TRAF2-NF-κB）、氧化壓力與凋亡（CHOP/TRB3、caspase-12）；ER 噬體作用則透過 FAM134B 等因子與自噬協同，以清除受壓力的內質網區室。

context.en-US: ER stress and the unfolded protein response are key inducers of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype and of cellular senescence programmes generally, making ER proteostasis a lever for modulating the SASP.
context.zh-TW: ER 壓力與未摺疊蛋白反應是衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）以及一般細胞衰老程序的主要誘導因子，使內質網蛋白穩定性成為調節 SASP 的槓桿。

context.en-US: The ER membrane forms close physical contacts with mitochondria — mitochondria-ER contacts (MAMs) — that couple ER calcium release to mitochondrial metabolism, coordinating calcium and lipid transfer and redox signalling between the two organelles.
context.zh-TW: 內質網膜與粒線體形成緊密的物理接觸——粒線體—內質網接觸（MAM）——將內質網的鈣釋放與粒線體代謝耦合，協調兩個胞器間的鈣與脂質轉移及氧化還原訊號。

context.en-US: Endosymbiotic theory holds that an ancestral eukaryotic cell engulfed an aerobic alphaproteobacterium which became a permanent inherited endosymbiont, giving rise to the mitochondrion. Supporting evidence includes circular mitochondrial DNA, the double-membrane architecture, bacterial-style ribosomes and replication, and prokaryotic metabolic pathways such as the TCA cycle retained in the matrix.
context.zh-TW: 內共生學說認為，祖先真核細胞吞噬了好氧 α-變形菌，使其成為永久性、可遺傳的內共生體，進而產生了粒線體。支持證據包括環狀的粒線體 DNA、雙層膜構造、細菌式的核糖體與複製方式，以及基質中保留的 TCA 循環等原核代謝途徑。

context.en-US: The conserved fusion GTPases reflect mitochondrial endosymbiotic heritage: yeast Mgm1 and Drosophila Fzo are ancient ancestors of mammalian OPA1 and the mitofusins MFN1/MFN2, linking the fusion/fission machinery to the bacterial ancestry of the organelle.
context.zh-TW: 保守的融合 GTP 酶反映了粒線體的內共生起源：酵母的 Mgm1 與果蠅的 Fzo 是哺乳類 OPA1 與線粒體融合蛋白 MFN1/MFN2 的古老祖先，將融合／分裂機制與該胞器的細菌祖先連結起來。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial DNA as a circular genome, together with the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes, bacterial-style ribosomes and replication, is among the strongest molecular evidence for endosymbiotic origin of the mitochondrion.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體 DNA 呈環狀，加上粒線體的內外膜、細菌式的核糖體與複製方式，是粒線體內共生起源最強的分子證據之一。

context.en-US: Cerebrovascular endothelial cells express cGAS and STING and are active participants in inflammation, hemostasis and immune surveillance. In endothelial cells, cGAS-STING is activated by damaged mtDNA and other cytosolic DNA triggers, inducing type I interferon signalling and pyroptotic cell death.
context.zh-TW: 腦血管內皮細胞表現 cGAS 與 STING，是發炎、止血與免疫監視的積極參與者。在內皮細胞中，cGAS-STING 由受損的 mtDNA 及其他細胞質 DNA 觸發物活化，誘發第一型干擾素訊號與細胞焦亡。

context.en-US: Endothelial STING activation is deleterious to the blood-brain barrier: across models of irradiation, infection and intracerebral hemorrhage, it induces IFN-I signalling and pyroptosis, leading to barrier disruption and leukocyte infiltration, while activated ECs adopt a pro-inflammatory and pro-thrombotic phenotype. By contrast, microglial STING signalling appears protective, preserving hippocampal barrier integrity during aging.
context.zh-TW: 內皮 STING 的活化對血腦屏障有害：在照射、感染與腦內出血等模型中，它誘發 IFN-I 訊號與細胞焦亡，造成屏障破壞與白血球浸潤，活化的內皮細胞並轉為促發炎與促血栓表型。相對地，微膠細胞的 STING 訊號似乎是保護性的，能在老化期間維持海馬的屏障完整性。

context.en-US: Cerebrovascular endothelial cells are the principal cellular constituent of the blood-brain barrier, joined by tight junctions and working with astrocytes and pericytes to restrict paracellular permeability, forming the neurovascular unit.
context.zh-TW: 腦血管內皮細胞是血腦屏障的主要細胞構成，藉由緊密連結相連，並與星狀膠細胞及周細胞共同限制旁細胞通透性，構成神經血管單元。

context.en-US: Senescent endothelial cells secrete CXCL12 as the most highly upregulated SASP factor, and this chemokine drives endothelial dysfunction in an autocrine/paracrine manner. Senescent ECs show reduced NO production (-24%) and increased mitochondrial superoxide (3.5-fold), and are both source and target of circulating CXCL12.
context.zh-TW: 衰老內皮細胞分泌 CXCL12 作為上調最明顯的 SASP 因子，此趨化因子以自分泌／旁分泌方式驅動內皮功能失調。衰老內皮細胞的 NO 產量下降 24%，粒線體超氧陰離子增加 3.5 倍，並同時是循環 CXCL12 的來源與受體。

context.en-US: Senescent endothelial cells lose endothelial markers CDH5 and PECAM1 and gain mesenchymal markers TGFB1 and ACTA2 — the transdifferentiation of endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT), driven by the SASP and its key factor CXCL12.
context.zh-TW: 衰老內皮細胞失去內皮標記 CDH5 與 PECAM1，並獲得間質標記 TGFB1 與 ACTA2——即內皮—間質轉化（EndoMT），由 SASP 及其關鍵因子 CXCL12 驅動。

context.en-US: Fisetin, a senolytic, selectively eliminates senescent endothelial cells in vivo. Among all aortic cell types, endothelial cells showed the greatest reduction in SenMayo senescence signature with fisetin treatment, and senescent EC burden increases 10.7-fold with ageing in the aorta — making ECs the primary senolytic target in the vasculature.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin 作為 senolytic，可在體內選擇性清除衰老內皮細胞。在所有主動脈細胞類型中，內皮細胞經 fisetin 處理後的 SenMayo 衰老簽名降幅最大，且主動脈中衰老內皮細胞的負荷隨老化增加 10.7 倍——使內皮細胞成為血管系統中主要的 senolytic 標的。

context.en-US: Endothelial dysfunction is a systemic pathological state of the vascular endothelium with reduced nitric oxide bioavailability, impaired vasodilation, increased inflammatory adhesion molecule expression and a pro-thrombotic phenotype. It is an early hallmark of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease, and the initiating step in atherogenesis.
context.zh-TW: 內皮功能失調是血管內皮的全身性病理狀態，特徵為一氧化氮生物可用度下降、血管舒張功能受損、發炎性黏附分子表現增加與促血栓表型。它是動脈粥狀硬化與心血管疾病的早期標記，也是致粥樣硬化的起始步驟。

context.en-US: Oxidative stress is the major driver of endothelial dysfunction: peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, causing BH4 deficiency; in the absence of sufficient BH4 eNOS uncouples and its oxygenase domain reduces oxygen to superoxide instead of producing NO. The superoxide reacts with remaining NO (~6.7 x 10^9 M-1 s-1) to form peroxynitrite, which further oxidizes BH4 — a feed-forward loop converting eNOS from protective to pro-oxidant.
context.zh-TW: 氧化壓力是內皮功能失調的主要驅動因子：過氧亞硝酸鹽將四氫生物蝶呤（BH4）氧化為 BH2，造成 BH4 缺乏；缺乏足夠 BH4 時 eNOS 發生「解偶聯」，其加氧酶結構域將氧還原為超氧陰離子而非產生 NO。該超氧陰離子會與殘餘 NO（約 6.7 x 10^9 M-1 s-1）反應形成過氧亞硝酸鹽，進一步氧化 BH4——形成將 eNOS 由保護性酵素轉為促氧化劑的正向迴路。

context.en-US: NADPH oxidase, particularly the NOX1 and NOX4 isoforms in endothelial cells, generates superoxide in response to angiotensin II, TNF-alpha and mechanical shear stress. NOX-derived hydrogen peroxide can stabilize HIF-1alpha and induce hypoxic gene programmes, while XO-derived superoxide upregulates NOX expression — a non-additive network of endothelial ROS sources.
context.zh-TW: NADPH 氧化酶（尤其是內皮細胞中的 NOX1 與 NOX4 亞型）會在血管張力素 II、TNF-alpha 與機械性剪應力作用下產生超氧陰離子。NOX 衍生的過氧化氫可穩定 HIF-1α 並誘導缺氧基因程序，而 XO 衍生的超氧陰離子則會上調 NOX 表現——構成非加成性的內皮 ROS 來源網絡。

context.en-US: Asymmetric dimethylarginine (ADMA) accumulates in oxidative stress states because ROS inhibit DDAH, the enzyme that degrades ADMA, via oxidation and S-nitrosylation of its active-site Cys-249. Elevated ADMA competitively inhibits eNOS, promoting uncoupling; plasma ADMA is a robust independent predictor of cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality in atherosclerotic, diabetic and chronic kidney disease patients.
context.zh-TW: 非對稱二甲基精胺（ADMA）在氧化壓力狀態下會累積，因為 ROS 會抑制分解 ADMA 的酵素 DDAH（經由其活性位點 Cys-249 的氧化與 S-硝基化）。升高的 ADMA 競爭性抑制 eNOS 並促進其解偶聯；血漿 ADMA 是動脈粥狀硬化、糖尿病與慢性腎病患者心血管事件與全因死亡的穩健獨立預測因子。

context.en-US: The circulating SASP milieu was established as a causal driver of age-related endothelial dysfunction through senescence induction: plasma from old mice directly impaired endothelium-dependent dilation (-17%), induced EC senescence (6.1-fold SA-beta-Gal), reduced NO (-24%) and raised mitochondrial superoxide 3.5-fold. Fisetin reversed these effects by eliminating senescent ECs and reducing circulating CXCL12.
context.zh-TW: 研究證實循環中的 SASP 環境經由誘發衰老，是年齡相關內皮功能失調的因果驅動因子：老年小鼠血漿直接損害內皮依賴性舒張（-17%）、誘發內皮細胞衰老（SA-β-Gal 上升 6.1 倍）、降低 NO（-24%）並使粒線體超氧陰離子增加 3.5 倍。Fisetin 則藉由清除衰老內皮細胞並降低循環 CXCL12 逆轉上述效應。

context.en-US: eNOS (NOS3) is the constitutive isoform of nitric oxide synthase expressed in vascular endothelium, continuously producing low-level nitric oxide for basal vascular tone and opposing vasoconstriction. It dimerizes to catalyze the NADPH-dependent oxidation of L-arginine to citrulline and NO, requiring the cofactors tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), FAD and FMN.
context.zh-TW: eNOS（NOS3）是表現於血管內皮的一氧化氮合成酶組成型亞型，持續產生低量一氧化氮以維持基礎血管張力並對抗血管收縮。它以二聚體形式催化 NADPH 依賴的 L-精胺酸氧化生成瓜胺酸與 NO，需輔因子四氫生物蝶呤（BH4）、FAD 與 FMN。

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates eNOS to promote vasodilation and endothelial function, and resveratrol enhances this SIRT1-dependent effect — linking NAD+-dependent sirtuin activity to the NO bioavailability that endothelial homeostasis depends on.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化並活化 eNOS，以促進血管舒張與內皮功能，且 resveratrol 可增強此 SIRT1 依賴效應——將 NAD+ 依賴的 sirtuin 活性與內皮恆定所依賴的 NO 生物可用度連結起來。

context.en-US: eNOS (NOS3) is the constitutive isoform of the nitric oxide synthase enzyme family, distinct from inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS). Unlike iNOS, eNOS is not inhibited by aminoguanidine, a relatively iNOS-selective inhibitor — which is why aminoguanidine can block inflammatory vasodilation without abolishing normal blood-pressure regulation.
context.zh-TW: eNOS（NOS3）是一氧化氮合成酶家族的組成型亞型，與誘發型一氧化氮合成酶（iNOS）不同。與 iNOS 不同的是，eNOS 不受相對具 iNOS 選擇性的抑制劑 aminoguanidine 抑制——因此 aminoguanidine 可阻斷發炎性血管舒張而不致於廢除正常的血壓調節。

context.en-US: CXCL12 directly drives EndoMT: CXCL12 add-back induced mesenchymal markers, and CXCL12 inhibition with LIT-927 rescued endothelial markers CDH5 and PECAM1 in aged plasma models. Aged plasma exposure reduced CDH5 (-72%) and PECAM1 (-54%) while increasing TGFB1 (21-fold) and ACTA2 (7.7-fold).
context.zh-TW: CXCL12 直接驅動 EndoMT：CXCL12 補回可誘導間質標記，而以 LIT-927 抑制 CXCL12 則可在老化血漿模型中救回內皮標記 CDH5 與 PECAM1。老化血漿暴露使 CDH5 下降 72%、PECAM1 下降 54%，同時使 TGFB1 上升 21 倍、ACTA2 上升 7.7 倍。

context.en-US: EndoMT is a mechanism of age-related endothelial dysfunction: senescent endothelial cells lose CDH5 and PECAM1 and gain TGFB1 and ACTA2. Fisetin plasma prevented EndoMT by restoring endothelial markers (3.1-fold CDH5, 2-fold PECAM1) and suppressing mesenchymal markers (-88% TGFB1, -89% ACTA2).
context.zh-TW: EndoMT 是年齡相關內皮功能失調的一項機制：衰老內皮細胞失去 CDH5 與 PECAM1，並獲得 TGFB1 與 ACTA2。Fisetin 血漿可預防 EndoMT，方式是恢復內皮標記（CDH5 上升 3.1 倍、PECAM1 上升 2 倍）並抑制間質標記（TGFB1 下降 88%、ACTA2 下降 89%）。

context.en-US: EndoMT is the transdifferentiation of endothelial cells, which lose their characteristic endothelial markers and acquire mesenchymal, contractile and matrix-producing properties. It is a key mechanism in cardiovascular pathology, vascular ageing and fibrosis.
context.zh-TW: EndoMT 是內皮細胞的轉分化：其失去特有的內皮標記並獲得間質性、收縮性與基質生成特性。它是心血管病理、血管老化與纖維化中的關鍵機制。

context.en-US: Because stored fat is the difference between metabolizable energy intake and energy expenditure, chronic positive energy balance produces weight gain and drives the obesity epidemic, whereas negative balance produces weight loss. If Western food intake has been stable or declining, reduced physical activity (PAL ~1.66) must have tipped the budget positive.
context.zh-TW: 由於儲存的脂肪即代謝可利用能量攝取與能量消耗之間的差值，慢性正能量平衡會造成體重增加並驅動肥胖流行；負平衡則造成體重減輕。若西方飲食攝取量穩定或下降，則身體活動量降低（PAL 約 1.66）必然使能量預算轉正。

context.en-US: Energy balance is the equilibrium between metabolizable energy intake and energy expenditure, which is partitioned into resting metabolic rate, the thermic effect of food and activity energy expenditure. It is regulated by interrelated adjustments of appetite, non-exercise activity thermogenesis and resting metabolism.
context.zh-TW: 能量平衡是代謝可利用的能量攝取與能量消耗之間的均衡，後者可分為休息代謝率、食物熱效應與活動能量消耗。它由食慾、非運動性活動產熱與休息代謝之間的相互調整來調節。

context.en-US: Exercise interventions outperform their modest direct energy cost because amplifier mechanisms — NEAT, EPOC and lean-mass-driven resting metabolic rate changes — and adaptive reductions in expenditure oppose long-term weight-loss maintenance. Appetite adjustment would otherwise fully offset the exercise cost.
context.zh-TW: 運動介入的效果優於其微小的直接能量成本，因為放大機制——NEAT、EPOC 與瘦體量驅動的休息代謝率變化——以及適應性的消耗下降會對抗長期的減重維持；否則單純的食慾調整就足以完全抵銷運動的能量成本。

context.en-US: Doubly-labelled water (DLW), the criterion field method, tracks total daily CO2 production from isotopically labelled water (2H and 18O) over 1-3 weeks, giving a measure of free-living daily energy expenditure. Indirect calorimetry instead measures O2 consumption and CO2 production to compute expenditure during RMR measurement or exercise.
context.zh-TW: 雙標水（DLW）為公認的現場標準方法，以同位素標記水（2H 與 18O）在 1 至 3 週內追蹤每日總 CO2 產生量，得到自由生活狀態下的每日能量消耗。間接測熱法則測量 O2 消耗與 CO2 產生，以計算休息代謝率測定或運動期間的能量消耗。

context.en-US: Resting metabolic rate is the largest component of daily energy expenditure, about 60% of the daily budget in sedentary Western adults. The remaining components are the thermic effect of food and physical activity energy expenditure; fat-free mass sets the resting expenditure floor.
context.zh-TW: 休息代謝率是每日能量消耗最大的組成，約佔久坐西方成年人每日預算的 60%。其餘組成為食物熱效應與身體活動能量消耗；去脂體量決定了休息消耗的下限。

context.en-US: Vigorous exercise (jogging or rowing ~2.9 MJ/h for a 70 kg subject, about 10x BMR) as three 30-min sessions per week adds only ~4.35 MJ, about 5.3% of a weekly budget of ~81.9 MJ. Matching primitive-society expenditure would require ~90 min vigorous activity daily and wild-animal levels ~2.5 h daily, so real exercise effects must be amplified via NEAT, appetite and resting metabolism.
context.zh-TW: 對 70 kg 對象而言，激烈運動（慢跑或划船約 2.9 MJ/h，約為 BMR 的 10 倍）以每週三次、每次 30 分鐘進行，僅增加約 4.35 MJ，約佔每週 81.9 MJ 預算的 5.3%。若要達到原始社會的消耗量，需每日約 90 分鐘激烈活動，達到野生動物水準則需每日約 2.5 小時，因此真實的運動效果必須透過 NEAT、食慾與休息代謝來放大。

context.en-US: Physical activity level (PAL) is the DEE:RMR ratio from doubly-labelled water data: ~1.66 in contemporary Western adults (n=574), meaning about 60% of energy is spent at rest, versus ~2.6x RMR in free-living wild mammals (range 1.4-7.5), which spend only ~32% of their daily budget at rest.
context.zh-TW: 體力活動量（PAL）為雙標水資料所得的 DEE:RMR 比值：當代西方成年人約 1.66（n=574），代表約 60% 的能量花在休息；自由生活的野生哺乳類則平均約 2.6 倍 RMR（範圍 1.4–7.5），僅約 32% 的每日預算用於休息。

context.en-US: FKBP38 (also called FKBP8) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that induces mitophagy independently of the canonical PINK1/Parkin pathway. It acts as a mitophagy receptor that directly tethers mitochondria to autophagosomes without requiring ubiquitination, providing an alternative route for mitochondrial clearance when the PINK1/Parkin pathway is compromised. FKBP38 triggers mitophagy by aggregating LC3 (specifically LC3A) at mitochondria through its LIR motif.
context.zh-TW: FKBP38（又稱 FKBP8）是粒線體外膜蛋白，可不依賴典型的 PINK1/Parkin 途徑誘導 mitophagy。它作為 mitophagy 受體，直接將粒線體與自噬體相連接，無需泛素化，因此當 PINK1/Parkin 途徑受損時提供另一種清除粒線體的方式。FKBP38 透過其 LIR motif 聚集 LC3（尤其是 LC3A）於粒線體上以啟動 mitophagy。

context.en-US: FKBP38 triggers mitophagy through aggregation of the autophagosomal protein LC3, specifically the LC3A isoform, via its LIR motif. This direct recruitment of autophagosomal membranes to the mitochondrial surface is what allows FKBP38 to bypass Parkin recruitment and ubiquitin tagging of outer mitochondrial membrane proteins.
context.zh-TW: FKBP38 透過其 LIR motif 使自噬相關蛋白 LC3（尤其是 LC3A 異構體）聚集，進而啟動 mitophagy。正是這種對自噬體膜的直接招募，讓 FKBP38 能繞過 Parkin 的招募以及外膜蛋白的泛素標記。

context.en-US: Unlike most outer mitochondrial membrane proteins that are ubiquitinated and degraded by the proteasome during autophagy, FKBP8 (FKBP38) escapes this process through an unknown structural escape mechanism. This allows it to remain available as a mitophagy receptor, maintaining mitochondrial quality control without depleting essential OMM proteins.
context.zh-TW: 與多數在自噬過程中會被泛素化並由 proteasome 降解的粒線體外膜蛋白不同，FKBP8（FKBP38）透過一種結構性的逃逸機制避開此過程。這使它能持續作為 mitophagy 受體，在不耗竭必需外膜蛋白的情況下維持粒線體品質管制。

context.en-US: FKBP8 provides an alternative pathway for mitochondrial clearance when the canonical PINK1/Parkin pathway is impaired, which is directly relevant to Parkinson's disease, where Parkin function is compromised. By maintaining mitochondrial quality control in the absence of Parkin, FKBP8-mediated mitophagy may slow neurodegeneration driven by damaged mitochondria.
context.zh-TW: 當典型的 PINK1/Parkin 途徑受損時，FKBP8 提供另一條清除受損粒線體的途徑，這與 Parkin 功能缺損的 Parkinson's disease 直接相關。在沒有 Parkin 的情況下，FKBP8 介導的 mitophagy 可維持粒線體品質管制，因而可能減緩受損粒線體所驅動的神經退化。

context.en-US: FLICA (fluorescent labeled inhibitors of caspases) probes such as FAM-YVAD-FMK are cell-permeant, fluorescently tagged caspase inhibitors that covalently bind the active site of cleaved caspases. Because they report enzymatic activity rather than mere protein presence, caspase-1 FLICA is the standard live-cell readout of inflammasome-driven Caspase-1 activation, typically paired with Gasdermin D-N staining and IL-1β or LDH release.
context.zh-TW: FLICA（fluorescent labeled inhibitors of caspases）探針，例如 FAM-YVAD-FMK，是可穿透細胞膜的螢光標記 caspase 抑制劑，能共價結合已被切割之 caspase 的活性位。由於它反映的是酵素活性而非單純的蛋白表現量，caspase-1 FLICA 是偵測發炎小體驅動之 Caspase-1 活化之標準活細胞讀值方法，通常搭配 Gasdermin D-N 染色以及 IL-1β 或 LDH 釋放量測定。

context.en-US: Caspase-1 FLICA is the standard live-cell readout used to detect the execution of pyroptosis. Because inflammasome activation and Caspase-1 cleavage occur upstream of Gasdermin D pore formation, FLICA signal is the earliest enzymatic marker that a cell has committed to pyroptotic death, and it is read alongside Gasdermin D-N staining and cytokine release.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-1 FLICA 是用來偵測 pyroptosis 執行的標準活細胞讀值方法。由於發炎小體活化與 Caspase-1 切割發生在 Gasdermin D 成孔之前，FLICA 訊號是細胞已啟動 pyroptotic 死亡最早期的酵素標記，通常與 Gasdermin D-N 染色及細胞激素釋放一起判讀。

context.en-US: FNDC5 is a 209-amino acid type I transmembrane protein whose fibronectin type III domain is proteolytically cleaved at a site in the linker region (around aa 140/141) and secreted as the myokine irisin. Böström et al. (2012) demonstrated this conversion during exercise, establishing that FNDC5 is the transmembrane precursor of irisin; the responsible sheddase is still not definitively identified, with cathepsin B proposed.
context.zh-TW: FNDC5 是一個 209 個胺基酸的 type I 跨膜蛋白，其 fibronectin type III 結構域會在 linker 區域（約 aa 140/141）被蛋白酶切割並以 myokine irisin 的形式分泌。Böström 等人（2012）在運動過程中證實了這個轉換，確立 FNDC5 是 irisin 的跨膜前驅物；負責切割的 sheddase 仍未定案，目前提出 cathepsin B 為候選。

context.en-US: FNDC5 transcription is transcriptionally driven by PGC-1α, with co-activation through ERRalpha and PPARγ. Exercise, cold exposure, AMPK activation and p38 MAPK signalling all raise FNDC5 expression through this axis, so the PGC-1α–FNDC5–irisin cascade links mechanical and metabolic stress to secretion of the myokine irisin.
context.zh-TW: FNDC5 的轉錄由 PGC-1α 驅動，並透過 ERRalpha 與 PPARγ 的共活化增強。運動、寒冷暴露、AMPK 活化與 p38 MAPK 訊號都經由此軸提升 FNDC5 表現，因此 PGC-1α–FNDC5–irisin 級聯將機械與代謝壓力連結至 myokine irisin 的分泌。

context.en-US: The functional output of FNDC5 cleavage is irisin, which induces UCP1 in adipocytes and thereby drives browning of white adipose tissue and thermogenesis. FNDC5 knockout mice show attenuated exercise-induced browning of inguinal white adipose tissue, confirming that the FNDC5–irisin axis is required for this adaptive thermogenic response.
context.zh-TW: FNDC5 切割後的功能產物是 irisin，它在脂肪細胞中誘導 UCP1，進而驅動白色脂肪組織褐變與產熱。FNDC5 基因敲除小鼠的腹股溝白色脂肪組織運動誘導性褐變減弱，證實 FNDC5–irisin 軸是此適應性產熱反應所必需的。

context.en-US: Because FNDC5 is expressed in brain, particularly the hippocampus, FNDC5-derived irisin drives local BDNF expression there and provides neuroprotection. In Alzheimer's models FNDC5-derived irisin enhances both BDNF levels and Aβ clearance, and eHsp90α co-secretion is required for irisin's optimal binding to its integrin αVβ5 receptor.
context.zh-TW: 由於 FNDC5 也在腦部（尤其是海馬迴）表現，源自 FNDC5 的 irisin 會在該處驅動局部 BDNF 表現並提供神經保護。在 Alzheimer's 模型中，FNDC5 衍生的 irisin 可提升 BDNF 濃度並促進 Aβ 清除；eHsp90α 的共同分泌則是 irisin 與其 integrin αVβ5 受體最佳結合所必需的。

context.en-US: FOXO3a is a major activator of the autophagic program. Under starvation or intermittent fasting it translocates to the nucleus and upregulates autophagy-related genes including LC3, LC3B, p62, BNIP3, GABARAPL1, Atg12 and Atg16, thereby coupling nutrient deprivation to increased autophagic flux.
context.zh-TW: FOXO3a 是自噬程式的主要活化因子。在飢餓或間歇性斷食時，FOXO3a 轉位進入細胞核並上調自噬相關基因，包括 LC3、LC3B、p62、BNIP3、GABARAPL1、Atg12 與 Atg16，因而將營養缺乏與自噬通量增加連結起來。

context.en-US: FOXO3a activity is inhibited by the Akt pathway, which phosphorylates FOXO3a and promotes its sequestration in the cytoplasm. Akt-dependent phosphorylation thus keeps the FOXO transcription factor inactive and blocks its autophagic and stress-resistance transcriptional output; mTORC2 depletion relieves this brake by reducing Akt signalling.
context.zh-TW: FOXO3a 的活性受 Akt 途徑抑制：Akt 磷酸化 FOXO3a 並促使其在細胞質中隔離。Akt 相依的磷酸化因此使 FOXO 轉錄因子維持不活性，阻斷其自噬與抗逆境轉錄輸出；mTORC2 耗損時 Akt 訊號下降，便解除此煞車。

context.en-US: Under oxidative stress or DNA damage, SIRT1 binds physically to FOXO3a and deacetylates key lysine residues. This SIRT1-mediated deacetylation dualistically modulates FOXO3a output: it suppresses induction of pro-apoptotic genes such as Bim, thereby inhibiting apoptosis, while amplifying induction of cell cycle arrest and stress-resistance genes such as p27Kip1, GADD45 and MnSOD, allowing cells to survive oxidative stress.
context.zh-TW: 在氧化壓力或 DNA 損傷下，SIRT1 會與 FOXO3a 物理結合並去乙醯化其關鍵離胺酸殘基。這種 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化以雙重方式調節 FOXO3a 的輸出：抑制其誘導 Bim 等促凋亡基因，因而抑制 apoptosis；同時放大其誘導 p27Kip1、GADD45 與 MnSOD 等細胞週期停滯及抗逆境基因的能力，使細胞得以在氧化壓力下存活。

context.en-US: FOXO3a is a forkhead transcription factor strongly associated with human longevity and healthy aging. Its activation helps maintain cellular homeostasis and protect against proteotoxicity by inducing cell cycle arrest, autophagy and antioxidant defence genes, which is why FOXO variants are among the most replicated longevity-associated loci.
context.zh-TW: FOXO3a 是與人類長壽及健康老化高度相關的 forkhead 轉錄因子。其活化藉由誘導細胞週期停滯、自噬與抗氧化防禦基因，協助維持 cellular homeostasis 並防止 proteotoxicity，因此 FOXO 變異是最常被重複驗證的長壽相關基因位點之一。

context.en-US: FOXO4 is directly targeted by sirtuin-mediated deacetylation in response to oxidative stress. Hydrogen peroxide treatment induces FOXO4 acetylation, which inhibits its transactivation potential; SIRT1 physically interacts with FOXO4 and deacetylates it, reversing that inhibition and restoring FOXO4 transactivation so that antioxidant defence genes are induced.
context.zh-TW: 在氧化壓力反應下，FOXO4 是 sirtuin 介導去乙醯化的直接標的。過氧化氫處理會誘導 FOXO4 乙醯化，抑制其轉錄活化潛能；SIRT1 與 FOXO4 物理互動並將其去乙醯化，逆轉此抑制作用並恢復 FOXO4 的轉錄活化，使抗氧化防禦基因得以被誘導。

context.en-US: When SIRT1-mediated deacetylation restores FOXO4 transcriptional activity, FOXO4 induces expression of the growth arrest and DNA-damage-inducible protein GADD45 (α-isoform). This links the SIRT1–FOXO4 axis to enhanced DNA repair and antioxidant defence, and in transformed cancer cells the same axis suppresses the pro-apoptotic proteases caspase-3 and caspase-7, promoting cancer cell survival.
context.zh-TW: 當 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化恢復 FOXO4 的轉錄活性時，FOXO4 會誘導生長停滯與 DNA 損傷誘導蛋白 GADD45（α 型）的表現。這將 SIRT1–FOXO4 軸與 DNA 修復及抗氧化防禦的增強連結起來；在轉化後的癌細胞中，同一軸還會抑制促凋亡蛋白酶 caspase-3 與 caspase-7，促進癌細胞存活。

context.en-US: FOXO4 is a forkhead transcription factor regulating stress resistance, autophagy and cellular senescence, acting alongside FoxO1 and FOXO3a to induce autophagy-related genes under metabolic stress. Its interaction with p53 is the target of the senolytic peptide FOXO4-DRI, which is why FOXO4 is considered a senolytic target rather than a general FOXO-family transcription factor only.
context.zh-TW: FOXO4 是調節抗逆境、抗自噬與細胞 senescence 的 forkhead 轉錄因子，在代謝壓力下與 FoxO1、FOXO3a 一同誘導自噬相關基因。其與 p53 的交互作用正是 senolytic 胜肽 FOXO4-DRI 的作用標的，因此 FOXO4 被視為 senolytic 的治療標的，而不只是 FOXO 家族的一般轉錄因子。

context.en-US: FPRL1 (FPR2) is a class A G-protein-coupled receptor on the plasma membrane that serves as a functional receptor for Humanin. FPRL1 signals through pertussis toxin-sensitive Gi/o proteins to induce Ca²⁺ mobilisation, ERK1/2 activation, PI3K/Akt signalling and p38 MAPK activation, thereby mediating the neuroprotective and cytoprotective effects of Humanin.
context.zh-TW: FPRL1（FPR2）是細胞膜上的 class A G 蛋白偶聯受體，是 Humanin 的功能性受體。FPRL1 透過對白喉毒素敏感的 Gi/o 蛋白傳遞訊號，誘發 Ca²⁺ 動員、ERK1/2 活化、PI3K/Akt 訊號與 p38 MAPK 活化，進而介導 Humanin 的神經保護與細胞保護作用。

context.en-US: FPRL1 mediates both amyloid-beta toxicity and Humanin protection at the same receptor. Both the 42-amino acid Aβ42 peptide and Humanin can activate FPRL1 in neuroblasts, but while Aβ42 is cytotoxic, Humanin is cytoprotective; Humanin's benefit may arise from competitively binding FPRL1 and blocking Aβ42-induced cytotoxicity, which suggests a therapeutic mechanism in Alzheimer's disease.
context.zh-TW: FPRL1 在同一受體上同時介導類澱粉β毒性與 Humanin 的保護作用。42 胺基酸的 Aβ42 胜肽與 Humanin 都能在神經母細胞中活化 FPRL1，但 Aβ42 具有細胞毒性而 Humanin 則具細胞保護性；Humanin 的效益可能來自與 FPRL1 的競爭性結合，阻斷 Aβ42 誘發的細胞毒性，這在 Alzheimer's disease 中提示了一種治療機制。

context.en-US: Originally identified as a pattern recognition receptor of the innate immune system, FPRL1 is activated by anti-inflammatory ligands such as lipoxin A4, annexin A1 and serum amyloid A. Activation by lipoxin A4 promotes inflammation resolution, and FPRL1 also modulates vascular inflammatory responses, giving it a dual pro-inflammatory and pro-resolving role in innate immunity.
context.zh-TW: FPRL1 最初被鑑定為先天免疫系統的模式辨識受體，但也可被 lipoxin A4、annexin A1 與 serum amyloid A 等抗發炎配體活化。由 lipoxin A4 活化可促進發炎消退，且 FPRL1 亦調節血管發炎反應，因此在先天免疫中兼具促發炎與促消退的雙重角色。

context.en-US: Fast-scan cyclic voltammetry (FSCV) is an electrochemical technique that measures rapid, real-time changes in neurotransmitter concentration in living brain tissue. Using a carbon-fiber microelectrode and a fast triangular voltage ramp (typically 400 V/s, −0.4 to +1.3 V), FSCV oxidizes dopamine at a characteristic potential to produce a Faradaic current proportional to its concentration, resolving sub-second dopamine release in awake, behaving rodents.
context.zh-TW: 快掃描循環伏安法（FSCV）是一項電化學技術，可在活體腦組織中量測神經傳遞物質濃度的快速即時變化。FSCV 使用碳纖維微電極與快速的三角電壓掃描（典型為 400 V/s，−0.4 至 +1.3 V），在特征電位氧化 dopamine，產生與其濃度成正比的法拉第電流，可解析清醒行為大鼠中次秒級的 dopamine 釋放。

context.en-US: Because FSCV resolves phasic dopamine release on a sub-second timescale, it is the method of choice for studying reward processing, addiction, motivation and the acute effects of psychostimulants on dopamine reuptake and release. Combined with genetic variation in COMT activity, FSCV recordings have shown that increased COMT activity increases striatal dopamine release capacity.
context.zh-TW: 由於 FSCV 能以次秒時間尺度解析 phasic dopamine 釋放，它是研究獎賞處理、成癮、動機以及精神刺激劑對 dopamine 再攝取與釋放急性效應的首選方法。結合 COMT 活性的遺傳變異，FSCV 記錄顯示 COMT 活性升高會增加紋狀體的 dopamine 釋放能力。

context.en-US: Ubiquinone/CoQ10, the substrate of FSP1, is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Suppressing mevalonate output therefore starves FSP1 of its ubiquinone substrate and collapses the FSP1 axis, predicting ferroptosis sensitivity. HMG-CoA reductase inhibition by statins lowers CoQ10 availability, and squalene synthase activation by FIN56 diverts intermediates toward sterol synthesis and depletes the ubiquinone pool.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 的受質 ubiquinone/CoQ10 是 mevalonate pathway 的非固醇產物。因此抑制 mevalonate 輸出會使 FSP1 缺乏其 ubiquinone 受質而使 FSP1 軸崩潰，進而預測 ferroptosis 敏感性。statins 藉由抑制 HMG-CoA 還原酶降低 CoQ10 可用性，而 squalene synthase 活化劑 FIN56 會將中間產物導向固醇合成，耗盡 ubiquinone 池。

context.en-US: PPARα transcriptionally drives FSP1 expression, so PPARα activators such as fenofibrate and bezafibrate raise FSP1 levels and ferroptosis resistance. Conversely the MDM2/MDMX complex suppresses FSP1 by inhibiting PPARα activity, lowering FSP1 and sensitizing cells to ferroptosis, and FSP1 protein levels correlate with ferroptosis resistance across hundreds of cancer cell lines.
context.zh-TW: PPARα 在轉錄層面驅動 FSP1 表現，因此 fenofibrate、bezafibrate 等 PPARα 活化劑會提高 FSP1 濃度與 ferroptosis 抵抗性。相反地，MDM2/MDMX 複合體藉由抑制 PPARα 活性來抑制 FSP1，降低 FSP1 並使細胞對 ferroptosis 敏感；而 FSP1 蛋白濃度在數百種癌細胞株中與 ferroptosis 抵抗性相關。

context.en-US: FTSJ1 is an X-linked tRNA 2′-O-methyltransferase that catalyses methylation of the ribose at position 34 of tRNA[Ser]Sec, producing the Um34 modification. Um34 distinguishes the two tRNA[Ser]Sec isodecoders, and only the methylated form supports efficient insertion of selenocysteine at recoded UGA stop codons; loss of FTSJ1 causes ribosomal stalling and decreased UGA recoding.
context.zh-TW: FTSJ1 是一個 X 聯鎖的 tRNA 2′-O-甲基轉移酶，催化 tRNA[Ser]Sec 第 34 位核糖的甲基化，產生 Um34 修飾。Um34 用來區分兩種 tRNA[Ser]Sec isodecoder，且只有甲基化形式能有效支持在重新編碼的 UGA 終止密碼子處插入 selenocysteine；FTSJ1 缺失會造成核糖體停滯與 UGA 重新編碼效率下降。

context.en-US: FTSJ1 is required for efficient selenocysteine incorporation into selenoproteins because it writes the Um34 modification that distinguishes the Sec-competent tRNA[Ser]Sec isodecoder. FTSJ1-deficient cells show reduced UGA recoding, selective impairment of antioxidant selenoprotein translation, hypersensitivity to oxidative stress and reduced melanoma metastatic colonization, marking FTSJ1 as a potential metastasis-selective therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: FTSJ1 對 selenocysteine 有效嵌入 selenoprotein 是必需的，因為它負責寫入能區分具 Sec 能力之 tRNA[Ser]Sec isodecoder 的 Um34 修飾。FTSJ1 缺失細胞的 UGA 重新編碼減少，抗氧化 selenoprotein 的轉譯受到選擇性損害，對氧化壓力高度敏感且黑色素瘤轉移定殖能力下降，使 FTSJ1 成為具轉移選擇性的治療標的。

context.en-US: FUNDC1 is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that acts as a receptor for ubiquitin-independent mitophagy, especially under hypoxic stress. Under normoxia Src kinase phosphorylates FUNDC1 and keeps it inactive; during hypoxia CK2 is inhibited and PGAM5 dephosphorylates FUNDC1 at Ser13, enabling it to recruit LC3 via its LIR motif and initiate mitophagy.
context.zh-TW: FUNDC1 是粒線體外膜蛋白，作為泛素非依賴性 mitophagy 的受體，在缺氧壓力下尤其重要。在常氧下 Src kinase 磷酸化 FUNDC1 使其維持不活性；缺氧時 CK2 受到抑制，PGAM5 將 FUNDC1 在 Ser13 去磷酸化，使其能透過 LIR motif 招募 LC3 並啟動 mitophagy。

context.en-US: Activating FUNDC1-mediated autophagy clears damaged mitochondria, significantly reducing neuronal apoptosis and infarct volume after ischemia/hypoxia-reperfusion injury.
